Mohsin_Khan (MK): But those who reject Our Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) and treat them with arrogance, they are the dwellers of the (Hell) Fire, they will abide therein forever.
Arberry: And those that cry lies to Our signs, and wax proud against them -- those shall be the inhabitants of the Fire, therein dwelling forever.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: وَيَزِيدُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱهۡتَدَوۡاْ هُدٗىۗ وَٱلۡبَٰقِيَٰتُ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتُ خَيۡرٌ عِندَ رَبِّكَ ثَوَابٗا وَخَيۡرٞ مَّرَدًّا
Verse: ويزيد الله الذين اهتدوا هدى والبٰقيٰت الصٰلحٰت خير عند ربك ثوابا وخير مردا
Sahih_International: And Allah increases those who were guided, in guidance, and the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord for reward and better for recourse.
Pickthall: Allah increaseth in right guidance those who walk aright, and the good deeds which endure are better in thy Lord's sight for reward, and better for resort.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "And Allah doth advance in guidance those who seek guidance: and the things that endure, Good Deeds, are best in the sight of thy Lord, as rewards, and best in respect of (their) eventual return."
Shakir: And Allah increases in guidance those who go aright; and ever-abiding good works are with your Lord best in recompense and best in yielding fruit.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): God further enlightens those who seek guidance. To those who do charitable deeds which produce continuing benefits, your Lord will give a better reward and a better place in Paradise.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And Allah increases in guidance those who walk aright [true believers in the Oneness of Allah who fear Allah much (abstain from all kinds of sins and evil deeds which He has forbidden), and love Allah much (perform all kinds of good deeds which He has ordained)]. And the righteous good deeds that last, are better with your Lord, for reward and better for resort.
Arberry: And God shall increase those who were guided in guidance; and the abiding things, the deeds of righteousness, are better with thy Lord in reward, and better in return
Label: joy

Verse_diac: ٱدۡخُلُواْ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ أَنتُمۡ وَأَزۡوَٰجُكُمۡ تُحۡبَرُونَ
Verse: ادخلوا الجنة انتم وازوٰجكم تحبرون
Sahih_International: Enter Paradise, you and your kinds, delighted."
Pickthall: Enter the Garden, ye and your wives, to be made glad.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Enter ye the Garden, ye and your wives, in (beauty and) rejoicing.
Shakir: Enter the garden, you and your wives; you shall be made happy.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): will be told, "Enter Paradise with your spouses in delight.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Enter Paradise, you and your wives, in happiness.
Arberry: 'Enter Paradise, you and your wives, walking with joy!'
Label: joy

Verse_diac: فَغُلِبُواْ هُنَالِكَ وَٱنقَلَبُواْ صَٰغِرِينَ
Verse: فغلبوا هنالك وانقلبوا صٰغرين
Sahih_International: And Pharaoh and his people were overcome right there and became debased.
Pickthall: Thus were they there defeated and brought low.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): So the (great ones) were vanquished there and then, and were made to look small.
Shakir: Thus they were vanquished there, and they went back abased.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): The magicians who were defeated on the spot and were proved to be worthless,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): So they were defeated there and then, and were returned disgraced.
Arberry: So they were vanquished there, and they turned about, humbled.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: لَّقَدۡ أَضَلَّنِي عَنِ ٱلذِّكۡرِ بَعۡدَ إِذۡ جَآءَنِيۗ وَكَانَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ لِلۡإِنسَٰنِ خَذُولٗا
Verse: لقد اضلني عن الذكر بعد اذ جاءني وكان الشيطٰن للانسٰن خذولا
Sahih_International: He led me away from the remembrance after it had come to me. And ever is Satan, to man, a deserter."
Pickthall: He verily led me astray from the Reminder after it had reached me. Satan was ever man's deserter in the hour of need.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "He did lead me astray from the Message (of Allah) after it had come to me! Ah! the Evil One is but a traitor to man!"
Shakir: Certainly he led me astray from the reminder after it had come to me; and the Shaitan fails to aid man.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): He led me away from the true guidance after it had come to us. Satan is a traitor to people."
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "He indeed led me astray from the Reminder (this Quran) after it had come to me. And Shaitan (Satan) is ever a deserter to man in the hour of need."
Arberry: He indeed led me astray from the Remembrance, after it had come to me; Satan is ever a forsaker of men.'
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: وَقَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنُ يَٰهَٰمَٰنُ ٱبۡنِ لِي صَرۡحٗا لَّعَلِّيٓ أَبۡلُغُ ٱلۡأَسۡبَٰبَ
Verse: وقال فرعون يٰهٰمٰن ابن لي صرحا لعلي ابلغ الاسبٰب
Sahih_International: And Pharaoh said, "O Haman, construct for me a tower that I might reach the ways -
Pickthall: And Pharaoh said: O Haman! Build for me a tower that haply I may reach the roads,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Pharaoh said: "O Haman! Build me a lofty palace, that I may attain the ways and means-
Shakir: And Firon said: O Haman! build for me a tower that I may attain the means of access,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Pharaoh said, "Haman, build a tower of baked bricks for me so that I shall have access.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And Fir'aun (Pharaoh) said: "O Haman! Build me a tower that I may arrive at the ways,
Arberry: Pharaoh said, 'Haman, build for me a tower, that haply so I may reach the cords,
Label: anger

Verse_diac: وَإِذَا ٱلصُّحُفُ نُشِرَتۡ
Verse: واذا الصحف نشرت
Sahih_International: And when the pages are made public
Pickthall: And when the pages are laid open,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): When the scrolls are laid open;
Shakir: And when the books are spread,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): the records of deeds are made public,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And when the written pages of deeds (good and bad) of every person shall be laid open;
Arberry: when the scrolls shall be unrolled,
Label: fear

Verse_diac: يَوۡمَ نَطۡوِي ٱلسَّمَآءَ كَطَيِّ ٱلسِّجِلِّ لِلۡكُتُبِۚ كَمَا بَدَأۡنَآ أَوَّلَ خَلۡقٖ نُّعِيدُهُۥۚ وَعۡدًا عَلَيۡنَآۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا فَٰعِلِينَ
Verse: يوم نطوي السماء كطي السجل للكتب كما بدانا اول خلق نعيده وعدا علينا انا كنا فٰعلين
Sahih_International: The Day when We will fold the heaven like the folding of a [written] sheet for the records. As We began the first creation, We will repeat it. [That is] a promise binding upon Us. Indeed, We will do it.
Pickthall: The Day when We shall roll up the heavens as a recorder rolleth up a written scroll. As We began the first creation, We shall repeat it. (It is) a promise (binding) upon Us. Lo! We are to perform it.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): The Day that We roll up the heavens like a scroll rolled up for books (completed),- even as We produced the first creation, so shall We produce a new one: a promise We have undertaken: truly shall We fulfil it.
Shakir: On the day when We will roll up heaven like the rolling up of the scroll for writings, as We originated the first creation, (so) We shall reproduce it; a promise (binding on Us); surely We will bring it about.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): (This will happen) on the day when We roll up the heavens as if it were a written scroll and bring it back into existence just as though We had created it for the first time. This is what We have promised and We have always been true to Our promise.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And (remember) the Day when We shall roll up the heavens like a scroll rolled up for books, as We began the first creation, We shall repeat it, (it is) a promise binding upon Us. Truly, We shall do it.
Arberry: On the day when We shall roll up heaven as a scroll is rolled for the writings; as We originated the first creation, so We shall bring it back again -- a promise binding on Us; so We shall do.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: إِنَّ فِي هَٰذَا لَبَلَٰغٗا لِّقَوۡمٍ عَٰبِدِينَ
Verse: ان في هٰذا لبلٰغا لقوم عٰبدين
Sahih_International: Indeed, in this [Qur'an] is notification for a worshipping people.
Pickthall: Lo! there is a plain statement for folk who are devout.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Verily in this (Qur'an) is a Message for people who would (truly) worship Allah.
Shakir: Most surely in this is a message to a people who serve
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): This is a lesson for those who worship (God).
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Verily, in this (the Quran) there is a plain Message for people who worship Allah (i.e. the true, real believers of Islamic Monotheism who act practically on the Quran and the Sunnah legal ways of the Prophet SAW).
Arberry: Surely in this is a Message delivered unto a people who serve.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَقَالُواْ لَوۡلَا نُزِّلَ هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانُ عَلَىٰ رَجُلٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡقَرۡيَتَيۡنِ عَظِيمٍ
Verse: وقالوا لولا نزل هٰذا القرءان علىٰ رجل من القريتين عظيم
Sahih_International: And they said, "Why was this Qur'an not sent down upon a great man from [one of] the two cities?"
Pickthall: And they say: If only this Qur'an had been revealed to some great man of the two towns?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Also, they say: "Why is not this Qur'an sent down to some leading man in either of the two (chief) cities?"
Shakir: And they say: Why was not this Quran revealed to a man of importance in the two towns?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Then they said, "Why this Quran had not been revealed to a man from either of the two great towns".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And they say: "Why is not this Quran sent down to some great man of the two towns (Makkah and Ta'if)?"
Arberry: They say, 'Why was this Koran not sent down upon some man of moment in the two cities?'
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: ٱلَّذِينَ طَغَوۡاْ فِي ٱلۡبِلَٰدِ
Verse: الذين طغوا في البلٰد
Sahih_International: [All of] whom oppressed within the lands
Pickthall: Who (all) were rebellious (to Allah) in these lands,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): (All) these transgressed beyond bounds in the lands,
Shakir: Who committed inordinacy in the cities,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): led rebellious lives,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Who did transgress beyond bounds in the lands (in the disobedience of Allah).
Arberry: who all were insolent in the land
Label: anger

Verse_diac: قُلۡ مَن يَكۡلَؤُكُم بِٱلَّيۡلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ مِنَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ عَن ذِكۡرِ رَبِّهِم مُّعۡرِضُونَ
Verse: قل من يكلؤكم باليل والنهار من الرحمٰن بل هم عن ذكر ربهم معرضون
Sahih_International: Say, "Who can protect you at night or by day from the Most Merciful?" But they are, from the remembrance of their Lord, turning away.
Pickthall: Say: Who guardeth you in the night or in the day from the Beneficent? Nay, but they turn away from mention of their Lord!
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Say: "Who can keep you safe by night and by day from (the Wrath of) (Allah) Most Gracious?" Yet they turn away from the mention of their Lord.
Shakir: Say: Who guards you by night and by day from the Beneficent Allah? Nay, they turn aside at the mention of their Lord.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Ask them, "Who can protect them from (the wrath of) the Beneficent God during the night and day?" Yet they are neglectful about their Lord.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Say: "Who can guard and protect you in the night or in the day from the (punishment of the) Most Beneficent (Allah)?" Nay, but they turn away from the remembrance of their Lord.
Arberry: Say: 'Who shall guard you by night and in the daytime from the All-merciful?' Nay, but from the Remembrance of their Lord they are turning away.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: فَإِذَا نُقِرَ فِي ٱلنَّاقُورِ
Verse: فاذا نقر في الناقور
Sahih_International: And when the trumpet is blown,
Pickthall: For when the trumpet shall sound,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Finally, when the Trumpet is sounded,
Shakir: For when the trumpet is sounded,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): When the trumpet is sounded,.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Then, when the Trumpet is sounded (i.e. its second blowing);
Arberry: For when the Trump is sounded
Label: fear

Verse_diac: تَحِيَّتُهُمۡ يَوۡمَ يَلۡقَوۡنَهُۥ سَلَٰمٞۚ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمۡ أَجۡرٗا كَرِيمٗا
Verse: تحيتهم يوم يلقونه سلٰم واعد لهم اجرا كريما
Sahih_International: Their greeting the Day they meet Him will be, "Peace." And He has prepared for them a noble reward.
Pickthall: Their salutation on the day when they shall meet Him will be: Peace. And He hath prepared for them a goodly recompense.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Their salutation on the Day they meet Him will be "Peace!"; and He has prepared for them a generous Reward.
Shakir: Their salutation on the day that they meet Him shall be, Peace, and He has prepared for them an honourable reward.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): On the day when they will be brought into the presence of their Lord, their greeting to each other will be, "Peace be with you." God has prepared an honorable reward for them.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Their greeting on the Day they shall meet Him will be "Salam: Peace (i.e. the angels will say to them: Salamu 'Alaikum)!" And He has prepared for them a generous reward (i.e. Paradise).
Arberry: Their greeting, on the day when they shall meet Him, will be 'Peace!' And He has prepared for them a generous wage.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَجَعَلۡنَا لَكُمۡ فِيهَا مَعَٰيِشَ وَمَن لَّسۡتُمۡ لَهُۥ بِرَٰزِقِينَ
Verse: وجعلنا لكم فيها معٰيش ومن لستم له برٰزقين
Sahih_International: And We have made for you therein means of living and [for] those for whom you are not providers.
Pickthall: And we have given unto you livelihoods therein, and unto those for whom ye provide not.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And We have provided therein means of subsistence,- for you and for those for whose sustenance ye are not responsible.
Shakir: And We have made in it means of subsistence for you and for him for whom you are not the suppliers.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): to provide you and those for whose sustenance you are not responsible, with the necessities of life.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And We have provided therein means of living, for you and for those whom you provide not [moving (living) creatures, cattle, beasts, and other animals].
Arberry: and there appointed for you livelihood, and for those you provide not for.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: يَسۡـَٔلُ أَيَّانَ يَوۡمُ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ
Verse: يسل ايان يوم القيٰمة
Sahih_International: He asks, "When is the Day of Resurrection?"
Pickthall: He asketh: When will be this Day of Resurrection?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): He questions: "When is the Day of Resurrection?"
Shakir: He asks: When is the day of resurrection?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): He asks, "When will be the Day of Judgment?"
Mohsin_Khan (MK): He asks: "When will be this Day of Resurrection?"
Arberry: asking, 'When shall be the Day of Resurrection?'
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَأَنَّ ٱلۡمَسَٰجِدَ لِلَّهِ فَلَا تَدۡعُواْ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ أَحَدٗا
Verse: وان المسٰجد لله فلا تدعوا مع الله احدا
Sahih_International: And [He revealed] that the masjids are for Allah , so do not invoke with Allah anyone.
Pickthall: And the places of worship are only for Allah, so pray not unto anyone along with Allah.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "And the places of worship are for Allah (alone): So invoke not any one along with Allah;
Shakir: And that the mosques are Allah's, therefore call not upon any one with Allah:
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): All the parts of the body to be placed on the ground during prostration belong to God.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And the mosques are for All?h (Alone), so invoke not anyone along with All?h.
Arberry: The places of worship belong to God; so call not, along with God, upon anyone.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: ۞وَلَوۡ يُعَجِّلُ ٱللَّهُ لِلنَّاسِ ٱلشَّرَّ ٱسۡتِعۡجَالَهُم بِٱلۡخَيۡرِ لَقُضِيَ إِلَيۡهِمۡ أَجَلُهُمۡۖ فَنَذَرُ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَرۡجُونَ لِقَآءَنَا فِي طُغۡيَٰنِهِمۡ يَعۡمَهُونَ
Verse: ولو يعجل الله للناس الشر استعجالهم بالخير لقضي اليهم اجلهم فنذر الذين لا يرجون لقاءنا في طغيٰنهم يعمهون
Sahih_International: And if Allah was to hasten for the people the evil [they invoke] as He hastens for them the good, their term would have been ended for them. But We leave the ones who do not expect the meeting with Us, in their transgression, wandering blindly
Pickthall: If Allah were to hasten on for men the ill (that they have earned) as they would hasten on the good, their respite would already have expired. But We suffer those who look not for the meeting with Us to wander blindly on in their contumacy.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): If Allah were to hasten for men the ill (they have earned) as they would fain hasten on the good,- then would their respite be settled at once. But We leave those who rest not their hope on their meeting with Us, in their trespasses, wandering in distraction to and fro.
Shakir: And if Allah should hasten the evil to men as they desire the hastening on of good, their doom should certainly have been decreed for them; but We leave those alone who hope not for Our meeting in their inordinacy, blindly wandering on.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Had God been as hasty to punish people as they were hasty to achieve good, their life would have already ended. We will leave those who have no hope of receiving Our mercy, in the life hereafter, to continue blindly in their transgression.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And were Allah to hasten for mankind the evil (they invoke for themselves and for their children, etc. while in a state of anger) as He hastens for them the good (they invoke) then they would have been ruined. So We leave those who expect not their meeting with Us, in their trespasses, wandering blindly in distraction. (Tafsir At-Tabari; Vol. 11, Page 91)
Arberry: If God should hasten unto men evil as they would hasten good, their term would be already decided for them. But We leave those, who look not to encounter Us, in their insolence wandering blindly.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: فَأَلۡهَمَهَا فُجُورَهَا وَتَقۡوَىٰهَا
Verse: فالهمها فجورها وتقوىٰها
Sahih_International: And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness,
Pickthall: And inspired it (with conscience of) what is wrong for it and (what is) right for it.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And its enlightenment as to its wrong and its right;-
Shakir: Then He inspired it to understand what is right and wrong for it;
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): and inspired it with knowledge of evil and piety,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Then He showed him what is wrong for him and what is right for him;
Arberry: and inspired it to lewdness and godfearing!
Label: fear

Verse_diac: فَجُمِعَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ لِمِيقَٰتِ يَوۡمٖ مَّعۡلُومٖ
Verse: فجمع السحرة لميقٰت يوم معلوم
Sahih_International: So the magicians were assembled for the appointment of a well-known day.
Pickthall: So the wizards were gathered together at a set time on a day appointed.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): So the sorcerers were got together for the appointment of a day well-known,
Shakir: So the magicians were gathered together at the appointed time on the fixed day,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): So all the magicians gathered together
Mohsin_Khan (MK): So the sorcerers were assembled at a fixed time on a day appointed.
Arberry: So the sorcerers were assembled for the appointed time of a fixed day.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: وَيۡلٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لِّلۡمُكَذِّبِينَ
Verse: ويل يومئذ للمكذبين
Sahih_International: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
Pickthall: Woe unto the repudiators on that day!
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Ah woe, that Day, to the Rejecters of Truth!
Shakir: Woe on that day to the rejecters.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): On that day, woe will be to those who have rejected God's revelations!
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Woe that Day to the deniers (of the Day of Resurrection)!
Arberry: Woe that day unto those who cry it lies!
Label: anger

Verse_diac: قُلۡ أَرَءَيۡتُمۡ إِن كَانَ مِنۡ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ثُمَّ كَفَرۡتُم بِهِۦ مَنۡ أَضَلُّ مِمَّنۡ هُوَ فِي شِقَاقِۭ بَعِيدٖ
Verse: قل ارءيتم ان كان من عند الله ثم كفرتم به من اضل ممن هو في شقاق بعيد
Sahih_International: Say, "Have you considered: if the Qur'an is from Allah and you disbelieved in it, who would be more astray than one who is in extreme dissension?"
Pickthall: Bethink you: If it is from Allah and ye reject it - Who is further astray than one who is at open feud (with Allah)?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Say: "See ye if the (Revelation) is (really) from Allah, and yet do ye reject it? Who is more astray than one who is in a schism far (from any purpose)?"
Shakir: Say: Tell me if it is from Allah; then you disbelieve in it, who is in greater error than he who is in a prolonged opposition?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Say, "Think, if the (Quran) is from God and you have rejected it, then who has gone farther astray than the one who has wandered far from the truth?
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Say: "Tell me, if it (the Quran) is from Allah, and you disbelieve in it, who is more astray than one who is in opposition far away (from Allah's Right Path and His obedience).
Arberry: Say: 'What think you? If it is from God, then you disbelieve in it, who is further astray than he who is in wide schism?'
Label: fear

Verse_diac: إِن تَحۡرِصۡ عَلَىٰ هُدَىٰهُمۡ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهۡدِي مَن يُضِلُّۖ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّٰصِرِينَ
Verse: ان تحرص علىٰ هدىٰهم فان الله لا يهدي من يضل وما لهم من نٰصرين
Sahih_International: [Even] if you should strive for their guidance, [O Muhammad], indeed, Allah does not guide those He sends astray, and they will have no helpers.
Pickthall: Even if thou (O Muhammad) desirest their right guidance, still Allah assuredly will not guide him who misleadeth. Such have no helpers.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): If thou art anxious for their guidance, yet Allah guideth not such as He leaves to stray, and there is none to help them.
Shakir: If you desire for their guidance, yet surely Allah does not guide him who leads astray, nor shall they have any helpers.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): (Muhammad), even though you have a strong desire to guide them, be sure that God will not guide those who have gone astray and no one will be able to help them.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): If you (O Muhammad SAW) covet for their guidance, then verily Allah guides not those whom He makes to go astray (or none can guide him whom Allah sends astray). And they will have no helpers.
Arberry: Though thou art ever so eager to guide them, God guides not those whom He leads astray; they have no helpers.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: وَإِذَا حُشِرَ ٱلنَّاسُ كَانُواْ لَهُمۡ أَعۡدَآءٗ وَكَانُواْ بِعِبَادَتِهِمۡ كَٰفِرِينَ
Verse: واذا حشر الناس كانوا لهم اعداء وكانوا بعبادتهم كٰفرين
Sahih_International: And when the people are gathered [that Day], they [who were invoked] will be enemies to them, and they will be deniers of their worship.
Pickthall: And when mankind are gathered (to the Judgment) will become enemies for them, and will become deniers of having been worshipped.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And when mankind are gathered together (at the Resurrection), they will be hostile to them and reject their worship (altogether)!
Shakir: And when men are gathered together they shall be their enemies, and shall be deniers of their worshipping (them).
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): When people will be resurrected, such gods will become their enemies and will reject their worship.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And when mankind are gathered (on the Day of Resurrection), they (false deities) will become enemies for them and will deny their worshipping.
Arberry: and when mankind are mustered, shall be enemies to them, and shall deny their service.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: فَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكَ عَنۡهَا مَن لَّا يُؤۡمِنُ بِهَا وَٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ فَتَرۡدَىٰ
Verse: فلا يصدنك عنها من لا يؤمن بها واتبع هوىٰه فتردىٰ
Sahih_International: So do not let one avert you from it who does not believe in it and follows his desire, for you [then] would perish.
Pickthall: Therefor, let not him turn thee aside from (the thought of) it who believeth not therein but followeth his own desire, lest thou perish.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "Therefore let not such as believe not therein but follow their own lusts, divert thee therefrom, lest thou perish!"..
Shakir: Therefore let not him who believes not in it and follows his low desires turn you away from it so that you should perish;
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Let not the unbelievers who follow their vain desires make you forget the Day of Judgment, lest you will perish."
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "Therefore, let not the one who believes not therein (i.e. in the Day of Resurrection, Reckoning, Paradise and Hell, etc.), but follows his own lusts, divert you therefrom, lest you perish.
Arberry: Let none bar thee from it, that believes not in it but follows after his own caprice, or thou wilt perish.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: وَنَصَرۡنَٰهُمۡ فَكَانُواْ هُمُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبِينَ
Verse: ونصرنٰهم فكانوا هم الغٰلبين
Sahih_International: And We supported them so it was they who overcame.
Pickthall: And helped them so that they became the victors.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And We helped them, so they overcame (their troubles);
Shakir: And We helped them, so they were the vanquishers.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We helped them and they were victorious.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And helped them, so that they became the victors;
Arberry: And We helped them, so that they were the victors;
Label: joy

Verse_diac: فَسَوۡفَ يَدۡعُواْ ثُبُورٗا
Verse: فسوف يدعوا ثبورا
Sahih_International: He will cry out for destruction
Pickthall: He surely will invoke destruction
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Soon will he cry for perdition,
Shakir: He shall call for perdition,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): they will say, "Woe to us!"
Mohsin_Khan (MK): He will invoke (his) destruction,
Arberry: he shall call for destruction
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَمَا تَأۡتِيهِم مِّنۡ ءَايَةٖ مِّنۡ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ إِلَّا كَانُواْ عَنۡهَا مُعۡرِضِينَ
Verse: وما تاتيهم من ءاية من ءايٰت ربهم الا كانوا عنها معرضين
Sahih_International: And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they turn away therefrom.
Pickthall: Never came there unto them a revelation of the revelations of Allah but they did turn away from it.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): But never did a single one of the signs of their Lord reach them, but they turned away therefrom.
Shakir: And there does not come to them any communication of the communications of their Lord but they turn aside from it
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): (The unbelievers) have always turned away from the revelations and the evidence (of the Truth) that has been sent to them from time to time.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And never an Ayah (sign) comes to them from the Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) of their Lord, but that they have been turning away from it.
Arberry: Not a sign of their Lord comes to them, but they turn away from it.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: لَيۡسَ لَكَ مِنَ ٱلۡأَمۡرِ شَيۡءٌ أَوۡ يَتُوبَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ أَوۡ يُعَذِّبَهُمۡ فَإِنَّهُمۡ ظَٰلِمُونَ
Verse: ليس لك من الامر شيء او يتوب عليهم او يعذبهم فانهم ظٰلمون
Sahih_International: Not for you, [O Muhammad, but for Allah], is the decision whether He should [cut them down] or forgive them or punish them, for indeed, they are wrongdoers.
Pickthall: It is no concern at all of thee (Muhammad) whether He relent toward them or punish them; for they are evil-doers.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Not for thee, (but for Allah), is the decision: Whether He turn in mercy to them, or punish them; for they are indeed wrong-doers.
Shakir: You have no concern in the affair whether He turns to them (mercifully) or chastises them, for surely they are unjust.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): (Muhammad), it is not your concern whether He forgives them or punishes them for they are unjust.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Not for you (O Muhammad SAW, but for Allah) is the decision; whether He turns in mercy to (pardons) them or punishes them; verily, they are the Zalimun (polytheists, disobedients, and wrong-doers, etc.).
Arberry: No part of the matter is thine, whether He turns towards them again, or chastises them; for they are evildoers.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: قَالَ أَلَمۡ أَقُلۡ إِنَّكَ لَن تَسۡتَطِيعَ مَعِيَ صَبۡرٗا
Verse: قال الم اقل انك لن تستطيع معي صبرا
Sahih_International: [Al-Khidh r] said, "Did I not say that with me you would never be able to have patience?"
Pickthall: He said: Did I not tell thee that thou couldst not bear with me?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): He answered: "Did I not tell thee that thou canst have no patience with me?"
Shakir: He said: Did I not say that you will not be able to have patience with me?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): He said, "Did I not tell you that you would not be able to remain patient with me?"
Mohsin_Khan (MK): He (Khidr) said: "Did I not tell you, that you would not be able to have patience with me?"
Arberry: Said he, 'Did I not say that thou couldst never bear with me patiently?'
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: وَإِن تُكَذِّبُواْ فَقَدۡ كَذَّبَ أُمَمٞ مِّن قَبۡلِكُمۡۖ وَمَا عَلَى ٱلرَّسُولِ إِلَّا ٱلۡبَلَٰغُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ
Verse: وان تكذبوا فقد كذب امم من قبلكم وما على الرسول الا البلٰغ المبين
Sahih_International: And if you [people] deny [the message] - already nations before you have denied. And there is not upon the Messenger except [the duty of] clear notification.
Pickthall: But if ye deny, then nations have denied before you. The messenger is only to convey (the message) plainly.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "And if ye reject (the Message), so did generations before you: and the duty of the messenger is only to preach publicly (and clearly)."
Shakir: And if you reject (the truth), nations before you did indeed reject (the truth); and nothing is incumbent on the messenger but a plain delivering (of the message).
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): If you, (pagans), call our (revelations) lies, certainly many generations living before you have also done the same thing. The duty of a Messenger is only to preach clearly.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "And if you deny, then nations before you have denied (their Messengers). And the duty of the Messenger is only to convey (the Message) plainly."
Arberry: 'But if you cry me lies, nations cried lies before you; and it is only for the Messenger to deliver the Manifest Message.'
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: وَلَا يَحُضُّ عَلَىٰ طَعَامِ ٱلۡمِسۡكِينِ
Verse: ولا يحض علىٰ طعام المسكين
Sahih_International: Nor did he encourage the feeding of the poor.
Pickthall: And urged not on the feeding of the wretched.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "And would not encourage the feeding of the indigent!
Shakir: Nor did he urge the feeding of the poor.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): nor were they concerned with feeding the destitute.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And urged not on the feeding of Al­Miskin (the poor),
Arberry: and he never urged the feeding of the needy;
Label: anger

Verse_diac: إِنَّهُمۡ أَلۡفَوۡاْ ءَابَآءَهُمۡ ضَآلِّينَ
Verse: انهم الفوا ءاباءهم ضالين
Sahih_International: Indeed they found their fathers astray.
Pickthall: They indeed found their fathers astray,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Truly they found their fathers on the wrong Path;
Shakir: Surely they found their fathers going astray,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): They found their father going astray
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Verily, they found their fathers on the wrong path;
Arberry: They found their fathers erring,
Label: anger

Verse_diac: فَسَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُونَ مَن يَأۡتِيهِ عَذَابٞ يُخۡزِيهِ وَيَحِلُّ عَلَيۡهِ عَذَابٞ مُّقِيمٌ
Verse: فسوف تعلمون من ياتيه عذاب يخزيه ويحل عليه عذاب مقيم
Sahih_International: And you are going to know who will get a punishment that will disgrace him [on earth] and upon whom will descend an enduring punishment [in the Hereafter]."
Pickthall: And ye shall know to whom a punishment that will confound him cometh, and upon whom a lasting doom will fall.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "But soon will ye know who it is on whom will descend a penalty that will cover them with shame,- on whom will be unloosed a penalty lasting:"
Shakir: So shall you know who it is on whom will come a chastisement which will disgrace him, and on whom will lasting chastisement come down.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): You will soon learn who will face a humiliating punishment and will be encompassed by an everlasting torment."
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "And you will know who it is on whom will come a torment that will cover him with disgrace and on whom will fall a lasting torment."
Arberry: and you shall know to whom will come a chastisement degrading him, and upon whom there shall alight a lasting chastisement.'
Label: fear

Verse_diac: أَيَطۡمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمۡرِيٕٖ مِّنۡهُمۡ أَن يُدۡخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٖ
Verse: ايطمع كل امري منهم ان يدخل جنة نعيم
Sahih_International: Does every person among them aspire to enter a garden of pleasure?
Pickthall: Doth every man among them hope to enter the Garden of Delight?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Does every man of them long to enter the Garden of Bliss?
Shakir: Does every man of them desire that he should be made to enter the garden of bliss?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Does every one of them desire to enter the bountiful Paradise?
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Does every man of them hope to enter the Paradise of delight?
Arberry: What, is every man of them eager to be admitted to a Garden of Bliss?
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: بَلِ ٱللَّهَ فَٱعۡبُدۡ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلشَّٰكِرِينَ
Verse: بل الله فاعبد وكن من الشٰكرين
Sahih_International: Rather, worship [only] Allah and be among the grateful.
Pickthall: Nay, but Allah must thou serve, and be among the thankful!
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Nay, but worship Allah, and be of those who give thanks.
Shakir: Nay! but serve Allah alone and be of the thankful.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): (Muhammad), You must worship God alone and give Him thanks.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Nay! But worship Allah (Alone and none else), and be among the grateful.
Arberry: Nay, but God do thou serve; and be thou among the thankful.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: هَلَكَ عَنِّي سُلۡطَٰنِيَهۡ
Verse: هلك عني سلطٰنيه
Sahih_International: Gone from me is my authority."
Pickthall: My power hath gone from me.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "My power has perished from me!"...
Shakir: My authority is gone away from me.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): and our belief has destroyed us".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "My power and arguments (to defend myself) have gone from me!"
Arberry: my authority is gone from me.'
Label: fear

Verse_diac: فَذَكِّرۡ إِن نَّفَعَتِ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ
Verse: فذكر ان نفعت الذكرىٰ
Sahih_International: So remind, if the reminder should benefit;
Pickthall: Therefor remind (men), for of use is the reminder.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Therefore give admonition in case the admonition profits (the hearer).
Shakir: Therefore do remind, surely reminding does profit.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Therefore, keep on preaching as long as it is of benefit.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Therefore remind (men) in case the reminder profits (them).
Arberry: Therefore remind, if the Reminder profits,
Label: joy

Verse_diac: فَيَوۡمَئِذٖ لَّا يُعَذِّبُ عَذَابَهُۥٓ أَحَدٞ
Verse: فيومئذ لا يعذب عذابه احد
Sahih_International: So on that Day, none will punish [as severely] as His punishment,
Pickthall: None punisheth as He will punish on that day!
Yusuf_Ali (YA): For, that Day, His Chastisement will be such as none (else) can inflict,
Shakir: But on that day shall no one chastise with (anything like) His chastisement,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): On that day the punishment of God and His detention will be unparalleled.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): So on that Day, none will punish as He will punish.
Arberry: Upon that day none shall chastise as He chastises,
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَا تَسۡمَعُواْ لِهَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ وَٱلۡغَوۡاْ فِيهِ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَغۡلِبُونَ
Verse: وقال الذين كفروا لا تسمعوا لهٰذا القرءان والغوا فيه لعلكم تغلبون
Sahih_International: And those who disbelieve say, "Do not listen to this Qur'an and speak noisily during [the recitation of] it that perhaps you will overcome."
Pickthall: Those who disbelieve say: Heed not this Qur'an, and drown the hearing of it; haply ye may conquer.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): The Unbelievers say: "Listen not to this Qur'an, but talk at random in the midst of its (reading), that ye may gain the upper hand!"
Shakir: And those who disbelieve say: Do not listen to this Quran and make noise therein, perhaps you may overcome.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): The disbelievers say, "Do not listen to this Quran but make a lot of unnecessary noise while it is being read so that perhaps you will defeat it".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And those who disbelieve say: "Listen not to this Quran, and make noise in the midst of its (recitation) that you may overcome."
Arberry: The unbelievers say, 'Do not give ear to this Koran, and talk idly about it; haply you will overcome.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: إِلَّا مَن رَّحِمَ ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
Verse: الا من رحم الله انه هو العزيز الرحيم
Sahih_International: Except those [believers] on whom Allah has mercy. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
Pickthall: Save him on whom Allah hath mercy. Lo! He is the Mighty, the Merciful.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Except such as receive Allah's Mercy: for He is Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
Shakir: Save those on whom Allah shall have mercy; surely He is the Mighty the Merciful.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): except for those to whom God grants mercy. He is Majestic and All-merciful.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Except him on whom Allah has Mercy. Verily, He is the All-Mighty, the Most Merciful.
Arberry: save him upon whom God has mercy; He is the All-mighty, the All-compassionate.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: إِنَّ رَبَّهُم بِهِمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لَّخَبِيرُۢ
Verse: ان ربهم بهم يومئذ لخبير
Sahih_International: Indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is [fully] Acquainted.
Pickthall: On that day will their Lord be perfectly informed concerning them.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): That their Lord had been Well-acquainted with them, (even to) that Day?
Shakir: Most surely their Lord that day shall be fully aware of them.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): their Lord will examine his deeds?
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Verily, that Day (i.e. the Day of Resurrection) their Lord will be Well-Acquainted with them (as to their deeds), (and will reward them for their deeds).
Arberry: surely on that day their Lord shall be aware of them!
Label: fear

Verse_diac: فَقَالَ إِنِّي سَقِيمٞ
Verse: فقال اني سقيم
Sahih_International: And said, "Indeed, I am [about to be] ill."
Pickthall: Then said: Lo! I feel sick!
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And he said, "I am indeed sick (at heart)!"
Shakir: Then he said: Surely I am sick (of your worshipping these).
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): and said, "I am sick!"
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And he said: "Verily, I am sick (with plague. He did this trick to remain in their temple of idols to destroy them and not to accompany them to the pagan's feast)."
Arberry: and he said, 'Surely I am sick.'
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَٱلَّذِينَ يُمَسِّكُونَ بِٱلۡكِتَٰبِ وَأَقَامُواْ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ إِنَّا لَا نُضِيعُ أَجۡرَ ٱلۡمُصۡلِحِينَ
Verse: والذين يمسكون بالكتٰب واقاموا الصلوٰة انا لا نضيع اجر المصلحين
Sahih_International: But those who hold fast to the Book and establish prayer - indeed, We will not allow to be lost the reward of the reformers.
Pickthall: And as for those who make (men) keep the Scripture, and establish worship - lo! We squander not the wages of reformers.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): As to those who hold fast by the Book and establish regular prayer,- never shall We suffer the reward of the righteous to perish.
Shakir: And (as for) those who hold fast by the Book and keep up prayer, surely We do not waste the reward of the right doers.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Those who devote themselves to the teachings of the Book and are steadfast in prayer (should know that) the reward of those who reform themselves will not be lost.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And as to those who hold fast to the Book (i.e. act on its teachings) and perform As-Salat (Iqamat-as-Salat), certainly, We shall never waste the reward of those who do righteous deeds.
Arberry: And those who hold fast to the Book, and perform the prayer -- surely We leave not to waste the wage of those who set aright.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: إِنِّي وَجَّهۡتُ وَجۡهِيَ لِلَّذِي فَطَرَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ حَنِيفٗاۖ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ
Verse: اني وجهت وجهي للذي فطر السمٰوٰت والارض حنيفا وما انا من المشركين
Sahih_International: Indeed, I have turned my face toward He who created the heavens and the earth, inclining toward truth, and I am not of those who associate others with Allah."
Pickthall: Lo! I have turned my face toward Him Who created the heavens and the earth, as one by nature upright, and I am not of the idolaters.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "For me, I have set my face, firmly and truly, towards Him Who created the heavens and the earth, and never shall I give partners to Allah."
Shakir: Surely I have turned myself, being upright, wholly to Him Who originated the heavens and the earth, and I am not of the polytheists.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): I have up-rightly submitted myself to the One who has created the heavens and the earth and I am not an idol worshipper."
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Verily, I have turned my face towards Him Who has created the heavens and the earth Hanifa (Islamic Monotheism, i.e. worshipping none but Allah Alone) and I am not of Al-Mushrikun (see V.2:105)".
Arberry: I have turned my face to Him who originated the heavens and the earth, a man of pure faith; I am not of the idolaters.'
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: فِي مَقۡعَدِ صِدۡقٍ عِندَ مَلِيكٖ مُّقۡتَدِرِۭ
Verse: في مقعد صدق عند مليك مقتدر
Sahih_International: In a seat of honor near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability.
Pickthall: Firmly established in the favour of a Mighty King.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): In an Assembly of Truth, in the Presence of a Sovereign Omnipotent.
Shakir: In the seat of honor with a most Powerful King.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): honorably seated in the presence of the All-dominant King.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): In a seat of truth (i.e. Paradise), near the Omnipotent King (Allah, the All-Blessed, the Most High, the Owner of Majesty and Honour).
Arberry: in a sure abode, in the presence of a King Omnipotent.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: ذَٰلِكُم بِأَنَّهُۥٓ إِذَا دُعِيَ ٱللَّهُ وَحۡدَهُۥ كَفَرۡتُمۡ وَإِن يُشۡرَكۡ بِهِۦ تُؤۡمِنُواْۚ فَٱلۡحُكۡمُ لِلَّهِ ٱلۡعَلِيِّ ٱلۡكَبِيرِ
Verse: ذٰلكم بانه اذا دعي الله وحده كفرتم وان يشرك به تؤمنوا فالحكم لله العلي الكبير
Sahih_International: [They will be told], "That is because, when Allah was called upon alone, you disbelieved; but if others were associated with Him, you believed. So the judgement is with Allah , the Most High, the Grand."
Pickthall: (It is said unto them): This is (your plight) because, when Allah only was invoked, ye disbelieved, but when some partner was ascribed to Him ye were believing. But the command belongeth only to Allah, the Sublime, the Majestic.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): (The answer will be:) "This is because, when Allah was invoked as the Only (object of worship), ye did reject Faith, but when partners were joined to Him, ye believed! the Command is with Allah, Most High, Most Great!"
Shakir: That is because when Allah alone was called upon, you disbelieved, and when associates were given to Him, you believed; so judgment belongs to Allah, the High, the Great.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): They will be answered, "Your suffering is only because you disbelieved when One God was mentioned. When other things were considered equal to Him, you believed in them. Judgment belongs to God, the Most High, the Most Great.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): (It will be said): "This is because, when Allah Alone was invoked (in worship, etc.) you disbelieved, but when partners were joined to Him, you believed! So the judgement is only with Allah, the Most High, the Most Great!"
Arberry: That is because, when God was called to alone, you disbelieved; but if others are associated with Him, then you believe. Judgment belongs to God, the All-high, the All-great.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: إِنَّآ أَنزَلۡنَٰهُ فِي لَيۡلَةٖ مُّبَٰرَكَةٍۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا مُنذِرِينَ
Verse: انا انزلنٰه في ليلة مبٰركة انا كنا منذرين
Sahih_International: Indeed, We sent it down during a blessed night. Indeed, We were to warn [mankind].
Pickthall: Lo! We revealed it on a blessed night - Lo! We are ever warning -
Yusuf_Ali (YA): We sent it down during a Blessed Night: for We (ever) wish to warn (against Evil).
Shakir: Surely We revealed it on a blessed night surely We are ever warning--
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): that We have revealed the Quran on a blessed night to warn mankind.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): We sent it (this Quran) down on a blessed night [(i.e. night of Qadr, Surah No: 97) in the month of Ramadan,, the 9th month of the Islamic calendar]. Verily, We are ever warning [mankind that Our Torment will reach those who disbelieve in Our Oneness of Lordship and in Our Oneness of worship].
Arberry: We have sent it down in a blessed night (We are ever warning)
Label: anger

Verse_diac: لَّا يُسۡمِنُ وَلَا يُغۡنِي مِن جُوعٖ
Verse: لا يسمن ولا يغني من جوع
Sahih_International: Which neither nourishes nor avails against hunger.
Pickthall: Which doth not nourish nor release from hunger.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Which will neither nourish nor satisfy hunger.
Shakir: Which will neither fatten nor avail against hunger.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): which will neither fatten them nor satisfy them.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Which will neither nourish nor avail against hunger.
Arberry: unfattening, unappeasing hunger.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَٱمۡرَأَتُهُۥ قَآئِمَةٞ فَضَحِكَتۡ فَبَشَّرۡنَٰهَا بِإِسۡحَٰقَ وَمِن وَرَآءِ إِسۡحَٰقَ يَعۡقُوبَ
Verse: وامراته قائمة فضحكت فبشرنٰها باسحٰق ومن وراء اسحٰق يعقوب
Sahih_International: And his Wife was standing, and she smiled. Then We gave her good tidings of Isaac and after Isaac, Jacob.
Pickthall: And his wife, standing by laughed when We gave her good tidings (of the birth) of Isaac, and, after Isaac, of Jacob.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And his wife was standing (there), and she laughed: But we gave her glad tidings of Isaac, and after him, of Jacob.
Shakir: And his wife was standing (by), so she laughed, then We gave her the good news of Ishaq and after Ishaq of (a son's son) Yaqoub.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): His wife who was standing nearby, smiled and so We gave her the glad news that she would give birth to Isaac who would have a son, Jacob.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And his wife was standing (there), and she laughed (either, because the Messengers did not eat their food or for being glad for the destruction of the people of Lout (Lot). But We gave her glad tidings of Ishaque (Isaac), and after him, of Ya'qub (Jacob).
Arberry: And his wife was standing by; she laughed, therefore We gave her the glad tidings of Isaac, and, after Isaac, of Jacob.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: ذَٰلِكَ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ يَهۡدِي بِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهِۦۚ وَلَوۡ أَشۡرَكُواْ لَحَبِطَ عَنۡهُم مَّا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
Verse: ذٰلك هدى الله يهدي به من يشاء من عباده ولو اشركوا لحبط عنهم ما كانوا يعملون
Sahih_International: That is the guidance of Allah by which He guides whomever He wills of His servants. But if they had associated others with Allah , then worthless for them would be whatever they were doing.
Pickthall: Such is the guidance of Allah wherewith He guideth whom He will of His bondmen. But if they had set up (for worship) aught beside Him, (all) that they did would have been vain.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): This is the guidance of Allah: He giveth that guidance to whom He pleaseth, of His worshippers. If they were to join other gods with Him, all that they did would be vain for them.
Shakir: This is Allah's guidance, He guides thereby whom He pleases of His servants; and if they had set up others (with Him), certainly what they did would have become ineffectual for them.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Such is the guidance of God by which He guides whichever of His servants He wants. If people worship idols, their deeds will be turned devoid of all virtue.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): This is the Guidance of Allah with which He guides whomsoever He will of His slaves. But if they had joined in worship others with Allah, all that they used to do would have been of no benefit to them.
Arberry: That is God's guidance; He guides by it whom He will of His servants; had they been idolaters, it would have failed them, the things they did.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: يَوۡمَ يُنفَخُ فِي ٱلصُّورِۚ وَنَحۡشُرُ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ يَوۡمَئِذٖ زُرۡقٗا
Verse: يوم ينفخ في الصور ونحشر المجرمين يومئذ زرقا
Sahih_International: The Day the Horn will be blown. And We will gather the criminals, that Day, blue-eyed.
Pickthall: The day when the Trumpet is blown. On that day we assemble the guilty white-eyed (with terror),
Yusuf_Ali (YA): The Day when the Trumpet will be sounded: that Day, We shall gather the sinful, blear-eyed (with terror).
Shakir: On the day when the trumpet shall be blown, and We will gather the guilty, blue-eyed, on that day
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): On the day when the trumpet will be sounded We will raise the criminals from their graves and their eyes will be turned blue and blind.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): The Day when the Trumpet will be blown (the second blowing): that Day, We shall gather the Mujrimun (criminals, polytheists, sinners, disbelievers in the Oneness of Allah, etc.) Zurqa: (blue or blind eyed with black faces).
Arberry: On the day the Trumpet is blown; and We shall muster the sinners upon that day with eyes staring,
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَإِنَّ جُندَنَا لَهُمُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبُونَ
Verse: وان جندنا لهم الغٰلبون
Sahih_International: And [that] indeed, Our soldiers will be those who overcome.
Pickthall: And that Our host, they verily would be the victors.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And that Our forces,- they surely must conquer.
Shakir: And most surely Our host alone shall be the victorious ones.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): and that Our army will be triumphant.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And that Our hosts, they verily would be the victors.
Arberry: and Our host -- they are the victors.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَأَنفِقُواْ مِن مَّا رَزَقۡنَٰكُم مِّن قَبۡلِ أَن يَأۡتِيَ أَحَدَكُمُ ٱلۡمَوۡتُ فَيَقُولَ رَبِّ لَوۡلَآ أَخَّرۡتَنِيٓ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٖ قَرِيبٖ فَأَصَّدَّقَ وَأَكُن مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
Verse: وانفقوا من ما رزقنٰكم من قبل ان ياتي احدكم الموت فيقول رب لولا اخرتني الىٰ اجل قريب فاصدق واكن من الصٰلحين
Sahih_International: And spend [in the way of Allah] from what We have provided you before death approaches one of you and he says, "My Lord, if only You would delay me for a brief term so I would give charity and be among the righteous."
Pickthall: And spend of that wherewith We have provided you before death cometh unto one of you and he saith: My Lord! If only thou wouldst reprieve me for a little while, then I would give alms and be among the righteous.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): and spend something (in charity) out of the substance which We have bestowed on you, before Death should come to any of you and he should say, "O my Lord! why didst Thou not give me respite for a little while? I should then have given (largely) in charity, and I should have been one of the doers of good".
Shakir: And spend out of what We have given you before death comes to one of you, so that he should say: My Lord! why didst Thou not respite me to a near term, so that I should have given alms and been of the doers of good deeds?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Spend for the cause of God out of what We have given you before death approaches you, and say, "Lord, would that you would give me respite for a short time so that I could spend for Your cause and become one of those who do good".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And spend (in charity) of that with which We have provided you, before death comes to one of you and he says: "My Lord! If only You would give me respite for a little while (i.e. return to the worldly life), then I should give Sadaqah (i.e. Zakat) of my wealth , and be among the righteous [i.e. perform Hajj (pilgrimage to Makkah)].
Arberry: Expend of what We have provided you before that death comes upon one of you and he says, 'O my Lord, if only Thou wouldst defer me unto a near term, so that I may make freewill offering, and so I may become one of the righteous.'
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: وَنَذۡكُرَكَ كَثِيرًا
Verse: ونذكرك كثيرا
Sahih_International: And remember You much.
Pickthall: And much remember Thee.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "And remember Thee without stint:
Shakir: And remember Thee oft.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): and remember you often.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "And remember You much,
Arberry: and remember Thee abundantly.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَٱلۡقَمَرَ قَدَّرۡنَٰهُ مَنَازِلَ حَتَّىٰ عَادَ كَٱلۡعُرۡجُونِ ٱلۡقَدِيمِ
Verse: والقمر قدرنٰه منازل حتىٰ عاد كالعرجون القديم
Sahih_International: And the moon - We have determined for it phases, until it returns [appearing] like the old date stalk.
Pickthall: And for the moon We have appointed mansions till she return like an old shrivelled palm-leaf.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And the Moon,- We have measured for her mansions (to traverse) till she returns like the old (and withered) lower part of a date-stalk.
Shakir: And (as for) the moon, We have ordained for it stages till it becomes again as an old dry palm branch.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): how We ordained the moon to pass through certain phases until it seems eventually to be like a bent twig;
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And the moon, We have measured for it mansions (to traverse) till it returns like the old dried curved date stalk.
Arberry: And the moon -- We have determined it by stations, till it returns like an aged palm-bough.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: قُلۡ هَٰذِهِۦ سَبِيلِيٓ أَدۡعُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱللَّهِۚ عَلَىٰ بَصِيرَةٍ أَنَا۠ وَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَنِيۖ وَسُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ
Verse: قل هٰذه سبيلي ادعوا الى الله علىٰ بصيرة انا ومن اتبعني وسبحٰن الله وما انا من المشركين
Sahih_International: Say, "This is my way; I invite to Allah with insight, I and those who follow me. And exalted is Allah ; and I am not of those who associate others with Him."
Pickthall: Say: This is my Way: I call on Allah with sure knowledge. I and whosoever followeth me - Glory be to Allah! - and I am not of the idolaters.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Say thou: "This is my way: I do invite unto Allah,- on evidence clear as the seeing with one's eyes,- I and whoever follows me. Glory to Allah! and never will I join gods with Allah!"
Shakir: Say: This is my way: I call to Allah, I and those who follow me being certain, and glory be to Allah, and I am not one of the polytheists.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): (Muhammad), say, "This is my way. I and all my followers invite you to God with proper understanding. God is most Glorious. I am not a pagan."
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Say (O Muhammad SAW): "This is my way; I invite unto Allah (i.e. to the Oneness of Allah - Islamic Monotheism) with sure knowledge, I and whosoever follows me (also must invite others to Allah i.e to the Oneness of Allah - Islamic Monotheism) with sure knowledge. And Glorified and Exalted be Allah (above all that they associate as partners with Him). And I am not of the Mushrikun (polytheists, pagans, idolaters and disbelievers in the Oneness of Allah; those who worship others along with Allah or set up rivals or partners to Allah)."
Arberry: Say: 'This is my way. I call to God with sure knowledge, I and whoever follows after me. To God be glory! And I am not among the idolaters.'
Label: joy

Verse_diac: قَالَ رَبِّ لِمَ حَشَرۡتَنِيٓ أَعۡمَىٰ وَقَدۡ كُنتُ بَصِيرٗا
Verse: قال رب لم حشرتني اعمىٰ وقد كنت بصيرا
Sahih_International: He will say, "My Lord, why have you raised me blind while I was [once] seeing?"
Pickthall: He will say: My Lord! Wherefor hast Thou gathered me (hither) blind, when I was wont to see?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): He will say: "O my Lord! why hast Thou raised me up blind, while I had sight (before)?"
Shakir: He shall say: My Lord! why hast Thou raised me blind and I was a seeing one indeed?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): He will say, "My Lord, why have you brought me back to life blind; before I could see?"
Mohsin_Khan (MK): He will say:"O my Lord! Why have you raised me up blind, while I had sight (before)."
Arberry: He shall say, 'O my Lord, why hast thou raised me blind, and I was wont to see?'
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمُ ٱتَّبَعُواْ مَآ أَسۡخَطَ ٱللَّهَ وَكَرِهُواْ رِضۡوَٰنَهُۥ فَأَحۡبَطَ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ
Verse: ذٰلك بانهم اتبعوا ما اسخط الله وكرهوا رضوٰنه فاحبط اعمٰلهم
Sahih_International: That is because they followed what angered Allah and disliked [what earns] His pleasure, so He rendered worthless their deeds.
Pickthall: That will be because they followed that which angereth Allah, and hated that which pleaseth Him. Therefor He hath made their actions vain.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): This because they followed that which called forth the Wrath of Allah, and they hated Allah's good pleasure; so He made their deeds of no effect.
Shakir: That is because they follow what is displeasing to Allah and are averse to His pleasure, therefore He has made null their deeds.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): for their following that which had incurred God's anger, and their hatred to please God. Thus, God has made their deeds devoid of all virtue.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): That is because they followed that which angered Allah, and hated that which pleased Him. So He made their deeds fruitless.
Arberry: That is because they have followed what angers God, and have been averse to His good pleasure, so He has made their works to fail.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: فَٱرۡتَقِبۡ إِنَّهُم مُّرۡتَقِبُونَ
Verse: فارتقب انهم مرتقبون
Sahih_International: So watch, [O Muhammad]; indeed, they are watching [for your end].
Pickthall: Wait then (O Muhammad). Lo! they (too) are waiting.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): So wait thou and watch; for they (too) are waiting.
Shakir: Therefore wait; surely they are waiting.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Wait (for God's decree) and they too will be waiting.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Wait then (O Muhammad SAW); Verily, they (too) are waiting.
Arberry: So be on the watch; they too are on the watch.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: فَنَجَّيۡنَٰهُ وَأَهۡلَهُۥٓ أَجۡمَعِينَ
Verse: فنجينٰه واهله اجمعين
Sahih_International: So We saved him and his family, all,
Pickthall: So We saved him and his household, every one,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): So We delivered him and his family,- all
Shakir: So We delivered him and his followers all,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We saved him and all of his family
Mohsin_Khan (MK): So We saved him and his family, all,
Arberry: So We delivered him and his people all together,
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَٱلنَّخۡلَ بَاسِقَٰتٖ لَّهَا طَلۡعٞ نَّضِيدٞ
Verse: والنخل باسقٰت لها طلع نضيد
Sahih_International: And lofty palm trees having fruit arranged in layers -
Pickthall: And lofty date-palms with ranged clusters,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And tall (and stately) palm-trees, with shoots of fruit-stalks, piled one over another;-
Shakir: And the tall palm-trees having spadices closely set one above another,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): and tall palm-trees with clusters of dates
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And tall date-palms, with ranged clusters;
Arberry: and tall palm-trees with spathes compact,
Label: joy

Verse_diac: قُلۡ إِنِّيٓ أُمِرۡتُ أَنۡ أَعۡبُدَ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡلِصٗا لَّهُ ٱلدِّينَ
Verse: قل اني امرت ان اعبد الله مخلصا له الدين
Sahih_International: Say, [O Muhammad], "Indeed, I have been commanded to worship Allah , [being] sincere to Him in religion.
Pickthall: Say (O Muhammad): Lo! I am commanded to worship Allah, making religion pure for Him (only).
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Say: "Verily, I am commanded to serve Allah with sincere devotion;
Shakir: Say: I am commanded that I should serve Allah, being sincere to Him in obedience.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Say, "I am commanded to worship God and be devoted to His religion
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Say (O Muhammad SAW): "Verily, I am commanded to worship Allah (Alone) by obeying Him and doing religious deeds sincerely for Allah's sake only and not to show off, and not to set up rivals with Him in worship;
Arberry: Say: 'I have been commanded to serve God making my religion His sincerely;
Label: anger

Verse_diac: قُلۡنَا لَا تَخَفۡ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ
Verse: قلنا لا تخف انك انت الاعلىٰ
Sahih_International: Allah said, "Fear not. Indeed, it is you who are superior.
Pickthall: We said: Fear not! Lo! thou art the higher.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): We said: "Fear not! for thou hast indeed the upper hand:
Shakir: We said: Fear not, surely you shall be the uppermost,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We told him, "Do not be afraid for you will be the winner.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): We (Allah) said: "Fear not! Surely, you will have the upper hand.
Arberry: We said unto him, 'Fear not; surely thou art the uppermost.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: لَّسۡتَ عَلَيۡهِم بِمُصَيۡطِرٍ
Verse: لست عليهم بمصيطر
Sahih_International: You are not over them a controller.
Pickthall: Thou art not at all a warder over them.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Thou art not one to manage (men's) affairs.
Shakir: You are not a watcher over them;
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): You do not have full control over them.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): You are not a dictator over them.
Arberry: thou art not charged to oversee them.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: إِنَّمَآ أَنتَ مُنذِرُ مَن يَخۡشَىٰهَا
Verse: انما انت منذر من يخشىٰها
Sahih_International: You are only a warner for those who fear it.
Pickthall: Thou art but a warner unto him who feareth it.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Thou art but a Warner for such as fear it.
Shakir: You are only a warner to him who would fear it.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): You are only a warner for those who fear such a day.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): You (O Muhammad (Peace be upon him)) are only a warner for those who fear it,
Arberry: Thou art only the warner of him who fears it.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَتِلۡكَ ٱلۡجَنَّةُ ٱلَّتِيٓ أُورِثۡتُمُوهَا بِمَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
Verse: وتلك الجنة التي اورثتموها بما كنتم تعملون
Sahih_International: And that is Paradise which you are made to inherit for what you used to do.
Pickthall: This is the Garden which ye are made to inherit because of what ye used to do.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Such will be the Garden of which ye are made heirs for your (good) deeds (in life).
Shakir: And this is the garden which you are given as an inheritance on account of what you did.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): This is the Paradise which you have received as your inheritance by virtue of what you have done.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): This is the Paradise which you have been made to inherit because of your deeds which you used to do (in the life of the world).
Arberry: This is the Paradise that you have been given for an inheritance for the things that you were doing.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: سُبۡحَٰنَ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَرۡشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
Verse: سبحٰن رب السمٰوٰت والارض رب العرش عما يصفون
Sahih_International: Exalted is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.
Pickthall: Glorified be the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, from that which they ascribe (unto Him)!
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Glory to the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne (of Authority)! (He is free) from the things they attribute (to him)!
Shakir: Glory to the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of power, from what they describe.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): The Lord of the heavens and the earth and the Throne is too glorious to be described in the way they describe Him.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Glorified be the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne! Exalted be He from all that they ascribe (to Him).
Arberry: Glory be to the Lord of the heavens and the earth, the Lord of the Throne, above that they describe.'
Label: fear

Verse_diac: أَفَلَمۡ يَدَّبَّرُواْ ٱلۡقَوۡلَ أَمۡ جَآءَهُم مَّا لَمۡ يَأۡتِ ءَابَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
Verse: افلم يدبروا القول ام جاءهم ما لم يات ءاباءهم الاولين
Sahih_International: Then have they not reflected over the Qur'an, or has there come to them that which had not come to their forefathers?
Pickthall: Have they not pondered the Word, or hath that come unto them which came not unto their fathers of old?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Do they not ponder over the Word (of Allah), or has anything (new) come to them that did not come to their fathers of old?
Shakir: Is it then that they do not ponder over what is said, or is it that there has come to them that which did not come to their fathers of old?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Was it that you did not give any thought to it (the Quran)? Was it different from what was revealed to your fathers?
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Have they not pondered over the Word (of Allah, i.e. what is sent down to the Prophet SAW), or has there come to them what had not come to their fathers of old?
Arberry: Have they not pondered the saying, or came there upon them that which came not upon their fathers, the ancients?
Label: anger

Verse_diac: إِن كُلٌّ إِلَّا كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ عِقَابِ
Verse: ان كل الا كذب الرسل فحق عقاب
Sahih_International: Each of them denied the messengers, so My penalty was justified.
Pickthall: Not one of them but did deny the messengers, therefor My doom was justified,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Not one (of them) but rejected the messengers, but My punishment came justly and inevitably (on them).
Shakir: There was none of them but called the messengers liars, so just was My retribution.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Each of them who rejected the Messenger become subject to Our punishment.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Not one of them but belied the Messengers, therefore My Torment was justified,
Arberry: not one, that cried not lies to the Messengers, so My retribution was just.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: وَٱللَّهُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يُوعُونَ
Verse: والله اعلم بما يوعون
Sahih_International: And Allah is most knowing of what they keep within themselves.
Pickthall: And Allah knoweth best what they are hiding.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): But Allah has full knowledge of what they secrete (in their breasts)
Shakir: And Allah knows best what they hide,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): but God knows best whatever they accumulate in their hearts.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And Allah knows best what they gather (of good and bad deeds),
Arberry: and God knows very well what they are secreting.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وُجُوهٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ نَّاضِرَةٌ
Verse: وجوه يومئذ ناضرة
Sahih_International: [Some] faces, that Day, will be radiant,
Pickthall: That day will faces be resplendent,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Some faces, that Day, will beam (in brightness and beauty);-
Shakir: (Some) faces on that day shall be bright,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): On the Day of Judgment some faces will be bright,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Some faces that Day shall be Nadirah (shining and radiant).
Arberry: Upon that day faces shall be radiant,
Label: joy

Verse_diac: بَلۡ مَتَّعۡتُ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ وَءَابَآءَهُمۡ حَتَّىٰ جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡحَقُّ وَرَسُولٞ مُّبِينٞ
Verse: بل متعت هٰؤلاء وءاباءهم حتىٰ جاءهم الحق ورسول مبين
Sahih_International: However, I gave enjoyment to these [people of Makkah] and their fathers until there came to them the truth and a clear Messenger.
Pickthall: Nay, but I let these and their fathers enjoy life (only) till there should come unto them the Truth and a messenger making plain.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Yea, I have given the good things of this life to these (men) and their fathers, until the Truth has come to them, and a messenger making things clear.
Shakir: Nay! I gave them and their fathers to enjoy until there came to them the truth and a Messenger making manifest (the truth).
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): In fact, We allowed them and their fathers to enjoy themselves until the truth and a strong Messenger came to them.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Nay, but I gave (the good things of this life) to these (polytheists) and their fathers to enjoy, till there came to them the truth (the Quran), and a Messenger (Muhammad SAW) making things clear.
Arberry: Nay, but I gave these and their fathers enjoyment of days, until the truth came unto them, and a manifest Messenger.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَٱدۡخُلِي جَنَّتِي
Verse: وادخلي جنتي
Sahih_International: And enter My Paradise."
Pickthall: Enter thou My Garden!
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "Yea, enter thou My Heaven!
Shakir: And enter into My garden.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): into My Paradise.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "And enter you My Paradise!"
Arberry: Enter thou My Paradise!'
Label: joy

Verse_diac: لَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيۡدِيَكُمۡ وَأَرۡجُلَكُم مِّنۡ خِلَٰفٖ ثُمَّ لَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
Verse: لاقطعن ايديكم وارجلكم من خلٰف ثم لاصلبنكم اجمعين
Sahih_International: I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides; then I will surely crucify you all."
Pickthall: Surely I shall have your hands and feet cut off upon alternate sides. Then I shall crucify you every one.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "Be sure I will cut off your hands and your feet on apposite sides, and I will cause you all to die on the cross."
Shakir: I will certainly cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, then will I crucify you all together.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): I will cut off your hands and feet on the alternate sides and crucify you all."
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "Surely, I will cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, then I will crucify you all."
Arberry: I shall assuredly cut off alternately your hands and feet, then I shall crucify you all together.'
Label: anger

Verse_diac: وَفُتِحَتِ ٱلسَّمَآءُ فَكَانَتۡ أَبۡوَٰبٗا
Verse: وفتحت السماء فكانت ابوٰبا
Sahih_International: And the heaven is opened and will become gateways
Pickthall: And the heaven is opened and becometh as gates,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And the heavens shall be opened as if there were doors,
Shakir: And the heaven shall be opened so that it shall be all openings,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): The heavens will have openings like doors.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And the heaven shall be opened, and it will become as gates,
Arberry: and heaven is opened, and become gates,
Label: fear

Verse_diac: كَلَّآ إِنَّهَا تَذۡكِرَةٞ
Verse: كلا انها تذكرة
Sahih_International: No! Indeed, these verses are a reminder;
Pickthall: Nay, but verily it is an Admonishment,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): By no means (should it be so)! For it is indeed a Message of instruction:
Shakir: Nay! surely it is an admonishment.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): These verses are a reminder
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Nay, (do not do like this), indeed it (these Verses of this Quran) are an admonition,
Arberry: No indeed; it is a Reminder
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَمَآ أَنزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ إِلَّا لِتُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ ٱلَّذِي ٱخۡتَلَفُواْ فِيهِ وَهُدٗى وَرَحۡمَةٗ لِّقَوۡمٖ يُؤۡمِنُونَ
Verse: وما انزلنا عليك الكتٰب الا لتبين لهم الذي اختلفوا فيه وهدى ورحمة لقوم يؤمنون
Sahih_International: And We have not revealed to you the Book, [O Muhammad], except for you to make clear to them that wherein they have differed and as guidance and mercy for a people who believe.
Pickthall: And We have revealed the Scripture unto thee only that thou mayst explain unto them that wherein they differ, and (as) a guidance and a mercy for a people who believe.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And We sent down the Book to thee for the express purpose, that thou shouldst make clear to them those things in which they differ, and that it should be a guide and a mercy to those who believe.
Shakir: And We have not revealed to you the Book except that you may make clear to them that about which they differ, and (as) a guidance and a mercy for a people who believe.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We have sent you the Book for no other reason than to settle their differences and to be a guide and mercy for those who believe.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And We have not sent down the Book (the Quran) to you (O Muhammad SAW), except that you may explain clearly unto them those things in which they differ, and (as) a guidance and a mercy for a folk who believe.
Arberry: And We have not sent down upon thee the Book except that thou mayest make clear to them that whereon they were at variance, and as a guidance and as a mercy to a people who believe.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَمَن نُّعَمِّرۡهُ نُنَكِّسۡهُ فِي ٱلۡخَلۡقِۚ أَفَلَا يَعۡقِلُونَ
Verse: ومن نعمره ننكسه في الخلق افلا يعقلون
Sahih_International: And he to whom We grant long life We reverse in creation; so will they not understand?
Pickthall: He whom we bring unto old age, We reverse him in creation (making him go back to weakness after strength). Have ye then no sense?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): If We grant long life to any, We cause him to be reversed in nature: Will they not then understand?
Shakir: And whomsoever We cause to live long, We reduce (him) to an abject state in constitution; do they not then understand?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): The physical growth of those whom We grant a long life will be reversed. Will you then not understand?
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And he whom We grant long life, We reverse him in creation (weakness after strength). Will they not then understand?
Arberry: And to whomsoever We give long life, We bend him over in His constitution; what, do they not understand?
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: وَفَٰكِهَةٗ وَأَبّٗا
Verse: وفٰكهة وابا
Sahih_International: And fruit and grass -
Pickthall: And fruits and grasses:
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And fruits and fodder,-
Shakir: And fruits and herbage
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): fruits, and grass.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And fruits and Abba (herbage, etc.),
Arberry: and fruits, and pastures,
Label: joy

Verse_diac: ٱصۡلَوۡهَا فَٱصۡبِرُوٓاْ أَوۡ لَا تَصۡبِرُواْ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡكُمۡۖ إِنَّمَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
Verse: اصلوها فاصبروا او لا تصبروا سواء عليكم انما تجزون ما كنتم تعملون
Sahih_International: [Enter to] burn therein; then be patient or impatient - it is all the same for you. You are only being recompensed [for] what you used to do."
Pickthall: Endure the heat thereof, and whether ye are patient of it or impatient of it is all one for you. Ye are only being paid for what ye used to do.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "Burn ye therein: the same is it to you whether ye bear it with patience, or not: Ye but receive the recompense of your (own) deeds."
Shakir: Enter into it, then bear (it) patiently, or do not bear (it) patiently, it is the same to you; you shall be requited only (for) what you did.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Burn in its heat. It is all the same for you whether you exercise patience or not; This is the recompense for your deeds".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Taste you therein its heat, and whether you are patient of it or impatient of it, it is all the same. You are only being requited for what you used to do.
Arberry: Roast in it! And bear you patiently, or bear not patiently, equal it is to you; you are only being recompensed for that you were working.'
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَٱصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ فَإِنَّكَ بِأَعۡيُنِنَاۖ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ حِينَ تَقُومُ
Verse: واصبر لحكم ربك فانك باعيننا وسبح بحمد ربك حين تقوم
Sahih_International: And be patient, [O Muhammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes. And exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord when you arise.
Pickthall: So wait patiently (O Muhammad) for thy Lord's decree, for surely thou art in Our sight; and hymn the praise of thy Lord when thou uprisest,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Now await in patience the command of thy Lord: for verily thou art in Our eyes: and celebrate the praises of thy Lord the while thou standest forth,
Shakir: And wait patiently for the judgment of your Lord, for surely you are before Our eyes, and sing the praise of your Lord when you rise;
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Wait patiently for the command of your Lord. We are watching over you. Glorify your Lord when you rise during the night
Mohsin_Khan (MK): So wait patiently (O Muhammad SAW) for the Decision of your Lord, for verily, you are under Our Eyes , and glorify the Praises of your Lord when you get up from sleep.
Arberry: And be thou patient under the judgment of thy Lord; surely thou art before Our eyes. And proclaim the praise of thy Lord when thou arisest,
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَكُلَّ إِنسَٰنٍ أَلۡزَمۡنَٰهُ طَٰٓئِرَهُۥ فِي عُنُقِهِۦۖ وَنُخۡرِجُ لَهُۥ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ كِتَٰبٗا يَلۡقَىٰهُ مَنشُورًا
Verse: وكل انسٰن الزمنٰه طٰئره في عنقه ونخرج له يوم القيٰمة كتٰبا يلقىٰه منشورا
Sahih_International: And [for] every person We have imposed his fate upon his neck, and We will produce for him on the Day of Resurrection a record which he will encounter spread open.
Pickthall: And every man's augury have We fastened to his own neck, and We shall bring forth for him on the Day of Resurrection a book which he will find wide open.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Every man's fate We have fastened on his own neck: On the Day of Judgment We shall bring out for him a scroll, which he will see spread open.
Shakir: And We have made every man's actions to cling to his neck, and We will bring forth to him on the resurrection day a book which he will find wide open:
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We have made every person's actions cling to his neck. On the Day of Judgment, We will bring forth the record of his actions in the form of a wide open book.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And We have fastened every man's deeds to his neck, and on the Day of Resurrection, We shall bring out for him a book which he will find wide open.
Arberry: And every man -- We have fastened to him his bird of omen upon his neck; and We shall bring forth for him, on the Day of Resurrection, a book he shall find spread wide open.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَلَتَعۡلَمُنَّ نَبَأَهُۥ بَعۡدَ حِينِۭ
Verse: ولتعلمن نباه بعد حين
Sahih_International: And you will surely know [the truth of] its information after a time."
Pickthall: And ye will come in time to know the truth thereof.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "And ye shall certainly know the truth of it (all) after a while."
Shakir: And most certainly you will come to know about it after a time.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): You will certainly know its truthfulness after a certain time.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "And you shall certainly know the truth of it after a while."
Arberry: and you shall surely know its tiding after a while.'
Label: fear

Verse_diac: ثُمَّ يَأۡتِي مِنۢ بَعۡدِ ذَٰلِكَ عَامٞ فِيهِ يُغَاثُ ٱلنَّاسُ وَفِيهِ يَعۡصِرُونَ
Verse: ثم ياتي من بعد ذٰلك عام فيه يغاث الناس وفيه يعصرون
Sahih_International: Then will come after that a year in which the people will be given rain and in which they will press [olives and grapes]."
Pickthall: Then, after that, will come a year when the people will have plenteous crops and when they will press (wine and oil).
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "Then will come after that (period) a year in which the people will have abundant water, and in which they will press (wine and oil)."
Shakir: Then there will come after that a year in which people shall have rain and in which they shall press (grapes).
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Then there will be a year with plenty of rain and people will have sufficient milk and other produce."
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "Then thereafter will come a year in which people will have abundant rain and in which they will press (wine and oil)."
Arberry: Then thereafter there shall come a year wherein the people will be succoured and press in season.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: مَا سَلَكَكُمۡ فِي سَقَرَ
Verse: ما سلككم في سقر
Sahih_International: [And asking them], "What put you into Saqar?"
Pickthall: What hath brought you to this burning?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "What led you into Hell Fire?"
Shakir: What has brought you into hell?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): "what led you into hell?"
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "What has caused you to enter Hell?"
Arberry: 'What thrusted you into Sakar?'
Label: anger

Verse_diac: قَالَ كَلَّآۖ إِنَّ مَعِيَ رَبِّي سَيَهۡدِينِ
Verse: قال كلا ان معي ربي سيهدين
Sahih_International: [Moses] said, "No! Indeed, with me is my Lord; He will guide me."
Pickthall: He said: Nay, verily! for lo! my Lord is with me. He will guide me.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): (Moses) said: "By no means! my Lord is with me! Soon will He guide me!"
Shakir: He said: By no means; surely my Lord is with me: He will show me a way out.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): When the two groups came close to each other, the companions of Moses said, "We will be caught".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): [Musa (Moses)] said: "Nay, verily! With me is my Lord, He will guide me."
Arberry: Said he, 'No indeed; surely my Lord is with me; He will guide me.'
Label: fear

Verse_diac: رُدُّوهَا عَلَيَّۖ فَطَفِقَ مَسۡحَۢا بِٱلسُّوقِ وَٱلۡأَعۡنَاقِ
Verse: ردوها علي فطفق مسحا بالسوق والاعناق
Sahih_International: [He said], "Return them to me," and set about striking [their] legs and necks.
Pickthall: (Then he said): Bring them back to me, and fell to slashing (with his sword their) legs and necks.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "Bring them back to me." then began he to pass his hand over (their) legs and their necks.
Shakir: Bring them back to me; so he began to slash (their) legs and necks.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): He said, "Bring them back to me." Then he started to rub their legs and necks.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Then he said "Bring them (horses) back to me." Then he began to pass his hand over their legs and their necks (till the end of the display).
