Arberry: Verily I am God; there is no god but I; therefore serve Me, and perform the prayer of My remembrance.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَخَسَفَ ٱلۡقَمَرُ
Verse: وخسف القمر
Sahih_International: And the moon darkens
Pickthall: And the moon is eclipsed
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And the moon is buried in darkness.
Shakir: And the moon becomes dark,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): the moon eclipsed.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And the moon will be eclipsed,
Arberry: and the moon is eclipsed,
Label: fear

Verse_diac: خَٰشِعَةً أَبۡصَٰرُهُمۡ تَرۡهَقُهُمۡ ذِلَّةٞۖ وَقَدۡ كَانُواْ يُدۡعَوۡنَ إِلَى ٱلسُّجُودِ وَهُمۡ سَٰلِمُونَ
Verse: خٰشعة ابصٰرهم ترهقهم ذلة وقد كانوا يدعون الى السجود وهم سٰلمون
Sahih_International: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. And they used to be invited to prostration while they were sound.
Pickthall: With eyes downcast, abasement stupefying them. And they had been summoned to prostrate themselves while they were yet unhurt.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Their eyes will be cast down,- ignominy will cover them; seeing that they had been summoned aforetime to bow in adoration, while they were whole, (and had refused).
Shakir: Their looks cast down, abasement shall overtake them; and they were called upon to make obeisance indeed while yet they were safe.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Their eyes will be lowered and disgrace will cover them. They had certainly been told to prostrate themselves before God when they were safe and sound.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Their eyes will be cast down, ignominy will cover them; they used to be called to prostrate (offer prayers), while they were healthy and good (in the life of the world, but they did not).
Arberry: humbled shall be their eyes, and abasement shall overspread them, for they had been summoned to bow themselves while they were whole.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: ۞ٱللَّهُ نُورُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ مَثَلُ نُورِهِۦ كَمِشۡكَوٰةٖ فِيهَا مِصۡبَاحٌۖ ٱلۡمِصۡبَاحُ فِي زُجَاجَةٍۖ ٱلزُّجَاجَةُ كَأَنَّهَا كَوۡكَبٞ دُرِّيّٞ يُوقَدُ مِن شَجَرَةٖ مُّبَٰرَكَةٖ زَيۡتُونَةٖ لَّا شَرۡقِيَّةٖ وَلَا غَرۡبِيَّةٖ يَكَادُ زَيۡتُهَا يُضِيٓءُ وَلَوۡ لَمۡ تَمۡسَسۡهُ نَارٞۚ نُّورٌ عَلَىٰ نُورٖۚ يَهۡدِي ٱللَّهُ لِنُورِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَيَضۡرِبُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡأَمۡثَٰلَ لِلنَّاسِۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٞ
Verse: الله نور السمٰوٰت والارض مثل نوره كمشكوٰة فيها مصباح المصباح في زجاجة الزجاجة كانها كوكب دري يوقد من شجرة مبٰركة زيتونة لا شرقية ولا غربية يكاد زيتها يضيء ولو لم تمسسه نار نور علىٰ نور يهدي الله لنوره من يشاء ويضرب الله الامثٰل للناس والله بكل شيء عليم
Sahih_International: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth. The example of His light is like a niche within which is a lamp, the lamp is within glass, the glass as if it were a pearly [white] star lit from [the oil of] a blessed olive tree, neither of the east nor of the west, whose oil would almost glow even if untouched by fire. Light upon light. Allah guides to His light whom He wills. And Allah presents examples for the people, and Allah is Knowing of all things.
Pickthall: Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth. The similitude of His light is as a niche wherein is a lamp. The lamp is in a glass. The glass is as it were a shining star. (This lamp is) kindled from a blessed tree, an olive neither of the East nor of the West, whose oil would almost glow forth (of itself) though no fire touched it. Light upon light. Allah guideth unto His light whom He will. And Allah speaketh to mankind in allegories, for Allah is Knower of all things.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth. The Parable of His Light is as if there were a Niche and within it a Lamp: the Lamp enclosed in Glass: the glass as it were a brilliant star: Lit from a blessed Tree, an Olive, neither of the east nor of the west, whose oil is well-nigh luminous, though fire scarce touched it: Light upon Light! Allah doth guide whom He will to His Light: Allah doth set forth Parables for men: and Allah doth know all things.
Shakir: Allah is the light of the heavens and the earth; a likeness of His light is as a niche in which is a lamp, the lamp is in a glass, (and) the glass is as it were a brightly shining star, lit from a blessed olive-tree, neither eastern nor western, the oil whereof almost gives light though fire touch it not-- light upon light-- Allah guides to His light whom He pleases, and Allah sets forth parables for men, and Allah is Cognizant of all things.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): God is the light of the heavens and the earth. A metaphor for His light is a niche in which there is a lamp placed in a glass. The glass is like a shining star which is lit from a blessed olive tree that is neither eastern nor western. Its oil almost lights up even though it has not been touched by the fire. It is light upon light. God guides to His light whomever He wants. God uses various metaphors. He has the knowledge of all things.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth. The parable of His Light is as (if there were) a niche and within it a lamp, the lamp is in glass, the glass as it were a brilliant star, lit from a blessed tree, an olive, neither of the east (i.e. neither it gets sun-rays only in the morning) nor of the west (i.e. nor it gets sun-rays only in the afternoon, but it is exposed to the sun all day long), whose oil would almost glow forth (of itself), though no fire touched it. Light upon Light! Allah guides to His Light whom He wills. And Allah sets forth parables for mankind, and Allah is All-Knower of everything.
Arberry: God is the Light of the heavens and the earth; the likeness of His Light is as a niche wherein is a lamp (the lamp in a glass, the glass as it were a glittering star) kindled from a Blessed Tree, an olive that is neither of the East nor of the West whose oil wellnigh would shine, even if no fire touched it; Light upon Light; (God guides to His Light whom He will.) (And God strikes similitudes for men, and God has knowledge of everything.)
Label: joy

Verse_diac: إِنَّ هَٰذِهِۦٓ أُمَّتُكُمۡ أُمَّةٗ وَٰحِدَةٗ وَأَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمۡ فَٱعۡبُدُونِ
Verse: ان هٰذه امتكم امة وٰحدة وانا ربكم فاعبدون
Sahih_International: Indeed this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so worship Me.
Pickthall: Lo! this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so worship Me.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Verily, this brotherhood of yours is a single brotherhood, and I am your Lord and Cherisher: therefore serve Me (and no other).
Shakir: Surely this Islam is your religion, one religion (only), and I am your Lord, therefore serve Me.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): People, you are one nation and I am your Lord. Worship Me.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Truly! This, your Ummah [Sharia or religion (Islamic Monotheism)] is one religion, and I am your Lord, therefore worship Me (Alone). [Tafsir Ibn Kathir]
Arberry: 'Surely this community of yours is one community, and I am your Lord; so serve Me.'
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَكَذَٰلِكَ حَقَّتۡ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ أَنَّهُمۡ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ
Verse: وكذٰلك حقت كلمت ربك على الذين كفروا انهم اصحٰب النار
Sahih_International: And thus has the word of your Lord come into effect upon those who disbelieved that they are companions of the Fire.
Pickthall: Thus was the word of thy Lord concerning those who disbelieve fulfilled: That they are owners of the Fire.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Thus was the Decree of thy Lord proved true against the Unbelievers; that truly they are Companions of the Fire!
Shakir: And thus did the word of your Lord prove true against those who disbelieved that they are the inmates of the fire.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): The word of your Lord that the disbelievers will be the dwellers of hell fire has already been decreed.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Thus has the Word of your Lord been justified against those who disbelieved, that they will be the dwellers of the Fire.
Arberry: Even so the Word of thy Lord was realised against the unbelievers, that they are the inhabitants of the Fire.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: وَمَا هُمۡ عَنۡهَا بِغَآئِبِينَ
Verse: وما هم عنها بغائبين
Sahih_International: And never therefrom will they be absent.
Pickthall: And will not be absent thence.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And they will not be able to keep away therefrom.
Shakir: And they shall by no means be absent from it.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): to burn therein.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And they (Al-Fujjar) will not be absent therefrom (i.e. will not go out from the Hell).
Arberry: nor shall they ever be absent from it.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: قُلۡ مَنۡ حَرَّمَ زِينَةَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّتِيٓ أَخۡرَجَ لِعِبَادِهِۦ وَٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ مِنَ ٱلرِّزۡقِۚ قُلۡ هِيَ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا خَالِصَةٗ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِۗ كَذَٰلِكَ نُفَصِّلُ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ لِقَوۡمٖ يَعۡلَمُونَ
Verse: قل من حرم زينة الله التي اخرج لعباده والطيبٰت من الرزق قل هي للذين ءامنوا في الحيوٰة الدنيا خالصة يوم القيٰمة كذٰلك نفصل الايٰت لقوم يعلمون
Sahih_International: Say, "Who has forbidden the adornment of Allah which He has produced for His servants and the good [lawful] things of provision?" Say, "They are for those who believe during the worldly life [but] exclusively for them on the Day of Resurrection." Thus do We detail the verses for a people who know.
Pickthall: Say: Who hath forbidden the adornment of Allah which He hath brought forth for His bondmen, and the good things of His providing? Say: Such, on the Day of Resurrection, will be only for those who believed during the life of the world. Thus do we detail Our revelations for people who have knowledge.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Say: Who hath forbidden the beautiful (gifts) of Allah, which He hath produced for His servants, and the things, clean and pure, (which He hath provided) for sustenance? Say: They are, in the life of this world, for those who believe, (and) purely for them on the Day of Judgment. Thus do We explain the signs in detail for those who understand.
Shakir: Say: Who has prohibited the embellishment of Allah which He has brought forth for His servants and the good provisions? Say: These are for the believers in the life of this world, purely (theirs) on the resurrection day; thus do We make the communications clear for a people who know.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): (Muhammad), ask them, "Who has made it unlawful to maintain beauty and to eat the pure foods which God has created for His servants? They are made for the believers in this world and are exclusively for them in the life hereafter." Thus do We explain Our revelations to the people who have knowledge.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Say (O Muhammad SAW): "Who has forbidden the adoration with clothes given by Allah, which He has produced for his slaves, and At-Taiyibat [all kinds of Halal (lawful) things] of food?" Say: "They are, in the life of this world, for those who believe, (and) exclusively for them (believers) on the Day of Resurrection (the disbelievers will not share them)." Thus We explain the Ayat (Islamic laws) in detail for people who have knowledge.
Arberry: Say: 'Who has forbidden the ornament of God which He brought forth for His servants, and the good things of His providing?' Say: 'These, on the Day of Resurrection, shall be exclusively for those who believed in this present life. So We distinguish the signs for a people who know.'
Label: anger

Verse_diac: فَمَا تَنفَعُهُمۡ شَفَٰعَةُ ٱلشَّٰفِعِينَ
Verse: فما تنفعهم شفٰعة الشٰفعين
Sahih_International: So there will not benefit them the intercession of [any] intercessors.
Pickthall: The mediation of no mediators will avail them then.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Then will no intercession of (any) intercessors profit them.
Shakir: So the intercession of intercessors shall not avail them.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): The intercession of the intercessors will be of no benefit to them.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): So no intercession of intercessors will be of any use to them.
Arberry: Then the intercession of the intercessors shall not profit them.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَيُحِقُّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡحَقَّ بِكَلِمَٰتِهِۦ وَلَوۡ كَرِهَ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ
Verse: ويحق الله الحق بكلمٰته ولو كره المجرمون
Sahih_International: And Allah will establish the truth by His words, even if the criminals dislike it."
Pickthall: And Allah will vindicate the Truth by His words, however much the guilty be averse.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "And Allah by His words doth prove and establish His truth, however much the sinners may hate it!"
Shakir: And Allah will show the truth to be the truth by His words, though the guilty may be averse (to it).
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): God will make the Truth stand supreme by His words, even though the wicked people dislike it."
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "And Allah will establish and make apparent the truth by His Words, however much the Mujrimun (criminals, disbelievers, polytheists, sinners, etc.) may hate it."
Arberry: God verifies the truth by His words, though sinners be averse.'
Label: fear

Verse_diac: فَأَرَىٰهُ ٱلۡأٓيَةَ ٱلۡكُبۡرَىٰ
Verse: فارىٰه الاية الكبرىٰ
Sahih_International: And he showed him the greatest sign,
Pickthall: And he showed him the tremendous token.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Then did (Moses) show him the Great Sign.
Shakir: So he showed him the mighty sign.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Moses showed him the great miracle
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Then [Musa (Moses)] showed him the great sign (miracles).
Arberry: So he showed him the great sign,
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: وَأَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ أَعۡتَدۡنَا لَهُمۡ عَذَابًا أَلِيمٗا
Verse: وان الذين لا يؤمنون بالاخرة اعتدنا لهم عذابا اليما
Sahih_International: And that those who do not believe in the Hereafter - We have prepared for them a painful punishment.
Pickthall: And that those who believe not in the Hereafter, for them We have prepared a painful doom.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And to those who believe not in the Hereafter, (it announceth) that We have prepared for them a Penalty Grievous (indeed).
Shakir: And that (as for) those who do not believe in the hereafter, We have prepared for them a painful chastisement.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): (It also declares) that for the disbelievers We have prepared a painful torment in the life to come.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And that those who believe not in the Hereafter (i.e. they disbelieve that they will be recompensed for what they did in this world, good or bad, etc.), for them We have prepared a painful torment (Hell).
Arberry: and that those who do not believe in the world to come -- we have prepared for them a painful chastisement.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: إِنَّهُۥ عَلَىٰ رَجۡعِهِۦ لَقَادِرٞ
Verse: انه علىٰ رجعه لقادر
Sahih_International: Indeed, Allah , to return him [to life], is Able.
Pickthall: Lo! He verily is Able to return him (unto life)
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Surely (Allah) is able to bring him back (to life)!
Shakir: Most surely He is able to return him (to life).
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): God has all power to resurrect him.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Verily, (Allah) is Able to bring him back (to life)!
Arberry: Surely He is able to bring him back
Label: fear

Verse_diac: فَإِنَّمَا هِيَ زَجۡرَةٞ وَٰحِدَةٞ
Verse: فانما هي زجرة وٰحدة
Sahih_International: Indeed, it will be but one shout,
Pickthall: Surely it will need but one shout,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): But verily, it will be but a single (Compelling) Cry,
Shakir: But it shall be only a single cry,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): However, it will only take a single blast
Mohsin_Khan (MK): But only, it will be a single Zajrah [shout (i.e., the second blowing of the Trumpet)]. (See Verse 37:19).
Arberry: But it shall be only a single scare,
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰكَ إِلَّا كَآفَّةٗ لِّلنَّاسِ بَشِيرٗا وَنَذِيرٗا وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
Verse: وما ارسلنٰك الا كافة للناس بشيرا ونذيرا ولٰكن اكثر الناس لا يعلمون
Sahih_International: And We have not sent you except comprehensively to mankind as a bringer of good tidings and a warner. But most of the people do not know.
Pickthall: And We have not sent thee (O Muhammad) save as a bringer of good tidings and a warner unto all mankind; but most of mankind know not.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): We have not sent thee but as a universal (Messenger) to men, giving them glad tidings, and warning them (against sin), but most men understand not.
Shakir: And We have not sent you but to all the men as a bearer of good news and as a warner, but most men do not know.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We have sent you as a bearer of glad news and a warner to the whole of mankind, but most people do not know.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And We have not sent you (O Muhammad SAW) except as a giver of glad tidings and a warner to all mankind, but most of men know not.
Arberry: We have sent thee not, except to mankind entire, good tidings to bear, and warning; but most men do not know it.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: وَيَقُولُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَسۡتَ مُرۡسَلٗاۚ قُلۡ كَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ شَهِيدَۢا بَيۡنِي وَبَيۡنَكُمۡ وَمَنۡ عِندَهُۥ عِلۡمُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ
Verse: ويقول الذين كفروا لست مرسلا قل كفىٰ بالله شهيدا بيني وبينكم ومن عنده علم الكتٰب
Sahih_International: And those who have disbelieved say, "You are not a messenger." Say, [O Muhammad], "Sufficient is Allah as Witness between me and you, and [the witness of] whoever has knowledge of the Scripture."
Pickthall: They who disbelieve say: Thou art no messenger (of Allah). Say: Allah, and whosoever hath knowledge of the Scripture, is sufficient witness between me and you.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): The Unbelievers say: "No messenger art thou." Say: "Enough for a witness between me and you is Allah, and such as have knowledge of the Book."
Shakir: And those who disbelieve say: You are not a messenger. Say: Allah is sufficient as a witness between me and you and whoever has knowledge of the Book.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): (Muhammad), the unbelievers say, "You are not a Messenger." Say, "God and those who have the knowledge of the Book are sufficient witness (to my prophethood)."
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And those who disbelieve, say: "You (O Muhammad SAW) are not a Messenger." Say: "Sufficient for a witness between me and you is Allah and those too who have knowledge of the Scripture (such as 'Abdullah bin Salam and other Jews and Christians who embraced Islam)."
Arberry: The unbelievers say, 'Thou art not an Envoy.' Say: 'God suffices as a witness between me and you, and whosoever possesses knowledge of the Book.'
Label: fear

Verse_diac: فَأَمَّا مَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَٰلِحٗا فَعَسَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُفۡلِحِينَ
Verse: فاما من تاب وءامن وعمل صٰلحا فعسىٰ ان يكون من المفلحين
Sahih_International: But as for one who had repented, believed, and done righteousness, it is promised by Allah that he will be among the successful.
Pickthall: But as for him who shall repent and believe and do right, he haply may be one of the successful.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): But any that (in this life) had repented, believed, and worked righteousness, will have hopes to be among those who achieve salvation.
Shakir: But as to him who repents and believes and does good, maybe he will be among the successful:
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): However, those who have repented and have become righteously striving believers will perhaps have everlasting happiness.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): But as for him who repented (from polytheism and sins, etc.), believed (in the Oneness of Allah, and in His Messenger Muhammad SAW), and did righteous deeds (in the life of this world), then he will be among those who are successful.
Arberry: But as for him who repents, and believes, and works righteousness, haply he shall be among the prosperers.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَٱذۡكُرِ ٱسۡمَ رَبِّكَ وَتَبَتَّلۡ إِلَيۡهِ تَبۡتِيلٗا
Verse: واذكر اسم ربك وتبتل اليه تبتيلا
Sahih_International: And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with [complete] devotion.
Pickthall: So remember the name of thy Lord and devote thyself with a complete devotion -
Yusuf_Ali (YA): But keep in remembrance the name of thy Lord and devote thyself to Him whole-heartedly.
Shakir: And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with (exclusive) devotion.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Glorify the Name of your Lord, the Lord of the eastern and western regions, with due sincerity.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And remember the Name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with a complete devotion.
Arberry: And remember the Name of thy Lord, and devote thyself unto Him very devoutly.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: أَمۡ لِلۡإِنسَٰنِ مَا تَمَنَّىٰ
Verse: ام للانسٰن ما تمنىٰ
Sahih_International: Or is there for man whatever he wishes?
Pickthall: Or shall man have what he coveteth?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Nay, shall man have (just) anything he hankers after?
Shakir: Or shall man have what he wishes?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Can the human being have whatever he wishes?
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Or shall man have what he wishes?
Arberry: Or shall man have whatever he fancies?
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَأَقۡبَلَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
Verse: واقبل بعضهم علىٰ بعض يتساءلون
Sahih_International: And they will approach one another blaming each other.
Pickthall: And some of them draw near unto others, mutually questioning.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And they will turn to one another, and question one another.
Shakir: And some of them shall advance towards others, questioning each other.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): They will turn to each other saying,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And they will turn to one another and question one another.
Arberry: and advance one upon another, asking each other questions.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: أُفّٖ لَّكُمۡ وَلِمَا تَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِۚ أَفَلَا تَعۡقِلُونَ
Verse: اف لكم ولما تعبدون من دون الله افلا تعقلون
Sahih_International: Uff to you and to what you worship instead of Allah. Then will you not use reason?"
Pickthall: Fie on you and all that ye worship instead of Allah! Have ye then no sense?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "Fie upon you, and upon the things that ye worship besides Allah! Have ye no sense?"..
Shakir: Fie on you and on what you serve besides Allah; what! do you not then understand?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Woe to you for what you worship instead of God. Have you no understanding?"
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "Fie upon you, and upon that which you worship besides Allah! Have you then no sense?"
Arberry: Fie upon you and that you serve apart from God! Do you not understand?'
Label: anger

Verse_diac: تَكَادُ تَمَيَّزُ مِنَ ٱلۡغَيۡظِۖ كُلَّمَآ أُلۡقِيَ فِيهَا فَوۡجٞ سَأَلَهُمۡ خَزَنَتُهَآ أَلَمۡ يَأۡتِكُمۡ نَذِيرٞ
Verse: تكاد تميز من الغيظ كلما القي فيها فوج سالهم خزنتها الم ياتكم نذير
Sahih_International: It almost bursts with rage. Every time a company is thrown into it, its keepers ask them, "Did there not come to you a warner?"
Pickthall: As it would burst with rage. Whenever a (fresh) host is flung therein the wardens thereof ask them: Came there unto you no warner?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Almost bursting with fury: Every time a Group is cast therein, its Keepers will ask, "Did no Warner come to you?"
Shakir: Almost bursting for fury. Whenever a group is cast into it, its keeper shall ask them: Did there not come to you a warner?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): It almost explodes in rage. Whenever a group is thrown into it, its keepers will ask them, "Did no one come to warn you?"
Mohsin_Khan (MK): It almost bursts up with fury. Every time a group is cast therein, its keeper will ask: "Did no warner come to you?"
Arberry: and wellnigh bursts asunder with rage. As often as a troop is cast into it, its keepers ask them, 'Came there no warner to you?';
Label: fear

Verse_diac: قَالَ إِنِّي لَيَحۡزُنُنِيٓ أَن تَذۡهَبُواْ بِهِۦ وَأَخَافُ أَن يَأۡكُلَهُ ٱلذِّئۡبُ وَأَنتُمۡ عَنۡهُ غَٰفِلُونَ
Verse: قال اني ليحزنني ان تذهبوا به واخاف ان ياكله الذئب وانتم عنه غٰفلون
Sahih_International: [Jacob] said, "Indeed, it saddens me that you should take him, and I fear that a wolf would eat him while you are of him unaware."
Pickthall: He said: Lo! in truth it saddens me that ye should take him with you, and I fear less the wolf devour him while ye are heedless of him.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): (Jacob) said: "Really it saddens me that ye should take him away: I fear lest the wolf should devour him while ye attend not to him."
Shakir: He said: Surely it grieves me that you should take him off, and I fear lest the wolf devour him while you are heedless of him.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Jacob replied, "I shall be grieved if you take him with you; I fear that some wild-beast will harm him in your absence."
Mohsin_Khan (MK): He [Ya'qub (Jacob)] said: "Truly, it saddens me that you should take him away. I fear lest a wolf should devour him, while you are careless of him."
Arberry: He said, 'It grieves me that you should go with him, and I fear the wolf may eat him, while you are heedless of him.'
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: قُلۡ جَآءَ ٱلۡحَقُّ وَمَا يُبۡدِئُ ٱلۡبَٰطِلُ وَمَا يُعِيدُ
Verse: قل جاء الحق وما يبدئ البٰطل وما يعيد
Sahih_International: Say, "The truth has come, and falsehood can neither begin [anything] nor repeat [it]."
Pickthall: Say: The Truth hath come, and falsehood showeth not its face and will not return.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Say: "The Truth has arrived, and Falsehood neither creates anything new, nor restores anything."
Shakir: Say: The truth has come, and the falsehood shall vanish and shall not come back.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Say, "The truth has come. Falsehood has vanished and it will not come back again".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Say (O Muhammad SAW): "The truth (the Quran and Allah's Inspiration) has come, and Al­Batil [falsehood - Iblis (Satan)] can neither create anything nor resurrect (anything)."
Arberry: Say. 'Truth has come; falsehood originates not, nor brings again.'
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَلَوۡ أَنَّهُمۡ صَبَرُواْ حَتَّىٰ تَخۡرُجَ إِلَيۡهِمۡ لَكَانَ خَيۡرٗا لَّهُمۡۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ
Verse: ولو انهم صبروا حتىٰ تخرج اليهم لكان خيرا لهم والله غفور رحيم
Sahih_International: And if they had been patient until you [could] come out to them, it would have been better for them. But Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
Pickthall: And if they had had patience till thou camest forth unto them, it had been better for them. And Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): If only they had patience until thou couldst come out to them, it would be best for them: but Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
Shakir: And if they wait patiently until you come out to them, it would certainly be better for them, and Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Had they exercised patience until you had come out, it would have been better for them. God is All-forgiving and All-merciful.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And if they had patience till you could come out to them, it would have been better for them. And Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
Arberry: And if they had patience, until thou comest out to them, that would be better for them; and God is All-forgiving, All-compassionate.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: وَمَا يَنطِقُ عَنِ ٱلۡهَوَىٰٓ
Verse: وما ينطق عن الهوىٰ
Sahih_International: Nor does he speak from [his own] inclination.
Pickthall: Nor doth he speak of (his own) desire.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Nor does he say (aught) of (his own) Desire.
Shakir: Nor does he speak out of desire.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): He does not speak out of his own desires.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Nor does he speak of (his own) desire.
Arberry: nor speaks he out of caprice.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: أَرۡسِلۡهُ مَعَنَا غَدٗا يَرۡتَعۡ وَيَلۡعَبۡ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَٰفِظُونَ
Verse: ارسله معنا غدا يرتع ويلعب وانا له لحٰفظون
Sahih_International: Send him with us tomorrow that he may eat well and play. And indeed, we will be his guardians.
Pickthall: Send him with us to-morrow that he may enjoy himself and play. And lo! we shall take good care of him.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "Send him with us tomorrow to enjoy himself and play, and we shall take every care of him."
Shakir: Send him with us tomorrow that he may enjoy himself and sport, and surely we will guard him well.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Send him with us tomorrow to play with us and enjoy himself. We shall carefully protect him".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "Send him with us tomorrow to enjoy himself and play, and verily, we will take care of him."
Arberry: Send him forth with us tomorrow, to frolic and play; surely we shall be watching over him.'
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: يُرۡسِلِ ٱلسَّمَآءَ عَلَيۡكُم مِّدۡرَارٗا
Verse: يرسل السماء عليكم مدرارا
Sahih_International: He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers
Pickthall: He will let loose the sky for you in plenteous rain,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "'He will send rain to you in abundance;
Shakir: He will send down upon you the cloud, pouring down abundance of rain:
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): He will send you abundant
Mohsin_Khan (MK): 'He will send rain to you in abundance;
Arberry: and He will loose heaven upon you in torrents
Label: joy

Verse_diac: أَلَمۡ نَشۡرَحۡ لَكَ صَدۡرَكَ
Verse: الم نشرح لك صدرك
Sahih_International: Did We not expand for you, [O Muhammad], your breast?
Pickthall: Have We not caused thy bosom to dilate,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Have We not expanded thee thy breast?-
Shakir: Have We not expanded for you your breast,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): (Muhammad), have We not comforted your heart,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Have We not opened your breast for you (O Muhammad (Peace be upon him))?
Arberry: Did We not expand thy breast for thee
Label: joy

Verse_diac: ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمۡ خَٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُؤۡفَكُونَ
Verse: ذٰلكم الله ربكم خٰلق كل شيء لا الٰه الا هو فانىٰ تؤفكون
Sahih_International: That is Allah , your Lord, Creator of all things; there is no deity except Him, so how are you deluded?
Pickthall: Such is Allah, your Lord, the Creator of all things, There is no Allah save Him. How then are ye perverted?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Such is Allah, your Lord, the Creator of all things, there is no god but He: Then how ye are deluded away from the Truth!
Shakir: That is Allah, your Lord, the Creator of everything; there is no Allah but He; whence are you then turned away?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): It is God, your Lord, Who has created all things. He is the only Lord. Why then do you turn away from His worship to the worshipping of idols?
Mohsin_Khan (MK): That is Allah, your Lord, the Creator of all things, La ilaha illa Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He), where then you are turning away (from Allah, by worshipping others instead of Him)!
Arberry: That then is God, your Lord, the Creator of everything; there is no god but He. How then are you perverted?
Label: joy

Verse_diac: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي ظِلَٰلٖ وَعُيُونٖ
Verse: ان المتقين في ظلٰل وعيون
Sahih_International: Indeed, the righteous will be among shades and springs
Pickthall: Lo! those who kept their duty are amid shade and fountains,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): As to the Righteous, they shall be amidst (cool) shades and springs (of water).
Shakir: Surely those who guard (against evil) shall be amid shades and fountains,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): The pious ones will rest amid the shade, springs,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Verily, the Muttaqun (pious - see V.2:2) shall be amidst shades and springs.
Arberry: Truly the godfearing shall dwell amid shades and fountains,
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَيَقُولُونَ أَئِنَّا لَتَارِكُوٓاْ ءَالِهَتِنَا لِشَاعِرٖ مَّجۡنُونِۭ
Verse: ويقولون ائنا لتاركوا ءالهتنا لشاعر مجنون
Sahih_International: And were saying, "Are we to leave our gods for a mad poet?"
Pickthall: And said: Shall we forsake our gods for a mad poet?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And say: "What! shall we give up our gods for the sake of a Poet possessed?"
Shakir: And to say: What! shall we indeed give up our gods for the sake of a mad poet?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): and said, "Should we give up our idols for the sake of an insane poet".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And (they) said: "Are we going to abandon our aliha (gods) for the sake of a mad poet?
Arberry: saying, 'What, shall we forsake our gods for a poet possessed?'
Label: anger

Verse_diac: فَٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ مَكۡرِهِمۡ أَنَّا دَمَّرۡنَٰهُمۡ وَقَوۡمَهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
Verse: فانظر كيف كان عٰقبة مكرهم انا دمرنٰهم وقومهم اجمعين
Sahih_International: Then look how was the outcome of their plan - that We destroyed them and their people, all.
Pickthall: Then see the nature of the consequence of their plotting, for lo! We destroyed them and their people, every one.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Then see what was the end of their plot!- this, that We destroyed them and their people, all (of them).
Shakir: See, then, how was the end of their plan that We destroyed them and their people, all (of them).
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We destroyed them and their people altogether.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Then see how was the end of their plot! Verily! We destroyed them and their nation, all together.
Arberry: and behold, how was the end of their device! For We destroyed them and their people all together.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: يُعۡرَفُ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ بِسِيمَٰهُمۡ فَيُؤۡخَذُ بِٱلنَّوَٰصِي وَٱلۡأَقۡدَامِ
Verse: يعرف المجرمون بسيمٰهم فيؤخذ بالنوٰصي والاقدام
Sahih_International: The criminals will be known by their marks, and they will be seized by the forelocks and the feet.
Pickthall: The guilty will be known by their marks, and will be taken by the forelocks and the feet.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): (For) the sinners will be known by their marks: and they will be seized by their forelocks and their feet.
Shakir: The guilty shall be recognized by their marks, so they shall be seized by the forelocks and the feet.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): The guilty ones will be recognized by their faces and will be seized by their forelocks and feet.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): The Mujrimun (polytheists, criminals, sinners, etc.) will be known by their marks (black faces), and they will be seized by their forelocks and their feet.
Arberry: The sinners shall be known by their mark, and they shall be seized by their forelocks and their feet.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: وَٱلۡمُؤۡتَفِكَةَ أَهۡوَىٰ
Verse: والمؤتفكة اهوىٰ
Sahih_International: And the overturned towns He hurled down
Pickthall: And Al-Mu'tafikah He destroyed
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And He destroyed the Overthrown Cities (of Sodom and Gomorrah).
Shakir: And the overthrown cities did He overthrow,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): It is He who turned upside down the people of Lot
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And He destroyed the overthrown cities [of Sodom to which Prophet Lout (Lot) was sent].
Arberry: and the Subverted City He also overthrew,
Label: anger

Verse_diac: فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمۡ سَلَفٗا وَمَثَلٗا لِّلۡأٓخِرِينَ
Verse: فجعلنٰهم سلفا ومثلا للاخرين
Sahih_International: And We made them a precedent and an example for the later peoples.
Pickthall: And We made them a thing past, and an example for those after (them).
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And We made them (a people) of the Past and an Example to later ages.
Shakir: And We made them a precedent and example to the later generations.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We made them become of the people of the past and an example for the coming generations.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And We made them a precedent (as a lesson for those coming after them), and an example to later generations.
Arberry: and We made them a thing past, and We appointed them for an example to later folk.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: مِن نُّطۡفَةٍ خَلَقَهُۥ فَقَدَّرَهُۥ
Verse: من نطفة خلقه فقدره
Sahih_International: From a sperm-drop He created him and destined for him;
Pickthall: From a drop of seed. He createth him and proportioneth him,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): From a sperm-drop: He hath created him, and then mouldeth him in due proportions;
Shakir: Of a small seed; He created him, then He made him according to a measure,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): He created him from a living germ. He determined his fate
Mohsin_Khan (MK): From Nutfah (male and female semen drops) He created him, and then set him in due proportion;
Arberry: Of a sperm-drop He created him, and determined him,
Label: fear

Verse_diac: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا مَا دَامَتِ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ وَٱلۡأَرۡضُ إِلَّا مَا شَآءَ رَبُّكَۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ فَعَّالٞ لِّمَا يُرِيدُ
Verse: خٰلدين فيها ما دامت السمٰوٰت والارض الا ما شاء ربك ان ربك فعال لما يريد
Sahih_International: [They will be] abiding therein as long as the heavens and the earth endure, except what your Lord should will. Indeed, your Lord is an effecter of what He intends.
Pickthall: Abiding there so long as the heavens and the earth endure save for that which thy Lord willeth. Lo! thy Lord is Doer of what He will.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): They will dwell therein for all the time that the heavens and the earth endure, except as thy Lord willeth: for thy Lord is the (sure) accomplisher of what He planneth.
Shakir: Abiding therein so long as the heavens and the earth endure, except as your Lord please; surely your Lord is the mighty doer of what He intends.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): for as long as the heavens and the earth exist, unless your Lord decides otherwise. Your Lord will certainly accomplish whatever He wants.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): They will dwell therein for all the time that the heavens and the earth endure, except as your Lord wills. Verily, your Lord is the doer of what He wills.
Arberry: so long as the heavens and earth abide, save as thy Lord will; surely thy Lord accomplishes what He desires.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: كَلَّآۖ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لِأٓيَٰتِنَا عَنِيدٗا
Verse: كلا انه كان لايٰتنا عنيدا
Sahih_International: No! Indeed, he has been toward Our verses obstinate.
Pickthall: Nay! For lo! he hath been stubborn to Our revelations.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): By no means! For to Our Signs he has been refractory!
Shakir: By no means! surely he offers opposition to Our communications.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Never will he receive more. He has been hostile to Our revelations.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Nay! Verily, he has been stubborn and opposing Our Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.).
Arberry: Nay! He is forward unto Our signs;
Label: anger

Verse_diac: وَمَا عَلَيۡنَآ إِلَّا ٱلۡبَلَٰغُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ
Verse: وما علينا الا البلٰغ المبين
Sahih_International: And we are not responsible except for clear notification."
Pickthall: And our duty is but plain conveyance (of the message).
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "And our duty is only to proclaim the clear Message."
Shakir: And nothing devolves on us but a clear deliverance (of the message).
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): who have been sent to you. Our only duty is to preach clearly to you".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "And our duty is only to convey plainly (the Message)."
Arberry: and it is only for us to deliver the Manifest Message.'
Label: fear

Verse_diac: هَٰذِهِۦ جَهَنَّمُ ٱلَّتِي كُنتُمۡ تُوعَدُونَ
Verse: هٰذه جهنم التي كنتم توعدون
Sahih_International: This is the Hellfire which you were promised.
Pickthall: This is hell which ye were promised (if ye followed him).
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "This is the Hell of which ye were (repeatedly) warned!
Shakir: This is the hell with which you were threatened.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): This is hell with which you were threatened.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): This is Hell which you were promised!
Arberry: This is Gehenna, then, the same that you were promised;
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَأَمۡدَدۡنَٰهُم بِفَٰكِهَةٖ وَلَحۡمٖ مِّمَّا يَشۡتَهُونَ
Verse: وامددنٰهم بفٰكهة ولحم مما يشتهون
Sahih_International: And We will provide them with fruit and meat from whatever they desire.
Pickthall: And We provide them with fruit and meat such as they desire.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And We shall bestow on them, of fruit and meat, anything they shall desire.
Shakir: And We will aid them with fruit and flesh such as they desire.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We shall provide them with fruits and the meat of the kind which they desire.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And We shall provide them with fruit and meat, such as they desire.
Arberry: And We shall succour them with fruits and flesh such as they desire
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَقُل لِّلَّذِينَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ ٱعۡمَلُواْ عَلَىٰ مَكَانَتِكُمۡ إِنَّا عَٰمِلُونَ
Verse: وقل للذين لا يؤمنون اعملوا علىٰ مكانتكم انا عٰملون
Sahih_International: And say to those who do not believe, "Work according to your position; indeed, we are working.
Pickthall: And say unto those who believe not: Act according to your power. Lo! We (too) are acting.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Say to those who do not believe: "Do what ever ye can: We shall do our part;
Shakir: And say to those who do not believe: Act according to your state; surely we too are acting.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Tell the unbelievers, "Do as you wish and I will do as I believe.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And say to those who do not believe: "Act according to your ability and way, We are acting (in our way).
Arberry: And say to the unbelievers: 'Act you according to your station; we are acting.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: قَالَ إِنَّ هَٰٓؤُلَآءِ ضَيۡفِي فَلَا تَفۡضَحُونِ
Verse: قال ان هٰؤلاء ضيفي فلا تفضحون
Sahih_International: [Lot] said, "Indeed, these are my guests, so do not shame me.
Pickthall: He said: Lo! they are my guests. Affront me not!
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Lut said: "These are my guests: disgrace me not:
Shakir: He said: Surely these are my guests, therefore do not disgrace me,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): rushed towards the house of Lot. Lot said to them, "These are my guests. Do not disgrace me.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): [Lout (Lot)] said: "Verily! these are my guests, so shame me not.
Arberry: He said, 'These are my guests; put me not to shame,
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعۡجِزِينَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَلِيّٖ وَلَا نَصِيرٖ
Verse: وما انتم بمعجزين في الارض وما لكم من دون الله من ولي ولا نصير
Sahih_International: And you will not cause failure [to Allah] upon the earth. And you have not besides Allah any protector or helper.
Pickthall: Ye cannot escape in the earth, for beside Allah ye have no protecting friend nor any helper.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Nor can ye frustrate (aught), (fleeing) through the earth; nor have ye, besides Allah, any one to protect or to help.
Shakir: And you cannot escape in the earth, and you shall not have a guardian or a helper besides Allah.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): You cannot challenge God on earth and you will have no one besides Him as your guardian or helper.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And you cannot escape from Allah (i.e. His Punishment) in the earth, and besides Allah you have neither any Wali (guardian or a protector) nor any helper.
Arberry: You are not able to frustrate Him in the earth; and, apart from God, you have neither protector nor helper.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: يُلۡقُونَ ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَأَكۡثَرُهُمۡ كَٰذِبُونَ
Verse: يلقون السمع واكثرهم كٰذبون
Sahih_International: They pass on what is heard, and most of them are liars.
Pickthall: They listen eagerly, but most of them are liars.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): (Into whose ears) they pour hearsay vanities, and most of them are liars.
Shakir: They incline their ears, and most of them are liars.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): The satans try to listen to the heavens but many of them are liars.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Who gives ear (to the devils and they pour what they may have heard of the unseen from the angels), and most of them are liars.
Arberry: They give ear, but most of them are liars.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَبۡلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُتۡرَفِينَ
Verse: انهم كانوا قبل ذٰلك مترفين
Sahih_International: Indeed they were, before that, indulging in affluence,
Pickthall: Lo! heretofore they were effete with luxury
Yusuf_Ali (YA): For that they were wont to be indulged, before that, in wealth (and luxury),
Shakir: Surely they were before that made to live in ease and plenty.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): They had lived in luxury before this
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Verily, before that, they indulged in luxury,
Arberry: and before that they lived at ease,
Label: fear

Verse_diac: فَصَبَّ عَلَيۡهِمۡ رَبُّكَ سَوۡطَ عَذَابٍ
Verse: فصب عليهم ربك سوط عذاب
Sahih_International: So your Lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment.
Pickthall: Therefore thy Lord poured on them the disaster of His punishment.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Therefore did thy Lord pour on them a scourge of diverse chastisements:
Shakir: Therefore your Lord let down upon them a portion of the chastisement.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Thus, your Lord afflicted them with torment;
Mohsin_Khan (MK): So your Lord poured on them different kinds of severe torment.
Arberry: Thy Lord unloosed on them a scourge of chastisement;
Label: fear

Verse_diac: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ رِزۡقٞ مَّعۡلُومٞ
Verse: اولٰئك لهم رزق معلوم
Sahih_International: Those will have a provision determined -
Pickthall: For them there is a known provision,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): For them is a Sustenance determined,
Shakir: For them is a known sustenance,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): will have their determined sustenance
Mohsin_Khan (MK): For them there will be a known provision (in Paradise).
Arberry: for them awaits a known provision,
Label: joy

Verse_diac: فَسَتَذۡكُرُونَ مَآ أَقُولُ لَكُمۡۚ وَأُفَوِّضُ أَمۡرِيٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَصِيرُۢ بِٱلۡعِبَادِ
Verse: فستذكرون ما اقول لكم وافوض امري الى الله ان الله بصير بالعباد
Sahih_International: And you will remember what I [now] say to you, and I entrust my affair to Allah. Indeed, Allah is Seeing of [His] servants."
Pickthall: And ye will remember what I say unto you. I confide my cause unto Allah. Lo! Allah is Seer of (His) slaves.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "Soon will ye remember what I say to you (now), My (own) affair I commit to Allah: for Allah (ever) watches over His Servants."
Shakir: So you shall remember what I say to you, and I entrust my affair to Allah, Surely Allah sees the servants.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): You will soon recall what I have told you. I entrust God with my affairs. God is Well Aware of His servants."
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "And you will remember what I am telling you, and my affair I leave it to Allah. Verily, Allah is the All-Seer of (His) slaves."
Arberry: You will remember what I say to you. I commit my affair to God; surely God sees His servants.'
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: وَءَاخَرِينَ مِنۡهُمۡ لَمَّا يَلۡحَقُواْ بِهِمۡۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
Verse: وءاخرين منهم لما يلحقوا بهم وهو العزيز الحكيم
Sahih_International: And [to] others of them who have not yet joined them. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
Pickthall: Along with others of them who have not yet joined them. He is the Mighty, the Wise.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): As well as (to confer all these benefits upon) others of them, who have not already joined them: And He is exalted in Might, Wise.
Shakir: And others from among them who have not yet joined them; and He is the Mighty, the Wise.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): and others who have not yet joined, and He will give them wisdom. Before this they had been in plain error. God is Majestic and All-wise.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And He has sent him (Prophet Muhammad SAW) also to others among them (Muslims) who have not yet joined them (but they will come). And He (Allah) is the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
Arberry: and others of them who have not yet joined them. And He is the All-mighty, the All-wise.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: ثُمَّ تَوَلَّوۡاْ عَنۡهُ وَقَالُواْ مُعَلَّمٞ مَّجۡنُونٌ
Verse: ثم تولوا عنه وقالوا معلم مجنون
Sahih_International: Then they turned away from him and said, "[He was] taught [and is] a madman."
Pickthall: And they had turned away from him and said: One taught (by others), a madman?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Yet they turn away from him and say: "Tutored (by others), a man possessed!"
Shakir: Yet they turned their backs on him and said: One taught (by others), a madman.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): and they turned away, saying, "He is a trained and insane person".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Then they had turned away from him (Messenger Muhammad SAW) and said: "One (Muhammad SAW) taught (by a human being), a madman!"
Arberry: then they turned away from him and said, 'A man tutored, possessed!'
Label: anger

Verse_diac: وَلَقَدۡ كَذَّبَ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ نَكِيرِ
Verse: ولقد كذب الذين من قبلهم فكيف كان نكير
Sahih_International: And already had those before them denied, and how [terrible] was My reproach.
Pickthall: And verily those before them denied, then (see) the manner of My wrath (with them)!
Yusuf_Ali (YA): But indeed men before them rejected (My warning): then how (terrible) was My rejection (of them)?
Shakir: And certainly those before them rejected (the truth), then how was My disapproval.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Those who lived before them had also rejected Our warning, and how terrible was Our retribution!
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And indeed those before them belied (the Messengers of Allah), then how terrible was My denial (punishment)?
Arberry: Those that were before them also cried lies; then how was My horror!
Label: anger

Verse_diac: وَسِيقَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوۡاْ رَبَّهُمۡ إِلَى ٱلۡجَنَّةِ زُمَرًاۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءُوهَا وَفُتِحَتۡ أَبۡوَٰبُهَا وَقَالَ لَهُمۡ خَزَنَتُهَا سَلَٰمٌ عَلَيۡكُمۡ طِبۡتُمۡ فَٱدۡخُلُوهَا خَٰلِدِينَ
Verse: وسيق الذين اتقوا ربهم الى الجنة زمرا حتىٰ اذا جاءوها وفتحت ابوٰبها وقال لهم خزنتها سلٰم عليكم طبتم فادخلوها خٰلدين
Sahih_International: But those who feared their Lord will be driven to Paradise in groups until, when they reach it while its gates have been opened and its keepers say, "Peace be upon you; you have become pure; so enter it to abide eternally therein," [they will enter].
Pickthall: And those who keep their duty to their Lord are driven unto the Garden in troops till, when they reach it, and the gates thereof are opened, and the warders thereof say unto them: Peace be unto you! Ye are good, so enter ye (the Garden of delight), to dwell therein;
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And those who feared their Lord will be led to the Garden in crowds: until behold, they arrive there; its gates will be opened; and its keepers will say: "Peace be upon you! well have ye done! enter ye here, to dwell therein."
Shakir: And those who are careful of (their duty to) their Lord shall be conveyed to the garden in companies; until when they come to it, and its doors shall be opened, and the keepers of it shall say to them: Peace be on you, you shall be happy; therefore enter it to abide.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): The pious ones will be led to Paradise in large groups. Its gates will be opened to them when they are brought nearby and its keepers will say, "Welcome! Peace be with you. Enter the gates of Paradise to live therein forever".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And those who kept their duty to their Lord will be led to Paradise in groups, till, when they reach it, and its gates will be opened (before their arrival for their reception) and its keepers will say: Salamun 'Alaikum (peace be upon you)! You have done well, so enter here to abide therein."
Arberry: Then those that feared their Lord shall be driven in companies into Paradise, till, when they have come thither, and its gates are opened, and its keepers will say to them, 'Peace be upon you! Well you have fared; enter in, to dwell forever.'
Label: joy

Verse_diac: لَا يَسۡتَوِيٓ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ وَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡجَنَّةِۚ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡجَنَّةِ هُمُ ٱلۡفَآئِزُونَ
Verse: لا يستوي اصحٰب النار واصحٰب الجنة اصحٰب الجنة هم الفائزون
Sahih_International: Not equal are the companions of the Fire and the companions of Paradise. The companions of Paradise - they are the attainers [of success].
Pickthall: Not equal are the owners of the Fire and the owners of the Garden. The owners of the Garden, they are the victorious.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Not equal are the Companions of the Fire and the Companions of the Garden: it is the Companions of the Garden, that will achieve Felicity.
Shakir: Not alike are the inmates of the fire and the dwellers of the garden: the dwellers of the garden are they that are the achievers.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): The Companions of the Fire and the Companions of the Garden are not equal. The Companions of the Garden will achieve felicity.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Not equal are the dwellers of the Fire and the dwellers of the Paradise. It is the dwellers of Paradise that will be successful.
Arberry: Not equal are the inhabitants of the Fire and the inhabitants of Paradise. The inhabitants of Paradise -- they are the triumphant.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: فَٱلۡتَقَمَهُ ٱلۡحُوتُ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٞ
Verse: فالتقمه الحوت وهو مليم
Sahih_International: Then the fish swallowed him, while he was blameworthy.
Pickthall: And the fish swallowed him while he was blameworthy;
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Then the big Fish did swallow him, and he had done acts worthy of blame.
Shakir: So the fish swallowed him while he did that for which he blamed himself
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): The fish swallowed him up and he deserved (all this).
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Then a (big) fish swallowed him and he had done an act worthy of blame.
Arberry: then the whale swallowed him down, and he blameworthy.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: ثُمَّ أَغۡرَقۡنَا ٱلۡأٓخَرِينَ
Verse: ثم اغرقنا الاخرين
Sahih_International: Then We drowned the others.
Pickthall: And We drowned the others.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): But We drowned the others.
Shakir: Then We drowned the others.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We saved Moses and all the people with him
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Then We drowned the others.
Arberry: then We drowned the others.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: لَّا يَأۡكُلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلۡخَٰطِـُٔونَ
Verse: لا ياكله الا الخٰطون
Sahih_International: None will eat it except the sinners.
Pickthall: Which none but sinners eat.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "Which none do eat but those in sin."
Shakir: Which none but the wrongdoers eat.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): which only the sinners eat".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): None will eat except the Khati'un (sinners, disbelievers, polytheists, etc.).
Arberry: that none excepting the sinners eat.'
Label: fear

Verse_diac: بِمَا غَفَرَ لِي رَبِّي وَجَعَلَنِي مِنَ ٱلۡمُكۡرَمِينَ
Verse: بما غفر لي ربي وجعلني من المكرمين
Sahih_International: Of how my Lord has forgiven me and placed me among the honored."
Pickthall: With what (munificence) my Lord hath pardoned me and made me of the honoured ones!
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "For that my Lord has granted me Forgiveness and has enrolled me among those held in honour!"
Shakir: Of that on account of which my Lord has forgiven me and made me of the honored ones!
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): (wherein he said), "Would that people knew how my Lord has granted me forgiveness and honor".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "That my Lord (Allah) has forgiven me, and made me of the honoured ones!"
Arberry: that my Lord has forgiven me and that He has placed me among the honoured.'
Label: joy

Verse_diac: أَيَحۡسَبُ أَن لَّن يَقۡدِرَ عَلَيۡهِ أَحَدٞ
Verse: ايحسب ان لن يقدر عليه احد
Sahih_International: Does he think that never will anyone overcome him?
Pickthall: Thinketh he that none hath power over him?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Thinketh he, that none hath power over him?
Shakir: Does he think that no one has power over him?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Does He think that no one will ever have control over him?
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Thinks he that none can overcome him?
Arberry: What, does he think none has power over him,
Label: fear

Verse_diac: إِنِّي وَجَدتُّ ٱمۡرَأَةٗ تَمۡلِكُهُمۡ وَأُوتِيَتۡ مِن كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ وَلَهَا عَرۡشٌ عَظِيمٞ
Verse: اني وجدت امراة تملكهم واوتيت من كل شيء ولها عرش عظيم
Sahih_International: Indeed, I found [there] a woman ruling them, and she has been given of all things, and she has a great throne.
Pickthall: Lo! I found a woman ruling over them, and she hath been given (abundance) of all things, and hers is a mighty throne.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "I found (there) a woman ruling over them and provided with every requisite; and she has a magnificent throne.
Shakir: Surely I found a woman ruling over them, and she has been given abundance and she has a mighty throne:
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): I found a woman ruling the people there and she possessed something of (almost) everything and a great throne.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "I found a woman ruling over them, and she has been given all things that could be possessed by any ruler of the earth, and she has a great throne.
Arberry: I found a woman ruling over them, and she has been given of everything, and she possesses a mighty throne.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: يُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُ وَيَرۡحَمُ مَن يَشَآءُۖ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُقۡلَبُونَ
Verse: يعذب من يشاء ويرحم من يشاء واليه تقلبون
Sahih_International: He punishes whom He wills and has mercy upon whom He wills, and to Him you will be returned.
Pickthall: He punisheth whom He will and showeth mercy unto whom He will, and unto Him ye will be turned.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "He punishes whom He pleases, and He grants Mercy to whom He pleases, and towards Him are ye turned.
Shakir: He punishes whom He pleases and has mercy on whom He pleases, and to Him you shall be turned back.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): He punishes or grants mercy to whomever He wants and to Him you will all return.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): He punishes whom He will, and shows mercy to whom He will, and to Him you will be returned.
Arberry: chastising whom He will, and having mercy on whomsoever He will, and unto Him you shall be turned.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: فَإِن لَّمۡ تَأۡتُونِي بِهِۦ فَلَا كَيۡلَ لَكُمۡ عِندِي وَلَا تَقۡرَبُونِ
Verse: فان لم تاتوني به فلا كيل لكم عندي ولا تقربون
Sahih_International: But if you do not bring him to me, no measure will there be [hereafter] for you from me, nor will you approach me."
Pickthall: And if ye bring him not unto me, then there shall be no measure for you with me, nor shall ye draw near.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "Now if ye bring him not to me, ye shall have no measure (of corn) from me, nor shall ye (even) come near me."
Shakir: But if you do not bring him to me, you shall have no measure (of corn) from me, nor shall you come near me.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): If you do not bring him, do not come to us for we shall not give you any more grain."
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "But if you bring him not to me, there shall be no measure (of corn) for you with me, nor shall you come near me."
Arberry: But if you bring him not to me, there shall be no measure for you with me, neither shall you come nigh me.'
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ مَنَامُكُم بِٱلَّيۡلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَٱبۡتِغَآؤُكُم مِّن فَضۡلِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَسۡمَعُونَ
Verse: ومن ءايٰته منامكم باليل والنهار وابتغاؤكم من فضله ان في ذٰلك لايٰت لقوم يسمعون
Sahih_International: And of His signs is your sleep by night and day and your seeking of His bounty. Indeed in that are signs for a people who listen.
Pickthall: And of His signs is your slumber by night and by day, and your seeking of His bounty. Lo! herein indeed are portents for folk who heed.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And among His Signs is the sleep that ye take by night and by day, and the quest that ye (make for livelihood) out of His Bounty: verily in that are signs for those who hearken.
Shakir: And one of His signs is your sleeping and your seeking of His grace by night and (by) day; most surely there are signs in this for a people who would hear.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Your sleeping during the night and in the day your seeking His favors are evidence (of the truth) for the people who have hearing.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And among His Signs is the sleep that you take by night and by day, and your seeking of His Bounty. Verily, in that are indeed signs for a people who listen.
Arberry: And of His signs is your slumbering by night and day, and your seeking after His bounty. Surely in that are signs for a people who hear.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَتَذَرُونَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةَ
Verse: وتذرون الاخرة
Sahih_International: And leave the Hereafter.
Pickthall: And neglect the Hereafter.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And leave alone the Hereafter.
Shakir: And neglect the hereafter.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): and neglect the life to come.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And leave (neglect) the Hereafter.
Arberry: and leave be the Hereafter.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَمِنۡهُم مَّن يُؤۡمِنُ بِهِۦ وَمِنۡهُم مَّن لَّا يُؤۡمِنُ بِهِۦۚ وَرَبُّكَ أَعۡلَمُ بِٱلۡمُفۡسِدِينَ
Verse: ومنهم من يؤمن به ومنهم من لا يؤمن به وربك اعلم بالمفسدين
Sahih_International: And of them are those who believe in it, and of them are those who do not believe in it. And your Lord is most knowing of the corrupters
Pickthall: And of them is he who believeth therein, and of them is he who believeth not therein, and thy Lord is Best Aware of the corrupters.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Of them there are some who believe therein, and some who do not: and thy Lord knoweth best those who are out for mischief.
Shakir: And of them is he who believes in it, and of them is he who does not believe in it, and your Lord best knows the mischief-makers.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Some of them believe in the Quran and others do not. Your Lord knows best the evil doers.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And of them there are some who believe therein, and of them there are some who believe not therein, and your Lord is All-Aware of the Mufsidun (evil-doers, liars, etc.).
Arberry: And some of them believe in it, and some believe not in it. Thy Lord knows very well those who do corruption.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: يَٰعِبَادِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ إِنَّ أَرۡضِي وَٰسِعَةٞ فَإِيَّٰيَ فَٱعۡبُدُونِ
Verse: يٰعبادي الذين ءامنوا ان ارضي وٰسعة فايٰي فاعبدون
Sahih_International: O My servants who have believed, indeed My earth is spacious, so worship only Me.
Pickthall: O my bondmen who believe! Lo! My earth is spacious. Therefor serve Me only.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): O My servants who believe! truly, spacious is My Earth: therefore serve ye Me - (and Me alone)!
Shakir: O My servants who believe! surely My earth is vast, therefore Me alone should you serve.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): My believing servants, My land is vast. Worship Me alone.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): O My slaves who believe! Certainly, spacious is My earth. Therefore worship Me (Alone)."
Arberry: O My servants who believe, surely My earth is wide; therefore Me do you serve!
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَلَا تُطِعِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ وَٱلۡمُنَٰفِقِينَ وَدَعۡ أَذَىٰهُمۡ وَتَوَكَّلۡ عَلَى ٱللَّهِۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِٱللَّهِ وَكِيلٗا
Verse: ولا تطع الكٰفرين والمنٰفقين ودع اذىٰهم وتوكل على الله وكفىٰ بالله وكيلا
Sahih_International: And do not obey the disbelievers and the hypocrites but do not harm them, and rely upon Allah. And sufficient is Allah as Disposer of affairs.
Pickthall: And incline not to the disbelievers and the hypocrites. Disregard their noxious talk, and put thy trust in Allah. Allah is sufficient as Trustee.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And obey not (the behests) of the Unbelievers and the Hypocrites, and heed not their annoyances, but put thy Trust in Allah. For enough is Allah as a Disposer of affairs.
Shakir: And be not compliant to the unbelievers and the hypocrites, and leave unregarded their annoying talk, and rely on Allah; and Allah is sufficient as a Protector.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Do not yield to the disbelievers or the hypocrites. Ignore their annoying you. Trust in God. God is your all Sufficient Protector.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And obey not the disbelievers and the hypocrites, and harm them not (till you are ordered). And put your trust in Allah, and Sufficient is Allah as a Wakil (Trustee, or Disposer of affairs).
Arberry: And obey not the unbelievers and the hypocrites; heed not their hurt, but put thy trust in God; God suffices as a guardian.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَلَقَد تَّرَكۡنَا مِنۡهَآ ءَايَةَۢ بَيِّنَةٗ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَعۡقِلُونَ
Verse: ولقد تركنا منها ءاية بينة لقوم يعقلون
Sahih_International: And We have certainly left of it a sign as clear evidence for a people who use reason.
Pickthall: And verily of that We have left a clear sign for people who have sense.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And We have left thereof an evident Sign, for any people who (care to) understand.
Shakir: And certainly We have left a clear sign of it for a people who understand.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We left manifest evidence (of the truth) there for the people of understanding.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And indeed We have left thereof an evident Ayah (a lesson and a warning and a sign the place where the Dead Sea is now in Palestine) for a folk who understand.
Arberry: And indeed, We have left thereof a sign, a clear sign? unto a people who understand.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَإِن يَكَادُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَيُزۡلِقُونَكَ بِأَبۡصَٰرِهِمۡ لَمَّا سَمِعُواْ ٱلذِّكۡرَ وَيَقُولُونَ إِنَّهُۥ لَمَجۡنُونٞ
Verse: وان يكاد الذين كفروا ليزلقونك بابصٰرهم لما سمعوا الذكر ويقولون انه لمجنون
Sahih_International: And indeed, those who disbelieve would almost make you slip with their eyes when they hear the message, and they say, "Indeed, he is mad."
Pickthall: And lo! those who disbelieve would fain disconcert thee with their eyes when they hear the Reminder, and they say: Lo! he is indeed mad;
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And the Unbelievers would almost trip thee up with their eyes when they hear the Message; and they say: "Surely he is possessed!"
Shakir: And those who disbelieve would almost smite you with their eyes when they hear the reminder, and they say: Most surely he is mad.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): When the disbelievers listen to you reciting the Quran they almost try to destroy you with their piercing eyes. Then they say, "He is certainly insane".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And verily, those who disbelieve would almost make you slip with their eyes through hatredness when they hear the Reminder (the Quran), and they say: "Verily, he (Muhammad SAW) is a madman!"
Arberry: The unbelievers wellnigh strike thee down with their glances, when they hear the Reminder, and they say, 'Surely he is a man possessed!'
Label: anger

Verse_diac: وَنَزَّلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءٗ مُّبَٰرَكٗا فَأَنۢبَتۡنَا بِهِۦ جَنَّٰتٖ وَحَبَّ ٱلۡحَصِيدِ
Verse: ونزلنا من السماء ماء مبٰركا فانبتنا به جنٰت وحب الحصيد
Sahih_International: And We have sent down blessed rain from the sky and made grow thereby gardens and grain from the harvest
Pickthall: And We send down from the sky blessed water whereby We give growth unto gardens and the grain of crops,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And We send down from the sky rain charted with blessing, and We produce therewith gardens and Grain for harvests;
Shakir: And We send down from the cloud water abounding in good, then We cause to grow thereby gardens and the grain that is reaped,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We have sent blessed water down from the sky to grow gardens, harvestable crops
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And We send down blessed water (rain) from the sky, then We produce therewith gardens and grain (every kind of harvests) that are reaped.
Arberry: And We sent down out of heaven water blessed, and caused to grow thereby gardens and grain of harvest
Label: joy

Verse_diac: إِذۡ يُوحِي رَبُّكَ إِلَى ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ أَنِّي مَعَكُمۡ فَثَبِّتُواْ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْۚ سَأُلۡقِي فِي قُلُوبِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ ٱلرُّعۡبَ فَٱضۡرِبُواْ فَوۡقَ ٱلۡأَعۡنَاقِ وَٱضۡرِبُواْ مِنۡهُمۡ كُلَّ بَنَانٖ
Verse: اذ يوحي ربك الى الملٰئكة اني معكم فثبتوا الذين ءامنوا سالقي في قلوب الذين كفروا الرعب فاضربوا فوق الاعناق واضربوا منهم كل بنان
Sahih_International: [Remember] when your Lord inspired to the angels, "I am with you, so strengthen those who have believed. I will cast terror into the hearts of those who disbelieved, so strike [them] upon the necks and strike from them every fingertip."
Pickthall: When thy Lord inspired the angels, (saying): I am with you. So make those who believe stand firm. I will throw fear into the hearts of those who disbelieve. Then smite the necks and smite of them each finger.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Remember thy Lord inspired the angels (with the message): "I am with you: give firmness to the Believers: I will instil terror into the hearts of the Unbelievers: smite ye above their necks and smite all their finger-tips off them."
Shakir: When your Lord revealed to the angels: I am with you, therefore make firm those who believe. I will cast terror into the hearts of those who disbelieve. Therefore strike off their heads and strike off every fingertip of them.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Your Lord inspired the angels saying, "I am with you. Encourage the believers. I shall cast terror into the hearts of the unbelievers and you will strike their heads and limbs;
Mohsin_Khan (MK): (Remember) when your Lord inspired the angels, "Verily, I am with you, so keep firm those who have believed. I will cast terror into the hearts of those who have disbelieved, so strike them over the necks, and smite over all their fingers and toes."
Arberry: When thy Lord was revealing to the angels, 'I am with you; so confirm the believers. I shall cast into the unbelievers' hearts terror; so smite above the necks, and smite every finger of them!'
Label: joy

Verse_diac: فَمَن تَابَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ ظُلۡمِهِۦ وَأَصۡلَحَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَتُوبُ عَلَيۡهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٌ
Verse: فمن تاب من بعد ظلمه واصلح فان الله يتوب عليه ان الله غفور رحيم
Sahih_International: But whoever repents after his wrongdoing and reforms, indeed, Allah will turn to him in forgiveness. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
Pickthall: But whoso repenteth after his wrongdoing and amendeth, lo! Allah will relent toward him. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): But if the thief repents after his crime, and amends his conduct, Allah turneth to him in forgiveness; for Allah is Oft-forgiving, Most Merciful.
Shakir: But whoever repents after his iniquity and reforms (himself), then surely Allah will turn to him (mercifully); surely Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): However, God will accept the repentance of whoever repents and reforms himself after committing injustice; He is All-forgiving and All-merciful.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): But whosoever repents after his crime and does righteous good deeds (by obeying Allah), then verily, Allah will pardon him (accept his repentance). Verily, Allah is Oft­Forgiving, Most Merciful.
Arberry: But whoso repents, after his evildoing, and makes amends, God will turn towards him; God is All-forgiving, All-compassionate.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: إِن كُلُّ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ إِلَّآ ءَاتِي ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ عَبۡدٗا
Verse: ان كل من في السمٰوٰت والارض الا ءاتي الرحمٰن عبدا
Sahih_International: There is no one in the heavens and earth but that he comes to the Most Merciful as a servant.
Pickthall: There is none in the heavens and the earth but cometh unto the Beneficent as a slave.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Not one of the beings in the heavens and the earth but must come to (Allah) Most Gracious as a servant.
Shakir: There is no one in the heavens and the earth but will come to the Beneficent Allah as a servant.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): All that is in the heavens and the earth will return to the Beneficent God as His submissive servants.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): There is none in the heavens and the earth but comes unto the Most Beneficent (Allah) as a slave.
Arberry: None is there in the heavens and earth but he comes to the All-merciful as a servant;
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: وَٱلطَّيۡرَ مَحۡشُورَةٗۖ كُلّٞ لَّهُۥٓ أَوَّابٞ
Verse: والطير محشورة كل له اواب
Sahih_International: And the birds were assembled, all with him repeating [praises].
Pickthall: And the birds assembled; all were turning unto Him.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And the birds gathered (in assemblies): all with him did turn (to Allah).
Shakir: And the birds gathered together; all joined in singing with him.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We made the birds assemble around him in flocks.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And (so did) the birds assembled: all with him [Dawud (David)] did turn (to Allah i.e. glorified His Praises).
Arberry: and the birds, duly mustered, every one to him reverting;
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُخۡزُونِ
Verse: واتقوا الله ولا تخزون
Sahih_International: And fear Allah and do not disgrace me."
Pickthall: And keep your duty to Allah, and shame me not!
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "But fear Allah, and shame me not."
Shakir: And guard against (the punishment of) Allah and do not put me to shame.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Have fear of God and do not humiliate me".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "And fear Allah and disgrace me not."
Arberry: and fear God, and do not degrade me.'
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: يَوۡمَ تَشۡهَدُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ أَلۡسِنَتُهُمۡ وَأَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَأَرۡجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
Verse: يوم تشهد عليهم السنتهم وايديهم وارجلهم بما كانوا يعملون
Sahih_International: On a Day when their tongues, their hands and their feet will bear witness against them as to what they used to do.
Pickthall: On the day when their tongues and their hands and their feet testify against them as to what they used to do,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): On the Day when their tongues, their hands, and their feet will bear witness against them as to their actions.
Shakir: On the day when their tongues and their hands and their feet shall bear witness against them as to what they did.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): on the day when their tongues, hands, and feet will testify to what they had done.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): On the Day when their tongues, their hands, and their legs or feet will bear witness against them as to what they used to do.
Arberry: on the day when their tongues, their hands and their feet shall testify against them touching that they were doing.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَيَقُولُونَ سُبۡحَٰنَ رَبِّنَآ إِن كَانَ وَعۡدُ رَبِّنَا لَمَفۡعُولٗا
Verse: ويقولون سبحٰن ربنا ان كان وعد ربنا لمفعولا
Sahih_International: And they say, "Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, the promise of our Lord has been fulfilled."
Pickthall: Saying: Glory to our Lord! Verily the promise of our Lord must be fulfilled.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "And they say: 'Glory to our Lord! Truly has the promise of our Lord been fulfilled!'"
Shakir: And they say: Glory be to our Lord! most surely the promise of our Lord was to be fulfilled.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): They say, "Our Lord is too Glorious to disregard His promise".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And they say: "Glory be to our Lord! Truly, the Promise of our Lord must be fulfilled."
Arberry: and say, "Glory be to our Lord! Our Lord's promise is performed."
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: مَا ٱلۡحَآقَّةُ
Verse: ما الحاقة
Sahih_International: What is the Inevitable Reality?
Pickthall: What is the Reality?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): What is the Sure Reality?
Shakir: What is the sure calamity!
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): What is the Inevitable?
Mohsin_Khan (MK): What is the Reality?
Arberry: What is the Indubitable?
Label: fear

Verse_diac: بَشِيرٗا وَنَذِيرٗا فَأَعۡرَضَ أَكۡثَرُهُمۡ فَهُمۡ لَا يَسۡمَعُونَ
Verse: بشيرا ونذيرا فاعرض اكثرهم فهم لا يسمعون
Sahih_International: As a giver of good tidings and a warner; but most of them turn away, so they do not hear.
Pickthall: Good tidings and a warning. But most of them turn away so that they hear not.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Giving good news and admonition: yet most of them turn away, and so they hear not.
Shakir: A herald of good news and a warner, but most of them turn aside so they hear not.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): It contains glad news and warnings (for the people), but most of them have ignored it and do not listen.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Giving glad tidings [of Paradise to the one who believes in the Oneness of Allah (i.e. Islamic Monotheism) and fears Allah much (abstains from all kinds of sins and evil deeds) and loves Allah much (performing all kinds of good deeds which He has ordained)], and warning (of punishment in the Hell Fire to the one who disbelieves in the Oneness of Allah), but most of them turn away, so they listen not.
Arberry: good tidings to bear, and warning, but most of them have turned away, and do not give ear.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: وَيَوۡمَ يُنَادِيهِمۡ فَيَقُولُ مَاذَآ أَجَبۡتُمُ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلِينَ
Verse: ويوم يناديهم فيقول ماذا اجبتم المرسلين
Sahih_International: And [mention] the Day He will call them and say, "What did you answer the messengers?"
Pickthall: And on the Day when He will call unto them and say: What answer gave ye to the messengers?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): That Day (Allah) will call to them, and say: "What was the answer ye gave to the messengers?"
Shakir: And on the day when He shall call them and say: What was the answer you gave to the messengers?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): On the day when God will call them and ask them, "What answer did you give to (Our) messengers?"
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And (remember) the Day (Allah) will call to them, and say: "What answer gave you to the Messengers?"
Arberry: Upon the day when He shall call to them, and He shall say, 'What answer gave you to the Envoys?'
Label: fear

Verse_diac: يَوۡمَ تَرۡجُفُ ٱلرَّاجِفَةُ
Verse: يوم ترجف الراجفة
Sahih_International: On the Day the blast [of the Horn] will convulse [creation],
Pickthall: On the day when the first trump resoundeth.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): One Day everything that can be in commotion will be in violent commotion,
Shakir: The day on which the quaking one shall quake,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): On the day when the first trumpet sound blasts
Mohsin_Khan (MK): On the Day (when the first blowing of the Trumpet is blown), the earth and the mountains will shake violently (and everybody will die),
Arberry: Upon the day when the first blast shivers
Label: fear

Verse_diac: لَأُعَذِّبَنَّهُۥ عَذَابٗا شَدِيدًا أَوۡ لَأَاْذۡبَحَنَّهُۥٓ أَوۡ لَيَأۡتِيَنِّي بِسُلۡطَٰنٖ مُّبِينٖ
Verse: لاعذبنه عذابا شديدا او لااذبحنه او لياتيني بسلطٰن مبين
Sahih_International: I will surely punish him with a severe punishment or slaughter him unless he brings me clear authorization."
Pickthall: I verily will punish him with hard punishment or I verily will slay him, or he verily shall bring me a plain excuse.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "I will certainly punish him with a severe penalty, or execute him, unless he bring me a clear reason (for absence)."
Shakir: I will most certainly punish him with a severe punishment, or kill him, or he shall bring to me a clear plea.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): I shall certainly punish him severely or slaughter him unless he has a good reason for his absence."
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "I will surely punish him with a severe torment, or slaughter him, unless he brings me a clear reason."
Arberry: Assuredly I will chastise him with a terrible chastisement, or I will slaughter him, or he bring me a clear authority.'
Label: anger

Verse_diac: عَمَّ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
Verse: عم يتساءلون
Sahih_International: About what are they asking one another?
Pickthall: Whereof do they question one another?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Concerning what are they disputing?
Shakir: Of what do they ask one another?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): What do they quarrel about?
Mohsin_Khan (MK): What are they asking (one another)?
Arberry: Of what do they question one another?
Label: fear

Verse_diac: أَزِفَتِ ٱلۡأٓزِفَةُ
Verse: ازفت الازفة
Sahih_International: The Approaching Day has approached.
Pickthall: The threatened Hour is nigh.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): The (Judgment) ever approaching draws nigh:
Shakir: The near event draws nigh.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): The Day of Judgment is drawing nearer.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): The Day of Resurrection draws near,
Arberry: The Imminent is imminent;
Label: anger

Verse_diac: فَإِنَّ لِلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ ذَنُوبٗا مِّثۡلَ ذَنُوبِ أَصۡحَٰبِهِمۡ فَلَا يَسۡتَعۡجِلُونِ
Verse: فان للذين ظلموا ذنوبا مثل ذنوب اصحٰبهم فلا يستعجلون
Sahih_International: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion [of punishment] like the portion of their predecessors, so let them not impatiently urge Me.
Pickthall: And lo! for those who (now) do wrong there is an evil day like unto the evil day (which came for) their likes (of old); so let them not ask Me to hasten on (that day).
Yusuf_Ali (YA): For the Wrong-doers, their portion is like unto the portion of their fellows (of earlier generations): then let them not ask Me to hasten (that portion)!
Shakir: So surely those who are unjust shall have a portion like the portion of their companions, therefore let them not ask Me to hasten on.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): The unjust will bear a burden like that of their unjust predecessors. Let them not make Me bring immediate punishment upon them.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And verily, for those who do wrong, there is a portion of torment like to the evil portion of torment (which came for) their likes (of old), so let them not ask Me to hasten on!
Arberry: The evildoers shall have their portion, like the portion of their fellows; so let them not hasten Me!
Label: fear

Verse_diac: مَآ ءَامَنَتۡ قَبۡلَهُم مِّن قَرۡيَةٍ أَهۡلَكۡنَٰهَآۖ أَفَهُمۡ يُؤۡمِنُونَ
Verse: ما ءامنت قبلهم من قرية اهلكنٰها افهم يؤمنون
