And, verily, many partners oppress one another, except those who believe and do righteous good deeds, and they are few." And Dawud (David) guessed that We have tried him and he sought Forgiveness of his Lord, and he fell down prostrate and turned (to Allah) in repentance.
Arberry: Said he, 'Assuredly he has wronged thee in asking for thy ewe in addition to his sheep; and indeed many intermixers do injury one against the other, save those who believe, and do deeds of righteousness -- and how few they are!' And David thought that We had only tried him; therefore he sought forgiveness of his Lord, and he fell down, bowing, and he repented.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: فَلَوۡلَآ إِذَا بَلَغَتِ ٱلۡحُلۡقُومَ
Verse: فلولا اذا بلغت الحلقوم
Sahih_International: Then why, when the soul at death reaches the throat
Pickthall: Why, then, when (the soul) cometh up to the throat (of the dying)
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Then why do ye not (intervene) when (the soul of the dying man) reaches the throat,-
Shakir: Why is it not then that when it (soul) comes up to the throat,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Why can you not help a soul dying
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Then why do you not (intervene) when (the soul of a dying person) reaches the throat?
Arberry: Why, but when the soul leaps to the throat of the dying
Label: fear

Verse_diac: إِنَّا جَعَلۡنَٰهُ قُرۡءَٰنًا عَرَبِيّٗا لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَعۡقِلُونَ
Verse: انا جعلنٰه قرءٰنا عربيا لعلكم تعقلون
Sahih_International: Indeed, We have made it an Arabic Qur'an that you might understand.
Pickthall: Lo! We have appointed it a Lecture, in Arabic that haply ye may understand.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): We have made it a Qur'an in Arabic, that ye may be able to understand (and learn wisdom).
Shakir: Surely We have made it an Arabic Quran that you may understand.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We have made it an Arabic reading text so that perhaps you may understand.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): We verily, have made it a Quran in Arabic, that you may be able to understand (its meanings and its admonitions).
Arberry: behold, We have made it an Arabic Koran; haply you will understand;
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَضَعَهَا لِلۡأَنَامِ
Verse: والارض وضعها للانام
Sahih_International: And the earth He laid [out] for the creatures.
Pickthall: And the earth hath He appointed for (His) creatures,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): It is He Who has spread out the earth for (His) creatures:
Shakir: And the earth, He has set it for living creatures;
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): He spread out the earth for the people.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And the earth He has put for the creatures.
Arberry: And earth -- He set it down for all beings,
Label: joy

Verse_diac: قَدۡ أَفۡلَحَ مَن زَكَّىٰهَا
Verse: قد افلح من زكىٰها
Sahih_International: He has succeeded who purifies it,
Pickthall: He is indeed successful who causeth it to grow,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Truly he succeeds that purifies it,
Shakir: He will indeed be successful who purifies it,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): those who purify their souls will certainly have everlasting happiness
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Indeed he succeeds who purifies his ownself (i.e. obeys and performs all that Allah ordered, by following the true Faith of Islamic Monotheism and by doing righteous good deeds).
Arberry: Prosperous is he who purifies it,
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَإِن يُكَذِّبُوكَ فَقَدۡ كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحٖ وَعَادٞ وَثَمُودُ
Verse: وان يكذبوك فقد كذبت قبلهم قوم نوح وعاد وثمود
Sahih_International: And if they deny you, [O Muhammad] - so, before them, did the people of Noah and 'Aad and Thamud deny [their prophets],
Pickthall: If they deny thee (Muhammad), even so the folk of Noah, and (the tribes of) A'ad and Thamud, before thee, denied (Our messengers);
Yusuf_Ali (YA): If they treat thy (mission) as false, so did the peoples before them (with their prophets),- the People of Noah, and 'Ad and Thamud;
Shakir: And if they reject you, then already before you did the people of Nuh and Ad and Samood reject (prophets).
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): If they have called you, (Muhammad), a liar, (remember that) the people of Noah, Ad, Thamud,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And if they belie you (O Muhammad SAW), so were belied the Prophets before them, (by) the people of Nuh (Noah), 'Ad and Thamud,
Arberry: If they cry lies to thee, so too before them the people of Noah cried lies, and Ad and Thamood,
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ عَلَىٰ صَلَوَٰتِهِمۡ يُحَافِظُونَ
Verse: والذين هم علىٰ صلوٰتهم يحافظون
Sahih_International: And they who carefully maintain their prayers -
Pickthall: And who pay heed to their prayers.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And who (strictly) guard their prayers;-
Shakir: And those who keep a guard on their prayers;
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): to their promise,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And those who strictly guard their (five compulsory congregational) Salawat (prayers) (at their fixed stated hours).
Arberry: and who observe their prayers.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: لِيُوَفِّيَهُمۡ أُجُورَهُمۡ وَيَزِيدَهُم مِّن فَضۡلِهِۦٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ غَفُورٞ شَكُورٞ
Verse: ليوفيهم اجورهم ويزيدهم من فضله انه غفور شكور
Sahih_International: That He may give them in full their rewards and increase for them of His bounty. Indeed, He is Forgiving and Appreciative.
Pickthall: That He will pay them their wages and increase them of His grace. Lo! He is Forgiving, Responsive.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): For He will pay them their meed, nay, He will give them (even) more out of His Bounty: for He is Oft-Forgiving, Most Ready to appreciate (service).
Shakir: That He may pay them back fully their rewards and give them more out of His grace: surely He is Forgiving, Multiplier of rewards.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): and in receiving their reward from God and in further favors. He is All-forgiving and All-appreciating.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): That He may pay them their wages in full, and give them (even) more, out of His Grace. Verily! He is Oft­Forgiving, Most Ready to appreciate (good deeds and to recompense).
Arberry: that He may pay them in full their wages and enrich them of His bounty; surely He is All-forgiving, All-thankful.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَإِن كَانُواْ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن يُنَزَّلَ عَلَيۡهِم مِّن قَبۡلِهِۦ لَمُبۡلِسِينَ
Verse: وان كانوا من قبل ان ينزل عليهم من قبله لمبلسين
Sahih_International: Although they were, before it was sent down upon them - before that, in despair.
Pickthall: Though before that, even before it was sent down upon them, they were in despair.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Even though, before they received (the rain) - just before this - they were dumb with despair!
Shakir: Though they were before this, before it was sent down upon them, confounded in sure despair.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): at the rainfall, though before that they had been in despair.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And verily before that (rain), just before it was sent down upon them, they were in despair!
Arberry: although before it was sent down on them before that they had been in despair.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ أَجۡرَمُواْ كَانُواْ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ يَضۡحَكُونَ
Verse: ان الذين اجرموا كانوا من الذين ءامنوا يضحكون
Sahih_International: Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.
Pickthall: Lo! the guilty used to laugh at those who believed,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Those in sin used to laugh at those who believed,
Shakir: Surely they who are guilty used to laugh at those who believe.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): The sinners had been laughing at the believers.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Verily! (During the worldly life) those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.
Arberry: Behold, the sinners were laughing at the believers,
Label: fear

Verse_diac: فِي جَنَّٰتِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
Verse: في جنٰت النعيم
Sahih_International: In the Gardens of Pleasure,
Pickthall: In gardens of delight;
Yusuf_Ali (YA): In Gardens of Bliss:
Shakir: In the gardens of bliss.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): in the beautiful Paradise.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): In the Gardens of delight (Paradise).
Arberry: in the Gardens of Delight
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَيُدۡخِلُهُمُ ٱلۡجَنَّةَ عَرَّفَهَا لَهُمۡ
Verse: ويدخلهم الجنة عرفها لهم
Sahih_International: And admit them to Paradise, which He has made known to them.
Pickthall: And bring them in unto the Garden which He hath made known to them.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And admit them to the Garden which He has announced for them.
Shakir: And cause them to enter the garden which He has made known to them.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): He will admit them into the Paradise which He has made known to them.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And admit them to Paradise which He has made known to them (i.e. they will know their places in Paradise more than they used to know their houses in the world).
Arberry: and He will admit them to Paradise, that He has made known to them.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: فَجَعَلَهُۥ غُثَآءً أَحۡوَىٰ
Verse: فجعله غثاء احوىٰ
Sahih_International: And [then] makes it black stubble.
Pickthall: Then turneth it to russet stubble.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And then doth make it (but) swarthy stubble.
Shakir: Then makes it dried up, dust-colored.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): then caused it to wither away.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And then makes it dark stubble.
Arberry: then made it a blackening wrack.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: لَعَلَّنَا نَتَّبِعُ ٱلسَّحَرَةَ إِن كَانُواْ هُمُ ٱلۡغَٰلِبِينَ
Verse: لعلنا نتبع السحرة ان كانوا هم الغٰلبين
Sahih_International: That we might follow the magicians if they are the predominant?"
Pickthall: (They said): Aye, so that we may follow the wizards if they are the winners.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "That we may follow the sorcerers (in religion) if they win?"
Shakir: Haply we may follow the magicians, if they are the vanquishers.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): and the people were asked, "Will you all be there so that we may follow the magicians if they become victorious?"
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "That we may follow the sorcerers [who were on Fir'aun's (Pharaoh) religion of disbelief] if they are the winners."
Arberry: Haply we shall follow the sorcerers if it should be they are the victors.'
Label: anger

Verse_diac: رَّبَّنَآ إِنَّنَا سَمِعۡنَا مُنَادِيٗا يُنَادِي لِلۡإِيمَٰنِ أَنۡ ءَامِنُواْ بِرَبِّكُمۡ فَـَٔامَنَّاۚ رَبَّنَا فَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَكَفِّرۡ عَنَّا سَيِّـَٔاتِنَا وَتَوَفَّنَا مَعَ ٱلۡأَبۡرَارِ
Verse: ربنا اننا سمعنا مناديا ينادي للايمٰن ان ءامنوا بربكم فامنا ربنا فاغفر لنا ذنوبنا وكفر عنا سياتنا وتوفنا مع الابرار
Sahih_International: Our Lord, indeed we have heard a caller calling to faith, [saying], 'Believe in your Lord,' and we have believed. Our Lord, so forgive us our sins and remove from us our misdeeds and cause us to die with the righteous.
Pickthall: Our Lord! Lo! we have heard a crier calling unto Faith: "Believe ye in your Lord!" So we believed. Our Lord! Therefor forgive us our sins, and remit from us our evil deeds, and make us die the death of the righteous.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "Our Lord! we have heard the call of one calling (Us) to Faith, 'Believe ye in the Lord,' and we have believed. Our Lord! Forgive us our sins, blot out from us our iniquities, and take to Thyself our souls in the company of the righteous.
Shakir: Our Lord! surely we have heard a preacher calling to the faith, saying: Believe in your Lord, so we did believe; Our Lord! forgive us therefore our faults, and cover our evil deeds and make us die with the righteous.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): "Lord, we have heard the person calling to the faith and have accepted his call. Forgive our sins, expiate our bad deeds, and let us die with the righteous ones.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "Our Lord! Verily, we have heard the call of one (Muhammad SAW) calling to Faith: 'Believe in your Lord,' and we have believed. Our Lord! Forgive us our sins and remit from us our evil deeds, and make us die in the state of righteousness along with Al-Abrar (those who are obedient to Allah and follow strictly His Orders).
Arberry: Our Lord, we have heard a caller calling us to belief, saying, "Believe you in your Lord!" And we believe. Our Lord, forgive Thou us our sins and acquit us of our evil deeds, and take us to Thee with the pious.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: أَهُمۡ يَقۡسِمُونَ رَحۡمَتَ رَبِّكَۚ نَحۡنُ قَسَمۡنَا بَيۡنَهُم مَّعِيشَتَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۚ وَرَفَعۡنَا بَعۡضَهُمۡ فَوۡقَ بَعۡضٖ دَرَجَٰتٖ لِّيَتَّخِذَ بَعۡضُهُم بَعۡضٗا سُخۡرِيّٗاۗ وَرَحۡمَتُ رَبِّكَ خَيۡرٞ مِّمَّا يَجۡمَعُونَ
Verse: اهم يقسمون رحمت ربك نحن قسمنا بينهم معيشتهم في الحيوٰة الدنيا ورفعنا بعضهم فوق بعض درجٰت ليتخذ بعضهم بعضا سخريا ورحمت ربك خير مما يجمعون
Sahih_International: Do they distribute the mercy of your Lord? It is We who have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of this world and have raised some of them above others in degrees [of rank] that they may make use of one another for service. But the mercy of your Lord is better than whatever they accumulate.
Pickthall: Is it they who apportion thy Lord's mercy? We have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of the world, and raised some of them above others in rank that some of them may take labour from others; and the mercy of thy Lord is better than (the wealth) that they amass.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Is it they who would portion out the Mercy of thy Lord? It is We Who portion out between them their livelihood in the life of this world: and We raise some of them above others in ranks, so that some may command work from others. But the Mercy of thy Lord is better than the (wealth) which they amass.
Shakir: Will they distribute the mercy of your Lord? We distribute among them their livelihood in the life of this world, and We j have exalted some of them above others in degrees, that some of them may take others in subjection; and the mercy of your Lord is better than what they amass.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Do they distribute the mercy of your Lord? It is We who have distributed their sustenance in this world and raised the positions of some of them above the others so that they would mock each other. The mercy of your Lord is better than what they can amass.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Is it they who would portion out the Mercy of your Lord? It is We Who portion out between them their livelihood in this world, and We raised some of them above others in ranks, so that some may employ others in their work. But the Mercy (Paradise) of your Lord (O Muhammad SAW) is better than the (wealth of this world) which they amass.
Arberry: What, is it they who divide the mercy of the Lord? We have divided between them their livelihood in the present life, and raised some of them above others in rank, that some of them may take others in servitude; and the mercy of thy Lord is better than that they amass.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: رَبَّنَا لَا تَجۡعَلۡنَا فِتۡنَةٗ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَٱغۡفِرۡ لَنَا رَبَّنَآۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
Verse: ربنا لا تجعلنا فتنة للذين كفروا واغفر لنا ربنا انك انت العزيز الحكيم
Sahih_International: Our Lord, make us not [objects of] torment for the disbelievers and forgive us, our Lord. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise."
Pickthall: Our Lord! Make us not a prey for those who disbelieve, and forgive us, our Lord! Lo! Thou, only Thou, are the Mighty, the Wise.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "Our Lord! Make us not a (test and) trial for the Unbelievers, but forgive us, our Lord! for Thou art the Exalted in Might, the Wise."
Shakir: Our Lord! do not make us a trial for those who disbelieve, and forgive us, our Lord! surely Thou art the Mighty, the Wise.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): They prayed, "Lord, we have trust in You, turned to You in repentance, and to You we shall all return. Lord, save us from the evil intentions of the disbelievers. Our Lord, forgives us. You are Majestic and All-wise".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "Our Lord! Make us not a trial for the disbelievers, and forgive us, Our Lord! Verily, You, only You are the All-Mighty, the All-Wise."
Arberry: Our Lord, make us not a temptation to those who disbelieve; and forgive us. Our. Lord, Thou art the All-mighty, the All-wise.'
Label: fear

Verse_diac: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقۡضِي بَيۡنَهُم بِحُكۡمِهِۦۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
Verse: ان ربك يقضي بينهم بحكمه وهو العزيز العليم
Sahih_International: Indeed, your Lord will judge between them by His [wise] judgement. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
Pickthall: Lo! thy Lord will judge between them of His wisdom, and He is the Mighty, the Wise.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Verily thy Lord will decide between them by His Decree: and He is Exalted in Might, All-Knowing.
Shakir: Surely your Lord will judge between them by his judgment, and He is the Mighty, the knowing.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Your Lord will judge among them according to His own decree. He is Majestic and All-Knowing.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Verily, your Lord will decide between them (various sects) by His Judgement. And He is the All-Mighty, the All-Knowing.
Arberry: Surely thy Lord will decide between them by His Judgment; He is the All-mighty, the All-knowing.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَمَهَّدتُّ لَهُۥ تَمۡهِيدٗا
Verse: ومهدت له تمهيدا
Sahih_International: And spread [everything] before him, easing [his life].
Pickthall: And made (life) smooth for him.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): To whom I made (life) smooth and comfortable!
Shakir: And I adjusted affairs for him adjustably;
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): whose life I have made run smoothly
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And made life smooth and comfortable for him!
Arberry: and made all things smooth for him;
Label: anger

Verse_diac: فَإِذَا ٱلنُّجُومُ طُمِسَتۡ
Verse: فاذا النجوم طمست
Sahih_International: So when the stars are obliterated
Pickthall: So when the stars are put out,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Then when the stars become dim;
Shakir: So when the stars are made to lose their light,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Then the stars will lose their light.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Then when the stars lose their lights;
Arberry: When the stars shall be extinguished,
Label: fear

Verse_diac: فَنَادَىٰهَا مِن تَحۡتِهَآ أَلَّا تَحۡزَنِي قَدۡ جَعَلَ رَبُّكِ تَحۡتَكِ سَرِيّٗا
Verse: فنادىٰها من تحتها الا تحزني قد جعل ربك تحتك سريا
Sahih_International: But he called her from below her, "Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream.
Pickthall: Then (one) cried unto her from below her, saying: Grieve not! Thy Lord hath placed a rivulet beneath thee,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): But (a voice) cried to her from beneath the (palm-tree): "Grieve not! for thy Lord hath provided a rivulet beneath thee;
Shakir: Then (the child) called out to her from beneath her: Grieve not, surely your Lord has made a stream to flow beneath you;
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Then she heard the baby saying, "Do not be sad. Your Lord has caused a stream to run at your feet.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Then [the babe 'Iesa (Jesus) or Jibrael (Gabriel)] cried unto her from below her, saying: "Grieve not! Your Lord has provided a water stream under you;
Arberry: But the one that was below her called to her, 'Nay, do not sorrow; see, thy Lord has set below thee a rivulet.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: لِمَن شَآءَ مِنكُمۡ أَن يَسۡتَقِيمَ
Verse: لمن شاء منكم ان يستقيم
Sahih_International: For whoever wills among you to take a right course.
Pickthall: Unto whomsoever of you willeth to walk straight.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): (With profit) to whoever among you wills to go straight:
Shakir: For him among you who pleases to go straight.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): So let those who want, choose the right guidance
Mohsin_Khan (MK): To whomsoever among you who wills to walk straight,
Arberry: for whosoever of you who would go straight;
Label: joy

Verse_diac: سَيَصۡلَىٰ نَارٗا ذَاتَ لَهَبٖ
Verse: سيصلىٰ نارا ذات لهب
Sahih_International: He will [enter to] burn in a Fire of [blazing] flame
Pickthall: He will be plunged in flaming Fire,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Burnt soon will he be in a Fire of Blazing Flame!
Shakir: He shall soon burn in fire that flames,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): His property and worldly gains will be of no help to him.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): He will be burnt in a Fire of blazing flames!
Arberry: he shall roast at a flaming fire
Label: anger

Verse_diac: يَغۡفِرۡ لَكُمۡ ذُنُوبَكُمۡ وَيُدۡخِلۡكُمۡ جَنَّٰتٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ وَمَسَٰكِنَ طَيِّبَةٗ فِي جَنَّٰتِ عَدۡنٖۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ
Verse: يغفر لكم ذنوبكم ويدخلكم جنٰت تجري من تحتها الانهٰر ومسٰكن طيبة في جنٰت عدن ذٰلك الفوز العظيم
Sahih_International: He will forgive for you your sins and admit you to gardens beneath which rivers flow and pleasant dwellings in gardens of perpetual residence. That is the great attainment.
Pickthall: He will forgive you your sins and bring you into Gardens underneath which rivers flow, and pleasant dwellings in Gardens of Eden. That is the supreme triumph.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): He will forgive you your sins, and admit you to Gardens beneath which Rivers flow, and to beautiful mansions in Gardens of Eternity: that is indeed the Supreme Achievement.
Shakir: He will forgive you your faults and cause you to enter into gardens, beneath which rivers flow, and goodly dwellings in gardens of perpetuity; that is the mighty achievement;
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): God will forgive your sins and admit you into Paradise wherein streams flow, and you live in the lofty mansions of the garden of Eden. This is indeed the greatest triumph.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): (If you do so) He will forgive you your sins, and admit you into Gardens under which rivers flow, and pleasant dwelling in Gardens of 'Adn ­ Eternity ['Adn (Edn) Paradise], that is indeed the great success.
Arberry: He will forgive you your sins and admit you into gardens underneath which rivers flow, and to dwelling-places goodly in Gardens of Eden; that is the mighty triumph;
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَلَقَدۡ أَخَذۡنَآ ءَالَ فِرۡعَوۡنَ بِٱلسِّنِينَ وَنَقۡصٖ مِّنَ ٱلثَّمَرَٰتِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَذَّكَّرُونَ
Verse: ولقد اخذنا ءال فرعون بالسنين ونقص من الثمرٰت لعلهم يذكرون
Sahih_International: And We certainly seized the people of Pharaoh with years of famine and a deficiency in fruits that perhaps they would be reminded.
Pickthall: And we straitened Pharaoh's folk with famine and dearth of fruits, that peradventure they might heed.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): We punished the people of Pharaoh with years (of droughts) and shortness of crops; that they might receive admonition.
Shakir: And certainly We overtook Firon's people with droughts and diminution of fruits that they may be mindful.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): For years We afflicted Pharaoh's people with shortages in food so that perhaps they would take heed.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And indeed We punished the people of Fir'aun (Pharaoh) with years of drought and shortness of fruits (crops, etc.), that they might remember (take heed).
Arberry: Then seized We Pharaoh's people with years of dearth, and scarcity of fruits, that haply they might remember.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَلُوطًا إِذۡ قَالَ لِقَوۡمِهِۦٓ إِنَّكُمۡ لَتَأۡتُونَ ٱلۡفَٰحِشَةَ مَا سَبَقَكُم بِهَا مِنۡ أَحَدٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
Verse: ولوطا اذ قال لقومه انكم لتاتون الفٰحشة ما سبقكم بها من احد من العٰلمين
Sahih_International: And [mention] Lot, when he said to his people, "Indeed, you commit such immorality as no one has preceded you with from among the worlds.
Pickthall: And Lot! (Remember) when he said unto his folk: Lo! ye commit lewdness such as no creature did before you.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And (remember) Lut: behold, he said to his people: "Ye do commit lewdness, such as no people in Creation (ever) committed before you.
Shakir: And (We sent) Lut when he said to his people: Most surely you are guilty of an indecency which none of the nations has ever done before you;
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Lot told his people, "You are certainly committing the kind of indecency which no one in the world has committed before".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And (remember) Lout (Lot), when he said to his people: "You commit Al-Fahishah (sodomy the worst sin) which none has preceded you in (committing) it in the 'Alamin (mankind and jinns)."
Arberry: And Lot, when he said to his people 'Surely you commit such indecency as never any being in all the world committed before you.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: فَأَنجَيۡنَٰهُ وَٱلَّذِينَ مَعَهُۥ بِرَحۡمَةٖ مِّنَّا وَقَطَعۡنَا دَابِرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَاۖ وَمَا كَانُواْ مُؤۡمِنِينَ
Verse: فانجينٰه والذين معه برحمة منا وقطعنا دابر الذين كذبوا بايٰتنا وما كانوا مؤمنين
Sahih_International: So We saved him and those with him by mercy from Us. And We eliminated those who denied Our signs, and they were not [at all] believers.
Pickthall: And We saved him and those with him by a mercy from Us, and We cut the root of those who denied Our revelations and were not believers.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): We saved him and those who adhered to him. By Our mercy, and We cut off the roots of those who rejected Our signs and did not believe.
Shakir: So We delivered him and those with him by mercy from Us, and We cut off the last of those who rejected Our communications and were not believers.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Through Our mercy, We saved him and his companions and destroyed the unbelievers who called Our revelations mere lies.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): So We saved him and those who were with him by a Mercy from Us, and We cut the roots of those who belied Our Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.), and they were not believers.
Arberry: So We delivered him, and those with him, by a mercy from Us; and We cut off the last remnant of those who cried lies to Our signs and were not believers.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: قَالَ عِلۡمُهَا عِندَ رَبِّي فِي كِتَٰبٖۖ لَّا يَضِلُّ رَبِّي وَلَا يَنسَى
Verse: قال علمها عند ربي في كتٰب لا يضل ربي ولا ينسى
Sahih_International: [Moses] said, "The knowledge thereof is with my Lord in a record. My Lord neither errs nor forgets."
Pickthall: He said: The knowledge thereof is with my Lord in a Record. My Lord neither erreth nor forgetteth,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): He replied: "The knowledge of that is with my Lord, duly recorded: my Lord never errs, nor forgets,-
Shakir: He said: The knowledge thereof is with my Lord in a book, my Lord errs not, nor does He forget;
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Moses replied, "The knowledge about it is with my Lord in the Book. My Lord is free from error and forgetfulness.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): [Musa (Moses)] said: "The knowledge thereof is with my Lord, in a Record. My Lord is neither unaware nor He forgets, "
Arberry: Said Moses, 'The knowledge of them is with my Lord, in a Book; my Lord goes not astray, nor forgets --
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ أَعۡمَٰلُهُمۡ كَسَرَابِۭ بِقِيعَةٖ يَحۡسَبُهُ ٱلظَّمۡـَٔانُ مَآءً حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَهُۥ لَمۡ يَجِدۡهُ شَيۡـٔٗا وَوَجَدَ ٱللَّهَ عِندَهُۥ فَوَفَّىٰهُ حِسَابَهُۥۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَرِيعُ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
Verse: والذين كفروا اعمٰلهم كسراب بقيعة يحسبه الظمان ماء حتىٰ اذا جاءه لم يجده شيا ووجد الله عنده فوفىٰه حسابه والله سريع الحساب
Sahih_International: But those who disbelieved - their deeds are like a mirage in a lowland which a thirsty one thinks is water until, when he comes to it, he finds it is nothing but finds Allah before Him, and He will pay him in full his due; and Allah is swift in account.
Pickthall: As for those who disbelieve, their deeds are as a mirage in a desert. The thirsty one supposeth it to be water till he cometh unto it and findeth it naught, and findeth, in the place thereof, Allah Who payeth him his due; and Allah is swift at reckoning.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): But the Unbelievers,- their deeds are like a mirage in sandy deserts, which the man parched with thirst mistakes for water; until when he comes up to it, he finds it to be nothing: But he finds Allah (ever) with him, and Allah will pay him his account: and Allah is swift in taking account.
Shakir: And (as for) those who disbelieve, their deeds are like the mirage in a desert, which the thirsty man deems to be water; until when he comes to it he finds it to be naught, and there he finds Allah, so He pays back to him his reckoning in full; and Allah is quick in reckoning;
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): The deeds of the unbelievers are like a mirage which a thirsty man thinks is water until he goes near and finds nothing. Instead he finds God who gives him his due recompense. God's reckoning is swift.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): As for those who disbelieve, their deeds are like a mirage in a desert. The thirsty one thinks it to be water, until he comes up to it, he finds it to be nothing, but he finds Allah with him, Who will pay him his due (Hell). And Allah is Swift in taking account.
Arberry: And as for the unbelievers, their works are as a mirage in a spacious plain which the man athirst supposes to be water, till, when he comes to it, he finds it is nothing; there indeed he finds God, and He pays him his account in full; (and God is swift at the reckoning.)
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَأَنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٞ لَّا رَيۡبَ فِيهَا وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَبۡعَثُ مَن فِي ٱلۡقُبُورِ
Verse: وان الساعة ءاتية لا ريب فيها وان الله يبعث من في القبور
Sahih_International: And [that they may know] that the Hour is coming - no doubt about it - and that Allah will resurrect those in the graves.
Pickthall: And because the Hour will come, there is no doubt thereof; and because Allah will raise those who are in the graves.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And verily the Hour will come: there can be no doubt about it, or about (the fact) that Allah will raise up all who are in the graves.
Shakir: And because the hour is coming, there is no doubt about it; and because Allah shall raise up those who are in the graves.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): There is no doubt about the coming of the Hour of Doom and that God will raise every one from their graves.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And surely, the Hour is coming, there is no doubt about it, and certainly, Allah will resurrect those who are in the graves.
Arberry: and because the Hour is coming, no doubt of it, and God shall raise up whosoever is within the tombs.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَأَنَّهُۥ هُوَ أَضۡحَكَ وَأَبۡكَىٰ
Verse: وانه هو اضحك وابكىٰ
Sahih_International: And that it is He who makes [one] laugh and weep
Pickthall: And that He it is who maketh laugh, and maketh weep,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): That it is He Who granteth Laughter and Tears;
Shakir: And that He it is Who makes (men) laugh and makes (them) weep;
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): It is He who causes laughter and weeping.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And that it is He (Allah) Who makes (whom He wills) laugh, and makes (whom He wills) weep;
Arberry: and that it is He who makes to laugh, and that makes to weep,
Label: joy

Verse_diac: يَٰبَنِيَّ ٱذۡهَبُواْ فَتَحَسَّسُواْ مِن يُوسُفَ وَأَخِيهِ وَلَا تَاْيۡـَٔسُواْ مِن رَّوۡحِ ٱللَّهِۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يَاْيۡـَٔسُ مِن رَّوۡحِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا ٱلۡقَوۡمُ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ
Verse: يٰبني اذهبوا فتحسسوا من يوسف واخيه ولا تايسوا من روح الله انه لا يايس من روح الله الا القوم الكٰفرون
Sahih_International: O my sons, go and find out about Joseph and his brother and despair not of relief from Allah. Indeed, no one despairs of relief from Allah except the disbelieving people."
Pickthall: Go, O my sons, and ascertain concerning Joseph and his brother, and despair not of the Spirit of Allah. Lo! none despaireth of the Spirit of Allah save disbelieving folk.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "O my sons! go ye and enquire about Joseph and his brother, and never give up hope of Allah's Soothing Mercy: truly no one despairs of Allah's Soothing Mercy, except those who have no faith."
Shakir: O my sons! Go and inquire respecting Yusuf and his brother, and despair not of Allah's mercy; surely none despairs of Allah's mercy except the unbelieving people.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): My sons, go and search for Joseph and his brother and do not despair of receiving comfort from God; only the unbelievers despair of receiving comfort from Him."
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "O my sons! Go you and enquire about Yusuf (Joseph) and his brother, and never give up hope of Allah's Mercy. Certainly no one despairs of Allah's Mercy, except the people who disbelieve."
Arberry: Depart, my sons, and search out tidings of Joseph and his brother. Do not despair of God's comfort; of God's comfort no man despairs, excepting the people of the unbelievers.'
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: وَيَوۡمَ نَبۡعَثُ مِن كُلِّ أُمَّةٖ شَهِيدٗا ثُمَّ لَا يُؤۡذَنُ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَلَا هُمۡ يُسۡتَعۡتَبُونَ
Verse: ويوم نبعث من كل امة شهيدا ثم لا يؤذن للذين كفروا ولا هم يستعتبون
Sahih_International: And [mention] the Day when We will resurrect from every nation a witness. Then it will not be permitted to the disbelievers [to apologize or make excuses], nor will they be asked to appease [Allah].
Pickthall: And (bethink you of) the day when we raise up of every nation a witness, then there is no leave for disbelievers, nor are they allowed to make amends.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): One Day We shall raise from all Peoples a Witness: then will no excuse be accepted from Unbelievers, nor will they receive any favours.
Shakir: And on the day when We will raise up a witness out of every nation, then shall no permission be given to those who disbelieve, nor shall they be made to solicit favor.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): On the day when We will call a witness from every nation, the disbelievers will not be given permission for anything, nor will they be allowed to seek solicitation.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And (remember) the Day when We shall raise up from each nation a witness (their Messenger), then, those who have disbelieved will not be given leave (to put forward excuses), nor will they be allowed (to return to the world) to repent and ask for Allah's Forgiveness (of their sins, etc.).
Arberry: And the day We shall raise up from every nation a witness, then to the unbelievers no leave shall be given, nor shall they be suffered to make amends.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنۡ خَشۡيَةِ رَبِّهِم مُّشۡفِقُونَ
Verse: ان الذين هم من خشية ربهم مشفقون
Sahih_International: Indeed, they who are apprehensive from fear of their Lord
Pickthall: Lo! those who go in awe for fear of their Lord.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Verily those who live in awe for fear of their Lord;
Shakir: Surely they who from fear of their Lord are cautious,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Only those who are, out of fear of Him, humble before their Lord,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Verily! Those who live in awe for fear of their Lord;
Arberry: Surely those who tremble in fear of their Lord
Label: fear

Verse_diac: فَهُمۡ عَلَىٰٓ ءَاثَٰرِهِمۡ يُهۡرَعُونَ
Verse: فهم علىٰ ءاثٰرهم يهرعون
Sahih_International: So they hastened [to follow] in their footsteps.
Pickthall: But they make haste (to follow) in their footsteps.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): So they (too) were rushed down on their footsteps!
Shakir: So in their footsteps they are being hastened on.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): and rushed to follow them.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): So they (too) made haste to follow in their footsteps!
Arberry: and they run in their footsteps.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: وَلَا تَدۡعُ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَۘ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۚ كُلُّ شَيۡءٍ هَالِكٌ إِلَّا وَجۡهَهُۥۚ لَهُ ٱلۡحُكۡمُ وَإِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ
Verse: ولا تدع مع الله الٰها ءاخر لا الٰه الا هو كل شيء هالك الا وجهه له الحكم واليه ترجعون
Sahih_International: And do not invoke with Allah another deity. There is no deity except Him. Everything will be destroyed except His Face. His is the judgement, and to Him you will be returned.
Pickthall: And cry not unto any other god along with Allah. There is no Allah save Him. Everything will perish save His countenance. His is the command, and unto Him ye will be brought back.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And call not, besides Allah, on another god. There is no god but He. Everything (that exists) will perish except His own Face. To Him belongs the Command, and to Him will ye (all) be brought back.
Shakir: And call not with Allah any other god; there is no god but He, every thing is perishable but He; His is the judgment, and to Him you shall be brought back.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Do not worship anything besides God. He is the only God. Everything will be destroyed except God. To Him belongs Judgment and to Him you will all return.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And invoke not any other ilah (god) along with Allah, La ilaha illa Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He). Everything will perish save His Face. His is the Decision, and to Him you (all) shall be returned.
Arberry: And call not upon another god with God; there is no god but He. All things perish, except His Face. His is the Judgment, and unto Him you shall be returned.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: ۞إِنَّ شَرَّ ٱلدَّوَآبِّ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلصُّمُّ ٱلۡبُكۡمُ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعۡقِلُونَ
Verse: ان شر الدواب عند الله الصم البكم الذين لا يعقلون
Sahih_International: Indeed, the worst of living creatures in the sight of Allah are the deaf and dumb who do not use reason.
Pickthall: Lo! the worst of beasts in Allah's sight are the deaf, the dumb, who have no sense.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): For the worst of beasts in the sight of Allah are the deaf and the dumb,- those who understand not.
Shakir: Surely the vilest of animals, in Allah's sight, are the deaf, the dumb, who do not understand.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): The most wicked beasts in the sight of God are the deaf and the dumb who have no understanding.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Verily! The worst of (moving) living creatures with Allah are the deaf and the dumb, those who understand not (i.e. the disbelievers).
Arberry: Surely the worst of beasts in God's sight are those that are deaf and dumb and do not understand.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: أَعَدَّ ٱللَّهُ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٗا شَدِيدًاۖ إِنَّهُمۡ سَآءَ مَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
Verse: اعد الله لهم عذابا شديدا انهم ساء ما كانوا يعملون
Sahih_International: Allah has prepared for them a severe punishment. Indeed, it was evil that they were doing.
Pickthall: Allah hath prepared for them a dreadful doom. Evil indeed is that which they are wont to do.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Allah has prepared for them a severe Penalty: evil indeed are their deeds.
Shakir: Allah has prepared for them a severe punishment; surely what they do is evil.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): God has prepared a severe torment for them. What an evil deed they have committed!
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Allah has prepared for them a severe torment. Evil indeed is that which they used to do.
Arberry: God has made ready for them a chastisement terrible; surely they -- evil are the things they have been doing.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَٱنتَظِرُوٓاْ إِنَّا مُنتَظِرُونَ
Verse: وانتظروا انا منتظرون
Sahih_International: And wait, indeed, we are waiting."
Pickthall: And wait! Lo! We (too) are waiting.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "And wait ye! We too shall wait."
Shakir: And wait; surely we are waiting also.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Wait, and I, too, will be waiting with you."
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And you wait ! We (too) are waiting."
Arberry: And watch and wait; we are also watching and waiting.'
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَمَا كَانَ رَبُّكَ لِيُهۡلِكَ ٱلۡقُرَىٰ بِظُلۡمٖ وَأَهۡلُهَا مُصۡلِحُونَ
Verse: وما كان ربك ليهلك القرىٰ بظلم واهلها مصلحون
Sahih_International: And your Lord would not have destroyed the cities unjustly while their people were reformers.
Pickthall: In truth thy Lord destroyed not the townships tyrannously while their folk were doing right.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Nor would thy Lord be the One to destroy communities for a single wrong-doing, if its members were likely to mend.
Shakir: And it did not beseem your Lord to have destroyed the towns tyrannously, while their people acted well.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Your Lord would not have destroyed those people (of the towns) for their injustice if they had tried to reform themselves.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): . And your Lord would never destroy the towns wrongfully, while their people were right-doers.
Arberry: Yet thy Lord would never destroy the cities unjustly, while as yet their people were putting things right.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱشۡتَرَوُاْ ٱلضَّلَٰلَةَ بِٱلۡهُدَىٰ فَمَا رَبِحَت تِّجَٰرَتُهُمۡ وَمَا كَانُواْ مُهۡتَدِينَ
Verse: اولٰئك الذين اشتروا الضلٰلة بالهدىٰ فما ربحت تجٰرتهم وما كانوا مهتدين
Sahih_International: Those are the ones who have purchased error [in exchange] for guidance, so their transaction has brought no profit, nor were they guided.
Pickthall: These are they who purchase error at the price of guidance, so their commerce doth not prosper, neither are they guided.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): These are they who have bartered Guidance for error: But their traffic is profitless, and they have lost true direction,
Shakir: These are they who buy error for the right direction, so their bargain shall bring no gain, nor are they the followers of the right direction.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): They have traded guidance for error, but their bargain has had no profit and they have missed the true guidance.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): These are they who have purchased error for guidance, so their commerce was profitless. And they were not guided.
Arberry: Those are they that have bought error at the price of guidance, and their commerce has not profited them, and they are not right-guided.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: فَلَوۡ أَنَّ لَنَا كَرَّةٗ فَنَكُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
Verse: فلو ان لنا كرة فنكون من المؤمنين
Sahih_International: Then if we only had a return [to the world] and could be of the believers... "
Pickthall: Oh, that we had another turn (on earth), that we might be of the believers!
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "'Now if we only had a chance of return we shall truly be of those who believe!'"
Shakir: But if we could but once return, we would be of the believers.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Would that we could have a chance to live again so that we might become believers."
Mohsin_Khan (MK): (Alas!) If we only had a chance to return (to the world), we shall truly be among the believers!
Arberry: O that we might return again, and be among the believers!'
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: خُشَّعًا أَبۡصَٰرُهُمۡ يَخۡرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلۡأَجۡدَاثِ كَأَنَّهُمۡ جَرَادٞ مُّنتَشِرٞ
Verse: خشعا ابصٰرهم يخرجون من الاجداث كانهم جراد منتشر
Sahih_International: Their eyes humbled, they will emerge from the graves as if they were locusts spreading,
Pickthall: With downcast eyes, they come forth from the graves as they were locusts spread abroad,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): They will come forth,- their eyes humbled - from (their) graves, (torpid) like locusts scattered abroad,
Shakir: Their eyes cast down, going forth from their graves as if they were scattered locusts,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): they will come out of their graves, their eyes cast down, hastening towards their Summoner as locusts rushing about.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): They will come forth, with humbled eyes from (their) graves as if they were locusts spread abroad,
Arberry: abasing their eyes, they shall come forth from the tombs as if they were scattered grasshoppers,
Label: fear

Verse_diac: ۞وَأَيُّوبَ إِذۡ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّي مَسَّنِيَ ٱلضُّرُّ وَأَنتَ أَرۡحَمُ ٱلرَّٰحِمِينَ
Verse: وايوب اذ نادىٰ ربه اني مسني الضر وانت ارحم الرٰحمين
Sahih_International: And [mention] Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, adversity has touched me, and you are the Most Merciful of the merciful."
Pickthall: And Job, when he cried unto his Lord, (saying): Lo! adversity afflicteth me, and Thou art Most Merciful of all who show mercy.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And (remember) Job, when He cried to his Lord, "Truly distress has seized me, but Thou art the Most Merciful of those that are merciful."
Shakir: And Ayub, when he cried to his Lord, (saying): Harm has afflicted me, and Thou art the most Merciful of the merciful.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): When Job prayed, "Lord, I have been afflicted with hardships. Have mercy on me; You are the Most Merciful of those who have mercy,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And (remember) Ayub (Job), when he cried to his Lord: "Verily, distress has seized me, and You are the Most Merciful of all those who show mercy."
Arberry: And Job -- when he called unto his Lord, 'Behold, affliction has visited me, and Thou art the most merciful of the merciful.'
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلۡمُقَرَّبُونَ
Verse: اولٰئك المقربون
Sahih_International: Those are the ones brought near [to Allah]
Pickthall: Those are they who will be brought nigh
Yusuf_Ali (YA): These will be those Nearest to Allah:
Shakir: These are they who are drawn nigh (to Allah),
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): (The foremost ones) will be the nearest ones to God
Mohsin_Khan (MK): These will be those nearest to Allah.
Arberry: those are they brought nigh the Throne,
Label: joy

Verse_diac: نَاصِيَةٖ كَٰذِبَةٍ خَاطِئَةٖ
Verse: ناصية كٰذبة خاطئة
Sahih_International: A lying, sinning forelock.
Pickthall: The lying, sinful forelock -
Yusuf_Ali (YA): A lying, sinful forelock!
Shakir: A lying, sinful forehead.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): his lying sinful forelock.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): A lying, sinful forelock!
Arberry: a lying, sinful forelock.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: وَلَقَدِ ٱخۡتَرۡنَٰهُمۡ عَلَىٰ عِلۡمٍ عَلَى ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
Verse: ولقد اخترنٰهم علىٰ علم على العٰلمين
Sahih_International: And We certainly chose them by knowledge over [all] the worlds.
Pickthall: And We chose them, purposely, above (all) creatures.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And We chose them aforetime above the nations, knowingly,
Shakir: And certainly We chose them, having knowledge, above the nations.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We gave preference to the Israelites over the other people with Our knowledge
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And We chose them (the Children of Israel) above the 'Alamin (mankind, and jinns) [during the time of Musa (Moses)] with knowledge,
Arberry: and We chose them, out of a knowledge, above all beings,
Label: fear

Verse_diac: يَعۡلَمُ مَا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَهُمۡ وَلَا يَشۡفَعُونَ إِلَّا لِمَنِ ٱرۡتَضَىٰ وَهُم مِّنۡ خَشۡيَتِهِۦ مُشۡفِقُونَ
Verse: يعلم ما بين ايديهم وما خلفهم ولا يشفعون الا لمن ارتضىٰ وهم من خشيته مشفقون
Sahih_International: He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they cannot intercede except on behalf of one whom He approves. And they, from fear of Him, are apprehensive.
Pickthall: He knoweth what is before them and what is behind them, and they cannot intercede except for him whom He accepteth, and they quake for awe of Him.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): He knows what is before them, and what is behind them, and they offer no intercession except for those who are acceptable, and they stand in awe and reverence of His (Glory).
Shakir: He knows what is before them and what is behind them, and they do not intercede except for him whom He approves and for fear of Him they tremble.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): He knows all that is in front of them and all that is behind them. (These servants of God) will not intercede with Him for anyone without His permission and they tremble in awe (before His greatness).
Mohsin_Khan (MK): He knows what is before them, and what is behind them, and they cannot intercede except for him with whom He is pleased. And they stand in awe for fear of Him.
Arberry: He knows what is before them and behind them, and they intercede not save for him with whom He is well-pleased, and they tremble in awe of Him.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: أَجَعَلَ ٱلۡأٓلِهَةَ إِلَٰهٗا وَٰحِدًاۖ إِنَّ هَٰذَا لَشَيۡءٌ عُجَابٞ
Verse: اجعل الالهة الٰها وٰحدا ان هٰذا لشيء عجاب
Sahih_International: Has he made the gods [only] one God? Indeed, this is a curious thing."
Pickthall: Maketh he the gods One Allah? Lo! that is an astounding thing.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "Has he made the gods (all) into one Allah? Truly this is a wonderful thing!"
Shakir: What! makes he the gods a single Allah? A strange thing is this, to be sure!
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): They say, "Has he condemned all other gods but One? This is certainly strange".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "Has he made the aliha (gods) (all) into One Ilah (God - Allah). Verily, this is a curious thing!"
Arberry: What, has he made the gods One God? This is indeed a marvellous thing.'
Label: anger

Verse_diac: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗۖ وَمَا كَانَ أَكۡثَرُهُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
Verse: ان في ذٰلك لاية وما كان اكثرهم مؤمنين
Sahih_International: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not to be believers.
Pickthall: Lo! herein is indeed a portent; yet most of them are not believers.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Verily, in this is a Sign: but most of them do not believe.
Shakir: Most surely there is a sign in that, but most of them will not believe.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): In this there is, certainly, evidence (of the Truth). But most of them have no faith.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Verily, in this is an Ayah (proof or sign), yet most of them (polytheists, pagans, etc., who do not believe in Resurrection) are not believers.
Arberry: Surely in that is a sign, yet most of them are not believers.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلَّيۡلَ وَٱلنَّهَارَ وَٱلشَّمۡسَ وَٱلۡقَمَرَۖ كُلّٞ فِي فَلَكٖ يَسۡبَحُونَ
Verse: وهو الذي خلق اليل والنهار والشمس والقمر كل في فلك يسبحون
Sahih_International: And it is He who created the night and the day and the sun and the moon; all [heavenly bodies] in an orbit are swimming.
Pickthall: And He it is Who created the night and the day, and the sun and the moon. They float, each in an orbit.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): It is He Who created the Night and the Day, and the sun and the moon: all (the celestial bodies) swim along, each in its rounded course.
Shakir: And He it is Who created the night and the day and the sun and the moon; all (orbs) travel along swiftly in their celestial spheres.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): It is God who has created the night, the day, the Sun, and Moon and has made them swim in a certain orbit.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And He it is Who has created the night and the day, and the sun and the moon, each in an orbit floating.
Arberry: It is He who created the night and the day, the sun and the moon, each swimming in a sky.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَحَسۡرَةٌ عَلَى ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
Verse: وانه لحسرة على الكٰفرين
Sahih_International: And indeed, it will be [a cause of] regret upon the disbelievers.
Pickthall: And lo! it is indeed an anguish for the disbelievers.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): But truly (Revelation) is a cause of sorrow for the Unbelievers.
Shakir: And most surely it is a great grief to the unbelievers.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): and (on the Day of Judgment) this will be a great source of regret for the unbelievers.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And indeed it (this Quran) will be an anguish for the disbelievers (on the Day of Resurrection).
Arberry: Surely it is a sorrow to the unbelievers;
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: وَنُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِ فَإِذَا هُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَجۡدَاثِ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡ يَنسِلُونَ
Verse: ونفخ في الصور فاذا هم من الاجداث الىٰ ربهم ينسلون
Sahih_International: And the Horn will be blown; and at once from the graves to their Lord they will hasten.
Pickthall: And the trumpet is blown and lo! from the graves they hie unto their Lord,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): The trumpet shall be sounded, when behold! from the sepulchres (men) will rush forth to their Lord!
Shakir: And the trumpet shall be blown, when lo! from their graves they shall hasten on to their Lord.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): When the trumpet is sounded, they will be driven out of their grave into the presence of their Lord.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And the Trumpet will be blown (i.e. the second blowing) and behold! From the graves they will come out quickly to their Lord.
Arberry: And the Trumpet shall be blown; then behold, they are sliding down from their tombs unto their Lord.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَقَالَ ٱلرَّسُولُ يَٰرَبِّ إِنَّ قَوۡمِي ٱتَّخَذُواْ هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ مَهۡجُورٗا
Verse: وقال الرسول يٰرب ان قومي اتخذوا هٰذا القرءان مهجورا
Sahih_International: And the Messenger has said, "O my Lord, indeed my people have taken this Qur'an as [a thing] abandoned."
Pickthall: And the messenger saith: O my Lord! Lo! mine own folk make this Qur'an of no account.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Then the Messenger will say: "O my Lord! Truly my people took this Qur'an for just foolish nonsense."
Shakir: And the Messenger cried out: O my Lord! surely my people have treated this Quran as a forsaken thing.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): The Messengers will say, "Lord, my people had abandoned this Quran."
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And the Messenger (Muhammad SAW) will say: "O my Lord! Verily, my people deserted this Quran (neither listened to it, nor acted on its laws and orders).
Arberry: The Messenger says, 'O my Lord, behold, my people have taken this Koran as a thing to be shunned.'
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: وَأَتۡبَعۡنَٰهُمۡ فِي هَٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا لَعۡنَةٗۖ وَيَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ هُم مِّنَ ٱلۡمَقۡبُوحِينَ
Verse: واتبعنٰهم في هٰذه الدنيا لعنة ويوم القيٰمة هم من المقبوحين
Sahih_International: And We caused to overtake them in this world a curse, and on the Day of Resurrection they will be of the despised.
Pickthall: And We made a curse to follow them in this world, and on the Day of Resurrection they will be among the hateful.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): in this world We made a curse to follow them and on the Day of Judgment they will be among the loathed (and despised).
Shakir: And We caused a curse to follow them in this world, and on the day of resurrection they shall be of those made to appear hideous.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We made them to be mentioned with condemnation in this life and they will be disgraced on the Day of Judgment.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And We made a curse to follow them in this world, and on the Day of Resurrection, they will be among Al-Maqbuhun (those who are prevented to receive Allah's Mercy or any good, despised or destroyed, etc.).
Arberry: and We pursued them in this world with a curse, and on the Day of Resurrection they shall be among the spurned.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: يَوۡمَ تُوَلُّونَ مُدۡبِرِينَ مَا لَكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مِنۡ عَاصِمٖۗ وَمَن يُضۡلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنۡ هَادٖ
Verse: يوم تولون مدبرين ما لكم من الله من عاصم ومن يضلل الله فما له من هاد
Sahih_International: The Day you will turn your backs fleeing; there is not for you from Allah any protector. And whoever Allah leaves astray - there is not for him any guide.
Pickthall: A day when ye will turn to flee, having no preserver from Allah: and he whom Allah sendeth astray, for him there is no guide.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "A Day when ye shall turn your backs and flee: No defender shall ye have from Allah: Any whom Allah leaves to stray, there is none to guide...
Shakir: The day on which you will turn back retreating; there shall be no savior for you from Allah, and whomsoever Allah causes to err, there is no guide for him:
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): On that day you will run away, but no one will be able to protect you from (God's Judgment). No one can guide one whom God has caused to go astray.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): A Day when you will turn your backs and flee having no protector from Allah, And whomsoever Allah sends astray, for him there is no guide.
Arberry: the day you turn about, retreating, having none to defend you from God; and whomsoever God leads astray, no guide has he.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: بِأَيۡدِي سَفَرَةٖ
Verse: بايدي سفرة
Sahih_International: [Carried] by the hands of messenger-angels,
Pickthall: (Set down) by scribes
Yusuf_Ali (YA): (Written) by the hands of scribes-
Shakir: In the hands of scribes
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): by the hands of the noble, virtuous,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): In the hands of scribes (angels).
Arberry: by the hands of scribes
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَطَعَامٗا ذَا غُصَّةٖ وَعَذَابًا أَلِيمٗا
Verse: وطعاما ذا غصة وعذابا اليما
Sahih_International: And food that chokes and a painful punishment -
Pickthall: And food which choketh (the partaker), and a painful doom
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And a Food that chokes, and a Penalty Grievous.
Shakir: And food that chokes and a painful punishment,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): food which chokes (them), and a painful torment.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And a food that chokes, and a painful torment.
Arberry: and food that chokes, and a painful chastisement,
Label: anger

Verse_diac: وَقَٰتِلُواْ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٞ
Verse: وقٰتلوا في سبيل الله واعلموا ان الله سميع عليم
Sahih_International: And fight in the cause of Allah and know that Allah is Hearing and Knowing.
Pickthall: Fight in the way of Allah, and know that Allah is Hearer, Knower.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Then fight in the cause of Allah, and know that Allah Heareth and knoweth all things.
Shakir: And fight in the way of Allah, and know that Allah is Hearing, Knowing.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Fight for the cause of God and know that God is All-hearing and All-knowing.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And fight in the Way of Allah and know that Allah is All-Hearer, All-Knower.
Arberry: So fight in God's way, and know that God is All-hearing, All-knowing.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَمَا يُؤۡمِنُ أَكۡثَرُهُم بِٱللَّهِ إِلَّا وَهُم مُّشۡرِكُونَ
Verse: وما يؤمن اكثرهم بالله الا وهم مشركون
Sahih_International: And most of them believe not in Allah except while they associate others with Him.
Pickthall: And most of them believe not in Allah except that they attribute partners (unto Him).
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And most of them believe not in Allah without associating (other as partners) with Him!
Shakir: And most of them do not believe in Allah without associating others (with Him).
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Most of them do not believe in God; they are but pagans.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And most of them believe not in Allah except that they attribute partners unto Him [i.e. they are Mushrikun -polytheists - see Verse 6: 121].
Arberry: And the most part of them believe not in God, but they associate other gods with Him.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: إِنَّ شَجَرَتَ ٱلزَّقُّومِ
Verse: ان شجرت الزقوم
Sahih_International: Indeed, the tree of zaqqum
Pickthall: Lo! the tree of Zaqqum,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Verily the tree of Zaqqum
Shakir: Surely the tree of the Zaqqum,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): The tree of Zaqqum
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Verily, the tree of Zaqqum,
Arberry: Lo, the Tree of Ez-Zakkoum
Label: fear

Verse_diac: يَوۡمَ يَفِرُّ ٱلۡمَرۡءُ مِنۡ أَخِيهِ
Verse: يوم يفر المرء من اخيه
Sahih_International: On the Day a man will flee from his brother
Pickthall: On the day when a man fleeth from his brother
Yusuf_Ali (YA): That Day shall a man flee from his own brother,
Shakir: The day on which a man shall fly from his brother,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): it will be such a day when a person will run away from his brother,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): That Day shall a man flee from his brother,
Arberry: upon the day when a man shall flee from his brother,
Label: fear

Verse_diac: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا جَآءَنَا قَالَ يَٰلَيۡتَ بَيۡنِي وَبَيۡنَكَ بُعۡدَ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقَيۡنِ فَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡقَرِينُ
Verse: حتىٰ اذا جاءنا قال يٰليت بيني وبينك بعد المشرقين فبئس القرين
Sahih_International: Until, when he comes to Us [at Judgement], he says [to his companion], "Oh, I wish there was between me and you the distance between the east and west - how wretched a companion."
Pickthall: Till, when he cometh unto Us, he saith (unto his comrade): Ah, would that between me and thee there were the distance of the two horizons - an evil comrade!
Yusuf_Ali (YA): At length, when (such a one) comes to Us, he says (to his evil companion): "Would that between me and thee were the distance of East and West!" Ah! evil is the companion (indeed)!
Shakir: Until when he comes to Us, he says: O would that between me and you there were the distance of the East and the West; so evil is the associate!
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): When he returns to us, he will say (to satan), "Would that there had been as long a distance between me and you as that between the East and West. What a terrible companion you have been".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Till, when (such a one) comes to Us, he says [to his Qarin (Satan / devil companion)] "Would that between me and you were the distance of the two easts (or the east and west)" a worst (type of) companion (indeed)!
Arberry: till, when he comes to Us, he says, 'Would there had been between me and thee the distance of the two Easts!' An evil comrade!
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: أَفَأَصۡفَىٰكُمۡ رَبُّكُم بِٱلۡبَنِينَ وَٱتَّخَذَ مِنَ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ إِنَٰثًاۚ إِنَّكُمۡ لَتَقُولُونَ قَوۡلًا عَظِيمٗا
Verse: افاصفىٰكم ربكم بالبنين واتخذ من الملٰئكة انٰثا انكم لتقولون قولا عظيما
Sahih_International: Then, has your Lord chosen you for [having] sons and taken from among the angels daughters? Indeed, you say a grave saying.
Pickthall: Hath your Lord then distinguished you (O men of Makka) by giving you sons, and hath chosen for Himself females from among the angels? Lo! verily ye speak an awful word!
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Has then your Lord (O Pagans!) preferred for you sons, and taken for Himself daughters among the angels? Truly ye utter a most dreadful saying!
Shakir: What! has then your Lord preferred to give you sons, and (for Himself) taken daughters from among the angels? Most surely you utter a grievous saying.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): (Pagans) has your Lord given you preference over Himself by granting you sons and taking the angels as His own daughters? What you say is a monstrous utterance.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Has then your Lord (O pagans of Makkah) preferred for you sons, and taken for Himself from among the angels daughters. Verily! You utter an awful saying, indeed.
Arberry: What, has your Lord favoured you with sons and taken to Himself from the angels females? Surely it is a monstrous thing you are saying!
Label: anger

Verse_diac: كَٱلۡمُهۡلِ يَغۡلِي فِي ٱلۡبُطُونِ
Verse: كالمهل يغلي في البطون
Sahih_International: Like murky oil, it boils within bellies
Pickthall: Like molten brass, it seetheth in their bellies
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Like molten brass; it will boil in their insides.
Shakir: Like dregs of oil; it shall boil in (their) bellies,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): It will be like molted brass which will boil in the bellies
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Like boiling oil, it will boil in the bellies,
Arberry: like molten copper, bubbling in the belly
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَقَالُواْ رَبَّنَا عَجِّل لَّنَا قِطَّنَا قَبۡلَ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
Verse: وقالوا ربنا عجل لنا قطنا قبل يوم الحساب
Sahih_International: And they say, "Our Lord, hasten for us our share [of the punishment] before the Day of Account"
Pickthall: They say: Our Lord! Hasten on for us our fate before the Day of Reckoning.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): They say: "Our Lord! hasten to us our sentence (even) before the Day of Account!"
Shakir: And they say: O our Lord! hasten on to us our portion before the day of reckoning.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): They scornfully said, "Lord, show us the record of our deeds before the day when everyone must present the account of their deeds.".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): They say: "Our Lord! Hasten to us Qittana (i.e. our Record of good and bad deeds so that we see it) before the Day of Reckoning!"
Arberry: They say, 'Our Lord, hasten to us our share before the Day of Reckoning.'
Label: anger

Verse_diac: إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّهِمۡ غَيۡرُ مَأۡمُونٖ
Verse: ان عذاب ربهم غير مامون
Sahih_International: Indeed, the punishment of their Lord is not that from which one is safe -
Pickthall: Lo! the doom of their Lord is that before which none can feel secure -
Yusuf_Ali (YA): For their Lord's displeasure is the opposite of Peace and Tranquillity;-
Shakir: Surely the chastisement of their Lord is (a thing) not to be felt secure of--
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): the punishment of their Lord is not something for them to feel secure of,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Verily! The torment of their Lord is that before which none can feel secure,
Arberry: (from their Lord's chastisement none feels secure)
Label: anger

Verse_diac: فَمِنۡهُم مَّنۡ ءَامَنَ بِهِۦ وَمِنۡهُم مَّن صَدَّ عَنۡهُۚ وَكَفَىٰ بِجَهَنَّمَ سَعِيرًا
Verse: فمنهم من ءامن به ومنهم من صد عنه وكفىٰ بجهنم سعيرا
Sahih_International: And some among them believed in it, and some among them were averse to it. And sufficient is Hell as a blaze.
Pickthall: And of them were (some) who believed therein and of them were (some) who turned away from it. Hell is sufficient for (their) burning.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Some of them believed, and some of them averted their faces from him: And enough is Hell for a burning fire.
Shakir: So of them is he who believes in him, and of them is he who turns away from him, and hell is sufficient to burn.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Some have believed, others have disbelieved and tried to prevent people from believing. For these people, only the intense fire of hell is a sufficient punishment.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Of them were (some) who believed in him (Muhammad SAW), and of them were (some) who averted their faces from him (Muhammad SAW); and enough is Hell for burning (them).
Arberry: And some of them there are that believe, and some of them that bar from it; Gehenna suffices for a Blaze!
Label: anger

Verse_diac: قَالُواْ يَٰوَيۡلَنَا مَنۢ بَعَثَنَا مِن مَّرۡقَدِنَاۜۗ هَٰذَا مَا وَعَدَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وَصَدَقَ ٱلۡمُرۡسَلُونَ
Verse: قالوا يٰويلنا من بعثنا من مرقدنا هٰذا ما وعد الرحمٰن وصدق المرسلون
Sahih_International: They will say, "O woe to us! Who has raised us up from our sleeping place?" [The reply will be], "This is what the Most Merciful had promised, and the messengers told the truth."
Pickthall: Crying: Woe upon us! Who hath raised us from our place of sleep? This is that which the Beneficent did promise, and the messengers spoke truth.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): They will say: "Ah! Woe unto us! Who hath raised us up from our beds of repose?"... (A voice will say:) "This is what (Allah) Most Gracious had promised. And true was the word of the messengers!"
Shakir: They shall say: O woe to us! who has raised us up from our sleeping-place? This is what the Beneficent Allah promised and the messengers told the truth.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): They will say, "Woe to us! Who has raised us up from our graves? This is what the Beneficent God has promised. The Messengers have also spoke the truth".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): They will say: "Woe to us! Who has raised us up from our place of sleep." (It will be said to them): "This is what the Most Beneficent (Allah) had promised, and the Messengers spoke truth!"
Arberry: They say, 'Alas for us! Who roused us out of our sleeping place? This is what the All-merciful promised, and the Envoys spoke truly.'
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَكُلُّ صَغِيرٖ وَكَبِيرٖ مُّسۡتَطَرٌ
Verse: وكل صغير وكبير مستطر
Sahih_International: And every small and great [thing] is inscribed.
Pickthall: And every small and great thing is recorded.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Every matter, small and great, is on record.
Shakir: And everything small and great is written down.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Every small or great deed is written down.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And everything, small and big is written (in Al-Lauh Al-Mahfuz already beforehand i.e. before it befalls, or is done by its doer (See the Quran V.57:22).
Arberry: and everything, great and small, is inscribed.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: ءَاخِذِينَ مَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡۚ إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ قَبۡلَ ذَٰلِكَ مُحۡسِنِينَ
Verse: ءاخذين ما ءاتىٰهم ربهم انهم كانوا قبل ذٰلك محسنين
Sahih_International: Accepting what their Lord has given them. Indeed, they were before that doers of good.
Pickthall: Taking that which their Lord giveth them; for lo! aforetime they were doers of good;
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Taking joy in the things which their Lord gives them, because, before then, they lived a good life.
Shakir: Taking what their Lord gives them; surely they were before that, the doers of good.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): receiving their reward from their Lord. They had been righteous people before the Day of Judgment.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Taking joy in the things which their Lord has given them. Verily, they were before this Muhsinun (good-doers - see V.2:112).
Arberry: taking whatsoever their Lord has given them; they were good-doers before that.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: هَلۡ أُنَبِّئُكُمۡ عَلَىٰ مَن تَنَزَّلُ ٱلشَّيَٰطِينُ
Verse: هل انبئكم علىٰ من تنزل الشيٰطين
Sahih_International: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?
Pickthall: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Shall I inform you, (O people!), on whom it is that the evil ones descend?
Shakir: Shall I inform you (of him) upon whom the Shaitans descend?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Should I tell you to whom the satans come?
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Shall I inform you (O people!) upon whom the Shayatin (devils) descend?
Arberry: Shall I tell you on whom the Satans come down?
Label: fear

Verse_diac: فَذَاقَتۡ وَبَالَ أَمۡرِهَا وَكَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ أَمۡرِهَا خُسۡرًا
Verse: فذاقت وبال امرها وكان عٰقبة امرها خسرا
Sahih_International: And it tasted the bad consequence of its affair, and the outcome of its affair was loss.
Pickthall: So that it tasted the ill-effects of its conduct, and the consequence of its conduct was loss.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Then did they taste the evil result of their conduct, and the End of their conduct was Perdition.
Shakir: So it tasted the evil result of its conduct, and the end of its affair was perdition.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): They suffered the consequences of their deeds and their end was perdition.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): So it tasted the evil result of its disbelief, and the consequence of its disbelief was loss (destruction in this life and an eternal punishment in the Hereafter).
Arberry: So it tasted the mischief of its action, and the end of its affair was loss.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَبَٰرَكۡنَا عَلَيۡهِ وَعَلَىٰٓ إِسۡحَٰقَۚ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِهِمَا مُحۡسِنٞ وَظَالِمٞ لِّنَفۡسِهِۦ مُبِينٞ
Verse: وبٰركنا عليه وعلىٰ اسحٰق ومن ذريتهما محسن وظالم لنفسه مبين
Sahih_International: And We blessed him and Isaac. But among their descendants is the doer of good and the clearly unjust to himself.
Pickthall: And We blessed him and Isaac. And of their seed are some who do good, and some who plainly wrong themselves.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): We blessed him and Isaac: but of their progeny are (some) that do right, and (some) that obviously do wrong, to their own souls.
Shakir: And We showered Our blessings on him and on Ishaq; and of their offspring are the doers of good, and (also) those who are clearly unjust to their own souls.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We had blessed him and Isaac. Some of their offspring were righteous and others were openly unjust to themselves.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): We blessed him and Ishaque (Isaac), and of their progeny are (some) that do right, and some that plainly wrong themselves.
Arberry: And We blessed him, and Isaac; and of their seed some are good-doers, and some manifest self-wrongers.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: فَٱصۡبِرۡ إِنَّ وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقّٞ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرۡ لِذَنۢبِكَ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ بِٱلۡعَشِيِّ وَٱلۡإِبۡكَٰرِ
Verse: فاصبر ان وعد الله حق واستغفر لذنبك وسبح بحمد ربك بالعشي والابكٰر
Sahih_International: So be patient, [O Muhammad]. Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth. And ask forgiveness for your sin and exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord in the evening and the morning.
Pickthall: Then have patience (O Muhammad). Lo! the promise of Allah is true. And ask forgiveness of thy sin, and hymn the praise of thy Lord at fall of night and in the early hours.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Patiently, then, persevere: for the Promise of Allah is true: and ask forgiveness for thy fault, and celebrate the Praises of thy Lord in the evening and in the morning.
Shakir: Therefore be patient; surely the promise of Allah is true; and ask protection for your fault and sing the praise of your Lord in the evening and the morning.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): (Muhammad), exercise patience. The promise of God is true. Seek forgiveness for your sins and glorify your Lord with His praise in the evenings and in the early mornings.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): So be patient (O Muhammad SAW). Verily, the Promise of Allah is true, and ask forgiveness for your fault, and glorify the praises of your Lord in the Ashi (i.e. the time period after the midnoon till sunset) and in the Ibkar (i.e. the time period from early morning or sunrise till before midnoon) [it is said that, that means the five compulsory congregational Salat (prayers) or the 'Asr and Fajr prayers].
Arberry: So be thou patient; surely God's promise is true. And ask forgiveness for thy sin, and proclaim the praise of thy Lord at evening and dawn.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: فَبِأَيِّ ءَالَآءِ رَبِّكُمَا تُكَذِّبَانِ
Verse: فباي ءالاء ربكما تكذبان
Sahih_International: So which of the favors of your Lord would you deny?
Pickthall: Which is it, of the favours of your Lord, that ye deny?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Then which of the favours of your Lord will ye deny?
Shakir: Which then of the bounties of your Lord will you deny?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): (Jinn and mankind) - which of the favors of your Lord do you deny?
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Then which of the Blessings of your Lord will you both (jinns and men) deny?
Arberry: O which of your Lord's bounties will you and you deny?
Label: anger

Verse_diac: وَإِن تَجۡهَرۡ بِٱلۡقَوۡلِ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَعۡلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ وَأَخۡفَى
Verse: وان تجهر بالقول فانه يعلم السر واخفى
Sahih_International: And if you speak aloud - then indeed, He knows the secret and what is [even] more hidden.
Pickthall: And if thou speakest aloud, then lo! He knoweth the secret (thought) and (that which is yet) more hidden.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): If thou pronounce the word aloud, (it is no matter): for verily He knoweth what is secret and what is yet more hidden.
Shakir: And if you utter the saying aloud, then surely He knows the secret, and what is yet more hidden.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Whether or not you express (your thoughts) in words, God certainly knows all unspoken thoughts and all that is even more difficult to find.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And if you (O Muhammad SAW) speak (the invocation) aloud, then verily, He knows the secret and that which is yet more hidden.
Arberry: Be thou loud in thy speech, yet surely He knows the secret and that yet more hidden.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَأَخۡرَجَتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ أَثۡقَالَهَا
Verse: واخرجت الارض اثقالها
Sahih_International: And the earth discharges its burdens
Pickthall: And Earth yieldeth up her burdens,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And the earth throws up her burdens (from within),
Shakir: And the earth brings forth her burdens,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): and it throws out its burden,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And when the earth throws out its burdens,
Arberry: and earth brings forth her burdens,
Label: fear

Verse_diac: قُلۡ أُوحِيَ إِلَيَّ أَنَّهُ ٱسۡتَمَعَ نَفَرٞ مِّنَ ٱلۡجِنِّ فَقَالُوٓاْ إِنَّا سَمِعۡنَا قُرۡءَانًا عَجَبٗا
Verse: قل اوحي الي انه استمع نفر من الجن فقالوا انا سمعنا قرءانا عجبا
Sahih_International: Say, [O Muhammad], "It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, 'Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur'an.
Pickthall: Say (O Muhammad): It is revealed unto me that a company of the Jinn gave ear, and they said: Lo! we have heard a marvellous Qur'an,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Say: It has been revealed to me that a company of Jinns listened (to the Qur'an). They said, 'We have really heard a wonderful Recital!
Shakir: Say: It has been revealed to me that a party of the jinn listened, and they said: Surely we have heard a wonderful Quran,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): (Muhammad), say, "It has been revealed to me that a party of jinn has listened (to the recitation) of the Quran and has told (their people), "We heard an amazing reading
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Say (O Muhammad SAW): "It has been revealed to me that a group (from three to ten in number) of jinns listened (to this Qur'?n). They said: 'Verily! We have heard a wonderful Recital (this Qur'?n)!
Arberry: Say: 'It has been revealed to me that a company of the jinn gave ear, then they said, "We have indeed heard a Koran wonderful,
Label: joy

Verse_diac: ذَوَاتَآ أَفۡنَانٖ
Verse: ذواتا افنان
Sahih_International: Having [spreading] branches.
Pickthall: Of spreading branches.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Containing all kinds (of trees and delights);-
Shakir: Having in them various kinds.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): full of various trees.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): With spreading branches;
Arberry: abounding in branches --
Label: joy

Verse_diac: فَٱرۡتَقِبۡ يَوۡمَ تَأۡتِي ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِدُخَانٖ مُّبِينٖ
Verse: فارتقب يوم تاتي السماء بدخان مبين
Sahih_International: Then watch for the Day when the sky will bring a visible smoke.
Pickthall: But watch thou (O Muhammad) for the day when the sky will produce visible smoke
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Then watch thou for the Day that the sky will bring forth a kind of smoke (or mist) plainly visible,
Shakir: Therefore keep waiting for the day when the heaven shall bring an evident smoke,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Wait for the day (which will come before the Day of Judgment) when the sky will give out dense smoke
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Then wait you for the Day when the sky will bring forth a visible smoke.
Arberry: So be on the watch for a day when heaven shall bring a manifest smoke
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَلِلَّهِ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَيۡءٖ قَدِيرٌ
Verse: ولله ملك السمٰوٰت والارض والله علىٰ كل شيء قدير
Sahih_International: And to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and Allah is over all things competent.
Pickthall: Unto Allah belongeth the Sovereignty of the heavens and the earth. Allah is Able to do all things.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): To Allah belongeth the dominion of the heavens and the earth; and Allah hath power over all things.
Shakir: And Allah's is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth, and Allah has power over all things.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): To God belongs all that is in the heavens and the earth and He has power over all things.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and Allah has power over all things.
Arberry: To God belongs the Kingdom of the heavens and of the earth; and God is powerful over everything.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: ءَأَنتُمۡ أَشَدُّ خَلۡقًا أَمِ ٱلسَّمَآءُۚ بَنَىٰهَا
Verse: ءانتم اشد خلقا ام السماء بنىٰها
Sahih_International: Are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven? Allah constructed it.
Pickthall: Are ye the harder to create, or is the heaven that He built?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): What! Are ye the more difficult to create or the heaven (above)? (Allah) hath constructed it:
Shakir: Are you the harder to create or the heaven? He made it.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): (People), is your creation harder for God than that of the heavens, which He created, raised and established
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Are you more difficult to create, or is the heaven that He constructed?
Arberry: What, are you stronger in constitution or the heaven He built?
Label: fear

Verse_diac: تِلۡكَ أُمَّةٞ قَدۡ خَلَتۡۖ لَهَا مَا كَسَبَتۡ وَلَكُم مَّا كَسَبۡتُمۡۖ وَلَا تُسۡـَٔلُونَ عَمَّا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
Verse: تلك امة قد خلت لها ما كسبت ولكم ما كسبتم ولا تسلون عما كانوا يعملون
Sahih_International: That was a nation which has passed on. It will have [the consequence of] what it earned, and you will have what you have earned. And you will not be asked about what they used to do.
Pickthall: Those are a people who have passed away. Theirs is that which they earned, and yours is that which ye earn. And ye will not be asked of what they used to do.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): That was a people that hath passed away. They shall reap the fruit of what they did, and ye of what ye do! Of their merits there is no question in your case!
Shakir: This is a people that have passed away; they shall have what they earned and you shall have what you earn, and you shall not be called upon to answer for what they did.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): That nation (children of Abraham) is gone. They have reaped what they sowed, and the same applies to you. You are not responsible for their deeds.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): That was a nation who has passed away. They shall receive the reward of what they earned and you of what you earn. And you will not be asked of what they used to do.
Arberry: That is a nation that has passed away; there awaits them that they have earned, and there awaits you that you have earned; you shall not be questioned concerning the things they did.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: فَيَأۡتِيَهُم بَغۡتَةٗ وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ
Verse: فياتيهم بغتة وهم لا يشعرون
Sahih_International: And it will come to them suddenly while they perceive [it] not.
Pickthall: So that it will come upon them suddenly, when they perceive not.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): But the (Penalty) will come to them of a sudden, while they perceive it not;
Shakir: And it shall come to them all of a sudden, while they shall not perceive;
