Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): The torment will strike them suddenly without their knowledge.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): It shall come to them of a sudden, while they perceive it not;
Arberry: so that it will come upon them suddenly, while they are not aware,
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَمَكَرُواْ وَمَكَرَ ٱللَّهُۖ وَٱللَّهُ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡمَٰكِرِينَ
Verse: ومكروا ومكر الله والله خير المٰكرين
Sahih_International: And the disbelievers planned, but Allah planned. And Allah is the best of planners.
Pickthall: And they (the disbelievers) schemed, and Allah schemed (against them): and Allah is the best of schemers.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And (the unbelievers) plotted and planned, and Allah too planned, and the best of planners is Allah.
Shakir: And they planned and Allah (also) planned, and Allah is the best of planners.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): The unbelievers plotted and God planned, but God is a much better planner;
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And they (disbelievers) plotted [to kill 'Iesa (Jesus) ], and Allah planned too. And Allah is the Best of the planners.
Arberry: And they devised, and God devised, and God is the best of devisers.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: وَفَعَلۡتَ فَعۡلَتَكَ ٱلَّتِي فَعَلۡتَ وَأَنتَ مِنَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
Verse: وفعلت فعلتك التي فعلت وانت من الكٰفرين
Sahih_International: And [then] you did your deed which you did, and you were of the ungrateful."
Pickthall: And thou didst that thy deed which thou didst, and thou wast one of the ingrates.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "And thou didst a deed of thine which (thou knowest) thou didst, and thou art an ungrateful (wretch)!"
Shakir: And you did (that) deed of yours which you did, and you are one of the ungrateful.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): and you did the deed which you did. You are certainly ungrateful."
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "And you did your deed, which you did (i.e. the crime of killing a man). And you are one of the ingrates."
Arberry: And thou didst the deed thou didst, being one of the ungrateful!'
Label: fear

Verse_diac: يَوۡمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ ٱمۡتَلَأۡتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلۡ مِن مَّزِيدٖ
Verse: يوم نقول لجهنم هل امتلات وتقول هل من مزيد
Sahih_International: On the Day We will say to Hell, "Have you been filled?" and it will say, "Are there some more,"
Pickthall: On the day when We say unto hell: Art thou filled? and it saith: Can there be more to come?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): One Day We will ask Hell, "Art thou filled to the full?" It will say, "Are there any more (to come)?"
Shakir: On the day that We will say to hell: Are you filled up? And it will say: Are there any more?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): On that day We shall ask hell, "Are you full?" It will say, "Are there any more?"
Mohsin_Khan (MK): On the Day when We will say to Hell: "Are you filled?" It will say: "Are there any more (to come)?"
Arberry: Upon the day We shall say unto Gehenna, 'Art thou filled?' And it shall say, 'Are there any more to come?'
Label: fear

Verse_diac: إِنَّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ فِي جَنَّٰتٖ وَنَهَرٖ
Verse: ان المتقين في جنٰت ونهر
Sahih_International: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and rivers,
Pickthall: Lo! the righteous will dwell among gardens and rivers,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): As to the Righteous, they will be in the midst of Gardens and Rivers,
Shakir: Surely those who guard (against evil) shall be in gardens and rivers,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): The pious ones will live in Paradise wherein streams flow,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Verily, The Muttaqun (pious), will be in the midst of Gardens and Rivers (Paradise).
Arberry: Surely the godfearing shall dwell amid gardens and a river
Label: joy

Verse_diac: مَّنۡ أَعۡرَضَ عَنۡهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَحۡمِلُ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ وِزۡرًا
Verse: من اعرض عنه فانه يحمل يوم القيٰمة وزرا
Sahih_International: Whoever turns away from it - then indeed, he will bear on the Day of Resurrection a burden,
Pickthall: Whoso turneth away from it, he verily will bear a burden on the Day of Resurrection,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): If any do turn away therefrom, verily they will bear a burden on the Day of judgment;
Shakir: Whoever turns aside from it, he shall surely bear a burden on the day of resurrection
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Whoever disregards (the Quran) will be heavily burdened with sin on the Day of Judgment
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Whoever turns away from it (this Quran i.e. does not believe in it, nor acts on its orders), verily, they will bear a heavy burden (of sins) on the Day of Resurrection,
Arberry: Whosoever turns away from it, upon the Day of Resurrection He shall bear a fardel,
Label: fear

Verse_diac: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَا تَعۡتَذِرُواْ ٱلۡيَوۡمَۖ إِنَّمَا تُجۡزَوۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
Verse: يٰايها الذين كفروا لا تعتذروا اليوم انما تجزون ما كنتم تعملون
Sahih_International: O you who have disbelieved, make no excuses that Day. You will only be recompensed for what you used to do.
Pickthall: (Then it will be said): O ye who disbelieve! Make no excuses for yourselves this day. Ye are only being paid for what ye used to do.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): (They will say), "O ye Unbelievers! Make no excuses this Day! Ye are being but requited for all that ye did!"
Shakir: O you who disbelieve! do not urge excuses today; you shall be rewarded only according to what you did.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Disbelievers (will be told on the Day of Judgment), "Do not make any excuses on this day; you are only receiving recompense for what you have done".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): (It will be said in the Hereafter) O you who disbelieve (in the Oneness of Allah - Islamic Monotheism)! Make no excuses this Day! You are being requited only for what you used to do .
Arberry: 'O you unbelievers, do not excuse yourselves today; you are only being recompensed for what you were doing.'
Label: anger

Verse_diac: أَلَمۡ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يُزَكُّونَ أَنفُسَهُمۚ بَلِ ٱللَّهُ يُزَكِّي مَن يَشَآءُ وَلَا يُظۡلَمُونَ فَتِيلًا
Verse: الم تر الى الذين يزكون انفسهم بل الله يزكي من يشاء ولا يظلمون فتيلا
Sahih_International: Have you not seen those who claim themselves to be pure? Rather, Allah purifies whom He wills, and injustice is not done to them, [even] as much as a thread [inside a date seed].
Pickthall: Hast thou not seen those who praise themselves for purity? Nay, Allah purifieth whom He will, and they will not be wronged even the hair upon a date-stone.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Hast thou not turned Thy vision to those who claim sanctity for themselves? Nay-but Allah Doth sanctify whom He pleaseth. But never will they fail to receive justice in the least little thing.
Shakir: Have you not considered those who attribute purity to themselves? Nay, Allah purifies whom He pleases; and they shall not be wronged the husk of a date stone.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): (Muhammad), have you seen those who try to purify themselves? They should know that God only purifies whomever He wants and that the slightest wrong will not be done to such people.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Have you not seen those who claim sanctity for themselves. Nay - but Allah sanctifies whom He pleases, and they will not be dealt with injustice even equal to the extent of a Fatila (A scalish thread in the long slit of a date­stone).
Arberry: Hast thou not regarded those who purify themselves? Nay; only God purifies whom He will; and they shall not be wronged a single date-thread.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: عِندَ سِدۡرَةِ ٱلۡمُنتَهَىٰ
Verse: عند سدرة المنتهىٰ
Sahih_International: At the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary -
Pickthall: By the lote-tree of the utmost boundary,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Near the Lote-tree beyond which none may pass:
Shakir: At the farthest lote-tree;
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): to the Lot-tree (in the seven heavens)
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Near Sidrat-ul-Muntaha [lote-tree of the utmost boundary (beyond which none can pass)],
Arberry: by the Lote-Tree of the Boundary
Label: joy

Verse_diac: حَدَآئِقَ وَأَعۡنَٰبٗا
Verse: حدائق واعنٰبا
Sahih_International: Gardens and grapevines
Pickthall: Gardens enclosed and vineyards,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Gardens enclosed, and grapevines;
Shakir: Gardens and vineyards,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): They will have gardens and vineyards,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Gardens and grapeyards;
Arberry: gardens and vineyards
Label: joy

Verse_diac: ٱسۡتَجِيبُواْ لِرَبِّكُم مِّن قَبۡلِ أَن يَأۡتِيَ يَوۡمٞ لَّا مَرَدَّ لَهُۥ مِنَ ٱللَّهِۚ مَا لَكُم مِّن مَّلۡجَإٖ يَوۡمَئِذٖ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّكِيرٖ
Verse: استجيبوا لربكم من قبل ان ياتي يوم لا مرد له من الله ما لكم من ملجا يومئذ وما لكم من نكير
Sahih_International: Respond to your Lord before a Day comes from Allah of which there is no repelling. No refuge will you have that day, nor for you will there be any denial.
Pickthall: Answer the call of your Lord before there cometh unto you from Allah a Day which there is no averting. Ye have no refuge on that Day, nor have a ye any (power of) refusal.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Hearken ye to your Lord, before there come a Day which there will be no putting back, because of (the Ordainment of) Allah! that Day there will be for you no place of refuge nor will there be for you any room for denial (of your sins)!
Shakir: Hearken to your Lord before there comes the day from Allah for which there shall be no averting; you shall have no refuge on that day, nor shall it be yours to make a denial.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Pledge obedience to your Lord before the coming of the inevitable Day when you will find no refuge to escape from God's wrath and no one to defend you.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Answer the Call of your Lord (i.e. accept the Islamic Monotheism, O mankind, and jinns) before there comes from Allah a Day which cannot be averted. You will have no refuge on that Day nor there will be for you any denying (of your crimes as they are all recorded in the Book of your deeds).
Arberry: Answer your Lord, before there comes a day from God that cannot be turned back; upon that day you shall have no shelter, no denial.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: فَلَمَّا كَشَفۡنَا عَنۡهُمُ ٱلرِّجۡزَ إِلَىٰٓ أَجَلٍ هُم بَٰلِغُوهُ إِذَا هُمۡ يَنكُثُونَ
Verse: فلما كشفنا عنهم الرجز الىٰ اجل هم بٰلغوه اذا هم ينكثون
Sahih_International: But when We removed the punishment from them until a term which they were to reach, then at once they broke their word.
Pickthall: But when We did remove from them the terror for a term which they must reach, behold! they broke their covenant.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): But every time We removed the penalty from them according to a fixed term which they had to fulfil,- Behold! they broke their word!
Shakir: But when We removed the plague from them till a term which they should attain lo! they broke (the promise).
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): But when We relieved them from the torment for a given time, they again broke their promise.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): But when We removed the punishment from them to a fixed term, which they had to reach, behold! They broke their word!
Arberry: But when We removed from them the wrath unto a term that they should come to, lo, they broke their troth.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: يَوۡمَ هُم بَٰرِزُونَۖ لَا يَخۡفَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مِنۡهُمۡ شَيۡءٞۚ لِّمَنِ ٱلۡمُلۡكُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَۖ لِلَّهِ ٱلۡوَٰحِدِ ٱلۡقَهَّارِ
Verse: يوم هم بٰرزون لا يخفىٰ على الله منهم شيء لمن الملك اليوم لله الوٰحد القهار
Sahih_International: The Day they come forth nothing concerning them will be concealed from Allah. To whom belongs [all] sovereignty this Day? To Allah , the One, the Prevailing.
Pickthall: The day when they come forth, nothing of them being hidden from Allah. Whose is the Sovereignty this day? It is Allah's, the One, the Almighty.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): The Day whereon they will (all) come forth: not a single thing concerning them is hidden from Allah. Whose will be the dominion that Day?" That of Allah, the One the Irresistible!
Shakir: (Of) the day when they shall come forth, nothing concerning them remains hidden to Allah. To whom belongs the kingdom this day? To Allah, the One, the Subduer (of all).
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Nothing will remain hidden from God concerning them on the day when they appear before God (from their graves) (It will be asked), "To whom does the kingdom belong on this Day?" (It will be answered), "The kingdom belongs to the Almighty One God".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): The Day when they will (all) come out, nothing of them will be hidden from Allah. Whose is the kingdom this Day? (Allah Himself will reply to His Question): It is Allah's the One, the Irresistible!
Arberry: the day they sally forth, and naught of theirs is hidden from God. 'Whose is' the Kingdom today?' 'God's, the One, the Omnipotent.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: فَمَنِ ٱفۡتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡكَذِبَ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّٰلِمُونَ
Verse: فمن افترىٰ على الله الكذب من بعد ذٰلك فاولٰئك هم الظٰلمون
Sahih_International: And whoever invents about Allah untruth after that - then those are [truly] the wrongdoers.
Pickthall: And whoever shall invent a falsehood after that concerning Allah, such will be wrong-doers.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): If any, after this, invent a lie and attribute it to Allah, they are indeed unjust wrong-doers.
Shakir: Then whoever fabricates a lie against Allah after this, these it is that are the unjust.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Whoever ascribes falsehood to God despite of all the evidence is unjust.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Then after that, whosoever shall invent a lie against Allah, ... such shall indeed be the Zalimun (disbelievers).
Arberry: Whoso forges falsehood against God after that, those are the evildoers.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: كِرَامٗا كَٰتِبِينَ
Verse: كراما كٰتبين
Sahih_International: Noble and recording;
Pickthall: Generous and recording,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Kind and honourable,- Writing down (your deeds):
Shakir: Honorable recorders,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): watching over you
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Kiraman (honourable) Katibin writing down (your deeds) ,
Arberry: noble, writers
Label: joy

Verse_diac: أَوۡ يُوبِقۡهُنَّ بِمَا كَسَبُواْ وَيَعۡفُ عَن كَثِيرٖ
Verse: او يوبقهن بما كسبوا ويعف عن كثير
Sahih_International: Or He could destroy them for what they earned; but He pardons much.
Pickthall: Or He causeth them to perish on account of that which they have earned - And He forgiveth much -
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Or He can cause them to perish because of the (evil) which (the men) have earned; but much doth He forgive.
Shakir: Or He may make them founder for what they have earned, and (even then) pardon most;
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): or He could have destroyed them as punishment for the human being's deeds. However, God pardons many sins.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Or He may destroy them (by drowning) because of that which their (people) have earned. And He pardons much.
Arberry: Or He wrecks them for what they have earned; and He pardons much;
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَلَا تَمۡشِ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ مَرَحًاۖ إِنَّكَ لَن تَخۡرِقَ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَلَن تَبۡلُغَ ٱلۡجِبَالَ طُولٗا
Verse: ولا تمش في الارض مرحا انك لن تخرق الارض ولن تبلغ الجبال طولا
Sahih_International: And do not walk upon the earth exultantly. Indeed, you will never tear the earth [apart], and you will never reach the mountains in height.
Pickthall: And walk not in the earth exultant. Lo! thou canst not rend the earth, nor canst thou stretch to the height of the hills.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Nor walk on the earth with insolence: for thou canst not rend the earth asunder, nor reach the mountains in height.
Shakir: And do not go about in the land exultingly, for you cannot cut through the earth nor reach the mountains in height.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Do not walk proudly on the earth; your feet cannot tear apart the earth nor are you as tall as the mountains.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And walk not on the earth with conceit and arrogance. Verily, you can neither rend nor penetrate the earth, nor can you attain a stature like the mountains in height.
Arberry: And walk not in the earth exultantly; certainly thou wilt never tear the earth open, nor attain the mountains in height.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَيُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمُ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِۚ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
Verse: ويبين الله لكم الايٰت والله عليم حكيم
Sahih_International: And Allah makes clear to you the verses, and Allah is Knowing and Wise.
Pickthall: And He expoundeth unto you the revelations. Allah is Knower, Wise.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And Allah makes the Signs plain to you: for Allah is full of knowledge and wisdom.
Shakir: And Allah makes clear to you the communications; and Allah is Knowing, Wise.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): God explains to you His revelations. He is All-knowing and All-wise.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And Allah makes the Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) plain to you, and Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
Arberry: God makes clear to you the signs; and God is All-knowing, All-wise.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: لِيَجۡزِيَ ٱللَّهُ كُلَّ نَفۡسٖ مَّا كَسَبَتۡۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلۡحِسَابِ
Verse: ليجزي الله كل نفس ما كسبت ان الله سريع الحساب
Sahih_International: So that Allah will recompense every soul for what it earned. Indeed, Allah is swift in account.
Pickthall: That Allah may repay each soul what it hath earned. Lo! Allah is swift at reckoning.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): That Allah may requite each soul according to its deserts; and verily Allah is swift in calling to account.
Shakir: That Allah may requite each soul (according to) what it has earned; surely Allah is swift in reckoning.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): This is how God will recompense each soul for its deeds. God's reckoning is swift.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): That Allah may requite each person according to what he has earned. Truly, Allah is Swift at reckoning.
Arberry: that God may recompense every soul for its earnings; surely God is swift at the reckoning.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: فَتَعَٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡمَلِكُ ٱلۡحَقُّۗ وَلَا تَعۡجَلۡ بِٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ مِن قَبۡلِ أَن يُقۡضَىٰٓ إِلَيۡكَ وَحۡيُهُۥۖ وَقُل رَّبِّ زِدۡنِي عِلۡمٗا
Verse: فتعٰلى الله الملك الحق ولا تعجل بالقرءان من قبل ان يقضىٰ اليك وحيه وقل رب زدني علما
Sahih_International: So high [above all] is Allah , the Sovereign, the Truth. And, [O Muhammad], do not hasten with [recitation of] the Qur'an before its revelation is completed to you, and say, "My Lord, increase me in knowledge."
Pickthall: Then exalted be Allah, the True King! And hasten not (O Muhammad) with the Qur'an ere its revelation hath been perfected unto thee, and say: My Lord! Increase me in knowledge.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): High above all is Allah, the King, the Truth! Be not in haste with the Qur'an before its revelation to thee is completed, but say, "O my Lord! advance me in knowledge."
Shakir: Supremely exalted is therefore Allah, the King, the Truth, and do not make haste with the Quran before its revelation is made complete to you and say: O my Lord! increase me in knowledge.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): God is the Most High and the True King. (Muhammad), do not be hasty in reading the Quran to the people before the revelation has been completed. "Say, My Lord, grant me more knowledge."
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Then High above all be Allah, the True King. And be not in haste (O Muhammad SAW) with the Quran before its revelation is completed to you, and say: "My Lord! Increase me in knowledge."
Arberry: So high exalted be God, the true King! And hasten not with the Koran ere its revelation is accomplished unto thee; and say, 'O my Lord, increase me in knowledge.'
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَأَلۡقَىٰ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ رَوَٰسِيَ أَن تَمِيدَ بِكُمۡ وَأَنۡهَٰرٗا وَسُبُلٗا لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَهۡتَدُونَ
Verse: والقىٰ في الارض روٰسي ان تميد بكم وانهٰرا وسبلا لعلكم تهتدون
Sahih_International: And He has cast into the earth firmly set mountains, lest it shift with you, and [made] rivers and roads, that you may be guided,
Pickthall: And He hath cast into the earth firm hills that it quake not with you, and streams and roads that ye may find a way.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And He has set up on the earth mountains standing firm, lest it should shake with you; and rivers and roads; that ye may guide yourselves;
Shakir: And He has cast great mountains in the earth lest it might be convulsed with you, and rivers and roads that you may go aright,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): God has fixed the mountains on earth lest you should be hurled away when it quakes. Therein He has also made rivers and roads so that you will find your way.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And He has affixed into the earth mountains standing firm, lest it should shake with you, and rivers and roads, that you may guide yourselves.
Arberry: And He cast on the earth firm mountains, lest it shake with you, and rivers and ways; so haply you will be guided;
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا لُقۡمَٰنَ ٱلۡحِكۡمَةَ أَنِ ٱشۡكُرۡ لِلَّهِۚ وَمَن يَشۡكُرۡ فَإِنَّمَا يَشۡكُرُ لِنَفۡسِهِۦۖ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِيٌّ حَمِيدٞ
Verse: ولقد ءاتينا لقمٰن الحكمة ان اشكر لله ومن يشكر فانما يشكر لنفسه ومن كفر فان الله غني حميد
Sahih_International: And We had certainly given Luqman wisdom [and said], "Be grateful to Allah." And whoever is grateful is grateful for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever denies [His favor] - then indeed, Allah is Free of need and Praiseworthy.
Pickthall: And verily We gave Luqman wisdom, saying: Give thanks unto Allah; and whosoever giveth thanks, he giveth thanks for (the good of) his soul. And whosoever refuseth - Lo! Allah is Absolute, Owner of Praise.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): we bestowed (in the past) Wisdom on Luqman: "Show (thy) gratitude to Allah." Any who is (so) grateful does so to the profit of his own soul: but if any is ungrateful, verily Allah is free of all wants, Worthy of all praise.
Shakir: And certainly We gave wisdom to Luqman, saying: Be grateful to Allah. And whoever is grateful, he is on!y grateful for his own soul; and whoever is ungrateful, then surely Allah is Self-sufficient, Praised.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We gave wisdom to Luqman so that he would give thanks to God. Those who give thanks to God do so for their own good. Those who are ungrateful should know that God is Self-sufficient and Praiseworthy.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And indeed We bestowed upon Luqman Al­Hikmah (wisdom and religious understanding, etc.) saying: "Give thanks to Allah," and whoever gives thanks, he gives thanks for (the good of) his ownself. And whoever is unthankful, then verily, Allah is All­Rich (Free of all wants), Worthy of all praise.
Arberry: Indeed, We gave Lokman wisdom: 'Give thanks to God. Whosoever gives thanks gives thanks only for his own soul's good, and whosoever is ungrateful -- surely God is All-sufficient, All-laudable.'
Label: joy

Verse_diac: لِيَكۡفُرُواْ بِمَآ ءَاتَيۡنَٰهُمۡۚ فَتَمَتَّعُواْ فَسَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُونَ
Verse: ليكفروا بما ءاتينٰهم فتمتعوا فسوف تعلمون
Sahih_International: So that they will deny what We have granted them. Then enjoy yourselves, for you are going to know.
Pickthall: So as to disbelieve in that which We have given them. (Unto such it is said): Enjoy yourselves awhile, but ye will come to know.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): (As if) to show their ingratitude for the (favours) We have bestowed on them! Then enjoy (your brief day); but soon will ye know (your folly).
Shakir: So as to be ungrateful for what We have given them; but enjoy yourselves (for a while), for you shall soon come to know.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): because of their ingratitude for what We have given them. Let them enjoy themselves, but they will soon know (the consequences of their deeds).
Mohsin_Khan (MK): So as to be ungrateful for the graces which We have bestowed on them. Then enjoy (your short life); but you will come to know.
Arberry: that they may be ungrateful for what We have given them. 'Take your enjoyment; certainly you will soon know.'
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَأَقِيمُواْ ٱلۡوَزۡنَ بِٱلۡقِسۡطِ وَلَا تُخۡسِرُواْ ٱلۡمِيزَانَ
Verse: واقيموا الوزن بالقسط ولا تخسروا الميزان
Sahih_International: And establish weight in justice and do not make deficient the balance.
Pickthall: But observe the measure strictly, nor fall short thereof.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): So establish weight with justice and fall not short in the balance.
Shakir: And keep up the balance with equity and do not make the measure deficient.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Therefore, maintain just measure and do not transgress against the Balance.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And observe the weight with equity and do not make the balance deficient.
Arberry: and weigh with justice, and skimp not in the Balance.)
Label: fear

Verse_diac: إِلَّا مَن ظَلَمَ ثُمَّ بَدَّلَ حُسۡنَۢا بَعۡدَ سُوٓءٖ فَإِنِّي غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ
Verse: الا من ظلم ثم بدل حسنا بعد سوء فاني غفور رحيم
Sahih_International: Otherwise, he who wrongs, then substitutes good after evil - indeed, I am Forgiving and Merciful.
Pickthall: Save him who hath done wrong and afterward hath changed evil for good. And lo! I am Forgiving, Merciful.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "But if any have done wrong and have thereafter substituted good to take the place of evil, truly, I am Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
Shakir: Neither he who has been unjust, then he does good instead after evil, for surely I am the Forgiving, the Merciful:
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Only the unjust become afraid in My presence. Even to these people who replace their bad deeds by good ones, I am All-forgiving and All-merciful.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "Except him who has done wrong and afterwards has changed evil for good, then surely, I am Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
Arberry: save him who has done evil, then; after evil, has changed into good; All-forgiving am I, All-compassionate.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: فَإِذَا بَرِقَ ٱلۡبَصَرُ
Verse: فاذا برق البصر
Sahih_International: So when vision is dazzled
Pickthall: But when sight is confounded
Yusuf_Ali (YA): At length, when the sight is dazed,
Shakir: So when the sight becomes dazed,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): When the eye is bewildered,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): So, when the sight shall be dazed,
Arberry: But when the sight is dazed
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَمَا يَأۡتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
Verse: وما ياتيهم من رسول الا كانوا به يستهزءون
Sahih_International: And no messenger would come to them except that they ridiculed him.
Pickthall: And never came there unto them a messenger but they did mock him.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): But never came a messenger to them but they mocked him.
Shakir: And there never came a messenger to them but they mocked him.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): No Messenger went to them whom they did not mock.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And never came a Messenger to them but they did mock him.
Arberry: and not a single Messenger came to them, but they mocked at him;
Label: anger

Verse_diac: قُلۡ أَفَغَيۡرَ ٱللَّهِ تَأۡمُرُوٓنِّيٓ أَعۡبُدُ أَيُّهَا ٱلۡجَٰهِلُونَ
Verse: قل افغير الله تامروني اعبد ايها الجٰهلون
Sahih_International: Say, [O Muhammad], "Is it other than Allah that you order me to worship, O ignorant ones?"
Pickthall: Say (O Muhammad, to the disbelievers): Do ye bid me serve other than Allah? O ye fools!
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Say: "Is it some one other than Allah that ye order me to worship, O ye ignorant ones?"
Shakir: Say: What! Do you then bid me serve others than Allah, O ignorant men?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): (Muhammad), say, "Ignorant ones, do you command me to worship things other than God
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Say (O Muhammad SAW to the polytheists, etc.): "Do you order me to worship other than Allah O you fools ?"
Arberry: Say: 'Is it other than God you bid me serve, you ignorant ones?'
Label: anger

Verse_diac: وَنَرَىٰهُ قَرِيبٗا
Verse: ونرىٰه قريبا
Sahih_International: But We see it [as] near.
Pickthall: While we behold it nigh:
Yusuf_Ali (YA): But We see it (quite) near.
Shakir: And We see it nigh.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): but We see it to be very near.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): But We see it (quite) near.
Arberry: but We see it is nigh.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: يَسۡتَعۡجِلُونَكَ بِٱلۡعَذَابِ وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمُحِيطَةُۢ بِٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
Verse: يستعجلونك بالعذاب وان جهنم لمحيطة بالكٰفرين
Sahih_International: They urge you to hasten the punishment. And indeed, Hell will be encompassing of the disbelievers
Pickthall: They bid thee hasten on the doom, when lo! hell verily will encompass the disbelievers
Yusuf_Ali (YA): They ask thee to hasten on the Punishment: but, of a surety, Hell will encompass the Rejecters of Faith!-
Shakir: They ask you to hasten on the chastisement, and most surely hell encompasses the unbelievers;
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): They demand you to bring upon them the torment immediately. Hell will certainly engulf the unbelievers.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): They ask you to hasten on the torment. And verily! Hell, of a surety, will encompass the disbelievers.
Arberry: They demand of thee to hasten the chastisement! Lo, Gehenna encompasses the unbelievers.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَتَّبِعُونَ ٱلدَّاعِيَ لَا عِوَجَ لَهُۥۖ وَخَشَعَتِ ٱلۡأَصۡوَاتُ لِلرَّحۡمَٰنِ فَلَا تَسۡمَعُ إِلَّا هَمۡسٗا
Verse: يومئذ يتبعون الداعي لا عوج له وخشعت الاصوات للرحمٰن فلا تسمع الا همسا
Sahih_International: That Day, everyone will follow [the call of] the Caller [with] no deviation therefrom, and [all] voices will be stilled before the Most Merciful, so you will not hear except a whisper [of footsteps].
Pickthall: On that day they follow the summoner who deceiveth not, and voices are hushed for the Beneficent, and thou hearest but a faint murmur.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): On that Day will they follow the Caller (straight): no crookedness (can they show) him: all sounds shall humble themselves in the Presence of (Allah) Most Gracious: nothing shalt thou hear but the tramp of their feet (as they march).
Shakir: On that day they shall follow the inviter, there is no crookedness in him, and the voices shall be low before the Beneficent Allah so that you shall not hear aught but a soft sound.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): On that day they will follow their caller without deviation. Their voices will be low in the presence of the Beneficent God. You will hear nothing but the tread of the marching feet.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): On that Day mankind will follow strictly (the voice of) Allah's caller, no crookedness (that is without going to the right or left of that voice) will they show him (Allah's caller). And all voices will be humbled for the Most Beneficent (Allah), and nothing shall you hear but the low voice of their footsteps.
Arberry: On that day they will follow the Summoner in whom is no crookedness; voices will be hushed to the All-merciful, so that thou hearest naught but a murmuring.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَدۡعُونَ يَبۡتَغُونَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمُ ٱلۡوَسِيلَةَ أَيُّهُمۡ أَقۡرَبُ وَيَرۡجُونَ رَحۡمَتَهُۥ وَيَخَافُونَ عَذَابَهُۥٓۚ إِنَّ عَذَابَ رَبِّكَ كَانَ مَحۡذُورٗا
Verse: اولٰئك الذين يدعون يبتغون الىٰ ربهم الوسيلة ايهم اقرب ويرجون رحمته ويخافون عذابه ان عذاب ربك كان محذورا
Sahih_International: Those whom they invoke seek means of access to their Lord, [striving as to] which of them would be nearest, and they hope for His mercy and fear His punishment. Indeed, the punishment of your Lord is ever feared.
Pickthall: Those unto whom they cry seek the way of approach to their Lord, which of them shall be the nearest; they hope for His mercy and they fear His doom. Lo! the doom of thy Lord is to be shunned.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Those whom they call upon do desire (for themselves) means of access to their Lord, - even those who are nearest: they hope for His Mercy and fear His Wrath: for the Wrath of thy Lord is something to take heed of.
Shakir: Those whom they call upon, themselves seek the means of access to their Lord-- whoever of them is nearest-- and they hope for His mercy and fear His chastisement; surely the chastisement of your Lord is a thing to be cautious of.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Those whom they worship seek to find intercessors for themselves with God. (They try to find out which of the intercessors) are closer to God. They have hope for His mercy and fear of His punishment; the punishment of your Lord is awesome.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Those whom they call upon [like 'Iesa (Jesus) ­ son of Maryam (Mary), 'Uzair (Ezra), angel, etc.] desire (for themselves) means of access to their Lord (Allah), as to which of them should be the nearest and they ['Iesa (Jesus), 'Uzair (Ezra), angels, etc.] hope for His Mercy and fear His Torment. Verily, the Torment of your Lord is something to be afraid of!
Arberry: Those they call upon are themselves seeking the means to come to their Lord, which of them shall be nearer; they hope for His mercy, and fear His chastisement. Surely thy Lord's chastisement is a thing to beware of.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: لَا يُسۡـَٔلُ عَمَّا يَفۡعَلُ وَهُمۡ يُسۡـَٔلُونَ
Verse: لا يسل عما يفعل وهم يسلون
Sahih_International: He is not questioned about what He does, but they will be questioned.
Pickthall: He will not be questioned as to that which He doeth, but they will be questioned.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): He cannot be questioned for His acts, but they will be questioned (for theirs).
Shakir: He cannot be questioned concerning what He does and they shall be questioned.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): He will not be questioned about anything He does, but all people will be questioned about their deeds.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): He cannot be questioned as to what He does, while they will be questioned.
Arberry: He shall not be questioned as to what He does, but they shall he questioned.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: فَسَنُيَسِّرُهُۥ لِلۡعُسۡرَىٰ
Verse: فسنيسره للعسرىٰ
Sahih_International: We will ease him toward difficulty.
Pickthall: Surely We will ease his way unto adversity.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): We will indeed make smooth for him the path to Misery;
Shakir: We will facilitate for him the difficult end.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We shall facilitate the path to affliction
Mohsin_Khan (MK): We will make smooth for him the path for evil;
Arberry: We shall surely ease him to the Hardship;
Label: fear

Verse_diac: كَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
Verse: كذٰلك نجزي المحسنين
Sahih_International: Indeed, We thus reward the doers of good.
Pickthall: Thus do We reward the good.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Thus indeed do We reward those who do right.
Shakir: Thus do We reward the doers of good.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Thus, do We reward the righteous ones.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Thus indeed do We reward the Muhsinun (good-doers - see V.2:112).
Arberry: Even so We recompense the good-doers;
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَلَآ أُقۡسِمُ بِٱلنَّفۡسِ ٱللَّوَّامَةِ
Verse: ولا اقسم بالنفس اللوامة
Sahih_International: And I swear by the reproaching soul [to the certainty of resurrection].
Pickthall: Nay, I swear by the accusing soul (that this Scripture is true).
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And I do call to witness the self-reproaching spirit: (Eschew Evil).
Shakir: Nay! I swear by the self-accusing soul.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): and by the self accusing soul (that you will certainly be resurrected).
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And I swear by the self-reproaching person (a believer).
Arberry: No! I swear by the reproachful soul.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَتَطۡمَئِنُّ قُلُوبُهُم بِذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِۗ أَلَا بِذِكۡرِ ٱللَّهِ تَطۡمَئِنُّ ٱلۡقُلُوبُ
Verse: الذين ءامنوا وتطمئن قلوبهم بذكر الله الا بذكر الله تطمئن القلوب
Sahih_International: Those who have believed and whose hearts are assured by the remembrance of Allah. Unquestionably, by the remembrance of Allah hearts are assured."
Pickthall: Who have believed and whose hearts have rest in the remembrance of Allah. Verily in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest!
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "Those who believe, and whose hearts find satisfaction in the remembrance of Allah: for without doubt in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find satisfaction.
Shakir: Those who believe and whose hearts are set at rest by the remembrance of Allah; now surely by Allah's remembrance are the hearts set at rest.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): and the faithful ones whose hearts are comforted by the remembrance of God. Remembrance of God certainly brings comfort to all hearts.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Those who believe (in the Oneness of Allah - Islamic Monotheism), and whose hearts find rest in the remembrance of Allah, Verily, in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest.
Arberry: Those who believe, their hearts being at rest in God's remembrance -- in God's remembrance are at rest the hearts
Label: joy

Verse_diac: فِي سِدۡرٖ مَّخۡضُودٖ
Verse: في سدر مخضود
Sahih_International: [They will be] among lote trees with thorns removed
Pickthall: Among thornless lote-trees
Yusuf_Ali (YA): (They will be) among Lote-trees without thorns,
Shakir: Amid thornless lote-trees,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): They will live amid the thornless lot trees
Mohsin_Khan (MK): (They will be) among thornless lote-trees,
Arberry: mid thornless lote-trees
Label: joy

Verse_diac: فَتَوَلَّىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنُ فَجَمَعَ كَيۡدَهُۥ ثُمَّ أَتَىٰ
Verse: فتولىٰ فرعون فجمع كيده ثم اتىٰ
Sahih_International: So Pharaoh went away, put together his plan, and then came [to Moses].
Pickthall: Then Pharaoh went and gathered his strength, then came (to the appointed tryst).
Yusuf_Ali (YA): So Pharaoh withdrew: He concerted his plan, and then came (back).
Shakir: So Firon turned his back and settled his plan, then came.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): The Pharaoh returned to organize his plans and then attended the appointment.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): So Fir'aun (Pharaoh) withdrew, devised his plot and then came back.
Arberry: Pharaoh then withdrew, and gathered his guile. Thereafter he came again,
Label: anger

Verse_diac: سَيَذَّكَّرُ مَن يَخۡشَىٰ
Verse: سيذكر من يخشىٰ
Sahih_International: He who fears [Allah] will be reminded.
Pickthall: He will heed who feareth,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): The admonition will be received by those who fear (Allah):
Shakir: He who fears will mind,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Those who have fear of God will benefit
Mohsin_Khan (MK): The reminder will be received by him who fears (Allah),
Arberry: and he who fears shall remember,
Label: fear

Verse_diac: مُهۡطِعِينَ مُقۡنِعِي رُءُوسِهِمۡ لَا يَرۡتَدُّ إِلَيۡهِمۡ طَرۡفُهُمۡۖ وَأَفۡـِٔدَتُهُمۡ هَوَآءٞ
Verse: مهطعين مقنعي رءوسهم لا يرتد اليهم طرفهم وافدتهم هواء
Sahih_International: Racing ahead, their heads raised up, their glance does not come back to them, and their hearts are void.
Pickthall: As they come hurrying on in fear, their heads upraised, their gaze returning not to them, and their hearts as air.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): They running forward with necks outstretched, their heads uplifted, their gaze returning not towards them, and their hearts a (gaping) void!
Shakir: Hastening forward, their heads upraised, their eyes not reverting to them and their hearts vacant.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): when people will hurry in fright, their heads raised, their eyes unable to look around, and their hearts stunned due to the confusion (which will prevail on that Day).
Mohsin_Khan (MK): (They will be) hastening forward with necks outstretched, their heads raised up (towards the sky), their gaze returning not towards them and their hearts empty (from thinking because of extreme fear).
Arberry: when they shall run with necks outstretched and heads erect, their glances never returned on themselves, their hearts void.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَتَذَرُونَ مَا خَلَقَ لَكُمۡ رَبُّكُم مِّنۡ أَزۡوَٰجِكُمۚ بَلۡ أَنتُمۡ قَوۡمٌ عَادُونَ
Verse: وتذرون ما خلق لكم ربكم من ازوٰجكم بل انتم قوم عادون
Sahih_International: And leave what your Lord has created for you as mates? But you are a people transgressing."
Pickthall: And leave the wives your Lord created for you? Nay, but ye are froward folk.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "And leave those whom Allah has created for you to be your mates? Nay, ye are a people transgressing (all limits)!"
Shakir: And leave what your Lord has created for you of your wives? Nay, you are a people exceeding limits.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): instead of your wives, whom your Lord has created specially for you? You are a transgressing people."
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "And leave those whom Allah has created for you to be your wives? Nay, you are a trespassing people!"
Arberry: leaving your wives that your Lord created for you? Nay, but you are a people of transgressors.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: فَلَنُذِيقَنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ عَذَابٗا شَدِيدٗا وَلَنَجۡزِيَنَّهُمۡ أَسۡوَأَ ٱلَّذِي كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
Verse: فلنذيقن الذين كفروا عذابا شديدا ولنجزينهم اسوا الذي كانوا يعملون
Sahih_International: But We will surely cause those who disbelieve to taste a severe punishment, and We will surely recompense them for the worst of what they had been doing.
Pickthall: But verily We shall cause those who disbelieve to taste an awful doom, and verily We shall requite them the worst of what they used to do.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): But We will certainly give the Unbelievers a taste of a severe Penalty, and We will requite them for the worst of their deeds.
Shakir: Therefore We will most certainly make those who disbelieve taste a severe punishment, and We will most certainly reward them for the evil deeds they used to do.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We shall certainly make the unbelievers suffer severe torment and will punish them far worse than what they deserve for their deeds.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): But surely, We shall cause those who disbelieve to taste a severe torment, and certainly, We shall requite them the worst of what they used to do.
Arberry: So We shall let the unbelievers taste a terrible chastisement, and shall recompense them with the worst of what they were working.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: وَمَا تَأۡتِيهِم مِّنۡ ءَايَةٖ مِّنۡ ءَايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ إِلَّا كَانُواْ عَنۡهَا مُعۡرِضِينَ
Verse: وما تاتيهم من ءاية من ءايٰت ربهم الا كانوا عنها معرضين
Sahih_International: And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they turn away therefrom.
Pickthall: Never came there unto them a revelation of the revelations of Allah but they did turn away from it.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): But never did a single one of the signs of their Lord reach them, but they turned away therefrom.
Shakir: And there does not come to them any communication of the communications of their Lord but they turn aside from it
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): (The unbelievers) have always turned away from the revelations and the evidence (of the Truth) that has been sent to them from time to time.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And never an Ayah (sign) comes to them from the Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) of their Lord, but that they have been turning away from it.
Arberry: Not a sign of their Lord comes to them, but they turn away from it.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: لَعَلَّكَ بَٰخِعٞ نَّفۡسَكَ أَلَّا يَكُونُواْ مُؤۡمِنِينَ
Verse: لعلك بٰخع نفسك الا يكونوا مؤمنين
Sahih_International: Perhaps, [O Muhammad], you would kill yourself with grief that they will not be believers.
Pickthall: It may be that thou tormentest thyself (O Muhammad) because they believe not.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): It may be thou frettest thy soul with grief, that they do not become Believers.
Shakir: Perhaps you will kill yourself with grief because they do not believe.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): You will perhaps kill yourself with anguish because they are not accepting the faith.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): It may be that you (O Muhammad SAW) are going to kill yourself with grief, that they do not become believers [in your Risalah (Messengership) and in your Message of Islamic Monotheism].
Arberry: Perchance thou consumest thyself that they are not believers.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ مَدَدۡنَٰهَا وَأَلۡقَيۡنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِيَ وَأَنۢبَتۡنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوۡجِۭ بَهِيجٖ
Verse: والارض مددنٰها والقينا فيها روٰسي وانبتنا فيها من كل زوج بهيج
Sahih_International: And the earth - We spread it out and cast therein firmly set mountains and made grow therein [something] of every beautiful kind,
Pickthall: And the earth have We spread out, and have flung firm hills therein, and have caused of every lovely kind to grow thereon,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And the earth- We have spread it out, and set thereon mountains standing firm, and produced therein every kind of beautiful growth (in pairs)-
Shakir: And the earth, We have made it plain and cast in it mountains and We have made to grow therein of all beautiful kinds,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): (Have they not seen) how We have spread out the earth, placed on it firm mountains and have made all kinds of flourishing pairs of plants grow?
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And the earth! We have spread it out, and set thereon mountains standing firm, and have produced therein every kind of lovely growth (plants).
Arberry: And the earth -- We stretched it forth, and cast on it firm mountains, and We caused to grow therein of every joyous kind
Label: fear

Verse_diac: إِذۡ يَغۡشَى ٱلسِّدۡرَةَ مَا يَغۡشَىٰ
Verse: اذ يغشى السدرة ما يغشىٰ
Sahih_International: When there covered the Lote Tree that which covered [it].
Pickthall: When that which shroudeth did enshroud the lote-tree,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Behold, the Lote-tree was shrouded (in mystery unspeakable!)
Shakir: When that which covers covered the lote-tree;
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): When the tree was covered with a covering,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): When that covered the lote-tree which did cover it!
Arberry: when there covered the Lote-Tree that which covered;
Label: fear

Verse_diac: إِنَّ أَوَّلَ بَيۡتٖ وُضِعَ لِلنَّاسِ لَلَّذِي بِبَكَّةَ مُبَارَكٗا وَهُدٗى لِّلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
Verse: ان اول بيت وضع للناس للذي ببكة مباركا وهدى للعٰلمين
Sahih_International: Indeed, the first House [of worship] established for mankind was that at Makkah - blessed and a guidance for the worlds.
Pickthall: Lo! the first Sanctuary appointed for mankind was that at Becca, a blessed place, a guidance to the peoples;
Yusuf_Ali (YA): The first House (of worship) appointed for men was that at Bakka: Full of blessing and of guidance for all kinds of beings:
Shakir: Most surely the first house appointed for men is the one at Bekka, blessed and a guidance for the nations.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): The first house (of worship) that God assigned to men was in Bakka (another name of Mecca). It is a blessed one and a guide for all people.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Verily, the first House (of worship) appointed for mankind was that at Bakkah (Makkah), full of blessing, and a guidance for Al-'Alamin (the mankind and jinns).
Arberry: The first House established for the people was that at Bekka, a place holy, and a guidance to all beings.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَإِذَا نَادَيۡتُمۡ إِلَى ٱلصَّلَوٰةِ ٱتَّخَذُوهَا هُزُوٗا وَلَعِبٗاۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمۡ قَوۡمٞ لَّا يَعۡقِلُونَ
Verse: واذا ناديتم الى الصلوٰة اتخذوها هزوا ولعبا ذٰلك بانهم قوم لا يعقلون
Sahih_International: And when you call to prayer, they take it in ridicule and amusement. That is because they are a people who do not use reason.
Pickthall: And when ye call to prayer they take it for a jest and sport. That is because they are a folk who understand not.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): When ye proclaim your call to prayer they take it (but) as mockery and sport; that is because they are a people without understanding.
Shakir: And when you call to prayer they make it a mockery and a joke; this is because they are a people who do not understand.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Because they are devoid of understanding, they ridicule your call for prayers saying that it is a useless act.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And when you proclaim the call for As-Salat [call for the prayer (Adhan)], they take it (but) as a mockery and fun; that is because they are a people who understand not.
Arberry: and when you call to prayer, take it in mockery and as a sport; that is because they are a people who have no understanding.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: ٱدۡعُواْ رَبَّكُمۡ تَضَرُّعٗا وَخُفۡيَةًۚ إِنَّهُۥ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلۡمُعۡتَدِينَ
Verse: ادعوا ربكم تضرعا وخفية انه لا يحب المعتدين
Sahih_International: Call upon your Lord in humility and privately; indeed, He does not like transgressors.
Pickthall: (O mankind!) Call upon your Lord humbly and in secret. Lo! He loveth not aggressors.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Call on your Lord with humility and in private: for Allah loveth not those who trespass beyond bounds.
Shakir: Call on your Lord humbly and secretly; surely He does not love those who exceed the limits.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Pray to your Lord humbly and privately. God does not love the transgressors.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Invoke your Lord with humility and in secret. He likes not the aggressors.
Arberry: Call on your Lord, humbly and secretly; He loves not transgressors.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: أَلَمۡ يَعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ يَقۡبَلُ ٱلتَّوۡبَةَ عَنۡ عِبَادِهِۦ وَيَأۡخُذُ ٱلصَّدَقَٰتِ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
Verse: الم يعلموا ان الله هو يقبل التوبة عن عباده وياخذ الصدقٰت وان الله هو التواب الرحيم
Sahih_International: Do they not know that it is Allah who accepts repentance from His servants and receives charities and that it is Allah who is the Accepting of repentance, the Merciful?
Pickthall: Know they not that Allah is He Who accepteth repentance from His bondmen and taketh the alms, and that Allah is He Who is the Relenting, the Merciful.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Know they not that Allah doth accept repentance from His votaries and receives their gifts of charity, and that Allah is verily He, the Oft-Returning, Most Merciful?
Shakir: Do they not know that Allah accepts repentance from His servants and takes the alms, and that Allah is the Oft-returning (to mercy), the Merciful?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Do they not know that it is God who accepts the repentance of His servants and receives the welfare funds and that it is God who is All-forgiving and All-merciful?
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Know they not that Allah accepts repentance from His slaves and takes the Sadaqat (alms, charities) and that All&achrc;h Alone is the One Who forgives and accepts repentance, Most Merciful?
Arberry: Do they not know that God is He who accepts repentance from His servants, and takes the freewill offerings, and that God -- He turns, and is All-compassionate?
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَجِاْيٓءَ يَوۡمَئِذِۭ بِجَهَنَّمَۚ يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَتَذَكَّرُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ
Verse: وجايء يومئذ بجهنم يومئذ يتذكر الانسٰن وانىٰ له الذكرىٰ
Sahih_International: And brought [within view], that Day, is Hell - that Day, man will remember, but what good to him will be the remembrance?
Pickthall: And hell is brought near that day; on that day man will remember, but how will the remembrance (then avail him)?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And Hell, that Day, is brought (face to face),- on that Day will man remember, but how will that remembrance profit him?
Shakir: And hell is made to appear on that day. On that day shall man be mindful, and what shall being mindful (then) avail him?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): On that day, hell will be brought closer and the human being will come to his senses, but this will be of no avail to him.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And Hell will be brought near that Day. On that Day will man remember, but how will that remembrance (then) avail him?
Arberry: and Gehenna is brought out, upon that day man will remember; and how shall the Reminder be for him?
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَكُلّٗا ضَرَبۡنَا لَهُ ٱلۡأَمۡثَٰلَۖ وَكُلّٗا تَبَّرۡنَا تَتۡبِيرٗا
Verse: وكلا ضربنا له الامثٰل وكلا تبرنا تتبيرا
Sahih_International: And for each We presented examples [as warnings], and each We destroyed with [total] destruction.
Pickthall: Each (of them) We warned by examples, and each (of them) We brought to utter ruin.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): To each one We set forth Parables and examples; and each one We broke to utter annihilation (for their sins).
Shakir: And to every one We gave examples and every one did We destroy with utter destruction.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We gave guidance and drove each to destruction.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And for each of them We put forward examples (as proofs and lessons, etc.), and each (of them) We brought to utter ruin (because of their disbelief and evil deeds).
Arberry: for each We struck similitudes, and each We ruined utterly.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: فَٱتَّخَذۡتُمُوهُمۡ سِخۡرِيًّا حَتَّىٰٓ أَنسَوۡكُمۡ ذِكۡرِي وَكُنتُم مِّنۡهُمۡ تَضۡحَكُونَ
Verse: فاتخذتموهم سخريا حتىٰ انسوكم ذكري وكنتم منهم تضحكون
Sahih_International: But you took them in mockery to the point that they made you forget My remembrance, and you used to laugh at them.
Pickthall: But ye chose them for a laughing-stock until they caused you to forget remembrance of Me, while ye laughed at them.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "But ye treated them with ridicule, so much so that (ridicule of) them made you forget My Message while ye were laughing at them!
Shakir: But you took them for a mockery until they made you forget My remembrance and you used to laugh at them.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): "You mocked and laughed at them until you forgot all about Me.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): But you took them for a laughingstock, so much so that they made you forget My Remembrance while you used to laugh at them!
Arberry: But you took them for a laughing-stock, till they made you forget My remembrance, mocking at them.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: ثُمَّ بَدَا لَهُم مِّنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا رَأَوُاْ ٱلۡأٓيَٰتِ لَيَسۡجُنُنَّهُۥ حَتَّىٰ حِينٖ
Verse: ثم بدا لهم من بعد ما راوا الايٰت ليسجننه حتىٰ حين
Sahih_International: Then it appeared to them after they had seen the signs that al-'Azeez should surely imprison him for a time.
Pickthall: And it seemed good to them (the men-folk) after they had seen the signs (of his innocence) to imprison him for a time.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Then it occurred to the men, after they had seen the signs, (that it was best) to imprison him for a time.
Shakir: Then it occurred to them after they had seen the signs that they should imprison him till a time.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Even after Joseph had been found innocent of any crime, the King and his people decided to imprison him for an appointed time (so that people would forget the incident).
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Then it appeared to them, after they had seen the proofs (of his innocence) to imprison him for a time.
Arberry: Then it seemed good to them, after they had seen the signs, that they should imprison him for a while.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَهُمۡ فِي رَوۡضَةٖ يُحۡبَرُونَ
Verse: فاما الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصٰلحٰت فهم في روضة يحبرون
Sahih_International: And as for those who had believed and done righteous deeds, they will be in a garden [of Paradise], delighted.
Pickthall: As for those who believed and did good works, they will be made happy in a Garden.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Then those who have believed and worked righteous deeds, shall be made happy in a Mead of Delight.
Shakir: Then as to those who believed and did good, they shall be made happy in a garden.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): The righteously striving believers will happily live in paradise.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Then as for those who believed (in the Oneness of Allah Islamic Monotheism) and did righteous good deeds, such shall be honoured and made to enjoy luxurious life (forever) in a Garden of delight (Paradise).
Arberry: as for those who believed, and did deeds of righteousness, they shall walk with joy in a green meadow,
Label: joy

Verse_diac: جَنَّٰتِ عَدۡنٖ مُّفَتَّحَةٗ لَّهُمُ ٱلۡأَبۡوَٰبُ
Verse: جنٰت عدن مفتحة لهم الابوٰب
Sahih_International: Gardens of perpetual residence, whose doors will be opened to them.
Pickthall: Gardens of Eden, whereof the gates are opened for them,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Gardens of Eternity, whose doors will (ever) be open to them;
Shakir: The gardens of perpetuity, the doors are opened for them.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): They will enter gardens of Eden with their gates open for them.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): 'Adn (Edn) Paradise (everlasting Gardens), whose doors will be open for them, [It is said (in Tafsir At-Tabari, Part 23, Page 174) that one can speak to the doors, just one tells it to open and close, and it will open or close as it is ordered].
Arberry: Gardens of Eden, whereof the gates are open to them,
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَإِذَا رَءَا ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ ٱلۡعَذَابَ فَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنظَرُونَ
Verse: واذا رءا الذين ظلموا العذاب فلا يخفف عنهم ولا هم ينظرون
Sahih_International: And when those who wronged see the punishment, it will not be lightened for them, nor will they be reprieved.
Pickthall: And when those who did wrong behold the doom, it will not be made light for them, nor will they be reprieved.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): When the wrong-doers (actually) see the Penalty, then will it in no way be mitigated, nor will they then receive respite.
Shakir: And when those who are unjust shall see the chastisement, it shall not be lightened for them, nor shall they be respited.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): There will be no relief for them when the torment approaches the unjust nor will they be given any respite.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And when those who did wrong (the disbelievers) will see the torment, then it will not be lightened unto them, nor will they be given respite.
Arberry: And when the evildoers behold the chastisement, it shall not be lightened for them, and no respite shall be given them.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: ثُمَّ أَدۡبَرَ يَسۡعَىٰ
Verse: ثم ادبر يسعىٰ
Sahih_International: Then he turned his back, striving.
Pickthall: Then turned he away in haste,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Further, he turned his back, striving hard (against Allah).
Shakir: Then he went back hastily.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Then he turned away in a hurry,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Then he turned his back, striving hard (against Allah).
Arberry: then he turned away hastily,
Label: anger

Verse_diac: تَنزِيلٞ مِّنَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
Verse: تنزيل من الرحمٰن الرحيم
Sahih_International: [This is] a revelation from the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful -
Pickthall: A revelation from the Beneficent, the Merciful,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): A Revelation from (Allah), Most Gracious, Most Merciful;-
Shakir: A revelation from the Beneficent, the Merciful Allah:
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): This is the revelations from the Beneficent, Merciful God.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): A revelation from Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful.
Arberry: A sending down from the Merciful, the Compassionate.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَلَقَدۡ ضَلَّ قَبۡلَهُمۡ أَكۡثَرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
Verse: ولقد ضل قبلهم اكثر الاولين
Sahih_International: And there had already strayed before them most of the former peoples,
Pickthall: And verily most of the men of old went astray before them,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And truly before them, many of the ancients went astray;-
Shakir: And certainly most of the ancients went astray before them,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Most of the ancient people had also gone astray.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And indeed most of the men of old went astray before them;
Arberry: Before them erred most of the ancients,
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: وَلَا طَعَامٌ إِلَّا مِنۡ غِسۡلِينٖ
Verse: ولا طعام الا من غسلين
Sahih_International: Nor any food except from the discharge of wounds;
Pickthall: Nor any food save filth
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "Nor hath he any food except the corruption from the washing of wounds,
Shakir: Nor any food except refuse,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): and no food except pus
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Nor any food except filth from the washing of wounds,
Arberry: neither any food saving foul pus,
Label: fear

Verse_diac: إِنَّ إِلَيۡنَآ إِيَابَهُمۡ
Verse: ان الينا ايابهم
Sahih_International: Indeed, to Us is their return.
Pickthall: Lo! unto Us is their return
Yusuf_Ali (YA): For to Us will be their return;
Shakir: Surely to Us is their turning back,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): To Us they will all return.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Verily, to Us will be their return;
Arberry: Truly, to Us is their return;
Label: fear

Verse_diac: عَلِمَتۡ نَفۡسٞ مَّا قَدَّمَتۡ وَأَخَّرَتۡ
Verse: علمت نفس ما قدمت واخرت
Sahih_International: A soul will [then] know what it has put forth and kept back.
Pickthall: A soul will know what it hath sent before (it) and what left behind.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): (Then) shall each soul know what it hath sent forward and (what it hath) kept back.
Shakir: Every soul shall know what it has sent before and held back.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): every soul will see the result of its deeds - those recorded before his death and those which will produce either virtue or evil after his death.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): (Then) a person will know what he has sent forward and (what he has) left behind (of good or bad deeds).
Arberry: then a soul shall know its works, the former and the latter.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: فَٱذۡكُرُونِيٓ أَذۡكُرۡكُمۡ وَٱشۡكُرُواْ لِي وَلَا تَكۡفُرُونِ
Verse: فاذكروني اذكركم واشكروا لي ولا تكفرون
Sahih_International: So remember Me; I will remember you. And be grateful to Me and do not deny Me.
Pickthall: Therefore remember Me, I will remember you. Give thanks to Me, and reject not Me.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Then do ye remember Me; I will remember you. Be grateful to Me, and reject not Faith.
Shakir: Therefore remember Me, I will remember you, and be thankful to Me, and do not be ungrateful to Me.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): therefore, remember Me and I shall remember you. Thank Me and do not hide the truth about Me.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Therefore remember Me (by praying, glorifying, etc.). I will remember you, and be grateful to Me (for My countless Favours on you) and never be ungrateful to Me.
Arberry: So remember Me, and I will remember you; and be thankful to Me; and be you not ungrateful towards Me.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
Verse: وما اسلكم عليه من اجر ان اجري الا علىٰ رب العٰلمين
Sahih_International: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
Pickthall: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "No reward do I ask of you for it: my reward is only from the Lord of the Worlds:
Shakir: And I do not ask you any reward for it; my reward is only with the Lord of the worlds:
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): I ask no payment from you for my preaching. The Lord of the Universe will give me my reward.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "No reward do I ask of you for it (my Message of Islamic Monotheism), my reward is only from the Lord of the 'Alamin (mankind, jinns and all that exists).
Arberry: I ask of you no wage for this; my wage falls only upon the Lord of all Being;
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: هَٰذَا هُدٗىۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ مِّن رِّجۡزٍ أَلِيمٌ
Verse: هٰذا هدى والذين كفروا بايٰت ربهم لهم عذاب من رجز اليم
Sahih_International: This [Qur'an] is guidance. And those who have disbelieved in the verses of their Lord will have a painful punishment of foul nature.
Pickthall: This is guidance. And those who disbelieve the revelations of their Lord, for them there is a painful doom of wrath.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): This is (true) Guidance and for those who reject the Signs of their Lord, is a grievous Penalty of abomination.
Shakir: This is guidance; and (as for) those who disbelieve in the communications of their Lord, they shall have a painful punishment on account of uncleanness.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): This (Quran) is a guidance. Those who reject the revelations of their Lord will suffer the most painful punishment.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): This (Quran) is a guidance. And those who disbelieve in the Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) of their Lord, for them there is a painful torment of Rijz (a severe kind of punishment).
Arberry: This is guidance; and those who disbelieve in the signs of their Lord, there awaits them a painful chastisement of wrath.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: هَٰذَا نُزُلُهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلدِّينِ
Verse: هٰذا نزلهم يوم الدين
Sahih_International: That is their accommodation on the Day of Recompense.
Pickthall: This will be their welcome on the Day of Judgment.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Such will be their entertainment on the Day of Requital!
Shakir: This is their entertainment on the day of requital.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Such will be their dwelling on the Day of Judgment.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): That will be their entertainment on the Day of Recompense!
Arberry: This shall be their hospitality on the Day of Doom.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَءَايَةٞ لَّهُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ ٱلۡمَيۡتَةُ أَحۡيَيۡنَٰهَا وَأَخۡرَجۡنَا مِنۡهَا حَبّٗا فَمِنۡهُ يَأۡكُلُونَ
Verse: وءاية لهم الارض الميتة احيينٰها واخرجنا منها حبا فمنه ياكلون
Sahih_International: And a sign for them is the dead earth. We have brought it to life and brought forth from it grain, and from it they eat.
Pickthall: A token unto them is the dead earth. We revive it, and We bring forth from it grain so that they eat thereof;
Yusuf_Ali (YA): A Sign for them is the earth that is dead: We do give it life, and produce grain therefrom, of which ye do eat.
Shakir: And a sign to them is the dead earth: We give life to it and bring forth from it grain SQ they eat of it.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Evidence (of the truth) for them is how We revived the dead earth
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And a sign for them is the dead land. We gave it life, and We brought forth from it grains, so that they eat thereof.
Arberry: And a sign for them is the dead land, that We quickened and brought forth from it grain, whereof they eat;
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِن صَلۡصَٰلٖ مِّنۡ حَمَإٖ مَّسۡنُونٖ
Verse: ولقد خلقنا الانسٰن من صلصٰل من حما مسنون
Sahih_International: And We did certainly create man out of clay from an altered black mud.
Pickthall: Verily We created man of potter's clay of black mud altered,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): We created man from sounding clay, from mud moulded into shape;
Shakir: And certainly We created man of clay that gives forth sound, of black mud fashioned in shape.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We have created the human being out of pure mud-moulded clay
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And indeed, We created man from sounding clay of altered black smooth mud.
Arberry: Surely We created man of a clay of mud moulded,
Label: fear

Verse_diac: ذُو ٱلۡعَرۡشِ ٱلۡمَجِيدُ
Verse: ذو العرش المجيد
Sahih_International: Honorable Owner of the Throne,
Pickthall: Lord of the Throne of Glory,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Lord of the Throne of Glory,
Shakir: Lord of the Arsh, the Glorious,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): the Owner of the Throne, the Glorious One,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Owner of the throne, the Glorious
Arberry: Lord of the Throne, the All-glorious,
Label: joy

Verse_diac: كَلَّآ إِنَّهُمۡ عَن رَّبِّهِمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٖ لَّمَحۡجُوبُونَ
Verse: كلا انهم عن ربهم يومئذ لمحجوبون
Sahih_International: No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned.
Pickthall: Nay, but surely on that day they will be covered from (the mercy of) their Lord.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Verily, from (the Light of) their Lord, that Day, will they be veiled.
Shakir: Nay! most surely they shall on that day be debarred from their Lord.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): On the Day of Judgment, they will certainly be barred from the mercy of their Lord.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Nay! Surely, they (evil-doers) will be veiled from seeing their Lord that Day.
Arberry: No indeed; but upon that day they shall be veiled from their Lord,
Label: fear

Verse_diac: مَّا تَسۡبِقُ مِنۡ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسۡتَـٔۡخِرُونَ
Verse: ما تسبق من امة اجلها وما يستخرون
Sahih_International: No nation will precede its term, nor will they remain thereafter.
Pickthall: No nation can outstrip its term nor can they lag behind.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Neither can a people anticipate its term, nor delay it.
Shakir: No people can hasten on their doom nor can they postpone (it).
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Every nation can only live for the time appointed for it.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): No nation can anticipate its term, nor delay it.
Arberry: and no nation outstrips its term, nor do they put it back.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: لَا يَسۡمَعُونَ فِيهَا لَغۡوٗا وَلَا تَأۡثِيمًا
Verse: لا يسمعون فيها لغوا ولا تاثيما
Sahih_International: They will not hear therein ill speech or commission of sin -
Pickthall: There hear they no vain speaking nor recrimination
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Not frivolity will they hear therein, nor any taint of ill,-
Shakir: They shall not hear therein vain or sinful discourse,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): They will not hear any unnecessary or sinful talk
Mohsin_Khan (MK): No Laghw (dirty, false, evil vain talk) will they hear therein, nor any sinful speech (like backbiting, etc.).
Arberry: Therein they shall hear no idle talk, no cause of sin,
Label: joy

Verse_diac: فَأَذَاقَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلۡخِزۡيَ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَاۖ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ أَكۡبَرُۚ لَوۡ كَانُواْ يَعۡلَمُونَ
Verse: فاذاقهم الله الخزي في الحيوٰة الدنيا ولعذاب الاخرة اكبر لو كانوا يعلمون
Sahih_International: So Allah made them taste disgrace in worldly life. But the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.
Pickthall: Thus Allah made them taste humiliation in the life of the world, and verily the doom of the Hereafter will be greater if they did but know.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): So Allah gave them a taste of humiliation in the present life, but greater is the punishment of the Hereafter, if they only knew!
Shakir: So Allah made them taste the disgrace in this world's life, and certainly the punishment of the hereafter is greater; did they but know!
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): God made them suffer humiliation in this life. Would that they knew that the torment for them in the next life will be even greater.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): So Allah made them to taste the disgrace in the present life, but greater is the torment of the Hereafter if they only knew!
Arberry: so God let them taste degradation in this present life; and the chastisement of the world to come is assuredly greater, did they but know.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: إِنَّا خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطۡفَةٍ أَمۡشَاجٖ نَّبۡتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُ سَمِيعَۢا بَصِيرًا
Verse: انا خلقنا الانسٰن من نطفة امشاج نبتليه فجعلنٰه سميعا بصيرا
Sahih_International: Indeed, We created man from a sperm-drop mixture that We may try him; and We made him hearing and seeing.
Pickthall: Lo! We create man from a drop of thickened fluid to test him; so We make him hearing, knowing.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Verily We created Man from a drop of mingled sperm, in order to try him: So We gave him (the gifts), of Hearing and Sight.
Shakir: Surely We have created man from a small life-germ uniting (itself): We mean to try him, so We have made him hearing, seeing.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We created the human being from the union of sperm and egg to test him. We gave him hearing and vision.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Verily, We have created man from Nutfah drops of mixed semen (discharge of man and woman), in order to try him, so We made him hearer, seer.
Arberry: We created man of a sperm-drop, a mingling, and We made him hearing, seeing.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: أَوَلَمۡ يَسِيرُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ فَيَنظُرُواْ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِمۡ وَكَانُوٓاْ أَشَدَّ مِنۡهُمۡ قُوَّةٗۚ وَمَا كَانَ ٱللَّهُ لِيُعۡجِزَهُۥ مِن شَيۡءٖ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَلَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ عَلِيمٗا قَدِيرٗا
Verse: اولم يسيروا في الارض فينظروا كيف كان عٰقبة الذين من قبلهم وكانوا اشد منهم قوة وما كان الله ليعجزه من شيء في السمٰوٰت ولا في الارض انه كان عليما قديرا
Sahih_International: Have they not traveled through the land and observed how was the end of those before them? And they were greater than them in power. But Allah is not to be caused failure by anything in the heavens or on the earth. Indeed, He is ever Knowing and Competent.
Pickthall: Have they not travelled in the land and seen the nature of the consequence for those who were before them, and they were mightier than these in power? Allah is not such that aught in the heavens or in the earth escapeth Him. Lo! He is the Wise, the Mighty.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Do they not travel through the earth, and see what was the End of those before them,- though they were superior to them in strength? Nor is Allah to be frustrated by anything whatever in the heavens or on earth: for He is All-Knowing. All-Powerful.
Shakir: Have they not travelled in the land and seen how was the end of those before them while they were stronger than these in power? And Allah is not such that any thing in the heavens or in the earth should escape Him; surely He is Knowing, Powerful.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Have they not travelled (sufficiently) through the land to see how terrible was the end of the mightier people who lived before them. Nothing in the heavens or the earth can challenge God. God is All-knowing and All-powerful.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Have they not travelled in the land, and seen what was the end of those before them, and they were superior to them in power? Allah is not such that anything in the heavens or in the earth escapes Him. Verily, He is All­Knowing, All­Omnipotent.
Arberry: What, have they not journeyed in the land and beheld how was the end of those before them? They were stronger than themselves in might; but God -- there is naught in the heavens or the earth that can frustrate Him. Surely He is All-knowing, All-powerful.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا هُمۡ أَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡمَشۡـَٔمَةِ
Verse: والذين كفروا بايٰتنا هم اصحٰب المشمة
Sahih_International: But they who disbelieved in Our signs - those are the companions of the left.
Pickthall: But those who disbelieve Our revelations, their place will be on the left hand.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): But those who reject Our Signs, they are the (unhappy) Companions of the Left Hand.
Shakir: And (as for) those who disbelieve in our communications, they are the people of the left hand.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): As for those who disbelieve in Our revelations, they are the people of the left
Mohsin_Khan (MK): But those who disbelieved in Our Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.), they are those on the Left Hand (the dwellers of Hell).
Arberry: And those who disbelieve in Our signs, they are the Companions of the Left Hand;
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَمَن جَآءَ بِٱلسَّيِّئَةِ فَكُبَّتۡ وُجُوهُهُمۡ فِي ٱلنَّارِ هَلۡ تُجۡزَوۡنَ إِلَّا مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
Verse: ومن جاء بالسيئة فكبت وجوههم في النار هل تجزون الا ما كنتم تعملون
Sahih_International: And whoever comes with an evil deed - their faces will be overturned into the Fire, [and it will be said], "Are you recompensed except for what you used to do?"
Pickthall: And whoso bringeth an ill-deed, such will be flung down on their faces in the Fire. Are ye rewarded aught save what ye did?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And if any do evil, their faces will be thrown headlong into the Fire: "Do ye receive a reward other than that which ye have earned by your deeds?"
Shakir: And whoever brings evil, these shall be thrown down on their faces into the fire; shall you be rewarded (for) aught except what you did?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Those who commit evil will be thrown headlong into hell fire. (It will be said to them) can you expect any recompense other than what you deserve for your deeds?
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And whoever brings an evil (deed) (i.e. Shirk polytheism, disbelief in the Oneness of Allah and every evil sinful deed), they will be cast down (prone) on their faces in the Fire. (And it will be said to them) "Are you being recompensed anything except what you used to do?"
Arberry: And whosoever comes with an evil deed, their faces shall be thrust into the Fire: 'Are you recompensed but for what you did?'
Label: anger

Verse_diac: وَتِلۡكَ نِعۡمَةٞ تَمُنُّهَا عَلَيَّ أَنۡ عَبَّدتَّ بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ
Verse: وتلك نعمة تمنها علي ان عبدت بني اسرٰءيل
Sahih_International: And is this a favor of which you remind me - that you have enslaved the Children of Israel?"
Pickthall: And this is the past favour wherewith thou reproachest me: that thou hast enslaved the Children of Israel.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "And this is the favour with which thou dost reproach me,- that thou hast enslaved the Children of Israel!"
Shakir: And is it a favor of which you remind me that you have enslaved the children of Israel?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): And this is the favor with which you oblige me: You have made the Israelites your slaves.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "And this is the past favour with which you reproach me, that you have enslaved the Children of Israel."
Arberry: That is a blessing thou reproachest me with, having enslaved the Children of Israel.'
Label: anger

Verse_diac: وَجَآءَ رَبُّكَ وَٱلۡمَلَكُ صَفّٗا صَفّٗا
Verse: وجاء ربك والملك صفا صفا
Sahih_International: And your Lord has come and the angels, rank upon rank,
Pickthall: And thy Lord shall come with angels, rank on rank,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And thy Lord cometh, and His angels, rank upon rank,
Shakir: And your Lord comes and (also) the angels in ranks,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): and (when you find yourself) in the presence of your Lord and the rows and rows of angels, your greed for riches will certainly be of no avail to you.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And your Lord comes with the angels in rows,
Arberry: and thy Lord comes, and the angels rank on rank,
Label: fear

Verse_diac: عَلَىٰ سُرُرٖ مَّوۡضُونَةٖ
Verse: علىٰ سرر موضونة
Sahih_International: On thrones woven [with ornament],
Pickthall: On lined couches,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): (They will be) on Thrones encrusted (with gold and precious stones),
Shakir: On thrones decorated,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): They will recline on jewelled couches
Mohsin_Khan (MK): (They will be) on thrones woven with gold and precious stones,
Arberry: upon close-wrought couches
Label: joy

Verse_diac: أَلَّا تَتَّبِعَنِۖ أَفَعَصَيۡتَ أَمۡرِي
Verse: الا تتبعن افعصيت امري
Sahih_International: From following me? Then have you disobeyed my order?"
Pickthall: That thou followedst me not? Hast thou then disobeyed my order?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "From following me? Didst thou then disobey my order?"
Shakir: So that you did not follow me? Did you then disobey my order?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Did you disobey my orders?"
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "That you followed me not (according to my advice to you)? Have you then disobeyed my order?"
Arberry: so that thou didst not follow after me? Didst thou then disobey my commandment?'
Label: anger

Verse_diac: وَتَمَّتۡ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ صِدۡقٗا وَعَدۡلٗاۚ لَّا مُبَدِّلَ لِكَلِمَٰتِهِۦۚ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
Verse: وتمت كلمت ربك صدقا وعدلا لا مبدل لكلمٰته وهو السميع العليم
Sahih_International: And the word of your Lord has been fulfilled in truth and in justice. None can alter His words, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
Pickthall: Perfected is the Word of thy Lord in truth and justice. There is naught that can change His words. He is the Hearer, the Knower.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): The word of thy Lord doth find its fulfilment in truth and in justice: None can change His words: for He is the one who heareth and knoweth all.
Shakir: And the word of your Lord has been accomplished truly and justly; there is none who can change His words, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): (After having revealed the Quran to you) in all truth and justice, your Lord's Word has been completed. No one can change His Words. He is All-hearing and All-knowing.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And the Word of your Lord has been fulfilled in truth and in justice. None can change His Words. And He is the All­Hearer, the All­Knower.
Arberry: Perfect are the words of thy Lord in truthfulness and justice; no man can change His words; He is the All-hearing, the All-knowing.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: وَٱلَّيۡلِ إِذَا عَسۡعَسَ
Verse: واليل اذا عسعس
Sahih_International: And by the night as it closes in
Pickthall: And the close of night,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And the Night as it dissipates;
Shakir: And the night when it departs,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): and sit during the day, or by the darkening night
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And by the night as it departs;
Arberry: by the night swarming,
Label: joy

Verse_diac: كَأَن لَّمۡ يَغۡنَوۡاْ فِيهَآۗ أَلَآ إِنَّ ثَمُودَاْ كَفَرُواْ رَبَّهُمۡۗ أَلَا بُعۡدٗا لِّثَمُودَ
Verse: كان لم يغنوا فيها الا ان ثمودا كفروا ربهم الا بعدا لثمود
Sahih_International: As if they had never prospered therein. Unquestionably, Thamud denied their Lord; then, away with Thamud.
Pickthall: As though they had not dwelt there. Lo! Thamud disbelieved in their Lord. A far removal for Thamud!
Yusuf_Ali (YA): As if they had never dwelt and flourished there. Ah! Behold! for the Thamud rejected their Lord and Cherisher! Ah! Behold! removed (from sight) were the Thamud!
Shakir: As though they had never dwelt in them; now surely did Samood disbelieve in their Lord; now surely, away with Samood.
