Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Do not yield to those who reject the Truth.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): So (O Muhammad SAW) obey not the deniers [(of Islamic Monotheism those who belie the Verses of Allah), the Oneness of Allah, and the Messenger of Allah (Muhammad SAW), etc.]
Arberry: So obey thou not those who cry lies.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ عَلَىٰ هُدٗى مِّن رَّبِّهِمۡۖ وَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡمُفۡلِحُونَ
Verse: اولٰئك علىٰ هدى من ربهم واولٰئك هم المفلحون
Sahih_International: Those are upon [right] guidance from their Lord, and it is those who are the successful.
Pickthall: These depend on guidance from their Lord. These are the successful.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): They are on (true) guidance, from their Lord, and it is these who will prosper.
Shakir: These are on a right course from their Lord and these it is that shall be successful.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): It is the pious who follow the guidance of their Lord and gain lasting happiness.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): They are on (true) guidance from their Lord, and they are the successful.
Arberry: those are upon guidance from their Lord, those are the ones who prosper.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَءَاتَيۡنَا مُوسَى ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَجَعَلۡنَٰهُ هُدٗى لِّبَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ أَلَّا تَتَّخِذُواْ مِن دُونِي وَكِيلٗا
Verse: وءاتينا موسى الكتٰب وجعلنٰه هدى لبني اسرٰءيل الا تتخذوا من دوني وكيلا
Sahih_International: And We gave Moses the Scripture and made it a guidance for the Children of Israel that you not take other than Me as Disposer of affairs,
Pickthall: We gave unto Moses the Scripture, and We appointed it a guidance for the children of Israel, saying: Choose no guardian beside Me.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): We gave Moses the Book, and made it a Guide to the Children of Israel, (commanding): "Take not other than Me as Disposer of (your) affairs."
Shakir: And We gave Musa the Book and made it a guidance to the children of Israel, saying: Do not take a protector besides Me;
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): To Moses We gave the Book and made it a guide for the children of Israel, so that they would not have any one as their guardian other than Me
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And We gave Musa (Moses) the Scripture and made it a guidance for the Children of Israel (saying): "Take not other than Me as (your) Wakil (Protector, Lord, or Disposer of your affairs, etc).
Arberry: And We gave Moses the Book, and made it a guidance to the Children of Israel: 'Take not unto yourselves any guardian apart from Me.'
Label: joy

Verse_diac: نَتۡلُواْ عَلَيۡكَ مِن نَّبَإِ مُوسَىٰ وَفِرۡعَوۡنَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ لِقَوۡمٖ يُؤۡمِنُونَ
Verse: نتلوا عليك من نبا موسىٰ وفرعون بالحق لقوم يؤمنون
Sahih_International: We recite to you from the news of Moses and Pharaoh in truth for a people who believe.
Pickthall: We narrate unto thee (somewhat) of the story of Moses and Pharaoh with truth, for folk who believe.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): We rehearse to thee some of the story of Moses and Pharaoh in Truth, for people who believe.
Shakir: We recite to you from the account of Musa and Firon with truth for people who believe.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We recite to you some of the story of Moses and the Pharaoh for a genuine purpose, and for the benefit of the believing people.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): We recite to you some of the news of Musa (Moses) and Fir'aun (Pharaoh) in truth, for a people who believe (those who believe in this Quran, and in the Oneness of Allah).
Arberry: We will recite to thee something of the tiding of Moses and Pharaoh truthfully, for a people who believe.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: لَا يَذُوقُونَ فِيهَا ٱلۡمَوۡتَ إِلَّا ٱلۡمَوۡتَةَ ٱلۡأُولَىٰۖ وَوَقَىٰهُمۡ عَذَابَ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
Verse: لا يذوقون فيها الموت الا الموتة الاولىٰ ووقىٰهم عذاب الجحيم
Sahih_International: They will not taste death therein except the first death, and He will have protected them from the punishment of Hellfire
Pickthall: They taste not death therein, save the first death. And He hath saved them from the doom of hell,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Nor will they there taste Death, except the first death; and He will preserve them from the Penalty of the Blazing Fire,-
Shakir: They shall not taste therein death except the first death, and He will save them from the punishment of the hell,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): They will not experience any death other than that which they have already been through.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): They will never taste death therein except the first death (of this world), and He will save them from the torment of the blazing Fire,
Arberry: They shall not taste therein of death, save the first death, And He shall guard them against the chastisement of Hell --
Label: fear

Verse_diac: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتۡهُمۡ ءَايَٰتُنَا مُبۡصِرَةٗ قَالُواْ هَٰذَا سِحۡرٞ مُّبِينٞ
Verse: فلما جاءتهم ءايٰتنا مبصرة قالوا هٰذا سحر مبين
Sahih_International: But when there came to them Our visible signs, they said, "This is obvious magic."
Pickthall: But when Our tokens came unto them, plain to see, they said: This is mere magic,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): But when Our Signs came to them, that should have opened their eyes, they said: "This is sorcery manifest!"
Shakir: So when Our clear signs came to them, they said: This is clear enchantment.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): When Our miracles were visibly shown to them, they said, "It is plain magic".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): But when Our Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) came to them, clear to see, they said: "This is a manifest magic."
Arberry: But when Our signs came to them visibly, they said, 'This is a manifest sorcery';
Label: anger

Verse_diac: يَخۡرُجُ مِنۢ بَيۡنِ ٱلصُّلۡبِ وَٱلتَّرَآئِبِ
Verse: يخرج من بين الصلب والترائب
Sahih_International: Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs.
Pickthall: That issued from between the loins and ribs.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Proceeding from between the backbone and the ribs:
Shakir: Coming from between the back and the ribs.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): which comes out of the loins and ribs.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Proceeding from between the back-bone and the ribs,
Arberry: issuing between the loins and the breast-bones.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَصۡدُرُ ٱلنَّاسُ أَشۡتَاتٗا لِّيُرَوۡاْ أَعۡمَٰلَهُمۡ
Verse: يومئذ يصدر الناس اشتاتا ليروا اعمٰلهم
Sahih_International: That Day, the people will depart separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds.
Pickthall: That day mankind will issue forth in scattered groups to be shown their deeds.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): On that Day will men proceed in companies sorted out, to be shown the deeds that they (had done).
Shakir: On that day men shall come forth in sundry bodies that they may be shown their works.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): On that day, people will come out of their graves in different groups to see (the results of) their own deeds.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): That Day mankind will proceed in scattered groups that they may be shown their deeds.
Arberry: Upon that day men shall issue in scatterings to see their works,
Label: fear

Verse_diac: فَإِذَا سَوَّيۡتُهُۥ وَنَفَخۡتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِي فَقَعُواْ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ
Verse: فاذا سويته ونفخت فيه من روحي فقعوا له سٰجدين
Sahih_International: And when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration."
Pickthall: So, when I have made him and have breathed into him of My Spirit, do ye fall down, prostrating yourselves unto him.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "When I have fashioned him (in due proportion) and breathed into him of My spirit, fall ye down in obeisance unto him."
Shakir: So when I have made him complete and breathed into him of My spirit, fall down making obeisance to him.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): When it is properly shaped and I have blown My Spirit into it, you should then bow down in prostration".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "So, when I have fashioned him completely and breathed into him (Adam) the soul which I created for him, then fall (you) down prostrating yourselves unto him."
Arberry: When I have shaped him, and breathed My spirit in him, fall you down, bowing before him!'
Label: fear

Verse_diac: لَّا يَمَسُّهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱلۡمُطَهَّرُونَ
Verse: لا يمسه الا المطهرون
Sahih_International: None touch it except the purified.
Pickthall: Which none toucheth save the purified,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Which none shall touch but those who are clean:
Shakir: None shall touch it save the purified ones.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): no one can touch it except the purified ones.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Which (that Book with Allah) none can touch but the purified (i.e. the angels).
Arberry: none but the purified shall touch,
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَأَرَادُواْ بِهِۦ كَيۡدٗا فَجَعَلۡنَٰهُمُ ٱلۡأَخۡسَرِينَ
Verse: وارادوا به كيدا فجعلنٰهم الاخسرين
Sahih_International: And they intended for him harm, but We made them the greatest losers.
Pickthall: And they wished to set a snare for him, but We made them the greater losers.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Then they sought a stratagem against him: but We made them the ones that lost most!
Shakir: And they desired a war on him, but We made them the greatest losers.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): They had devised an evil plan (against Abraham), but We turned it into failure."
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And they wanted to harm him, but We made them the worst losers.
Arberry: They desired to outwit him; so We made them the worse losers,
Label: joy

Verse_diac: مَا سَمِعۡنَا بِهَٰذَا فِي ٱلۡمِلَّةِ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ إِنۡ هَٰذَآ إِلَّا ٱخۡتِلَٰقٌ
Verse: ما سمعنا بهٰذا في الملة الاخرة ان هٰذا الا اختلٰق
Sahih_International: We have not heard of this in the latest religion. This is not but a fabrication.
Pickthall: We have not heard of this in later religion. This is naught but an invention.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "We never heard (the like) of this among the people of these latter days: this is nothing but a made-up tale!"
Shakir: We never heard of this in the former faith; this is nothing but a forgery:
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We have heard nothing like this in the latest religion. This is only his own false invention.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "We have not heard (the like) of this among the people of these later days. This is nothing but an invention!
Arberry: We have not heard of this in the last religion; this is surely an invention.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَإِن يَكُن لَّهُمُ ٱلۡحَقُّ يَأۡتُوٓاْ إِلَيۡهِ مُذۡعِنِينَ
Verse: وان يكن لهم الحق ياتوا اليه مذعنين
Sahih_International: But if the right is theirs, they come to him in prompt obedience.
Pickthall: But if right had been with them they would have come unto him willingly.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): But if the right is on their side, they come to him with all submission.
Shakir: And if the truth be on their side, they come to him quickly, obedient.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): If right was on their side, they would come quickly.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): But if the right is with them, they come to him willingly with submission.
Arberry: but if they are in the right, they will come to him submissively.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: يَٰبُنَيَّ إِنَّهَآ إِن تَكُ مِثۡقَالَ حَبَّةٖ مِّنۡ خَرۡدَلٖ فَتَكُن فِي صَخۡرَةٍ أَوۡ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ أَوۡ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ يَأۡتِ بِهَا ٱللَّهُۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَطِيفٌ خَبِيرٞ
Verse: يٰبني انها ان تك مثقال حبة من خردل فتكن في صخرة او في السمٰوٰت او في الارض يات بها الله ان الله لطيف خبير
Sahih_International: [And Luqman said], "O my son, indeed if wrong should be the weight of a mustard seed and should be within a rock or [anywhere] in the heavens or in the earth, Allah will bring it forth. Indeed, Allah is Subtle and Acquainted.
Pickthall: O my dear son! Lo! though it be but the weight of a grain of mustard-seed, and though it be in a rock, or in the heavens, or in the earth, Allah will bring it forth. Lo! Allah is Subtile, Aware.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "O my son!" (said Luqman), "If there be (but) the weight of a mustard-seed and it were (hidden) in a rock, or (anywhere) in the heavens or on earth, Allah will bring it forth: for Allah understands the finest mysteries, (and) is well-acquainted (with them).
Shakir: O my son! surely if it is the very weight of the grain of a mustard-seed, even though it is in (the heart of) rock, or (high above) in the heaven or (deep down) in the earth, Allah will bring it (to light); surely Allah is Knower of subtleties, Aware;
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): "My son, God keeps the records of all the good and evil deeds, even if they are as small as a grain of mustard seed, hidden in a rock or in the heavens or the earth. God is subtle and All-aware.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "O my son! If it be (anything) equal to the weight of a grain of mustard seed, and though it be in a rock, or in the heavens or in the earth, Allah will bring it forth. Verily, Allah is Subtle (in bringing out that grain), Well­Aware (of its place).
Arberry: 'O my son, if it should be but the weight of one grain of mustard-seed, and though it be in a rock, or in the heavens, or in the earth, God shall bring it forth; surely God is All-subtle, All-aware.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: إِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ ءَايَٰتُنَا قَالَ أَسَٰطِيرُ ٱلۡأَوَّلِينَ
Verse: اذا تتلىٰ عليه ءايٰتنا قال اسٰطير الاولين
Sahih_International: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, "Legends of the former peoples."
Pickthall: Who, when thou readest unto him Our revelations, saith: (Mere) fables of the men of old.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): When Our Signs are rehearsed to him, he says, "Tales of the ancients!"
Shakir: When Our communications are recited to him, he says: Stories of those of yore.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): who, when listening to Our revelations, say, "These are only ancient legends".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): When Our Verses (of the Quran) are recited to him he says: "Tales of the ancients!"
Arberry: When our signs are recited to him, he says, 'Fairy-tales of the ancients!'
Label: anger

Verse_diac: وَإِنَّهُمۡ عِندَنَا لَمِنَ ٱلۡمُصۡطَفَيۡنَ ٱلۡأَخۡيَارِ
Verse: وانهم عندنا لمن المصطفين الاخيار
Sahih_International: And indeed they are, to Us, among the chosen and outstanding.
Pickthall: Lo! in Our sight they are verily of the elect, the excellent.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): They were, in Our sight, truly, of the company of the Elect and the Good.
Shakir: And most surely they were with Us, of the elect, the best.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): In Our eyes they were of the chosen, virtuous people.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And they are with Us, verily, of the chosen and the best!
Arberry: and in Our sight they are of the chosen, the excellent.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَكَانَ فِي ٱلۡمَدِينَةِ تِسۡعَةُ رَهۡطٖ يُفۡسِدُونَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَا يُصۡلِحُونَ
Verse: وكان في المدينة تسعة رهط يفسدون في الارض ولا يصلحون
Sahih_International: And there were in the city nine family heads causing corruption in the land and not amending [its affairs].
Pickthall: And there were in the city nine persons who made mischief in the land and reformed not.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): There were in the city nine men of a family, who made mischief in the land, and would not reform.
Shakir: And there were in the city nine persons who made mischief in the land and did not act aright.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): There were nine tribes in the city spreading evil without any reform in the land.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And there were in the city nine men (from the sons of their chiefs), who made mischief in the land, and would not reform.
Arberry: Now in the city there were nine persons who did corruption in the land, and put not things right;
Label: anger

Verse_diac: أَتُتۡرَكُونَ فِي مَا هَٰهُنَآ ءَامِنِينَ
Verse: اتتركون في ما هٰهنا ءامنين
Sahih_International: Will you be left in what is here, secure [from death],
Pickthall: Will ye be left secure in that which is here before us,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "Will ye be left secure, in (the enjoyment of) all that ye have here?-
Shakir: Will you be left secure in what is here;
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): "Do you think that you will remain here peacefully forever
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "Will you be left secure in that which you have here?
Arberry: Will you be left secure in this here,
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: فَسِيحُواْ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ أَرۡبَعَةَ أَشۡهُرٖ وَٱعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّكُمۡ غَيۡرُ مُعۡجِزِي ٱللَّهِ وَأَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُخۡزِي ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ
Verse: فسيحوا في الارض اربعة اشهر واعلموا انكم غير معجزي الله وان الله مخزي الكٰفرين
Sahih_International: So travel freely, [O disbelievers], throughout the land [during] four months but know that you cannot cause failure to Allah and that Allah will disgrace the disbelievers.
Pickthall: Travel freely in the land four months, and know that ye cannot escape Allah and that Allah will confound the disbelievers (in His Guidance).
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Go ye, then, for four months, backwards and forwards, (as ye will), throughout the land, but know ye that ye cannot frustrate Allah (by your falsehood) but that Allah will cover with shame those who reject Him.
Shakir: So go about in the land for four months and know that you cannot weaken Allah and that Allah will bring disgrace to the unbelievers.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): However, during the four sacred months, they (pagans) may travel peacefully through the land. Know (pagans) that you cannot make God helpless, but it is God who has the power to disgrace the unbelievers.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): So travel freely (O Mushrikun - see V.2:105) for four months (as you will) throughout the land, but know that you cannot escape (from the Punishment of) Allah, and Allah will disgrace the disbelievers.
Arberry: 'Journey freely in the land for four months; and know that you cannot frustrate the will of God, and that God degrades the unbelievers.'
Label: anger

Verse_diac: وَمِنۡ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ خَلۡقُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَٱخۡتِلَٰفُ أَلۡسِنَتِكُمۡ وَأَلۡوَٰنِكُمۡۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّلۡعَٰلِمِينَ
Verse: ومن ءايٰته خلق السمٰوٰت والارض واختلٰف السنتكم والوٰنكم ان في ذٰلك لايٰت للعٰلمين
Sahih_International: And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and the diversity of your languages and your colors. Indeed in that are signs for those of knowledge.
Pickthall: And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth, and the difference of your languages and colours. Lo! herein indeed are portents for men of knowledge.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And among His Signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth, and the variations in your languages and your colours: verily in that are Signs for those who know.
Shakir: And one of His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and the diversity of your tongues and colors; most surely there are signs in this for the learned.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Other evidence of His existence are the creation of the heavens and the earth and the differences of languages and colors. In this there is evidence (of the truth) for the worlds (mankind).
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And among His Signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth, and the difference of your languages and colours. Verily, in that are indeed signs for men of sound knowledge.
Arberry: And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and earth and the variety of your tongues and hues. Surely in that are signs for all living beings.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: قَالُواْ ٱبۡنُواْ لَهُۥ بُنۡيَٰنٗا فَأَلۡقُوهُ فِي ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
Verse: قالوا ابنوا له بنيٰنا فالقوه في الجحيم
Sahih_International: They said, "Construct for him a furnace and throw him into the burning fire."
Pickthall: They said: Build for him a building and fling him in the red-hotfire.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): They said, "Build him a furnace, and throw him into the blazing fire!"
Shakir: They said: Build for him a furnace, then cast him into the burning fire.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): They said, "Let us build a fire and throw him into the flames".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): They said: "Build for him a building (it is said that the building was like a furnace) and throw him into the blazing fire!"
Arberry: They said, 'Build him a building, and cast him into the furnace!'
Label: fear

Verse_diac: فَدَعَا رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّي مَغۡلُوبٞ فَٱنتَصِرۡ
Verse: فدعا ربه اني مغلوب فانتصر
Sahih_International: So he invoked his Lord, "Indeed, I am overpowered, so help."
Pickthall: So he cried unto his Lord, saying: I am vanquished, so give help.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Then he called on his Lord: "I am one overcome: do Thou then help (me)!"
Shakir: Therefore he called upon his Lord: I am overcome, come Thou then to help.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Noah prayed, "Lord, help me; I am defeated".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Then he invoked his Lord (saying): "I have been overcome, so help (me)!"
Arberry: And so he called unto his Lord, saying, 'I am vanquished; do Thou succour me!'
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: وَلَقَدۡ فَتَنَّا سُلَيۡمَٰنَ وَأَلۡقَيۡنَا عَلَىٰ كُرۡسِيِّهِۦ جَسَدٗا ثُمَّ أَنَابَ
Verse: ولقد فتنا سليمٰن والقينا علىٰ كرسيه جسدا ثم اناب
Sahih_International: And We certainly tried Solomon and placed on his throne a body; then he returned.
Pickthall: And verily We tried Solomon, and set upon his throne a (mere) body. Then did he repent.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And We did try Solomon: We placed on his throne a body (without life); but he did turn (to Us in true devotion):
Shakir: And certainly We tried Sulaiman, and We put on his throne a (mere) body, so he turned (to Allah).
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We tested Solomon by (causing death to his son) and leaving his body on Solomon's chair. Then he turned to Us in repentance,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And, indeed We did try Sulaiman (Solomon) and We placed on his throne Jasadan (a devil, so he lost his kingdom for a while) but he did return (to his throne and kingdom by the Grace of Allah and he did return) to Allah with obedience and in repentance.
Arberry: Certainly We tried Solomon, and We cast upon his throne a mere body; then he repented.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: قَالُواْ سَوَآءٌ عَلَيۡنَآ أَوَعَظۡتَ أَمۡ لَمۡ تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلۡوَٰعِظِينَ
Verse: قالوا سواء علينا اوعظت ام لم تكن من الوٰعظين
Sahih_International: They said, "It is all the same to us whether you advise or are not of the advisors.
Pickthall: They said: It is all one to us whether thou preachest or art not of those who preach;
Yusuf_Ali (YA): They said: "It is the same to us whether thou admonish us or be not among (our) admonishers!
Shakir: They said: It is the same to us whether you admonish or are not one of the admonishers
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): They said, "Whether you preach to us or not,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): They said: "It is the same to us whether you preach or be not of those who preach.
Arberry: They said, 'Alike it is to us, whether thou admonishest, or art not one of the admonishers;
Label: anger

Verse_diac: وَلِلَّهِۤ يَسۡجُدُۤ مَن فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ طَوۡعٗا وَكَرۡهٗا وَظِلَٰلُهُم بِٱلۡغُدُوِّ وَٱلۡأٓصَالِ۩
Verse: ولله يسجد من في السمٰوٰت والارض طوعا وكرها وظلٰلهم بالغدو والاصال
Sahih_International: And to Allah prostrates whoever is within the heavens and the earth, willingly or by compulsion, and their shadows [as well] in the mornings and the afternoons.
Pickthall: And unto Allah falleth prostrate whosoever is in the heavens and the earth, willingly or unwillingly, as do their shadows in the morning and the evening hours.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Whatever beings there are in the heavens and the earth do prostrate themselves to Allah (Acknowledging subjection),- with good-will or in spite of themselves: so do their shadows in the morning and evenings.
Shakir: And whoever is in the heavens and the earth makes obeisance to Allah only, willingly and unwillingly, and their shadows too at morn and eve.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): All in the heavens and the earth prostrate themselves before God, either of their own free will or by force, just as do their shadows in the mornings and evenings.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And unto Allah (Alone) falls in prostration whoever is in the heavens and the earth, willingly or unwillingly, and so do their shadows in the mornings and in the afternoons.
Arberry: To God bow all who are in the heavens and the earth, willingly or unwillingly, as do their shadows also in the mornings and the evenings.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَأَنذِرۡهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡأٓزِفَةِ إِذِ ٱلۡقُلُوبُ لَدَى ٱلۡحَنَاجِرِ كَٰظِمِينَۚ مَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ مِنۡ حَمِيمٖ وَلَا شَفِيعٖ يُطَاعُ
Verse: وانذرهم يوم الازفة اذ القلوب لدى الحناجر كٰظمين ما للظٰلمين من حميم ولا شفيع يطاع
Sahih_International: And warn them, [O Muhammad], of the Approaching Day, when hearts are at the throats, filled [with distress]. For the wrongdoers there will be no devoted friend and no intercessor [who is] obeyed.
Pickthall: Warn them (O Muhammad) of the Day of the approaching (doom), when the hearts will be choking the throats, (when) there will be no friend for the wrong-doers, nor any intercessor who will be heard.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Warn them of the Day that is (ever) drawing near, when the hearts will (come) right up to the throats to choke (them); No intimate friend nor intercessor will the wrong-doers have, who could be listened to.
Shakir: And warn them of the day that draws near, when hearts shall rise up to the throats, grieving inwardly; the unjust shall not have any compassionate friend nor any intercessor who should be obeyed.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): (Muhammad), warn them of the approaching day when because of hardship and frustration their hearts will almost reach up to their throats. The unjust will have no friends nor any intercessor who will be heard.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And warn them (O Muhammad SAW) of the Day that is drawing near (i.e. the Day of Resurrection), when the hearts will be choking the throats, and they can neither return them (hearts) to their chests nor can they throw them out. There will be no friend, nor an intercessor for the Zalimun (polytheists and wrong-doers, etc.), who could be given heed to.
Arberry: And warn them against the Day of the Imminent when, choking with anguish, the hearts are in the throats and the evildoers have not one loyal friend, no intercessor to be heeded.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَٱلۡيَوۡمِ ٱلۡمَوۡعُودِ
Verse: واليوم الموعود
Sahih_International: And [by] the promised Day
Pickthall: And by the Promised Day.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): By the promised Day (of Judgment);
Shakir: And the promised day,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): by the promised day,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And by the Promised Day (i.e. the Day of Resurrection);
Arberry: by the promised day,
Label: fear

Verse_diac: سَلَٰمٞ قَوۡلٗا مِّن رَّبّٖ رَّحِيمٖ
Verse: سلٰم قولا من رب رحيم
Sahih_International: [And] "Peace," a word from a Merciful Lord.
Pickthall: The word from a Merciful Lord (for them) is: Peace!
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "Peace!" - a word (of salutation) from a Lord Most Merciful!
Shakir: Peace: a word from a Merciful Lord.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): "Peace be with you," will be a greeting for them from the Merciful Lord.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): (It will be said to them): Salamun (peace be on you), a Word from the Lord (Allah), Most Merciful.
Arberry: 'Peace!' -- such is the greeting, from a Lord All-compassionate.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: ٱللَّهُ يَحۡكُمُ بَيۡنَكُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كُنتُمۡ فِيهِ تَخۡتَلِفُونَ
Verse: الله يحكم بينكم يوم القيٰمة فيما كنتم فيه تختلفون
Sahih_International: Allah will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which you used to differ."
Pickthall: Allah will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection concerning that wherein ye used to differ.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "Allah will judge between you on the Day of Judgment concerning the matters in which ye differ."
Shakir: Allah will judge between you on the day of resurrection respecting that in which you differ.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): He will issue His decree about your differences on the Day of Judgment."
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "Allah will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection about that wherein you used to differ."
Arberry: God shall judge between you on the Day of Resurrection touching that whereon you were at variance.'
Label: fear

Verse_diac: فَأَنجَيۡنَٰهُ وَأَهۡلَهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱمۡرَأَتَهُۥ كَانَتۡ مِنَ ٱلۡغَٰبِرِينَ
Verse: فانجينٰه واهله الا امراته كانت من الغٰبرين
Sahih_International: So We saved him and his family, except for his wife; she was of those who remained [with the evildoers].
Pickthall: And We rescued him and his household, save his wife, who was of those who stayed behind.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): But we saved him and his family, except his wife: she was of those who legged behind.
Shakir: So We delivered him and his followers, except his wife; she was of those who remained behind.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We saved (Lot) and his family except his wife who remained with the rest.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Then We saved him and his family, except his wife; she was of those who remained behind (in the torment).
Arberry: So We delivered him and his family, except his wife; she was one of those that tarried.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: ثُمَّ أَفِيضُواْ مِنۡ حَيۡثُ أَفَاضَ ٱلنَّاسُ وَٱسۡتَغۡفِرُواْ ٱللَّهَۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ
Verse: ثم افيضوا من حيث افاض الناس واستغفروا الله ان الله غفور رحيم
Sahih_International: Then depart from the place from where [all] the people depart and ask forgiveness of Allah. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
Pickthall: Then hasten onward from the place whence the multitude hasteneth onward, and ask forgiveness of Allah. Lo! Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Then pass on at a quick pace from the place whence it is usual for the multitude so to do, and ask for Allah's forgiveness. For Allah is Oft-forgiving, Most Merciful.
Shakir: Then hasten on from the Place from which the people hasten on and ask the forgiveness of Allah; surely Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Then leave Mash'ar as the rest of the people do and ask forgiveness from God; He is All-forgiving and All-merciful.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Then depart from the place whence all the people depart and ask Allah for His Forgiveness. Truly, Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most-Merciful.
Arberry: Then press on from where the people press on, and pray for God's forgiveness; God is All-forgiving, All-compassionate.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: فَٱطَّلَعَ فَرَءَاهُ فِي سَوَآءِ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
Verse: فاطلع فرءاه في سواء الجحيم
Sahih_International: And he will look and see him in the midst of the Hellfire.
Pickthall: Then looketh he and seeth him in the depth of hell.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): He looked down and saw him in the midst of the Fire.
Shakir: Then he looked down and saw him in the midst of hell.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): He will look down and see him in hell.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): So he looked down and saw him in the midst of the Fire.
Arberry: Then he looks, and sees him in the midst of Hell.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: يَعۡلَمُ مَا بَيۡنَ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَمَا خَلۡفَهُمۡۚ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرۡجَعُ ٱلۡأُمُورُ
Verse: يعلم ما بين ايديهم وما خلفهم والى الله ترجع الامور
Sahih_International: He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them. And to Allah will be returned [all] matters.
Pickthall: He knoweth all that is before them and all that is behind them, and unto Allah all things are returned. $$A
Yusuf_Ali (YA): He knows what is before them and what is behind them: and to Allah go back all questions (for decision).
Shakir: He knows what is before them and what is behind them and to Allah are all affairs turned back.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): God knows all that they have and all that is behind them, and to Him do all things return.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): He knows what is before them, and what is behind them. And to Allah return all matters (for decision).
Arberry: He knows whatsoever is before them and behind them, and unto God all matters are returned.'
Label: fear

Verse_diac: فَـَٔامِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَٱلنُّورِ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنزَلۡنَاۚ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعۡمَلُونَ خَبِيرٞ
Verse: فامنوا بالله ورسوله والنور الذي انزلنا والله بما تعملون خبير
Sahih_International: So believe in Allah and His Messenger and the Qur'an which We have sent down. And Allah is Acquainted with what you do.
Pickthall: So believe in Allah and His messenger and the light which We have revealed. And Allah is Informed of what ye do.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Believe, therefore, in Allah and His Messenger, and in the Light which we have sent down. And Allah is well acquainted with all that ye do.
Shakir: Therefore believe in Allah and His Messenger and the Light which We have revealed; and Allah is Aware of what you do.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Thus, have faith in God, His Messenger and the Light which We have revealed. God is Well-Aware of what you do.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Therefore, believe in Allah and His Messenger (Muhammad SAW), and in the Light (this Quran) which We have sent down. And Allah is All-Aware of what you do.
Arberry: Therefore believe in God and His Messenger, and in the Light which We have sent down. And God is aware of the things you do.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَأَذِنَتۡ لِرَبِّهَا وَحُقَّتۡ
Verse: واذنت لربها وحقت
Sahih_International: And has responded to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]
Pickthall: And attentive to her Lord in fear,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And hearkens to (the Command of) its Lord, and it must needs (do so);-
Shakir: And obeys its Lord and it must.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): in obedience to the commands of their Lord which are incumbent on them,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And listens and obeys its Lord, and it must do so;
Arberry: and gives ear to its Lord, and is fitly disposed;
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَإِذَا ٱلۡجَحِيمُ سُعِّرَتۡ
Verse: واذا الجحيم سعرت
Sahih_International: And when Hellfire is set ablaze
Pickthall: And when hell is lighted,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): When the Blazing Fire is kindled to fierce heat;
Shakir: And when the hell is kindled up,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): hell is made to blaze,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And when Hell-fire shall be kindled to fierce ablaze.
Arberry: when Hell shall be set blazing,
Label: fear

Verse_diac: قَالَ تَٱللَّهِ إِن كِدتَّ لَتُرۡدِينِ
Verse: قال تالله ان كدت لتردين
Sahih_International: He will say, "By Allah , you almost ruined me.
Pickthall: He saith: By Allah, thou verily didst all but cause my ruin,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): He said: "By Allah! thou wast little short of bringing me to perdition!
Shakir: He shall say: By Allah! you had almost caused me to perish;
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): He will say to his friend in hell, "By God, you almost destroyed me.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): He said: "By Allah! You have nearly ruined me.
Arberry: He says, 'By God, wellnigh thou didst destroy me;
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: فَشَٰرِبُونَ شُرۡبَ ٱلۡهِيمِ
Verse: فشٰربون شرب الهيم
Sahih_International: And will drink as the drinking of thirsty camels.
Pickthall: Drinking even as the camel drinketh.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "Indeed ye shall drink like diseased camels raging with thirst!"
Shakir: And drink as drinks the thirsty camel.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): like a thirsty camel".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "So you will drink (that) like thirsty camels!"
Arberry: lapping it down like thirsty camels.'
Label: anger

Verse_diac: وَظِلّٖ مَّمۡدُودٖ
Verse: وظل ممدود
Sahih_International: And shade extended
Pickthall: And spreading shade,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): In shade long-extended,
Shakir: And extended shade,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): with fruits piled up one on the other,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): In shade long-extended,
Arberry: and spreading shade
Label: joy

Verse_diac: قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَأۡتِيكُم بِهِ ٱللَّهُ إِن شَآءَ وَمَآ أَنتُم بِمُعۡجِزِينَ
Verse: قال انما ياتيكم به الله ان شاء وما انتم بمعجزين
Sahih_International: He said, " Allah will only bring it to you if He wills, and you will not cause [Him] failure.
Pickthall: He said: Only Allah will bring it upon you if He will, and ye can by no means escape.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): He said: "Truly, Allah will bring it on you if He wills,- and then, ye will not be able to frustrate it!
Shakir: He said: Allah only will bring it to you if He please, and you will not escape:
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): (Noah) replied, "God will bring torment down on you whenever He wants and you will not be able to make His (plans) fail.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): He said: "Only Allah will bring it (the punishment) on you, if He will, and then you will escape not.
Arberry: He said, 'God will bring you it if He will; you cannot frustrate Him.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: لَّا تَجۡعَلۡ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَتَقۡعُدَ مَذۡمُومٗا مَّخۡذُولٗا
Verse: لا تجعل مع الله الٰها ءاخر فتقعد مذموما مخذولا
Sahih_International: Do not make [as equal] with Allah another deity and [thereby] become censured and forsaken.
Pickthall: Set not up with Allah any other god (O man) lest thou sit down reproved, forsaken.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Take not with Allah another object of worship; or thou (O man!) wilt sit in disgrace and destitution.
Shakir: Do not associate with Allah any other god, lest you sit down despised, neglected.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Do not consider anything equal to God lest you will become despised and neglected.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Set not up with Allah any other ilah (god), (O man)! (This verse is addressed to Prophet Muhammad SAW , but its implication is general to all mankind), or you will sit down reproved, forsaken (in the Hell-fire).
Arberry: Set not up with God another god, or thou wilt sit condemned and forsaken.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: فَيَوۡمَئِذٖ لَّا يَنفَعُ ٱلَّذِينَ ظَلَمُواْ مَعۡذِرَتُهُمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يُسۡتَعۡتَبُونَ
Verse: فيومئذ لا ينفع الذين ظلموا معذرتهم ولا هم يستعتبون
Sahih_International: So that Day, their excuse will not benefit those who wronged, nor will they be asked to appease [Allah].
Pickthall: In that day their excuses will not profit those who did injustice, nor will they be allowed to make amends.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): So on that Day no excuse of theirs will avail the transgressors, nor will they be invited (then) to seek grace (by repentance).
Shakir: But on that day their excuse shall not profit those who were unjust, nor shall they be regarded with goodwill.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): The excuses of the unjust on this day will be of no avail to them and they will not be able to please God.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): So on that Day no excuse of theirs will avail those who did wrong (by associating partners in worship with Allah, and by denying the Day of Resurrection), nor will they be allowed (then) to return to seek Allah's Pleasure (by having Islamic Faith with righteous deeds and by giving up polytheism, sins and crimes with repentance).
Arberry: So that day their excuses will not profit the evildoers, nor will they be suffered to make amends.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: ٱلَّذِي خَلَقَ ٱلۡمَوۡتَ وَٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ لِيَبۡلُوَكُمۡ أَيُّكُمۡ أَحۡسَنُ عَمَلٗاۚ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡغَفُورُ
Verse: الذي خلق الموت والحيوٰة ليبلوكم ايكم احسن عملا وهو العزيز الغفور
Sahih_International: [He] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might, the Forgiving -
Pickthall: Who hath created life and death that He may try you which of you is best in conduct; and He is the Mighty, the Forgiving,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): He Who created Death and Life, that He may try which of you is best in deed: and He is the Exalted in Might, Oft-Forgiving;-
Shakir: Who created death and life that He may try you-- which of you is best in deeds; and He is the Mighty, the Forgiving,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): It is He who has created death and life to put you to the test and see which of you is most virtuous in your deeds. He is Majestic and All-forgiving.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Who has created death and life, that He may test you which of you is best in deed. And He is the All-Mighty, the Oft-Forgiving;
Arberry: who created death and life, that He might try you which of you is fairest in works; and He is the All-mighty, the All-forgiving --
Label: fear

Verse_diac: تَنزِيلَ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ
Verse: تنزيل العزيز الرحيم
Sahih_International: [This is] a revelation of the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,
Pickthall: A revelation of the Mighty, the Merciful,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): It is a Revelation sent down by (Him), the Exalted in Might, Most Merciful.
Shakir: A revelation of the Mighty, the Merciful.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): This is a revelation sent down from the Majestic and All-merciful
Mohsin_Khan (MK): (This is) a Revelation sent down by the All­Mighty, the Most Merciful,
Arberry: the sending down of the All-mighty, the All-wise,
Label: joy

Verse_diac: ثُمَّ لَتُسۡـَٔلُنَّ يَوۡمَئِذٍ عَنِ ٱلنَّعِيمِ
Verse: ثم لتسلن يومئذ عن النعيم
Sahih_International: Then you will surely be asked that Day about pleasure.
Pickthall: Then, on that day, ye will be asked concerning pleasure.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Then, shall ye be questioned that Day about the joy (ye indulged in!).
Shakir: Then on that day you shall most certainly be questioned about the boons.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Then, on that day, you will be questioned about the bounties (of God).
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Then, on that Day, you shall be asked about the delight (you indulged in, in this world)!
Arberry: then you shall be questioned that day concerning true bliss.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: مَنۡ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحٗا فَلِنَفۡسِهِۦۖ وَمَنۡ أَسَآءَ فَعَلَيۡهَاۖ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمۡ تُرۡجَعُونَ
Verse: من عمل صٰلحا فلنفسه ومن اساء فعليها ثم الىٰ ربكم ترجعون
Sahih_International: Whoever does a good deed - it is for himself; and whoever does evil - it is against the self. Then to your Lord you will be returned.
Pickthall: Whoso doeth right, it is for his soul, and whoso doeth wrong, it is against it. And afterward unto your Lord ye will be brought back.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): If any one does a righteous deed, it ensures to the benefit of his own soul; if he does evil, it works against (his own soul). In the end will ye (all) be brought back to your Lord.
Shakir: Whoever does good, it is for his own soul, and whoever does evil, it is against himself; then you shall be brought back to your-- Lord.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): One who acts righteously does so for his own benefit and one who commits evil does so against his own soul. To your Lord you will all return.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Whosoever does a good deed, it is for his ownself, and whosoever does evil, it is against (his ownself). Then to your Lord you will be made to return.
Arberry: Whoso does righteousness, it is to his own gain, and whoso does evil, it is to his own loss; then to your Lord you shall be returned.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: فَمَهِّلِ ٱلۡكَٰفِرِينَ أَمۡهِلۡهُمۡ رُوَيۡدَۢا
Verse: فمهل الكٰفرين امهلهم رويدا
Sahih_International: So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile.
Pickthall: So give a respite to the disbelievers. Deal thou gently with them for a while.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Therefore grant a delay to the Unbelievers: Give respite to them gently (for awhile).
Shakir: So grant the unbelievers a respite: let them alone for a
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Give respite to the disbelievers and leave them alone for a while.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): So give a respite to the disbelievers. Deal you gently with them for a while.
Arberry: So respite the unbelievers; delay with them awhile.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: فَأَمَّا مَنۡ أُوتِيَ كِتَٰبَهُۥ بِيَمِينِهِۦ فَيَقُولُ هَآؤُمُ ٱقۡرَءُواْ كِتَٰبِيَهۡ
Verse: فاما من اوتي كتٰبه بيمينه فيقول هاؤم اقرءوا كتٰبيه
Sahih_International: So as for he who is given his record in his right hand, he will say, "Here, read my record!
Pickthall: Then, as for him who is given his record in his right hand, he will say: Take, read my book!
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Then he that will be given his Record in his right hand will say: "Ah here! Read ye my Record!
Shakir: Then as for him who is given his book in his right hand, he will say: Lo! read my book:
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Those who will receive the books of the records of their deeds in their right hands will say, "Come and read my record.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Then as for him who will be given his Record in his right hand will say: "Take, read my Record!
Arberry: Then as for him who is given his book in his right hand, he shall say, 'Here, take and read my book!
Label: joy

Verse_diac: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُؤۡذُونَ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ لَعَنَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ وَأَعَدَّ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٗا مُّهِينٗا
Verse: ان الذين يؤذون الله ورسوله لعنهم الله في الدنيا والاخرة واعد لهم عذابا مهينا
Sahih_International: Indeed, those who abuse Allah and His Messenger - Allah has cursed them in this world and the Hereafter and prepared for them a humiliating punishment.
Pickthall: Lo! those who malign Allah and His messenger, Allah hath cursed them in the world and the Hereafter, and hath prepared for them the doom of the disdained.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Those who annoy Allah and His Messenger - Allah has cursed them in this World and in the Hereafter, and has prepared for them a humiliating Punishment.
Shakir: Surely (as for) those who speak evil things of Allah and His Messenger, Allah has cursed them in this world and the here after, and He has prepared for them a chastisement bringing disgrace.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Those who annoy God and His Messenger will be condemned by God in this life and in the life to come. He has prepared for them a humiliating torment.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Verily, those who annoy Allah and His Messenger (SAW) Allah has cursed them in this world, and in the Hereafter, and has prepared for them a humiliating torment.
Arberry: Those who hurt God and His Messenger -- them God has cursed in the present world and the world to come, and has prepared for them a humbling chastisement.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: وَلَيَعۡلَمَنَّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَلَيَعۡلَمَنَّ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقِينَ
Verse: وليعلمن الله الذين ءامنوا وليعلمن المنٰفقين
Sahih_International: And Allah will surely make evident those who believe, and He will surely make evident the hypocrites.
Pickthall: Verily Allah knoweth those who believe, and verily He knoweth the hypocrites.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And Allah most certainly knows those who believe, and as certainly those who are Hypocrites.
Shakir: And most certainly Allah will know those who believe and most certainly He will know the hypocrites.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): God certainly knows all about the believers and the hypocrites.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Verily, Allah knows those who believe, and verily, He knows the hypocrites [i.e. Allah will test the people with good and hard days to discriminate the good from the wicked (although Allah knows all that before putting them to test)].
Arberry: God surely knows the believers, and He knows the hypocrites.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: فِيهِمَا عَيۡنَانِ نَضَّاخَتَانِ
Verse: فيهما عينان نضاختان
Sahih_International: In both of them are two springs, spouting.
Pickthall: Wherein are two abundant springs.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): In them (each) will be two Springs pouring forth water in continuous abundance:
Shakir: In both of them are two springs gushing forth.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): In these there will also be two springs gushing forth.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): In them (both) will be two springs gushing forth water.
Arberry: therein two fountains of gushing water --
Label: joy

Verse_diac: أُبَلِّغُكُمۡ رِسَٰلَٰتِ رَبِّي وَأَنَا۠ لَكُمۡ نَاصِحٌ أَمِينٌ
Verse: ابلغكم رسٰلٰت ربي وانا لكم ناصح امين
Sahih_International: I convey to you the messages of my Lord, and I am to you a trustworthy adviser.
Pickthall: I convey unto you the messages of my Lord and am for you a true adviser.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "I but fulfil towards you the duties of my Lord's mission: I am to you a sincere and trustworthy adviser.
Shakir: I deliver to you the messages of my Lord and I am a faithful adviser to you:
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): I preach the message of my Lord to you and am a trustworthy advisor for you.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "I convey unto you the Messages of my Lord, and I am a trustworthy adviser (or well­wisher) for you.
Arberry: I deliver to you the Messages of my Lord; I am your adviser sincere, faithful.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: إِلَّآ إِبۡلِيسَ أَبَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّٰجِدِينَ
Verse: الا ابليس ابىٰ ان يكون مع السٰجدين
Sahih_International: Except Iblees, he refused to be with those who prostrated.
Pickthall: Save Iblis. He refused to be among the prostrate.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Not so Iblis: he refused to be among those who prostrated themselves.
Shakir: But Iblis (did it not); he refused to be with those who made obeisance.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): except Iblis who refused to join with the others in prostration.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Except Iblis (Satan), - he refused to be among the prostrators.
Arberry: save Iblis; he refused to be among those bowing.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: وَكُلّٗا نَّقُصُّ عَلَيۡكَ مِنۡ أَنۢبَآءِ ٱلرُّسُلِ مَا نُثَبِّتُ بِهِۦ فُؤَادَكَۚ وَجَآءَكَ فِي هَٰذِهِ ٱلۡحَقُّ وَمَوۡعِظَةٞ وَذِكۡرَىٰ لِلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
Verse: وكلا نقص عليك من انباء الرسل ما نثبت به فؤادك وجاءك في هٰذه الحق وموعظة وذكرىٰ للمؤمنين
Sahih_International: And each [story] We relate to you from the news of the messengers is that by which We make firm your heart. And there has come to you, in this, the truth and an instruction and a reminder for the believers.
Pickthall: And all that We relate unto thee of the story of the messengers is in order that thereby We may make firm thy heart. And herein hath come unto thee the Truth and an exhortation and a reminder for believers.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): All that we relate to thee of the stories of the messengers,- with it We make firm thy heart: in them there cometh to thee the Truth, as well as an exhortation and a message of remembrance to those who believe.
Shakir: And all we relate to you of the accounts of the messengers is to strengthen your heart therewith; and in this has come to you the truth and an admonition, and a reminder to the believers.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): (Muhammad), We tell you all the stories of the Messengers which will strengthen your heart. In the Quran We have revealed the Truth to you with good advice and reminders for the faithful ones.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And all that We relate to you (O Muhammad SAW) of the news of the Messengers is in order that We may make strong and firm your heart thereby. And in this (chapter of the Quran) has come to you the truth, as well as an admonition and a reminder for the believers.
Arberry: And all that We relate to thee of the tidings of the Messengers is that whereby We strengthen thy heart; in these there has come to thee the truth and an admonition, and a reminder to the believers.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَٱعۡبُدۡ رَبَّكَ حَتَّىٰ يَأۡتِيَكَ ٱلۡيَقِينُ
Verse: واعبد ربك حتىٰ ياتيك اليقين
Sahih_International: And worship your Lord until there comes to you the certainty (death).
Pickthall: And serve thy Lord till the Inevitable cometh unto thee.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And serve thy Lord until there come unto thee the Hour that is Certain.
Shakir: And serve your Lord until there comes to you that which is certain.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Worship your Lord until you achieve the ultimate certainty.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And worship your Lord until there comes unto you the certainty (i.e. death).
Arberry: and serve thy Lord, until the Certain comes to thee.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: وَجَحَدُواْ بِهَا وَٱسۡتَيۡقَنَتۡهَآ أَنفُسُهُمۡ ظُلۡمٗا وَعُلُوّٗاۚ فَٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلۡمُفۡسِدِينَ
Verse: وجحدوا بها واستيقنتها انفسهم ظلما وعلوا فانظر كيف كان عٰقبة المفسدين
Sahih_International: And they rejected them, while their [inner] selves were convinced thereof, out of injustice and haughtiness. So see how was the end of the corrupters.
Pickthall: And they denied them, though their souls acknowledged them, for spite and arrogance. Then see the nature of the consequence for the wrong-doers!
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And they rejected those Signs in iniquity and arrogance, though their souls were convinced thereof: so see what was the end of those who acted corruptly!
Shakir: And they denied them unjustly and proudly while their soul had been convinced of them; consider, then how was the end of the mischief-makers.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): They rejected the evidence because of their arrogance and injustice, although their souls knew it to be true. Think how terrible the end of the sinful ones was!
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And they belied them (those Ayat) wrongfully and arrogantly, though their ownselves were convinced thereof [i.e. those (Ayat) are from Allah, and Musa (Moses) is the Messenger of Allah in truth, but they disliked to obey Musa (Moses), and hated to believe in his Message of Monotheism]. So see what was the end of the Mufsidun (disbelievers, disobedient to Allah, evil-doers, liars.).
Arberry: and they denied them, though their souls acknowledged them, wrongfully and out of pride. Behold, how was the end of the workers of corruption!
Label: anger

Verse_diac: وَلَسَوۡفَ يَرۡضَىٰ
Verse: ولسوف يرضىٰ
Sahih_International: And he is going to be satisfied.
Pickthall: He verily will be content.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And soon will they attain (complete) satisfaction.
Shakir: And he shall soon be well-pleased.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): and the reward (of their Lord) will certainly make them happy.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): He surely will be pleased (when he will enter Paradise).
Arberry: and he shall surely be satisfied.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَٱلۡتَفَّتِ ٱلسَّاقُ بِٱلسَّاقِ
Verse: والتفت الساق بالساق
Sahih_International: And the leg is wound about the leg,
Pickthall: And agony is heaped on agony;
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And one leg will be joined with another:
Shakir: And affliction is combined with affliction;
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): When legs are twisted around each other,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And leg will be joined with another leg (shrouded)
Arberry: and leg is intertwined with leg,
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَكَذَّبُواْ وَٱتَّبَعُوٓاْ أَهۡوَآءَهُمۡۚ وَكُلُّ أَمۡرٖ مُّسۡتَقِرّٞ
Verse: وكذبوا واتبعوا اهواءهم وكل امر مستقر
Sahih_International: And they denied and followed their inclinations. But for every matter is a [time of] settlement.
Pickthall: They denied (the Truth) and followed their own lusts. Yet everything will come to a decision
Yusuf_Ali (YA): They reject (the warning) and follow their (own) lusts but every matter has its appointed time.
Shakir: And they call (it) a lie, and follow their low desires; and every affair has its appointed term.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): They have rejected it and have followed their own desires, but all matters will be settled (by God).
Mohsin_Khan (MK): They belied (the Verses of Allah, this Quran), and followed their own lusts. And every matter will be settled [according to the kind of deeds (for the doer of good deeds, his deeds will take him to Paradise, and similarly evil deeds will take their doers to Hell)].
Arberry: They have cried lies, and followed their caprices; but every matter is settled.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: فَلَا تَعۡلَمُ نَفۡسٞ مَّآ أُخۡفِيَ لَهُم مِّن قُرَّةِ أَعۡيُنٖ جَزَآءَۢ بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
Verse: فلا تعلم نفس ما اخفي لهم من قرة اعين جزاء بما كانوا يعملون
Sahih_International: And no soul knows what has been hidden for them of comfort for eyes as reward for what they used to do.
Pickthall: No soul knoweth what is kept hid for them of joy, as a reward for what they used to do.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Now no person knows what delights of the eye are kept hidden (in reserve) for them - as a reward for their (good) deeds.
Shakir: So no soul knows what is hidden for them of that which will refresh the eyes; a reward for what they did.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): No soul knows what delight awaits them as the reward for their deeds.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): No person knows what is kept hidden for them of joy as a reward for what they used to do.
Arberry: No soul knows what comfort is laid up for them secretly, as a recompense for that they were doing.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: ۞وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيۡهِمۡ غِلۡمَانٞ لَّهُمۡ كَأَنَّهُمۡ لُؤۡلُؤٞ مَّكۡنُونٞ
Verse: ويطوف عليهم غلمان لهم كانهم لؤلؤ مكنون
Sahih_International: There will circulate among them [servant] boys [especially] for them, as if they were pearls well-protected.
Pickthall: And there go round, waiting on them menservants of their own, as they were hidden pearls.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Round about them will serve, (devoted) to them, young male servants (handsome) as Pearls well-guarded.
Shakir: And round them shall go boys of theirs as if they were hidden pearls.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): They will be served by youths who will be as beautiful as pearls.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And there will go round boy-servants of theirs, to serve them as if they were preserved pearls.
Arberry: and there go round them youths, their own, as if they were hidden pearls.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: قُلُوبٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ وَاجِفَةٌ
Verse: قلوب يومئذ واجفة
Sahih_International: Hearts, that Day, will tremble,
Pickthall: On that day hearts beat painfully
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Hearts that Day will be in agitation;
Shakir: Hearts on that day shall palpitate,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): hearts will undergo terrible trembling,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): (Some) hearts that Day will shake with fear and anxiety.
Arberry: hearts upon that day shall be athrob
Label: fear

Verse_diac: أَمۡ حَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٌ أَن لَّن يُخۡرِجَ ٱللَّهُ أَضۡغَٰنَهُمۡ
Verse: ام حسب الذين في قلوبهم مرض ان لن يخرج الله اضغٰنهم
Sahih_International: Or do those in whose hearts is disease think that Allah would never expose their [feelings of] hatred?
Pickthall: Or do those in whose hearts is a disease deem that Allah will not bring to light their (secret) hates?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Or do those in whose hearts is a disease, think that Allah will not bring to light all their rancour?
Shakir: Or do those in whose hearts is a disease think that Allah will not bring forth their spite?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Do those whose hearts are sick think that God will never make their malice public?
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Or do those in whose hearts is a disease (of hypocrisy), think that Allah will not bring to light all their hidden ill-wills?
Arberry: Or did those in whose hearts is sickness think that God would not bring to light their rancour?
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَأَقۡبَلَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖ يَتَسَآءَلُونَ
Verse: واقبل بعضهم علىٰ بعض يتساءلون
Sahih_International: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.
Pickthall: And some of them draw near unto others, questioning,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): They will advance to each other, engaging in mutual enquiry.
Shakir: And some of them shall advance towards others questioning each other.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): They will turn to one another ask questions,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And some of them draw near to others, questioning.
Arberry: They advance one upon another, asking each other questions.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَإِنَّهُۥ لَتَذۡكِرَةٞ لِّلۡمُتَّقِينَ
Verse: وانه لتذكرة للمتقين
Sahih_International: And indeed, the Qur'an is a reminder for the righteous.
Pickthall: And lo! it is a warrant unto those who ward off (evil).
Yusuf_Ali (YA): But verily this is a Message for the Allah-fearing.
Shakir: And most surely it is a reminder for those who guard (against evil).
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): The Quran is certainly a reminder for the pious ones.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And verily, this Quran is a Reminder for the Muttaqun (pious - see V.2:2).
Arberry: Surely it is a Reminder to the godfearing;
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَلَوۡ تَرَىٰٓ إِذۡ فَزِعُواْ فَلَا فَوۡتَ وَأُخِذُواْ مِن مَّكَانٖ قَرِيبٖ
Verse: ولو ترىٰ اذ فزعوا فلا فوت واخذوا من مكان قريب
Sahih_International: And if you could see when they are terrified but there is no escape, and they will be seized from a place nearby.
Pickthall: Couldst thou but see when they are terrified with no escape, and are seized from near at hand,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): If thou couldst but see when they will quake with terror; but then there will be no escape (for them), and they will be seized from a position (quite) near.
Shakir: And could you see when they shall become terrified, but (then) there shall be no escape and they shall be seized upon from a near place
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Would that you could see how the unbelievers will be terrified by death from which they cannot escape. They will be seized from a nearby place
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And if you could but see, when they will be terrified with no escape (for them), and they will be seized from a near place.
Arberry: Ah, if thou couldst see when they are terrified, and there is no escape, and they are seized from a place near at hand,
Label: fear

Verse_diac: بَلۡ كَذَّبُواْ بِٱلسَّاعَةِۖ وَأَعۡتَدۡنَا لِمَن كَذَّبَ بِٱلسَّاعَةِ سَعِيرًا
Verse: بل كذبوا بالساعة واعتدنا لمن كذب بالساعة سعيرا
Sahih_International: But they have denied the Hour, and We have prepared for those who deny the Hour a Blaze.
Pickthall: Nay, but they deny (the coming of) the Hour, and for those who deny (the coming of) the Hour We have prepared a flame.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Nay they deny the hour (of the judgment to come): but We have prepared a blazing fire for such as deny the hour:
Shakir: But they reject the hour, and We have prepared a burning fire for him who rejects the hour.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): They deny the Hour of Doom so We have prepared for them a burning fire.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Nay, they deny the Hour (the Day of Resurrection), and for those who deny the Hour, We have prepared a flaming Fire (i.e. Hell).
Arberry: Nay, but they cry lies to the Hour; and We have prepared for him who cries lies to the Hour a Blaze.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: لَّا ظَلِيلٖ وَلَا يُغۡنِي مِنَ ٱللَّهَبِ
Verse: لا ظليل ولا يغني من اللهب
Sahih_International: [But having] no cool shade and availing not against the flame."
Pickthall: (Which yet is) no relief nor shelter from the flame.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "(Which yields) no shade of coolness, and is of no use against the fierce Blaze.
Shakir: Neither having the coolness of the shade nor availing against the flame.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): which neither gives shade nor protects one from the flames.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "Neither shading, nor of any use against the fierce flame of the Fire."
Arberry: unshading against the blazing flame
Label: fear

Verse_diac: فَتَوَلَّوۡاْ عَنۡهُ مُدۡبِرِينَ
Verse: فتولوا عنه مدبرين
Sahih_International: So they turned away from him, departing.
Pickthall: And they turned their backs and went away from him.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): So they turned away from him, and departed.
Shakir: So they went away from him, turning back.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): All the people turned away from him
Mohsin_Khan (MK): So they turned away from him, and departed (for fear of the disease).
Arberry: But they went away from him, turning their backs.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: ٱقۡتَرَبَتِ ٱلسَّاعَةُ وَٱنشَقَّ ٱلۡقَمَرُ
Verse: اقتربت الساعة وانشق القمر
Sahih_International: The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two].
Pickthall: The hour drew nigh and the moon was rent in twain.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): The Hour (of Judgment) is nigh, and the moon is cleft asunder.
Shakir: The hour drew nigh and the moon did rend asunder.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): The Hour of Doom is drawing near and the moon is rent asunder.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): The Hour has drawn near, and the moon has been cleft asunder (the people of Makkah requested Prophet Muhammad SAW to show them a miracle, so he showed them the splitting of the moon).
Arberry: The Hour has drawn nigh: the moon is split.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: فَأَوۡجَسَ مِنۡهُمۡ خِيفَةٗۖ قَالُواْ لَا تَخَفۡۖ وَبَشَّرُوهُ بِغُلَٰمٍ عَلِيمٖ
Verse: فاوجس منهم خيفة قالوا لا تخف وبشروه بغلٰم عليم
Sahih_International: And he felt from them apprehension. They said, "Fear not," and gave him good tidings of a learned boy.
Pickthall: Then he conceived a fear of them. They said: Fear not! and gave him tidings of (the birth of) a wise son.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): (When they did not eat), He conceived a fear of them. They said, "Fear not," and they gave him glad tidings of a son endowed with knowledge.
Shakir: So he conceived in his mind a fear on account of them. They said: Fear not. And they gave him the good news of a boy possessing knowledge.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): He began to feel afraid. They said, "Do not be afraid," and then gave him the glad news of the birth of a knowledgeable son.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Then he conceived a fear of them (when they ate not). They said: "Fear not." And they gave him glad tidings of an intelligent son, having knowledge (about Allah and His religion of True Monotheism).
Arberry: Then he conceived a fear of them. They said, 'Be not afraid!' And they gave him good tidings of a cunning boy.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَمَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٍۖ إِنۡ أَجۡرِيَ إِلَّا عَلَىٰ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
Verse: وما اسلكم عليه من اجر ان اجري الا علىٰ رب العٰلمين
Sahih_International: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
Pickthall: And I ask of you no wage therefor; my wage is the concern only of the Lord of the Worlds.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "No reward do I ask of you for it: my reward is only from the Lord of the Worlds:
Shakir: And I do not ask you any reward for it; my reward is only with the Lord of the worlds:
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): I ask no payment from you for my preaching. The Lord of the Universe will give me my reward.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "No reward do I ask of you for it (my Message of Islamic Monotheism), my reward is only from the Lord of the 'Alamin (mankind, jinns and all that exists).
Arberry: I ask of you no wage for this; my wage falls only upon the Lord of all Being;
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِن سُلَٰلَةٖ مِّن طِينٖ
Verse: ولقد خلقنا الانسٰن من سلٰلة من طين
Sahih_International: And certainly did We create man from an extract of clay.
Pickthall: Verily We created man from a product of wet earth;
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Man We did create from a quintessence (of clay);
Shakir: And certainly We created man of an extract of clay,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We have created the human being from an extract of clay
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And indeed We created man (Adam) out of an extract of clay (water and earth).
Arberry: We created man of an extraction of clay,
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَٱلَّذِينَ يَبِيتُونَ لِرَبِّهِمۡ سُجَّدٗا وَقِيَٰمٗا
Verse: والذين يبيتون لربهم سجدا وقيٰما
Sahih_International: And those who spend [part of] the night to their Lord prostrating and standing [in prayer]
Pickthall: And who spend the night before their Lord, prostrate and standing,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Those who spend the night in adoration of their Lord prostrate and standing;
Shakir: And they who pass the night prostrating themselves before their Lord and standing.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): They are those who spend the night worshipping their Lord, prostrating, and standing,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And those who spend the night before their Lord, prostrate and standing.
Arberry: who pass the night prostrate to their Lord and standing;
Label: joy

Verse_diac: مَا جَعَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِنۢ بَحِيرَةٖ وَلَا سَآئِبَةٖ وَلَا وَصِيلَةٖ وَلَا حَامٖ وَلَٰكِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ يَفۡتَرُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡكَذِبَۖ وَأَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡقِلُونَ
Verse: ما جعل الله من بحيرة ولا سائبة ولا وصيلة ولا حام ولٰكن الذين كفروا يفترون على الله الكذب واكثرهم لا يعقلون
Sahih_International: Allah has not appointed [such innovations as] bahirah or sa'ibah or wasilah or Ham. But those who disbelieve invent falsehood about Allah , and most of them do not reason.
Pickthall: Allah hath not appointed anything in the nature of a Bahirah or a Sa'ibah or a Wasilah or a Hami, but those who disbelieve invent a lie against Allah. Most of them have no sense.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): It was not Allah who instituted (superstitions like those of) a slit-ear she-camel, or a she-camel let loose for free pasture, or idol sacrifices for twin-births in animals, or stallion-camels freed from work: It is blasphemers who invent a lie against Allah; but most of them lack wisdom.
Shakir: Allah has not ordained (the making of) a bahirah or a saibah or a wasilah or a hami but those who disbelieve fabricate a lie against Allah, and most of them do not understand.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): God has not instituted the rites of Bahirah, Sa'ibah, Wasilah, nor of Hami (names of certain animals that the pagans would offer as sacrifice). It is the pagans who have attributed falsehood to God. Many of them have no understanding.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Allah has not instituted things like Bahirah (a she­camel whose milk was spared for the idols and nobody was allowed to milk it) or a Sa'ibah (a she­camel let loose for free pasture for their false gods, e.g. idols, etc., and nothing was allowed to be carried on it), or a Wasilah (a she­camel set free for idols because it has given birth to a she­camel at its first delivery and then again gives birth to a she­camel at its second delivery) or a Ham (a stallion­camel freed from work for their idols, after it had finished a number of copulations assigned for it, all these animals were liberated in honour of idols as practised by pagan Arabs in the pre­Islamic period). But those who disbelieve invent lies against Allah, and most of them have no understanding.
Arberry: God has not appointed cattle dedicated to idols, such as Bahira, Sa'iba, Wasila, Hami; but the unbelievers forge against God falsehood, and most of them have no understanding.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: فَأۡتُواْ بِكِتَٰبِكُمۡ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
Verse: فاتوا بكتٰبكم ان كنتم صٰدقين
Sahih_International: Then produce your scripture, if you should be truthful.
Pickthall: Then produce your writ, if ye are truthful.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Then bring ye your Book (of authority) if ye be truthful!
Shakir: Then bring your book, if you are truthful.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Bring your book if what you say is true.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Then bring your Book if you are truthful!
Arberry: Bring your Book, if you speak truly!
Label: anger

Verse_diac: فَأَخَذۡنَٰهُ وَجُنُودَهُۥ فَنَبَذۡنَٰهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡيَمِّ وَهُوَ مُلِيمٞ
Verse: فاخذنٰه وجنوده فنبذنٰهم في اليم وهو مليم
Sahih_International: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy.
Pickthall: So We seized him and his hosts and flung them in the sea, for he was reprobate.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): So We took him and his forces, and threw them into the sea; and his was the blame.
Shakir: So We seized him and his hosts and hurled them into the sea and he was blamable.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We seized him and his army and threw them into the sea. He himself was to be blamed.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): So We took him and his hosts, and dumped them into the sea, while he was to be blamed.
Arberry: So We seized him and his hosts, and We cast them into the sea, and he blameworthy.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: فَمَن يَعۡمَلۡ مِنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَهُوَ مُؤۡمِنٞ فَلَا كُفۡرَانَ لِسَعۡيِهِۦ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ كَٰتِبُونَ
Verse: فمن يعمل من الصٰلحٰت وهو مؤمن فلا كفران لسعيه وانا له كٰتبون
Sahih_International: So whoever does righteous deeds while he is a believer - no denial will there be for his effort, and indeed We, of it, are recorders.
Pickthall: Then whoso doeth some good works and is a believer, there will be no rejection of his effort. Lo! We record (it) for him.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Whoever works any act of righteousness and has faith,- His endeavour will not be rejected: We shall record it in his favour.
Shakir: Therefore whoever shall do of good deeds and he is a believer, there shall be no denying of his exertion, and surely We will write (It) down for him.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): The reward of the righteously striving believers will not be neglected. We are keeping the record of their good deeds.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): So whoever does righteous good deeds while he is a believer (in the Oneness of Allah Islamic Monotheism), his efforts will not be rejected. Verily! We record it in his Book of deeds.
Arberry: And whosoever does deeds of righteousness, being a believer, no unthankfulness shall befall his endeavour; We Ourselves write it down for him.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: فَإِذَا قَرَأۡتَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ فَٱسۡتَعِذۡ بِٱللَّهِ مِنَ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنِ ٱلرَّجِيمِ
Verse: فاذا قرات القرءان فاستعذ بالله من الشيطٰن الرجيم
Sahih_International: So when you recite the Qur'an, [first] seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the expelled [from His mercy].
Pickthall: And when thou recitest the Qur'an, seek refuge in Allah from Satan the outcast.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): When thou dost read the Qur'an, seek Allah's protection from Satan the rejected one.
Shakir: So when you recite the Quran, seek refuge with Allah from the accursed Shaitan,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): (Muhammad), when you recite the Quran, seek refuge in God from the mischief of satan.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): So when you want to recite the Quran, seek refuge with Allah from Shaitan (Satan), the outcast (the cursed one).
Arberry: When thou recitest the Koran, seek refuge in God from the accursed Satan;
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَٱلنَّٰزِعَٰتِ غَرۡقٗا
Verse: والنٰزعٰت غرقا
Sahih_International: By those [angels] who extract with violence
Pickthall: By those who drag forth to destruction,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): By the (angels) who tear out (the souls of the wicked) with violence;
Shakir: I swear by the angels who violently pull out the souls of the wicked,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): By the angels who violently tear-out the souls of the disbelievers from their bodies,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): By those (angels) who pull out (the souls of the disbelievers and the wicked) with great violence;
Arberry: By those that pluck out vehemently
Label: fear

Verse_diac: لِّيَجۡزِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُم مَّغۡفِرَةٞ وَرِزۡقٞ كَرِيمٞ
Verse: ليجزي الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصٰلحٰت اولٰئك لهم مغفرة ورزق كريم
Sahih_International: That He may reward those who believe and do righteous deeds. Those will have forgiveness and noble provision.
Pickthall: That He may reward those who believe and do good works. For them is pardon and a rich provision.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): That He may reward those who believe and work deeds of righteousness: for such is Forgiveness and a Sustenance Most Generous."
Shakir: That He may reward those who believe and do good; these it is for whom is forgiveness and an honorable sustenance.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): God will certainly reward the righteously striving believers. These are the ones who will receive forgiveness and honorable sustenance.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): That He may recompense those who believe (in the Oneness of Allah Islamic Monotheism) and do righteous good deeds. Those, theirs is forgiveness and Rizqun Karim (generous provision, i.e. Paradise).
Arberry: that He may recompense those who believe, and do righteous deeds; theirs shall be forgiveness and generous provision.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَهَدَيۡنَٰهُ ٱلنَّجۡدَيۡنِ
Verse: وهدينٰه النجدين
Sahih_International: And have shown him the two ways?
Pickthall: And guide him to the parting of the mountain ways?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And shown him the two highways?
Shakir: And pointed out to him the two conspicuous ways?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Have We not shown him the ways of good and evil?
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And shown him the two ways (good and evil)?
Arberry: and guided him on the two highways?
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَإِن كَذَّبُوكَ فَقُل لِّي عَمَلِي وَلَكُمۡ عَمَلُكُمۡۖ أَنتُم بَرِيٓـُٔونَ مِمَّآ أَعۡمَلُ وَأَنَا۠ بَرِيٓءٞ مِّمَّا تَعۡمَلُونَ
Verse: وان كذبوك فقل لي عملي ولكم عملكم انتم بريون مما اعمل وانا بريء مما تعملون
Sahih_International: And if they deny you, [O Muhammad], then say, "For me are my deeds, and for you are your deeds. You are disassociated from what I do, and I am disassociated from what you do."
Pickthall: And if they deny thee, say: Unto me my work, and unto you your work. Ye are innocent of what I do, and I am innocent of what ye do.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): If they charge thee with falsehood, say: "My work to me, and yours to you! ye are free from responsibility for what I do, and I for what ye do!"
Shakir: And if they call you a liar, say: My work is for me and your work for you; you are clear of what I do and I am clear of what you do.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): If they call you a liar, tell them, "Let each one of us follow his own way. You will not be responsible for what I do and I will not be responsible for what you do".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And if they belie you, say: "For me are my deeds and for you are your deeds! You are innocent of what I do, and I am innocent of what you do!"
Arberry: If they cry lies to thee, then do thou say: 'I have my work, and you have your work; you are quit of What I do, and I am quit of what you do.'
Label: anger

Verse_diac: وَٱلۡأَنۡعَٰمَ خَلَقَهَاۖ لَكُمۡ فِيهَا دِفۡءٞ وَمَنَٰفِعُ وَمِنۡهَا تَأۡكُلُونَ
Verse: والانعٰم خلقها لكم فيها دفء ومنٰفع ومنها تاكلون
Sahih_International: And the grazing livestock He has created for you; in them is warmth and [numerous] benefits, and from them you eat.
Pickthall: And the cattle hath He created, whence ye have warm clothing and uses, and whereof ye eat;
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And cattle He has created for you (men): from them ye derive warmth, and numerous benefits, and of their (meat) ye eat.
Shakir: And He created the cattle for you; you have in them warm clothing and (many) advantages, and of them do you eat.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): He created cattle which provide you with clothes, food, and other benefits.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And the cattle, He has created them for you; in them there is warmth (warm clothing), and numerous benefits, and of them you eat.
Arberry: And the cattle -- He created them for you; in them is warmth, and uses various, and of them you eat,
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَلَقَدِ ٱسۡتُهۡزِئَ بِرُسُلٖ مِّن قَبۡلِكَ فَأَمۡلَيۡتُ لِلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ ثُمَّ أَخَذۡتُهُمۡۖ فَكَيۡفَ كَانَ عِقَابِ
Verse: ولقد استهزئ برسل من قبلك فامليت للذين كفروا ثم اخذتهم فكيف كان عقاب
Sahih_International: And already were [other] messengers ridiculed before you, and I extended the time of those who disbelieved; then I seized them, and how [terrible] was My penalty.
Pickthall: And verily messengers (of Allah) were mocked before thee, but long I bore with those who disbelieved. At length I seized them, and how (awful) was My punishment!
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Mocked were (many) messengers before thee: but I granted respite to the unbelievers, and finally I punished them: Then how (terrible) was my requital!
Shakir: And messengers before you were certainly mocked at, but I gave respite to those who disbelieved, then I destroyed them; how then was My requital (of evil)?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): (Muhammad), people have mocked the Messengers who lived before you. I gave a respite to the unbelievers (so that they would repent, but they did not). Then I struck them with a terrible retribution.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And indeed (many) Messengers were mocked at before you (O Muhammad SAW), but I granted respite to those who disbelieved, and finally I punished them. Then how (terrible) was My Punishment!
Arberry: Messengers indeed were scoffed at before thee, and I respited the unbelievers; then I seized them -- and how was my retribution?
Label: anger

Verse_diac: لَّقَدۡ كَانَ لَكُمۡ فِي رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ أُسۡوَةٌ حَسَنَةٞ لِّمَن كَانَ يَرۡجُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلۡيَوۡمَ ٱلۡأٓخِرَ وَذَكَرَ ٱللَّهَ كَثِيرٗا
Verse: لقد كان لكم في رسول الله اسوة حسنة لمن كان يرجوا الله واليوم الاخر وذكر الله كثيرا
Sahih_International: There has certainly been for you in the Messenger of Allah an excellent pattern for anyone whose hope is in Allah and the Last Day and [who] remembers Allah often.
Pickthall: Verily in the messenger of Allah ye have a good example for him who looketh unto Allah and the Last Day, and remembereth Allah much.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Ye have indeed in the Messenger of Allah a beautiful pattern (of conduct) for any one whose hope is in Allah and the Final Day, and who engages much in the Praise of Allah.
Shakir: Certainly you have in the Messenger of Allah an excellent exemplar for him who hopes in Allah and the latter day and remembers Allah much.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): The Messenger of God is certainly a good example for those of you who have hope in God and in the Day of Judgment and who remember God very often.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Indeed in the Messenger of Allah (Muhammad SAW) you have a good example to follow for him who hopes in (the Meeting with) Allah and the Last Day and remembers Allah much.
Arberry: You have had a good example in God's Messenger for whosoever hopes for God and the Last Day, and remembers God oft.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: بَلِ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ عَلَىٰ نَفۡسِهِۦ بَصِيرَةٞ
Verse: بل الانسٰن علىٰ نفسه بصيرة
Sahih_International: Rather, man, against himself, will be a witness,
Pickthall: Oh, but man is a telling witness against himself,
