Arberry: And that which He has multiplied for you in the earth of diverse hues. Surely in that is a sign for a people who remember.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: ثُمَّ سَوَّىٰهُ وَنَفَخَ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِهِۦۖ وَجَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرَ وَٱلۡأَفۡـِٔدَةَۚ قَلِيلٗا مَّا تَشۡكُرُونَ
Verse: ثم سوىٰه ونفخ فيه من روحه وجعل لكم السمع والابصٰر والافدة قليلا ما تشكرون
Sahih_International: Then He proportioned him and breathed into him from His [created] soul and made for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful.
Pickthall: Then He fashioned him and breathed into him of His Spirit; and appointed for you hearing and sight and hearts. Small thanks give ye!
Yusuf_Ali (YA): But He fashioned him in due proportion, and breathed into him something of His spirit. And He gave you (the faculties of) hearing and sight and feeling (and understanding): little thanks do ye give!
Shakir: Then He made him complete and breathed into him of His spirit, and made for you the ears and the eyes and the hearts; little is it that you give thanks.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): then He gave it proper shape and blew His spirit in it. He made ears, eyes and hearts for you, but you give Him very little thanks.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Then He fashioned him in due proportion, and breathed into him the soul (created by Allah for that person), and He gave you hearing (ears), sight (eyes) and hearts. Little is the thanks you give!
Arberry: then He shaped him, and breathed His spirit in him. And He appointed for you hearing, and sight, and hearts; little thanks you show.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَنُدۡخِلَنَّهُمۡ فِي ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
Verse: والذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصٰلحٰت لندخلنهم في الصٰلحين
Sahih_International: And those who believe and do righteous deeds - We will surely admit them among the righteous [into Paradise].
Pickthall: And as for those who believe and do good works, We verily shall make them enter in among the righteous.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And those who believe and work righteous deeds,- them shall We admit to the company of the Righteous.
Shakir: And (as for) those who believe and do good, We will most surely cause them to enter among the good.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We shall admit the righteously striving believers into the company of the pious ones.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And for those who believe (in the Oneness of Allah and other items of Faith) and do righteous good deeds, surely, We shall make them enter in (the enterance of) the righteous (i.e. in Paradise).
Arberry: And those who believe, and do righteous deeds assuredly We shall admit them among the righteous.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: كَلَّا لَا وَزَرَ
Verse: كلا لا وزر
Sahih_International: No! There is no refuge.
Pickthall: Alas! No refuge!
Yusuf_Ali (YA): By no means! No place of safety!
Shakir: By no means! there shall be no place of refuge!
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Certainly not! There will be no place of refuge.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): No! There is no refuge!
Arberry: No indeed; not a refuge!
Label: fear

Verse_diac: فَرَدَدۡنَٰهُ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّهِۦ كَيۡ تَقَرَّ عَيۡنُهَا وَلَا تَحۡزَنَ وَلِتَعۡلَمَ أَنَّ وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقّٞ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
Verse: فرددنٰه الىٰ امه كي تقر عينها ولا تحزن ولتعلم ان وعد الله حق ولٰكن اكثرهم لا يعلمون
Sahih_International: So We restored him to his mother that she might be content and not grieve and that she would know that the promise of Allah is true. But most of the people do not know.
Pickthall: So We restored him to his mother that she might be comforted and not grieve, and that she might know that the promise of Allah is true. But most of them know not.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Thus did We restore him to his mother, that her eye might be comforted, that she might not grieve, and that she might know that the promise of Allah is true: but most of them do not understand.
Shakir: So We gave him back to his mother that her eye might be refreshed, and that she might no grieve, and that she might know that the promise of Allah is true, but most of them do not know.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Thus did We return Moses to his mother that We would delight her eyes, relieve her sorrows, and let her know that the promise of God was true, but many people do not know.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): So did We restore him to his mother, that she might be delighted, and that she might not grieve, and that she might know that the Promise of Allah is true. But most of them know not.
Arberry: So We returned him to his mother, that she might be comforted and not sorrow, and that she might know that the promise of God is true; but most of them do not know.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَأَلۡقِيَاهُ فِي ٱلۡعَذَابِ ٱلشَّدِيدِ
Verse: الذي جعل مع الله الٰها ءاخر فالقياه في العذاب الشديد
Sahih_International: Who made [as equal] with Allah another deity; then throw him into the severe punishment."
Pickthall: Who setteth up another god along with Allah. Do ye twain hurl him to the dreadful doom.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "Who set up another god beside Allah: Throw him into a severe penalty."
Shakir: Who sets up another god with Allah, so do cast him into severe chastisement.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): and an idol worshipper. Throw him into severe torment".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "Who set up another ilah (god) with Allah, then (both of you) cast him in the severe torment."
Arberry: who set up with God another god; therefore, you twain, cast him into the terrible chastisement.'
Label: anger

Verse_diac: وَجَنَّٰتٍ أَلۡفَافًا
Verse: وجنٰت الفافا
Sahih_International: And gardens of entwined growth.
Pickthall: And gardens of thick foliage.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And gardens of luxurious growth?
Shakir: And gardens dense and luxuriant.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): and thick gardens grow?
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And gardens of thick growth.
Arberry: and gardens luxuriant.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِيٓ ءَامَنَ يَٰقَوۡمِ إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُم مِّثۡلَ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡأَحۡزَابِ
Verse: وقال الذي ءامن يٰقوم اني اخاف عليكم مثل يوم الاحزاب
Sahih_International: And he who believed said, "O my people, indeed I fear for you [a fate] like the day of the companies -
Pickthall: And he who believed said: O my people! Lo! I fear for you a fate like that of the factions (of old);
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Then said the man who believed: "O my people! Truly I do fear for you something like the Day (of disaster) of the Confederates (in sin)!-
Shakir: And he who believed said: O my people! surely I fear for you the like of what befell the parties:
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): The believing man said, "I am afraid that you will face a (terrible) day like that of the groups:
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And he who believed said: "O my people! Verily, I fear for you a fate like that day (of disaster) of the Confederates (of old)!
Arberry: Then said he who believed, 'My people, truly I fear for you the like of the day of the parties,
Label: anger

Verse_diac: وَقُل رَّبِّ أَنزِلۡنِي مُنزَلٗا مُّبَارَكٗا وَأَنتَ خَيۡرُ ٱلۡمُنزِلِينَ
Verse: وقل رب انزلني منزلا مباركا وانت خير المنزلين
Sahih_International: And say, 'My Lord, let me land at a blessed landing place, and You are the best to accommodate [us].' "
Pickthall: And say: My Lord! Cause me to land at a blessed landing-place, for Thou art Best of all who bring to land.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And say: "O my Lord! enable me to disembark with thy blessing: for Thou art the Best to enable (us) to disembark."
Shakir: And say: O my Lord! cause me to disembark a blessed alighting, and Thou art the best to cause to alight.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Say, "Lord, grant us a blessed landing from the Ark; You are the One who provides the safest landing".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And say: "My Lord! Cause me to land at a blessed landing-place, for You are the Best of those who bring to land."
Arberry: And say, "'O my Lord, do Thou harbour me in a blessed harbour, for Thou art the best of harbourers."
Label: joy

Verse_diac: أَوۡ يَأۡخُذَهُمۡ عَلَىٰ تَخَوُّفٖ فَإِنَّ رَبَّكُمۡ لَرَءُوفٞ رَّحِيمٌ
Verse: او ياخذهم علىٰ تخوف فان ربكم لرءوف رحيم
Sahih_International: Or that He would not seize them gradually [in a state of dread]? But indeed, your Lord is Kind and Merciful.
Pickthall: Or that He will not seize them with a gradual wasting? Lo! thy Lord is indeed Full of Pity, Merciful.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Or that He may not call them to account by a process of slow wastage - for thy Lord is indeed full of kindness and mercy.
Shakir: Or that He may not seize them by causing them to suffer gradual loss, for your Lord is most surely Compassionate, Merciful.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Are they confident that God will not slowly destroy them? Your Lord is Compassionate and All-merciful.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Or that He may catch them with gradual wasting (of their wealth and health). Truly! Your Lord is indeed full of Kindness, Most Merciful?
Arberry: Or that He will not seize them, little by little destroying them? Surely thy Lord is All-clement, All-compassionate.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: ثُمَّ إِنَّ عَلَيۡنَا حِسَابَهُم
Verse: ثم ان علينا حسابهم
Sahih_International: Then indeed, upon Us is their account.
Pickthall: And Ours their reckoning.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Then it will be for Us to call them to account.
Shakir: Then surely upon Us is the taking of their account.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): In Our hands are their accounts.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Then verily, for Us will be their reckoning.
Arberry: then upon Us shall rest their reckoning.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: وَٱتَّقُواْ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَمَدَّكُم بِمَا تَعۡلَمُونَ
Verse: واتقوا الذي امدكم بما تعلمون
Sahih_International: And fear He who provided you with that which you know,
Pickthall: Keep your duty toward Him Who hath aided you with (the good things) that ye know,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "Yea, fear Him Who has bestowed on you freely all that ye know.
Shakir: And be careful of (your duty to) Him Who has given you abundance of what you know.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Have fear of the One who has bestowed upon you all that you know.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "And keep your duty to Him, fear Him Who has aided you with all (good things) that you know.
Arberry: and fear Him who has succoured you with what you know,
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: مُتَّكِـِٔينَ عَلَىٰ فُرُشِۭ بَطَآئِنُهَا مِنۡ إِسۡتَبۡرَقٖۚ وَجَنَى ٱلۡجَنَّتَيۡنِ دَانٖ
Verse: متكين علىٰ فرش بطائنها من استبرق وجنى الجنتين دان
Sahih_International: [They are] reclining on beds whose linings are of silk brocade, and the fruit of the two gardens is hanging low.
Pickthall: Reclining upon couches lined with silk brocade, the fruit of both the gardens near to hand.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): They will recline on Carpets, whose inner linings will be of rich brocade: the Fruit of the Gardens will be near (and easy of reach).
Shakir: Reclining on beds, the inner coverings of which are of silk brocade; and the fruits of the two gardens shall be within reach.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): (The dwellers of Paradise) will recline on couches lined with silk brocade and it will be easy to reach the ripe fruits from the two gardens.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Reclining upon the couches lined with silk brocade, and the fruits of the two Gardens will be near at hand.
Arberry: reclining upon couches lined with brocade, the fruits of the gardens nigh to gather --
Label: joy

Verse_diac: إِنَّا كَذَٰلِكَ نَفۡعَلُ بِٱلۡمُجۡرِمِينَ
Verse: انا كذٰلك نفعل بالمجرمين
Sahih_International: Indeed, that is how We deal with the criminals.
Pickthall: Lo! thus deal We with the guilty.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Verily that is how We shall deal with Sinners.
Shakir: Surely thus do We deal with the guilty.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): This is how We deal with the criminals.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Certainly, that is how We deal with Al­Mujrimun (polytheists, sinners, criminals, the disobedient to Allah, etc.).
Arberry: Even so We do with the sinners;
Label: anger

Verse_diac: وَفَوَٰكِهَ مِمَّا يَشۡتَهُونَ
Verse: وفوٰكه مما يشتهون
Sahih_International: And fruits from whatever they desire,
Pickthall: And fruits such as they desire.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And (they shall have) fruits,- all they desire.
Shakir: And fruits such as they desire.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): and fruits of the kind which they desire.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And fruits, such as they desire.
Arberry: and such fruits as their hearts desire:
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَلَمَّا تَوَجَّهَ تِلۡقَآءَ مَدۡيَنَ قَالَ عَسَىٰ رَبِّيٓ أَن يَهۡدِيَنِي سَوَآءَ ٱلسَّبِيلِ
Verse: ولما توجه تلقاء مدين قال عسىٰ ربي ان يهديني سواء السبيل
Sahih_International: And when he directed himself toward Madyan, he said, "Perhaps my Lord will guide me to the sound way."
Pickthall: And when he turned his face toward Midian, he said: Peradventure my Lord will guide me in the right road.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Then, when he turned his face towards (the land of) Madyan, he said: "I do hope that my Lord will show me the smooth and straight Path."
Shakir: And when he turned his face towards Madyan, he said: Maybe my Lord will guide me in the right path.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): When he started his journey to Midian he said, "Perhaps my Lord will show me the right path."
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And when he went towards (the land of) Madyan (Midian) he said: "It may be that my Lord guides me to the Right Way."
Arberry: And when he turned his face towards Midian he said, 'It may be that my Lord will guide me
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: فَٱدۡخُلُوٓاْ أَبۡوَٰبَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَاۖ فَلَبِئۡسَ مَثۡوَى ٱلۡمُتَكَبِّرِينَ
Verse: فادخلوا ابوٰب جهنم خٰلدين فيها فلبئس مثوى المتكبرين
Sahih_International: So enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and how wretched is the residence of the arrogant.
Pickthall: So enter the gates of hell, to dwell therein for ever. Woeful indeed will be the lodging of the arrogant.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "So enter the gates of Hell, to dwell therein. Thus evil indeed is the abode of the arrogant."
Shakir: Therefore enter the gates of hell, to abide therein; so certainly evil is the dwelling place of the proud.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): They will be commanded to enter hell to live therein forever. How terrible will be the place of the proud ones!
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "So enter the gates of Hell, to abide therein, and indeed, what an evil abode will be for the arrogant."
Arberry: So enter the gates of Gehenna, there to dwell forever.' Evil is the lodging of those that wax proud.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: ثُمَّ جَعَلَ نَسۡلَهُۥ مِن سُلَٰلَةٖ مِّن مَّآءٖ مَّهِينٖ
Verse: ثم جعل نسله من سلٰلة من ماء مهين
Sahih_International: Then He made his posterity out of the extract of a liquid disdained.
Pickthall: Then He made his seed from a draught of despised fluid;
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And made his progeny from a quintessence of the nature of a fluid despised:
Shakir: Then He made his progeny of an extract, of water held in light estimation.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): He made His offspring come into existence from an extract of insignificant fluid,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Then He made his offspring from semen of worthless water (male and female sexual discharge).
Arberry: then He fashioned his progeny of an extraction of mean water,
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: رَحۡمَةٗ مِّن رَّبِّكَۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
Verse: رحمة من ربك انه هو السميع العليم
Sahih_International: As mercy from your Lord. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
Pickthall: A mercy from thy Lord. Lo! He, even He is the Hearer, the Knower,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): As Mercy from thy Lord: for He hears and knows (all things);
Shakir: A mercy from your Lord, surely He is the Hearing, the Knowing,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): as a mercy (for the human being) from your Lord. Your Lord is All-hearing and All-knowing.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): (As) a Mercy from your Lord. Verily! He is the All-Hearer, the All-Knower.
Arberry: as a mercy from thy Lord (surely He is the All-hearing, the All-knowing)
Label: joy

Verse_diac: فَأَعۡرَضُواْ فَأَرۡسَلۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ سَيۡلَ ٱلۡعَرِمِ وَبَدَّلۡنَٰهُم بِجَنَّتَيۡهِمۡ جَنَّتَيۡنِ ذَوَاتَيۡ أُكُلٍ خَمۡطٖ وَأَثۡلٖ وَشَيۡءٖ مِّن سِدۡرٖ قَلِيلٖ
Verse: فاعرضوا فارسلنا عليهم سيل العرم وبدلنٰهم بجنتيهم جنتين ذواتي اكل خمط واثل وشيء من سدر قليل
Sahih_International: But they turned away [refusing], so We sent upon them the flood of the dam, and We replaced their two [fields of] gardens with gardens of bitter fruit, tamarisks and something of sparse lote trees.
Pickthall: But they were froward, so We sent on them the flood of 'Iram, and in exchange for their two gardens gave them two gardens bearing bitter fruit, the tamarisk and here and there a lote-tree.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): But they turned away (from Allah), and We sent against them the Flood (released) from the dams, and We converted their two garden (rows) into "gardens" producing bitter fruit, and tamarisks, and some few (stunted) Lote-trees.
Shakir: But they turned aside, so We sent upon them a torrent of which the rush could not be withstood, and in place of their two gardens We gave to them two gardens yielding bitter fruit and (growing) tamarisk and a few lote-trees.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): They ignored (the evidence) and We sent to them a flood, arising from a broken dam. Nothing was left in their gardens but bitter fruits, some tamarisk and a few lotus trees.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): But they turned away (from the obedience of Allah), so We sent against them Sail Al­'Arim (flood released from the dam), and We converted their two gardens into gardens producing bitter bad fruit, and tamarisks, and some few lote­trees.
Arberry: But they turned away; so We loosed on them the Flood of Arim, and We gave them, in exchange for their two gardens, two gardens bearing bitter produce and tamarisk-bushes, and here and there a few lote-trees.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: كَذَٰلِكَ مَآ أَتَى ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبۡلِهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا قَالُواْ سَاحِرٌ أَوۡ مَجۡنُونٌ
Verse: كذٰلك ما اتى الذين من قبلهم من رسول الا قالوا ساحر او مجنون
Sahih_International: Similarly, there came not to those before them any messenger except that they said, "A magician or a madman."
Pickthall: Even so there came no messenger unto those before them but they said: A wizard or a madman!
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Similarly, no messenger came to the Peoples before them, but they said (of him) in like manner, "A sorcerer, or one possessed"!
Shakir: Thus there did not come to those before them a messenger but they said: A magician or a mad man.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): In the same way no Messenger came to those who lived before them without his people calling him a magician or an insane person.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Likewise, no Messenger came to those before them, but they said: "A sorcerer or a madman!"
Arberry: Even so not a Messenger came to those before them but they said, 'A sorcerer, or a man possessed!'
Label: anger

Verse_diac: قُلۡ مَن رَّبُّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ ٱلسَّبۡعِ وَرَبُّ ٱلۡعَرۡشِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
Verse: قل من رب السمٰوٰت السبع ورب العرش العظيم
Sahih_International: Say, "Who is Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the Great Throne?"
Pickthall: Say: Who is Lord of the seven heavens, and Lord of the Tremendous Throne?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Say: "Who is the Lord of the seven heavens, and the Lord of the Throne (of Glory) Supreme?"
Shakir: Say: Who is the Lord of the seven heavens and the Lord of the mighty dominion?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Ask them, "Who is the Lord of the seven heavens and the Great Throne?"
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Say: "Who is (the) Lord of the seven heavens, and (the) Lord of the Great Throne?"
Arberry: Say: 'Who is the Lord of the seven heavens and the Lord of the mighty Throne?'
Label: joy

Verse_diac: لَيُدۡخِلَنَّهُم مُّدۡخَلٗا يَرۡضَوۡنَهُۥۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلِيمٌ حَلِيمٞ
Verse: ليدخلنهم مدخلا يرضونه وان الله لعليم حليم
Sahih_International: He will surely cause them to enter an entrance with which they will be pleased, and indeed, Allah is Knowing and Forbearing.
Pickthall: Assuredly He will cause them to enter by an entry that they will love. Lo! Allah verily is Knower, Indulgent.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Verily He will admit them to a place with which they shall be well pleased: for Allah is All-Knowing, Most Forbearing.
Shakir: He will certainly cause them to enter a place of entrance which they shall be well pleased with, and most surely Allah is Knowing, Forbearing.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): God will certainly admit them to a pleasant dwelling. God is All-knowing and Forbearing.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Truly, He will make them enter an entrance with which they shall be well-pleased, and verily, Allah indeed is All-Knowing, Most Forbearing.
Arberry: He shall admit them by a gate that is well-pleasing to them; and surely God is All-knowing, All-clement.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: لِّتُؤۡمِنُواْ بِٱللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِۦ وَتُعَزِّرُوهُ وَتُوَقِّرُوهُۚ وَتُسَبِّحُوهُ بُكۡرَةٗ وَأَصِيلًا
Verse: لتؤمنوا بالله ورسوله وتعزروه وتوقروه وتسبحوه بكرة واصيلا
Sahih_International: That you [people] may believe in Allah and His Messenger and honor him and respect the Prophet and exalt Allah morning and afternoon.
Pickthall: That ye (mankind) may believe in Allah and His messenger, and may honour Him, and may revere Him, and may glorify Him at early dawn and at the close of day.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): In order that ye (O men) may believe in Allah and His Messenger, that ye may assist and honour Him, and celebrate His praise morning and evening.
Shakir: That you may believe in Allah and His Messenger and may aid him and revere him; and (that) you may declare His glory, morning and evening.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): so that you (people) may believe in God and His Messenger, help, and respect God and glorify Him in the morning and the evening.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): In order that you (O mankind) may believe in Allah and His Messenger (SAW), and that you assist and honour him (SAW), and (that you) glorify (Allah's) praises morning and afternoon.
Arberry: that you may believe in God and His Messenger and succour Him, and reverence Him, and that you may give Him glory at the dawn and in the evening.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: هَٰذَا فَلۡيَذُوقُوهُ حَمِيمٞ وَغَسَّاقٞ
Verse: هٰذا فليذوقوه حميم وغساق
Sahih_International: This - so let them taste it - is scalding water and [foul] purulence.
Pickthall: Here is a boiling and an ice-cold draught, so let them taste it,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Yea, such! - then shall they taste it,- a boiling fluid, and a fluid dark, murky, intensely cold!-
Shakir: This (shall be so); so let them taste it, boiling and intensely cold (drink).
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): (They will be told), "This is your recompense.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): This is so! Then let them taste it, a boiling fluid and dirty wound discharges.
Arberry: All this; so let them taste it - boiling water and pus,
Label: anger

Verse_diac: وَلَقَدۡ ضَرَبۡنَا لِلنَّاسِ فِي هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ مِن كُلِّ مَثَلٖ لَّعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَذَكَّرُونَ
Verse: ولقد ضربنا للناس في هٰذا القرءان من كل مثل لعلهم يتذكرون
Sahih_International: And We have certainly presented for the people in this Qur'an from every [kind of] example - that they might remember.
Pickthall: And verily We have coined for mankind in this Qur'an all kinds of similitudes, that haply they may reflect;
Yusuf_Ali (YA): We have put forth for men, in this Qur'an every kind of Parable, in order that they may receive admonition.
Shakir: And certainly We have set forth to men in this Quran similitudes of every sort that they may mind.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We have given all kinds of examples for the human being in this Quran so that perhaps he may take heed.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And indeed We have put forth for men, in this Quran every kind of similitude in order that they may remember.
Arberry: Indeed We have struck for the people in this Koran every manner of similitude; haply they will remember;
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ قَدۡ جَآءَكُم بُرۡهَٰنٞ مِّن رَّبِّكُمۡ وَأَنزَلۡنَآ إِلَيۡكُمۡ نُورٗا مُّبِينٗا
Verse: يٰايها الناس قد جاءكم برهٰن من ربكم وانزلنا اليكم نورا مبينا
Sahih_International: O mankind, there has come to you a conclusive proof from your Lord, and We have sent down to you a clear light.
Pickthall: O mankind! Now hath a proof from your Lord come unto you, and We have sent down unto you a clear light;
Yusuf_Ali (YA): O mankind! verily there hath come to you a convincing proof from your Lord: For We have sent unto you a light (that is) manifest.
Shakir: O people! surely there has come to you manifest proof from your Lord and We have sent to you clear light.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Mankind, an undeniable proof has certainly come to you and We have sent you a shining light
Mohsin_Khan (MK): O mankind! Verily, there has come to you a convincing proof (Prophet Muhammad SAW) from your Lord, and We sent down to you a manifest light (this Quran).
Arberry: O men, a proof has now come to you from your Lord; We have sent down to you a manifest light.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: ٱلۡيَوۡمَ نَخۡتِمُ عَلَىٰٓ أَفۡوَٰهِهِمۡ وَتُكَلِّمُنَآ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ وَتَشۡهَدُ أَرۡجُلُهُم بِمَا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ
Verse: اليوم نختم علىٰ افوٰههم وتكلمنا ايديهم وتشهد ارجلهم بما كانوا يكسبون
Sahih_International: That Day, We will seal over their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify about what they used to earn.
Pickthall: This day We seal up their mouths, and their hands speak out to Us and their feet bear witness as to what they used to earn.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): That Day shall We set a seal on their mouths. But their hands will speak to us, and their feet bear witness, to all that they did.
Shakir: On that day We will set a seal upon their mouths, and their hands shall speak to Us, and their feet shall bear witness of what they earned.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We shall seal your mouths on that Day, let your hands speak to us and your feet testify to what you had achieved.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): This Day, We shall seal up their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their legs will bear witness to what they used to earn. (It is said that one's left thigh will be the first to bear the witness). [Tafsir At-Tabari, Vol. 22, Page 24]
Arberry: Today We set a seal on their mouths, and their hands speak to Us, and their feet bear witness as to what they have been earning.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: يَوۡمَ لَا يُغۡنِي مَوۡلًى عَن مَّوۡلٗى شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا هُمۡ يُنصَرُونَ
Verse: يوم لا يغني مولى عن مولى شيا ولا هم ينصرون
Sahih_International: The Day when no relation will avail a relation at all, nor will they be helped -
Pickthall: A day when friend can in naught avail friend, nor can they be helped,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): The Day when no protector can avail his client in aught, and no help can they receive,
Shakir: The day on which a friend shall not avail (his) friend aught, nor shall they be helped,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): (when wrong will be distinguished from right). On this day friends will be of no benefit to one another, nor will they receive any help
Mohsin_Khan (MK): The Day when Maulan (a near relative) cannot avail Maulan (a near relative) in aught, and no help can they receive,
Arberry: the day a master shall avail nothing a client, and they shall not be helped,
Label: fear

Verse_diac: فَتِلۡكَ بُيُوتُهُمۡ خَاوِيَةَۢ بِمَا ظَلَمُوٓاْۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَةٗ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَعۡلَمُونَ
Verse: فتلك بيوتهم خاوية بما ظلموا ان في ذٰلك لاية لقوم يعلمون
Sahih_International: So those are their houses, desolate because of the wrong they had done. Indeed in that is a sign for people who know.
Pickthall: See, yonder are their dwellings empty and in ruins because they did wrong. Lo! herein is indeed a portent for a people who have knowledge.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Now such were their houses, - in utter ruin, - because they practised wrong-doing. Verily in this is a Sign for people of knowledge.
Shakir: So those are their houses fallen down because they were unjust, most surely there is a sign in this for a people who know.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Those are their empty houses which We ruined because of their injustice. In this there is evidence (of the truth) for the people of knowledge.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): These are their houses in utter ruin, for they did wrong. Verily, in this is indeed an Ayah (a lesson or a sign) for people who know.
Arberry: Those are their houses, all fallen down because of the evil they committed; surely in that is a sign for a people who have knowledge.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: عَلَيۡهِمۡ نَارٞ مُّؤۡصَدَةُۢ
Verse: عليهم نار مؤصدة
Sahih_International: Over them will be fire closed in.
Pickthall: Fire will be an awning over them.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): On them will be Fire vaulted over (all round).
Shakir: On them is fire closed over.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): who will be engulfed in the fire.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): The Fire will be shut over them (i.e. they will be enveloped by the Fire without any opening or window or outlet.
Arberry: over them is a Fire covered down.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: فَأَعۡرِضۡ عَن مَّن تَوَلَّىٰ عَن ذِكۡرِنَا وَلَمۡ يُرِدۡ إِلَّا ٱلۡحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا
Verse: فاعرض عن من تولىٰ عن ذكرنا ولم يرد الا الحيوٰة الدنيا
Sahih_International: So turn away from whoever turns his back on Our message and desires not except the worldly life.
Pickthall: Then withdraw (O Muhammad) from him who fleeth from Our remembrance and desireth but the life of the world.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Therefore shun those who turn away from Our Message and desire nothing but the life of this world.
Shakir: Therefore turn aside from him who turns his back upon Our reminder and does not desire anything but this world's life.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): (Muhammad), stay away from those who turn away from Our guidance and who do not desire anything except the worldly life.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Therefore withdraw (O Muhammad SAW) from him who turns away from Our Reminder (this Quran) and desires nothing but the life of this world.
Arberry: So turn thou from him who turns away from Our Remembrance, and desires only the present life.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: قَالُواْ تِلۡكَ إِذٗا كَرَّةٌ خَاسِرَةٞ
Verse: قالوا تلك اذا كرة خاسرة
Sahih_International: They say, "That, then, would be a losing return."
Pickthall: They say: Then that would be a vain proceeding.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): They say: "It would, in that case, be a return with loss!"
Shakir: They said: That then would be a return occasioning loss.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): They have said, "Such a resurrection will certainly be a great loss".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): They say: "It would in that case, be a return with loss!"
Arberry: They shall say, 'That then were a losing return!'
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: قَالَ يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلۡمَلَؤُاْ أَيُّكُمۡ يَأۡتِينِي بِعَرۡشِهَا قَبۡلَ أَن يَأۡتُونِي مُسۡلِمِينَ
Verse: قال يٰايها الملؤا ايكم ياتيني بعرشها قبل ان ياتوني مسلمين
Sahih_International: [Solomon] said, "O assembly [of jinn], which of you will bring me her throne before they come to me in submission?"
Pickthall: He said: O chiefs! Which of you will bring me her throne before they come unto me, surrendering?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): He said (to his own men): "Ye chiefs! which of you can bring me her throne before they come to me in submission?"
Shakir: He said: O chiefs! which of you can bring to me her throne before they come to me in submission?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Solomon asked his people, "Who among you can bring her throne before (she, the queen of Sheba) comes to me submissively?"
Mohsin_Khan (MK): He said: "O chiefs! Which of you can bring me her throne before they come to me surrendering themselves in obedience?"
Arberry: He said, 'O Council, which one of you will bring me her throne, before they come to me in surrender?'
Label: joy

Verse_diac: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمۡ شَآقُّواْ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥۚ وَمَن يُشَاقِقِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ شَدِيدُ ٱلۡعِقَابِ
Verse: ذٰلك بانهم شاقوا الله ورسوله ومن يشاقق الله ورسوله فان الله شديد العقاب
Sahih_International: That is because they opposed Allah and His Messenger. And whoever opposes Allah and His Messenger - indeed, Allah is severe in penalty.
Pickthall: That is because they opposed Allah and His messenger. Whoso opposeth Allah and His messenger, (for him) lo! Allah is severe in punishment.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): This because they contended against Allah and His Messenger: If any contend against Allah and His Messenger, Allah is strict in punishment.
Shakir: This is because they acted adversely to Allah and His Messenger; and whoever acts adversely to Allah and His Messenger-- then surely Allah is severe in requiting (evil).
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): they have opposed God and His Messengers." For those who oppose God and His Messengers, God has prepared a severe retribution.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): This is because they defied and disobeyed Allah and His Messenger. And whoever defies and disobeys Allah and His Messenger, then verily, Allah is Severe in punishment.
Arberry: That, because they had made a breach with God and with His Messenger; and whosoever makes a breach with God and with His Messenger, surely God is terrible in retribution.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا رَأَوۡاْ مَا يُوعَدُونَ فَسَيَعۡلَمُونَ مَنۡ أَضۡعَفُ نَاصِرٗا وَأَقَلُّ عَدَدٗا
Verse: حتىٰ اذا راوا ما يوعدون فسيعلمون من اضعف ناصرا واقل عددا
Sahih_International: [The disbelievers continue] until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number.
Pickthall: Till (the day) when they shall behold that which they are promised (they may doubt); but then they will know (for certain) who is weaker in allies and less in multitude.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): At length, when they see (with their own eyes) that which they are promised,- then will they know who it is that is weakest in (his) helper and least important in point of numbers.
Shakir: Until when they see what they are threatened with, then shall they know who is weaker in helpers and fewer in number.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): (On the Day of Judgment) when the disbelievers witness that with which they have been threatened, they will then know whose helpers are weaker and fewer in number.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Till, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who it is that is weaker concerning helpers and less important concerning numbers.
Arberry: Until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and fewer in numbers.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَلَقَدۡ أَرَيۡنَٰهُ ءَايَٰتِنَا كُلَّهَا فَكَذَّبَ وَأَبَىٰ
Verse: ولقد ارينٰه ءايٰتنا كلها فكذب وابىٰ
Sahih_International: And We certainly showed Pharaoh Our signs - all of them - but he denied and refused.
Pickthall: And We verily did show him all Our tokens, but he denied them and refused.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And We showed Pharaoh all Our Signs, but he did reject and refuse.
Shakir: And truly We showed him Our signs, all of them, but he rejected and refused.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We showed the Pharaoh all of Our miracles, but he called them lies and turned away from them.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And indeed We showed him [Fir'aun (Pharaoh)] all Our Signs and Evidences, but he denied and refused.
Arberry: So We showed Pharaoh all Our signs, but he cried lies, and refused.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: فَرَوۡحٞ وَرَيۡحَانٞ وَجَنَّتُ نَعِيمٖ
Verse: فروح وريحان وجنت نعيم
Sahih_International: Then [for him is] rest and bounty and a garden of pleasure.
Pickthall: Then breath of life, and plenty, and a Garden of delight.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): (There is for him) Rest and Satisfaction, and a Garden of Delights.
Shakir: Then happiness and bounty and a garden of bliss.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): it will have rest, happiness, and a beautiful Paradise.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): (There is for him) rest and provision, and a Garden of delights (Paradise).
Arberry: there shall be repose and ease, and a Garden of Delight;
Label: joy

Verse_diac: بَلِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ فِي عِزَّةٖ وَشِقَاقٖ
Verse: بل الذين كفروا في عزة وشقاق
Sahih_International: But those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension.
Pickthall: Nay, but those who disbelieve are in false pride and schism.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): But the Unbelievers (are steeped) in self-glory and Separatism.
Shakir: Nay! those who disbelieve are in self-exaltation and opposition.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): In fact, the unbelievers are the ones who are boastful and quarrelsome.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Nay, those who desbelieve are in false pride and opposition.
Arberry: nay, but the unbelievers glory in their schism.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: ٱلَّذِينَ ضَلَّ سَعۡيُهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَهُمۡ يَحۡسَبُونَ أَنَّهُمۡ يُحۡسِنُونَ صُنۡعًا
Verse: الذين ضل سعيهم في الحيوٰة الدنيا وهم يحسبون انهم يحسنون صنعا
Sahih_International: [They are] those whose effort is lost in worldly life, while they think that they are doing well in work."
Pickthall: Those whose effort goeth astray in the life of the world, and yet they reckon that they do good work.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "Those whose efforts have been wasted in this life, while they thought that they were acquiring good by their works?"
Shakir: (These are) they whose labor is lost in this world's life and they think that they are well versed in skill of the work of hands.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): It will be those who labor a great deal in this life but without guidance, yet think that they are doing a great many good deeds.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "Those whose efforts have been wasted in this life while they thought that they were acquiring good by their deeds!
Arberry: Those whose striving goes astray in the present life, while they think that they are working good deeds.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: وَٱلطُّورِ
Verse: والطور
Sahih_International: By the mount
Pickthall: By the Mount,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): By the Mount (of Revelation);
Shakir: I swear by the Mountain,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): By the Mount (Sinai),
Mohsin_Khan (MK): By the Mount;
Arberry: By the Mount
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَٱلصُّبۡحِ إِذَآ أَسۡفَرَ
Verse: والصبح اذا اسفر
Sahih_International: And [by] the morning when it brightens,
Pickthall: And the dawn when it shineth forth,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And by the Dawn as it shineth forth,-
Shakir: And the daybreak when it shines;
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): by the brightening dawn,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And by the dawn when it brightens,
Arberry: and the dawn when it is white,
Label: joy

Verse_diac: إِنِّيٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيۡكُمۡ عَذَابَ يَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٖ
Verse: اني اخاف عليكم عذاب يوم عظيم
Sahih_International: Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day."
Pickthall: Lo! I fear for you the retribution of an awful day.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "Truly I fear for you the Penalty of a Great Day."
Shakir: Surely I fear for you the chastisement of a grievous day
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): I am afraid that you will suffer the torment of the Day of Judgment."
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "Verily, I fear for you the torment of a Great Day."
Arberry: 'Indeed, I fear for you the chastisement of a dreadful day.'
Label: fear

Verse_diac: مَا ضَلَّ صَاحِبُكُمۡ وَمَا غَوَىٰ
Verse: ما ضل صاحبكم وما غوىٰ
Sahih_International: Your companion [Muhammad] has not strayed, nor has he erred,
Pickthall: Your comrade erreth not, nor is deceived;
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Your Companion is neither astray nor being misled.
Shakir: Your companion does not err, nor does he go astray;
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): your companion is not in error nor has he gone astray.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Your companion (Muhammad SAW) has neither gone astray nor has erred.
Arberry: your comrade is not astray, neither errs,
Label: joy

Verse_diac: فَلۡيَعۡبُدُواْ رَبَّ هَٰذَا ٱلۡبَيۡتِ
Verse: فليعبدوا رب هٰذا البيت
Sahih_International: Let them worship the Lord of this House,
Pickthall: So let them worship the Lord of this House,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Let them adore the Lord of this House,
Shakir: So let them serve the Lord of this House
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): It is He who has fed them when they were hungry
Mohsin_Khan (MK): So let them worship (Allah) the Lord of this House (the Ka'bah in Makkah).
Arberry: So let them serve the Lord of this House
Label: joy

Verse_diac: أَفَلَا يَتَدَبَّرُونَ ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ أَمۡ عَلَىٰ قُلُوبٍ أَقۡفَالُهَآ
Verse: افلا يتدبرون القرءان ام علىٰ قلوب اقفالها
Sahih_International: Then do they not reflect upon the Qur'an, or are there locks upon [their] hearts?
Pickthall: Will they then not meditate on the Qur'an, or are there locks on the hearts?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Do they not then earnestly seek to understand the Qur'an, or are their hearts locked up by them?
Shakir: Do they not then reflect on the Quran? Nay, on the hearts there are locks.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Is it that they do not think about the Quran or are their hearts sealed?
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Do they not then think deeply in the Quran, or are their hearts locked up (from understanding it)?
Arberry: What, do they not ponder the Koran? Or is it that there are locks upon their hearts?
Label: fear

Verse_diac: خَلَقَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَصَوَّرَكُمۡ فَأَحۡسَنَ صُوَرَكُمۡۖ وَإِلَيۡهِ ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
Verse: خلق السمٰوٰت والارض بالحق وصوركم فاحسن صوركم واليه المصير
Sahih_International: He created the heavens and earth in truth and formed you and perfected your forms; and to Him is the [final] destination.
Pickthall: He created the heavens and the earth with truth, and He shaped you and made good your shapes, and unto Him is the journeying.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): He has created the heavens and the earth in just proportions, and has given you shape, and made your shapes beautiful: and to Him is the final Goal.
Shakir: He created the heavens and the earth with truth, and He formed you, then made goodly your forms, and to Him is the ultimate resort.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): He has created the heavens and the earth for a genuine purpose and has formed you in the best shape. To Him all things return.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): He has created the heavens and the earth with truth, and He shaped you and made good your shapes, and to Him is the final Return.
Arberry: He created the heavens and the earth with the truth, and He shaped you, and shaped you well; and unto Him is the homecoming.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: بَلۡ نَقۡذِفُ بِٱلۡحَقِّ عَلَى ٱلۡبَٰطِلِ فَيَدۡمَغُهُۥ فَإِذَا هُوَ زَاهِقٞۚ وَلَكُمُ ٱلۡوَيۡلُ مِمَّا تَصِفُونَ
Verse: بل نقذف بالحق على البٰطل فيدمغه فاذا هو زاهق ولكم الويل مما تصفون
Sahih_International: Rather, We dash the truth upon falsehood, and it destroys it, and thereupon it departs. And for you is destruction from that which you describe.
Pickthall: Nay, but We hurl the true against the false, and it doth break its head and lo! it vanisheth. And yours will be woe for that which ye ascribe (unto Him).
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Nay, We hurl the Truth against falsehood, and it knocks out its brain, and behold, falsehood doth perish! Ah! woe be to you for the (false) things ye ascribe (to Us).
Shakir: Nay! We cast the truth against the falsehood, so that it breaks its head, and lo! it vanishes; and woe to you for what you describe;
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We bring forward the Truth to crush and destroy falsehood; it is doomed to be banished. Woe to you for your way of thinking about God!
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Nay, We fling (send down) the truth (this Quran) against the falsehood (disbelief), so it destroys it, and behold, it (falsehood) is vanished. And woe to you for that (lie) which you ascribe (to Us) (against Allah by uttering that Allah has a wife and a son).
Arberry: Nay, but We hurl the truth against falsehood and it prevails over it, and behold, falsehood vanishes away. Then woe to you for that you describe!
Label: anger

Verse_diac: إِذَا زُلۡزِلَتِ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ زِلۡزَالَهَا
Verse: اذا زلزلت الارض زلزالها
Sahih_International: When the earth is shaken with its [final] earthquake
Pickthall: When Earth is shaken with her (final) earthquake
Yusuf_Ali (YA): When the earth is shaken to her (utmost) convulsion,
Shakir: When the earth is shaken with her (violent) shaking,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): When the earth is shaken by a terrible quake
Mohsin_Khan (MK): When the earth is shaken with its (final) earthquake.
Arberry: When earth is shaken with a mighty shaking
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَلِبُيُوتِهِمۡ أَبۡوَٰبٗا وَسُرُرًا عَلَيۡهَا يَتَّكِـُٔونَ
Verse: ولبيوتهم ابوٰبا وسررا عليها يتكون
Sahih_International: And for their houses - doors and couches [of silver] upon which to recline
Pickthall: And for their houses doors (of silver) and couches of silver whereon to recline,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And (silver) doors to their houses, and thrones (of silver) on which they could recline,
Shakir: And the doors of their houses and the couches on which they recline,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): doors for their houses, couches on which to recline,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And for their houses, doors (of silver), and thrones (of silver) on which they could recline,
Arberry: and doors to their houses, and couches whereon to recline,
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَلَا يُوثِقُ وَثَاقَهُۥٓ أَحَدٞ
Verse: ولا يوثق وثاقه احد
Sahih_International: And none will bind [as severely] as His binding [of the evildoers].
Pickthall: None bindeth as He then will bind.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And His bonds will be such as none (other) can bind.
Shakir: And no one shall bind with (anything like) His binding.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): And His bonds will be such as none other can bind.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And none will bind as He will bind.
Arberry: none shall bind as He binds.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِي غُلَٰمٞ وَكَانَتِ ٱمۡرَأَتِي عَاقِرٗا وَقَدۡ بَلَغۡتُ مِنَ ٱلۡكِبَرِ عِتِيّٗا
Verse: قال رب انىٰ يكون لي غلٰم وكانت امراتي عاقرا وقد بلغت من الكبر عتيا
Sahih_International: He said, "My Lord, how will I have a boy when my wife has been barren and I have reached extreme old age?"
Pickthall: He said: My Lord! How can I have a son when my wife is barren and I have reached infirm old age?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): He said: "O my Lord! How shall I have a son, when my wife is barren and I have grown quite decrepit from old age?"
Shakir: He said: O my Lord! when shall I have a son, and my wife is barren, and I myself have reached indeed the extreme degree of old age?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): He said, "Lord, how can I have a son? My wife is barren and I have reached an extremely old age".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): He said: "My Lord! How can I have a son, when my wife is barren, and I have reached the extreme old age."
Arberry: He said, 'O my Lord, how shall I have a son, seeing my wife is barren, and I have attained to the declining of old age?'
Label: joy

Verse_diac: فَٱصۡدَعۡ بِمَا تُؤۡمَرُ وَأَعۡرِضۡ عَنِ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ
Verse: فاصدع بما تؤمر واعرض عن المشركين
Sahih_International: Then declare what you are commanded and turn away from the polytheists.
Pickthall: So proclaim that which thou art commanded, and withdraw from the idolaters.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Therefore expound openly what thou art commanded, and turn away from those who join false gods with Allah.
Shakir: Therefore declare openly what you are bidden and turn aside from the polytheists.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Preach what you have been commanded to and stay away from the pagans.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Therefore proclaim openly (Allah's Message Islamic Monotheism) that which you are commanded, and turn away from Al-Mushrikun (polytheists, idolaters, and disbelievers, etc. - see V.2:105).
Arberry: So shout that thou art commanded and turn thou away from the idolaters.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: إِنۡ هِيَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنۡيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحۡيَا وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمَبۡعُوثِينَ
Verse: ان هي الا حياتنا الدنيا نموت ونحيا وما نحن بمبعوثين
Sahih_International: Life is not but our worldly life - we die and live, but we will not be resurrected.
Pickthall: There is naught but our life of the world; we die and we live, and we shall not be raised (again).
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "There is nothing but our life in this world! We shall die and we live! But we shall never be raised up again!
Shakir: There is naught but our life in this world; we die and we live and we shall not be raised again.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): This is our only life. We live and will die but we will never be brought back to life again.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "There is nothing but our life of this world! We die and we live! And we are not going to be resurrected!
Arberry: There is nothing but our present life; we die, and we live, and we shall not be raised up.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: رَّبُّكُمۡ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا فِي نُفُوسِكُمۡۚ إِن تَكُونُواْ صَٰلِحِينَ فَإِنَّهُۥ كَانَ لِلۡأَوَّٰبِينَ غَفُورٗا
Verse: ربكم اعلم بما في نفوسكم ان تكونوا صٰلحين فانه كان للاوٰبين غفورا
Sahih_International: Your Lord is most knowing of what is within yourselves. If you should be righteous [in intention] - then indeed He is ever, to the often returning [to Him], Forgiving.
Pickthall: Your Lord is Best Aware of what is in your minds. If ye are righteous, then lo! He was ever Forgiving unto those who turn (unto Him).
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Your Lord knoweth best what is in your hearts: If ye do deeds of righteousness, verily He is Most Forgiving to those who turn to Him again and again (in true penitence).
Shakir: Your Lord knows best what is in your minds; if you are good, then He is surely Forgiving to those who turn (to Him) frequently.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Your Lord knows what is in your souls. If you would be righteous, know that He is All-forgiving to those who turn to Him in repentance.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Your Lord knows best what is in your inner-selves. If you are righteous, then, verily, He is Ever Most Forgiving to those who turn unto Him again and again in obedience, and in repentance.
Arberry: Your Lord knows very well what is in your hearts if you are righteous, for He is All-forgiving to those who are penitent.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: أَلَمۡ يَعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّهُۥ مَن يُحَادِدِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَأَنَّ لَهُۥ نَارَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدٗا فِيهَاۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡخِزۡيُ ٱلۡعَظِيمُ
Verse: الم يعلموا انه من يحادد الله ورسوله فان له نار جهنم خٰلدا فيها ذٰلك الخزي العظيم
Sahih_International: Do they not know that whoever opposes Allah and His Messenger - that for him is the fire of Hell, wherein he will abide eternally? That is the great disgrace.
Pickthall: Know they not that whoso opposeth Allah and His messenger, his verily is fire of hell, to abide therein? That is the extreme abasement.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Know they not that for those who oppose Allah and His Messenger, is the Fire of Hell?- wherein they shall dwell. That is the supreme disgrace.
Shakir: Do they not know that whoever acts in opposition to Allah and His Messenger, he shall surely have the fire of hell to abide in it? That is the grievous abasement.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Do they not know that for displeasing God and His Messenger, one would be admitted to Hell wherein he would live forever. This indeed is a great humiliation.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Know they not that whoever opposes and shows hostility to Allah (swt) and His Messenger (SAW), certainly for him will be the Fire of Hell to abide therein. That is extreme disgrace.
Arberry: Do they not know that whosoever opposes God and His Messenger -- for him awaits the fire of Gehenna, therein to dwell forever? That is the mighty degradation.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: يَٰمَرۡيَمُ ٱقۡنُتِي لِرَبِّكِ وَٱسۡجُدِي وَٱرۡكَعِي مَعَ ٱلرَّٰكِعِينَ
Verse: يٰمريم اقنتي لربك واسجدي واركعي مع الرٰكعين
Sahih_International: O Mary, be devoutly obedient to your Lord and prostrate and bow with those who bow [in prayer]."
Pickthall: O Mary! Be obedient to thy Lord, prostrate thyself and bow with those who bow (in worship).
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "O Mary! worship Thy Lord devoutly: Prostrate thyself, and bow down (in prayer) with those who bow down."
Shakir: O Marium! keep to obedience to your Lord and humble yourself, and bow down with those who bow.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Mary, pray devotedly to your Lord, prostrate yourself before Him and bow down with those who bow down before Him."
Mohsin_Khan (MK): O Mary! "Submit yourself with obedience to your Lord (Allah, by worshipping none but Him Alone) and prostrate yourself, and Irka'i (bow down etc.) along with Ar-Raki'un (those who bow down etc.)."
Arberry: Mary; be obedient to thy Lord, prostrating and bowing before Him.'
Label: joy

Verse_diac: هُوَ ٱلَّذِي يُحۡيِۦ وَيُمِيتُۖ فَإِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمۡرٗا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
Verse: هو الذي يحي ويميت فاذا قضىٰ امرا فانما يقول له كن فيكون
Sahih_International: He it is who gives life and causes death; and when He decrees a matter, He but says to it, "Be," and it is.
Pickthall: He it is Who quickeneth and giveth death. When He ordaineth a thing, He saith unto it only: Be! and it is.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): It is He Who gives Life and Death; and when He decides upon an affair, He says to it, "Be", and it is.
Shakir: He it is Who gives life and brings death, so when He decrees an affair, He only says to it: Be, and it is.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): It is He Who gives life and causes things to die. When He decides to do something, He only says, "Exist," and it comes into existence.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): He it is Who gives life and causes death. And when He decides upon a thing He says to it only: "Be!" and it is.
Arberry: It is He who gives life, and makes to die; and when He decrees a thing, He but says to it 'Be,' and it is.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَإِنَّا لَجَٰعِلُونَ مَا عَلَيۡهَا صَعِيدٗا جُرُزًا
Verse: وانا لجٰعلون ما عليها صعيدا جرزا
Sahih_International: And indeed, We will make that which is upon it [into] a barren ground.
Pickthall: And lo! We shall make all that is thereon a barren mound.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Verily what is on earth we shall make but as dust and dry soil (without growth or herbage).
Shakir: And most surely We will make what is on it bare ground without herbage.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Let it be known that We will turn all things on earth into dust.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And verily! We shall make all that is on it (the earth) a bare dry soil (without any vegetation or trees, etc.).
Arberry: and We shall surely make all that is on it barren dust.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: فَلَيۡسَ لَهُ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ هَٰهُنَا حَمِيمٞ
Verse: فليس له اليوم هٰهنا حميم
Sahih_International: So there is not for him here this Day any devoted friend
Pickthall: Therefor hath he no lover here this day,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "So no friend hath he here this Day.
Shakir: Therefore he has not here today a true friend,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): On this day, they will have no friends
Mohsin_Khan (MK): So no friend has he here this Day,
Arberry: therefore he today has not here one loyal friend,
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَٱمۡرَأَتُهُۥ حَمَّالَةَ ٱلۡحَطَبِ
Verse: وامراته حمالة الحطب
Sahih_International: And his wife [as well] - the carrier of firewood.
Pickthall: And his wife, the wood-carrier,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): His wife shall carry the (crackling) wood - As fuel!-
Shakir: And his wife, the bearer of fuel,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): He will suffer in a blazing fire
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And his wife too, who carries wood (thorns of Sadan which she used to put on the way of the Prophet (Peace be upon him) , or use to slander him) .
Arberry: and his wife, the carrier of the firewood,
Label: anger

Verse_diac: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۚ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلۡيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ
Verse: الله لا الٰه الا هو وعلى الله فليتوكل المؤمنون
Sahih_International: Allah - there is no deity except Him. And upon Allah let the believers rely.
Pickthall: Allah! There is no Allah save Him. In Allah, therefore, let believers put their trust.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Allah! There is no god but He: and on Allah, therefore, let the Believers put their trust.
Shakir: Allah, there is no god but He; and upon Allah, then, let the believers rely.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): God is the only Lord and in Him the believers should trust.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Allah! La ilaha illa Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He), and in Allah (Alone), therefore, let the believers put their trust.
Arberry: God -- there is no god but He. And in God let the believers put their trust.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا مَا جَآءُوهَا شَهِدَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ سَمۡعُهُمۡ وَأَبۡصَٰرُهُمۡ وَجُلُودُهُم بِمَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
Verse: حتىٰ اذا ما جاءوها شهد عليهم سمعهم وابصٰرهم وجلودهم بما كانوا يعملون
Sahih_International: Until, when they reach it, their hearing and their eyes and their skins will testify against them of what they used to do.
Pickthall: Till, when they reach it, their ears and their eyes and their skins testify against them as to what they used to do.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): At length, when they reach the (Fire), their hearing, their sight, and their skins will bear witness against them, as to (all) their deeds.
Shakir: Until when they come to it, their ears and their eyes and their skins shall bear witness against them as to what they did.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): until (on the brink of it) their eyes, ears and skin will testify to their deeds on the Day when the enemies of God are driven to the fire.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Till, when they reach it (Hell-fire), their hearing (ears) and their eyes, and their skins will testify against them as to what they used to do.
Arberry: till when they are come to it, their hearing, their eyes and their skins bear witness against them concerning what they have been doing,
Label: anger

Verse_diac: وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰكَ إِلَّا مُبَشِّرٗا وَنَذِيرٗا
Verse: وما ارسلنٰك الا مبشرا ونذيرا
Sahih_International: And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner.
Pickthall: And We have sent thee (O Muhammad) only as a bearer of good tidings and a warner.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): But thee We only sent to give glad tidings and admonition.
Shakir: And We have not sent you but as a giver of good news and as a warner.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We have sent you for no other reason but to be a bearer of glad news and warning.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And We have sent you (O Muhammad SAW ) only as a bearer of glad tidings and a warner.
Arberry: We have sent thee not, except good tidings to bear, and warning.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بَعۡضُهُمۡ أَوۡلِيَآءُ بَعۡضٍۚ إِلَّا تَفۡعَلُوهُ تَكُن فِتۡنَةٞ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَفَسَادٞ كَبِيرٞ
Verse: والذين كفروا بعضهم اولياء بعض الا تفعلوه تكن فتنة في الارض وفساد كبير
Sahih_International: And those who disbelieved are allies of one another. If you do not do so, there will be fitnah on earth and great corruption.
Pickthall: And those who disbelieve are protectors one of another - If ye do not so, there will be confusion in the land, and great corruption.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): The Unbelievers are protectors, one of another: Unless ye do this, (protect each other), there would be tumult and oppression on earth, and great mischief.
Shakir: And (as for) those who disbelieve, some of them are the guardians of others; if you will not do it, there will be in the land persecution and great mischief.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): The unbelievers are each other's friends. If you (the believers) do not keep the same among yourselves in the land, there will come into being widespread idolatry and great evil.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And those who disbelieve are allies to one another, (and) if you (Muslims of the whole world collectively) do not do so (i.e. become allies, as one united block with one Khalifah - chief Muslim ruler for the whole Muslim world to make victorious Allah's Religion of Islamic Monotheism), there will be Fitnah (wars, battles, polytheism, etc.) and oppression on earth, and a great mischief and corruption (appearance of polytheism).
Arberry: As for the unbelievers, they are friends one of another. Unless you do this, there will be persecution in the land and great corruption.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: ۞وَمَن يُسۡلِمۡ وَجۡهَهُۥٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَهُوَ مُحۡسِنٞ فَقَدِ ٱسۡتَمۡسَكَ بِٱلۡعُرۡوَةِ ٱلۡوُثۡقَىٰۗ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلۡأُمُورِ
Verse: ومن يسلم وجهه الى الله وهو محسن فقد استمسك بالعروة الوثقىٰ والى الله عٰقبة الامور
Sahih_International: And whoever submits his face to Allah while he is a doer of good - then he has grasped the most trustworthy handhold. And to Allah will be the outcome of [all] matters.
Pickthall: Whosoever surrendereth his purpose to Allah while doing good, he verily hath grasped the firm hand-hold. Unto Allah belongeth the sequel of all things.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Whoever submits his whole self to Allah, and is a doer of good, has grasped indeed the most trustworthy hand-hold: and with Allah rests the End and Decision of (all) affairs.
Shakir: And whoever submits himself wholly to Allah and he is the doer of good (to others), he indeed has taken hold of the firmest thing upon which one can lay hold; and Allah's is the end of affairs.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Whoever submits himself to the will of God in righteousness has certainly achieved a strong-hold. The end of all things is in the hands of God.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And whosoever submits his face (himself) to Allah [i.e.(follows Allah's Religion of Islamic Monotheism), worships Allah (Alone) with sincere Faith in the (1) Oneness of His Lordship,(2) Oneness of His worship, and (3) Oneness of His Names and Qualities], while he is a Muhsin (good­doer i.e. performs good deeds totally for Allah's sake without any show-off or to gain praise or fame etc. and does them in accordance with the Sunnah of Allah's Messenger Muhammad SAW), then he has grasped the most trustworthy hand­hold [La ilaha ill-Allah (none has the right to be worshipped but Allah)]. And to Allah return all matters for decision.
Arberry: And whosoever submits his will to God, being a good-doer, has laid hold of the most firm handle; and unto God is the issue of all affairs.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدٗاۖ لَّا يَجِدُونَ وَلِيّٗا وَلَا نَصِيرٗا
Verse: خٰلدين فيها ابدا لا يجدون وليا ولا نصيرا
Sahih_International: Abiding therein forever, they will not find a protector or a helper.
Pickthall: Wherein they will abide for ever. They will find (then) no protecting friend nor helper.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): To dwell therein for ever: no protector will they find, nor helper.
Shakir: To abide therein for a long time; they shall not find a protector or a helper.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): wherein they will live forever without being able to find any guardian or helper.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Wherein they will abide for ever, and they will find neither a Wali (a protector) nor a helper.
Arberry: therein to dwell for ever; they shall find neither protector nor helper.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: وَٱلۡجِبَالَ أَرۡسَىٰهَا
Verse: والجبال ارسىٰها
Sahih_International: And the mountains He set firmly
Pickthall: And He made fast the hills,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And the mountains hath He firmly fixed;-
Shakir: And the mountains, He made them firm,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): then set-up firmly the mountains.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And the mountains He has fixed firmly;
Arberry: and the mountains He set firm,
Label: joy

Verse_diac: إِنَّ مَعَ ٱلۡعُسۡرِ يُسۡرٗا
Verse: ان مع العسر يسرا
Sahih_International: Indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
Pickthall: Lo! with hardship goeth ease;
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Verily, with every difficulty there is relief.
Shakir: With difficulty is surely ease.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Certainly, after every difficulty there comes relief.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Verily, with the hardship, there is relief (i.e. there is one hardship with two reliefs, so one hardship cannot overcome two reliefs).
Arberry: truly with hardship comes ease.'
Label: joy

Verse_diac: قُل لِّلۡمُخَلَّفِينَ مِنَ ٱلۡأَعۡرَابِ سَتُدۡعَوۡنَ إِلَىٰ قَوۡمٍ أُوْلِي بَأۡسٖ شَدِيدٖ تُقَٰتِلُونَهُمۡ أَوۡ يُسۡلِمُونَۖ فَإِن تُطِيعُواْ يُؤۡتِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ أَجۡرًا حَسَنٗاۖ وَإِن تَتَوَلَّوۡاْ كَمَا تَوَلَّيۡتُم مِّن قَبۡلُ يُعَذِّبۡكُمۡ عَذَابًا أَلِيمٗا
Verse: قل للمخلفين من الاعراب ستدعون الىٰ قوم اولي باس شديد تقٰتلونهم او يسلمون فان تطيعوا يؤتكم الله اجرا حسنا وان تتولوا كما توليتم من قبل يعذبكم عذابا اليما
Sahih_International: Say to those who remained behind of the bedouins, "You will be called to [face] a people of great military might; you may fight them, or they will submit. So if you obey, Allah will give you a good reward; but if you turn away as you turned away before, He will punish you with a painful punishment."
Pickthall: Say unto those of the wandering Arabs who were left behind: Ye will be called against a folk of mighty prowess, to fight them until they surrender; and if ye obey, Allah will give you a fair reward; but if ye turn away as ye did turn away before, He will punish you with a painful doom.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Say to the desert Arabs who lagged behind: "Ye shall be summoned (to fight) against a people given to vehement war: then shall ye fight, or they shall submit. Then if ye show obedience, Allah will grant you a goodly reward, but if ye turn back as ye did before, He will punish you with a grievous Penalty."
Shakir: Say to those of the dwellers of the desert who were left behind: You shall soon be invited (to fight) against a people possessing mighty prowess; you will fight against them until they submit; then if you obey, Allah will grant you a good reward; and if you turn back as you turned back before, He will punish you with a painful punishment.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Tell the laggardly Bedouins, "You will be called to face strong people whom you will fight right to the end or who will submit to you. If you obey the Messenger, God will give you a good reward. But if you turn away as you did before, God will make you suffer a painful torment.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Say (O Muhammad SAW) to the bedouins who lagged behind: "You shall be called to fight against a people given to great warfare, then you shall fight them, or they shall surrender. Then if you obey, Allah will give you a fair reward, but if you turn away as you did turn away before, He will punish you with a painful torment."
Arberry: Say to the Bedouins who were left behind: 'You shall be called against a people possessed of great might' to fight them, or they surrender. If you obey, God will give you a goodly wage; but if you turn your backs, as you turned your backs before, He will chastise you with a painful chastisement.'
Label: anger

Verse_diac: وَفَدَيۡنَٰهُ بِذِبۡحٍ عَظِيمٖ
Verse: وفدينٰه بذبح عظيم
Sahih_International: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice,
Pickthall: Then We ransomed him with a tremendous victim.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And We ransomed him with a momentous sacrifice:
Shakir: And We ransomed him with a Feat sacrifice.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We ransomed his son with a great sacrifice
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice (i.e. ?EO - a ram);
Arberry: And We ransomed him with a mighty sacrifice,
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: ۞قُلۡ كُونُواْ حِجَارَةً أَوۡ حَدِيدًا
Verse: قل كونوا حجارة او حديدا
Sahih_International: Say, "Be you stones or iron
Pickthall: Say: Be ye stones or iron
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Say: "(Nay!) be ye stones or iron,
Shakir: Say: Become stones or iron,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): (Muhammad), say "Yes, even if you become rocks, iron,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Say (O Muhammad SAW) "Be you stones or iron,"
Arberry: Say: 'Let you be stones, or iron,
Label: anger

Verse_diac: وَنَضَعُ ٱلۡمَوَٰزِينَ ٱلۡقِسۡطَ لِيَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ فَلَا تُظۡلَمُ نَفۡسٞ شَيۡـٔٗاۖ وَإِن كَانَ مِثۡقَالَ حَبَّةٖ مِّنۡ خَرۡدَلٍ أَتَيۡنَا بِهَاۗ وَكَفَىٰ بِنَا حَٰسِبِينَ
Verse: ونضع الموٰزين القسط ليوم القيٰمة فلا تظلم نفس شيا وان كان مثقال حبة من خردل اتينا بها وكفىٰ بنا حٰسبين
Sahih_International: And We place the scales of justice for the Day of Resurrection, so no soul will be treated unjustly at all. And if there is [even] the weight of a mustard seed, We will bring it forth. And sufficient are We as accountant.
Pickthall: And We set a just balance for the Day of Resurrection so that no soul is wronged in aught. Though it be of the weight of a grain of mustard seed, We bring it. And We suffice for reckoners.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): We shall set up scales of justice for the Day of Judgment, so that not a soul will be dealt with unjustly in the least, and if there be (no more than) the weight of a mustard seed, We will bring it (to account): and enough are We to take account.
Shakir: And We will set up a just balance on the day of resurrection, so no soul shall be dealt with unjustly in the least; and though there be the weight of a grain of mustard seed, (yet) will We bring it, and sufficient are We to take account.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We shall maintain proper justice on the Day of Judgment. No soul will be wronged the least. For a deed even as small as a mustard seed one will duly be recompensed. We are efficient in maintaining the account.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And We shall set up balances of justice on the Day of Resurrection, then none will be dealt with unjustly in anything. And if there be the weight of a mustard seed, We will bring it. And Sufficient are We as Reckoners.
Arberry: And We shall set up the just balances for the Resurrection Day, so that not one soul shall be wronged anything; even if it be the weight of one grain of mustard-seed We shall produce it, and sufficient are We for reckoners.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ وَمَاتُواْ وَهُمۡ كُفَّارٌ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ لَعۡنَةُ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ أَجۡمَعِينَ
Verse: ان الذين كفروا وماتوا وهم كفار اولٰئك عليهم لعنة الله والملٰئكة والناس اجمعين
Sahih_International: Indeed, those who disbelieve and die while they are disbelievers - upon them will be the curse of Allah and of the angels and the people, all together,
Pickthall: Lo! Those who disbelieve, and die while they are disbelievers; on them is the curse of Allah and of angels and of men combined.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Those who reject Faith, and die rejecting,- on them is Allah's curse, and the curse of angels, and of all mankind;
Shakir: Surely those who disbelieve and die while they are disbelievers, these it is on whom is the curse of Allah and the angels and men all;
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Those who deny My existence and die with such attitude will be subject to the condemnation of God, the angels, and all people.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Verily, those who disbelieve, and die while they are disbelievers, it is they on whom is the Curse of Allah and of the angels and of mankind, combined.
Arberry: But those who disbelieve, and die disbelieving -- upon them shall rest the curse of God and the angels, and of men altogether,
Label: anger

Verse_diac: كَانُواْ لَا يَتَنَاهَوۡنَ عَن مُّنكَرٖ فَعَلُوهُۚ لَبِئۡسَ مَا كَانُواْ يَفۡعَلُونَ
Verse: كانوا لا يتناهون عن منكر فعلوه لبئس ما كانوا يفعلون
Sahih_International: They used not to prevent one another from wrongdoing that they did. How wretched was that which they were doing.
Pickthall: They restrained not one another from the wickedness they did. Verily evil was that they used to do!
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Nor did they (usually) forbid one another the iniquities which they committed: evil indeed were the deeds which they did.
Shakir: They used not to forbid each other the hateful things (which) they did; certainly evil was that which they did.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): They did not prevent each other from committing sins nor would they themselves stay away from them. Evil was what they had done!
Mohsin_Khan (MK): They used not to forbid one another from the Munkar (wrong, evil­doing, sins, polytheism, disbelief, etc.) which they committed. Vile indeed was what they used to do.
Arberry: They forbade not one another any dishonour that they committed; surely evil were the things they did.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: مَآ أَصَابَ مِن مُّصِيبَةٖ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَا فِيٓ أَنفُسِكُمۡ إِلَّا فِي كِتَٰبٖ مِّن قَبۡلِ أَن نَّبۡرَأَهَآۚ إِنَّ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ يَسِيرٞ
Verse: ما اصاب من مصيبة في الارض ولا في انفسكم الا في كتٰب من قبل ان نبراها ان ذٰلك على الله يسير
Sahih_International: No disaster strikes upon the earth or among yourselves except that it is in a register before We bring it into being - indeed that, for Allah , is easy -
Pickthall: Naught of disaster befalleth in the earth or in yourselves but it is in a Book before we bring it into being - Lo! that is easy for Allah -
Yusuf_Ali (YA): No misfortune can happen on earth or in your souls but is recorded in a decree before We bring it into existence: That is truly easy for Allah:
Shakir: No evil befalls on the earth nor in your own souls, but it is in a book before We bring it into existence; surely that is easy to Allah:
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Whatever hardships you face on earth and in your souls were written in the Book before the creation of the souls. This is certainly easy for God
Mohsin_Khan (MK): No calamity befalls on the earth or in yourselves but is inscribed in the Book of Decrees (Al-Lauh Al-Mahfuz), before We bring it into existence. Verily, that is easy for Allah.
Arberry: No affliction befalls in the earth or in yourselves, but it is in a Book, before We create it; that is easy for God;
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: وَيَوۡمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَتَفَرَّقُونَ
Verse: ويوم تقوم الساعة يومئذ يتفرقون
Sahih_International: And the Day the Hour appears - that Day they will become separated.
Pickthall: In the day when the Hour cometh, in that day they will be sundered.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): On the Day that the Hour will be established,- that Day shall (all men) be sorted out.
Shakir: And at the time when the hour shall come, at that time they shall become separated one from the other.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): When that day comes, (people) will be separated from one another.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And on the Day when the Hour will be established, that Day shall (all men) be separated (i.e the believers will be separated from the disbelievers).
Arberry: Upon the day when the Hour is come, that day they shall be divided;
Label: fear

Verse_diac: إِنَّهُمۡ كَانُواْ لَا يَرۡجُونَ حِسَابٗا
Verse: انهم كانوا لا يرجون حسابا
Sahih_International: Indeed, they were not expecting an account
Pickthall: For lo! they looked not for a reckoning;
Yusuf_Ali (YA): For that they used not to fear any account (for their deeds),
Shakir: Surely they feared not the account,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): They did not expect such a Judgment
Mohsin_Khan (MK): For verily, they used not to look for a reckoning.
Arberry: They indeed hoped not for a reckoning,
Label: anger

Verse_diac: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَٰكَ سَبۡعٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡمَثَانِي وَٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ ٱلۡعَظِيمَ
Verse: ولقد ءاتينٰك سبعا من المثاني والقرءان العظيم
Sahih_International: And We have certainly given you, [O Muhammad], seven of the often repeated [verses] and the great Qur'an.
Pickthall: We have given thee seven of the oft-repeated (verses) and the great Qur'an.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And We have bestowed upon thee the Seven Oft-repeated (verses) and the Grand Qur'an.
Shakir: And certainly We have given you seven of the oft-repeated (verses) and the grand Quran.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): (Muhammad), We have given you the seven most repeated (verses) and the great Quran.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And indeed, We have bestowed upon you seven of Al-Mathani (the seven repeatedly recited Verses), (i.e. Surat Al-Fatiha) and the Grand Quran.
Arberry: We have given thee seven of the oft-repeated, and the mighty Koran.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: مَّن يُطِعِ ٱلرَّسُولَ فَقَدۡ أَطَاعَ ٱللَّهَۖ وَمَن تَوَلَّىٰ فَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰكَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ حَفِيظٗا
Verse: من يطع الرسول فقد اطاع الله ومن تولىٰ فما ارسلنٰك عليهم حفيظا
Sahih_International: He who obeys the Messenger has obeyed Allah ; but those who turn away - We have not sent you over them as a guardian.
Pickthall: Whoso obeyeth the messenger hath obeyed Allah, and whoso turneth away: We have not sent thee as a warder over them.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): He who obeys the Messenger, obeys Allah: But if any turn away, We have not sent thee to watch over their (evil deeds).
Shakir: Whoever obeys the Messenger, he indeed obeys Allah, and whoever turns back, so We have not sent you as a keeper over them.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): One who obeys the Messenger has certainly obeyed God. You have not been sent to watch over those who turn away from you.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): He who obeys the Messenger (Muhammad SAW), has indeed obeyed Allah, but he who turns away, then we have not sent you (O Muhammad SAW) as a watcher over them.
Arberry: Whosoever obeys the Messenger, thereby obeys God; and whosoever turns his back - We have not sent thee to be a watcher over them.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: أَصۡطَفَى ٱلۡبَنَاتِ عَلَى ٱلۡبَنِينَ
Verse: اصطفى البنات على البنين
Sahih_International: Has He chosen daughters over sons?
Pickthall: (And again of their falsehood): He hath preferred daughters to sons.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Did He (then) choose daughters rather than sons?
Shakir: Has He chosen daughters in preference to sons?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Has He chosen daughters in preference to sons?
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Has He (then) chosen daughters rather than sons?
Arberry: Has He chosen daughters above sons?
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: وَمَا يَأۡتِيهِم مِّن نَّبِيٍّ إِلَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
Verse: وما ياتيهم من نبي الا كانوا به يستهزءون
Sahih_International: But there would not come to them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him.
Pickthall: And never came there unto them a prophet but they used to mock him.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And never came there a prophet to them but they mocked him.
Shakir: And there came not to them a prophet but they mocked at him.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): No Prophet came to them whom they did not mock.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And never came there a Prophet to them but they used to mock at him.
Arberry: but not a Prophet came to them, without they mocked at him;
Label: anger

Verse_diac: ٱلَّذِي يُوَسۡوِسُ فِي صُدُورِ ٱلنَّاسِ
Verse: الذي يوسوس في صدور الناس
Sahih_International: Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind -
Pickthall: Who whispereth in the hearts of mankind,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): (The same) who whispers into the hearts of Mankind,-
Shakir: Who whispers into the hearts of men,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): of jinn and human beings
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "Who whispers in the breasts of mankind,
Arberry: who whispers in the breasts of men
Label: anger

Verse_diac: فَأَسۡرِ بِعِبَادِي لَيۡلًا إِنَّكُم مُّتَّبَعُونَ
Verse: فاسر بعبادي ليلا انكم متبعون
Sahih_International: [Allah said], "Then set out with My servants by night. Indeed, you are to be pursued.
Pickthall: Then (his Lord commanded): Take away My slaves by night. Lo! ye will be followed,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): (The reply came:) "March forth with My Servants by night: for ye are sure to be pursued.
Shakir: So go forth with My servants by night; surely you will be pursued:
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We told him, "Leave the city with My servants during the night. You will be pursued.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): (Allah said): "Depart you with My slaves by night. Surely, you will be pursued.
Arberry: 'Then set thou forth with My servants in a watch of the night; surely you will be followed.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: لِيَوۡمٍ عَظِيمٖ
Verse: ليوم عظيم
Sahih_International: For a tremendous Day -
Pickthall: Unto an Awful Day,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): On a Mighty Day,
Shakir: For a mighty day,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): on a great day
Mohsin_Khan (MK): On a Great Day,
Arberry: unto a mighty day
Label: fear

Verse_diac: إِنَّ لَكَ فِي ٱلنَّهَارِ سَبۡحٗا طَوِيلٗا
Verse: ان لك في النهار سبحا طويلا
Sahih_International: Indeed, for you by day is prolonged occupation.
Pickthall: Lo! thou hast by day a chain of business.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): True, there is for thee by day prolonged occupation with ordinary duties:
Shakir: Surely you have in the day time a long occupation.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): During the day, you are preoccupied with many activities.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Verily, there is for you by day prolonged occupation with ordinary duties,
Arberry: surely in the day thou hast long business.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: أَعِندَهُۥ عِلۡمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ فَهُوَ يَرَىٰٓ
Verse: اعنده علم الغيب فهو يرىٰ
Sahih_International: Does he have knowledge of the unseen, so he sees?
Pickthall: Hath he knowledge of the Unseen so that he seeth?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): What! Has he knowledge of the Unseen so that he can see?
Shakir: Has he the knowledge of the unseen so that he can see?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Does he possess the knowledge of the unseen, thus, he sees (all things)?
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Is with him the knowledge of the unseen so that he sees?
Arberry: Does he possess the knowledge of the Unseen, and therefore he sees?
Label: anger
