Verse_diac: مَن جَآءَ بِٱلۡحَسَنَةِ فَلَهُۥ خَيۡرٞ مِّنۡهَاۖ وَمَن جَآءَ بِٱلسَّيِّئَةِ فَلَا يُجۡزَى ٱلَّذِينَ عَمِلُواْ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ إِلَّا مَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
Verse: من جاء بالحسنة فله خير منها ومن جاء بالسيئة فلا يجزى الذين عملوا السيات الا ما كانوا يعملون
Sahih_International: Whoever comes [on the Day of Judgement] with a good deed will have better than it; and whoever comes with an evil deed - then those who did evil deeds will not be recompensed except [as much as] what they used to do.
Pickthall: Whoso bringeth a good deed, he will have better than the same; while as for him who bringeth an ill-deed, those who do ill-deeds will be requited only what they did.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): If any does good, the reward to him is better than his deed; but if any does evil, the doers of evil are only punished (to the extent) of their deeds.
Shakir: Whoever brings good, he shall have better than it, and whoever brings evil, those who do evil shall not be rewarded (for) aught except what they did.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): The reward for a good deed will be greater than the deed itself and the recompense for an evil deed will be equivalent to the deed.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Whosoever brings good (Islamic Monotheism along with righteous deeds), he shall have the better thereof, and whosoever brings evil (polytheism along with evil deeds) then, those who do evil deeds will only be requited for what they used to do.
Arberry: Whoso brings a good deed shall have better than it; and whoso brings an evil deed those who have done evil deeds shall only be recompensed for that they were doing.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: وَيَٰقَوۡمِ مَن يَنصُرُنِي مِنَ ٱللَّهِ إِن طَرَدتُّهُمۡۚ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
Verse: ويٰقوم من ينصرني من الله ان طردتهم افلا تذكرون
Sahih_International: And O my people, who would protect me from Allah if I drove them away? Then will you not be reminded?
Pickthall: And, O my people! who would deliver me from Allah if I thrust them away? Will ye not then reflect?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "And O my people! who would help me against Allah if I drove them away? Will ye not then take heed?
Shakir: And, O my people! who will help me against Allah if I drive them away? Will you not then mind?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): My people, who would protect me against God if I were to drive these people away? Will you then not take heed?
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "And O my people! Who will help me against Allah, if I drove them away? Will you not then give a thought?
Arberry: O my people, who would help me against God, if I drive you away?
Label: anger

Verse_diac: قُلۡ يَٰعِبَادِ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱتَّقُواْ رَبَّكُمۡۚ لِلَّذِينَ أَحۡسَنُواْ فِي هَٰذِهِ ٱلدُّنۡيَا حَسَنَةٞۗ وَأَرۡضُ ٱللَّهِ وَٰسِعَةٌۗ إِنَّمَا يُوَفَّى ٱلصَّٰبِرُونَ أَجۡرَهُم بِغَيۡرِ حِسَابٖ
Verse: قل يٰعباد الذين ءامنوا اتقوا ربكم للذين احسنوا في هٰذه الدنيا حسنة وارض الله وٰسعة انما يوفى الصٰبرون اجرهم بغير حساب
Sahih_International: Say, "O My servants who have believed, fear your Lord. For those who do good in this world is good, and the earth of Allah is spacious. Indeed, the patient will be given their reward without account."
Pickthall: Say: O My bondmen who believe! Observe your duty to your Lord. For those who do good in this world there is good, and Allah's earth is spacious. Verily the steadfast will be paid their wages without stint.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Say: "O ye my servants who believe! Fear your Lord, good is (the reward) for those who do good in this world. Spacious is Allah's earth! those who patiently persevere will truly receive a reward without measure!"
Shakir: Say: O my servants who believe! be careful of (your duty to) your Lord; for those who do good in this world is good, and Allah's earth is spacious; only the patient will be paid back their reward in full without measure.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Say to My believing servants, "Have fear of your Lord. Those who act righteously in this life will receive good reward. The land of God is vast. God will recompense the deeds of those who have exercised patience, without keeping an account".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Say (O Muhammad SAW): "O My slaves who believe (in the Oneness of Allah Islamic Monotheism), be afraid of your Lord (Allah) and keep your duty to Him. Good is (the reward) for those who do good in this world, and Allah's earth is spacious (so if you cannot worship Allah at a place, then go to another)! Only those who are patient shall receive their rewards in full, without reckoning."
Arberry: Say: 'My servants who believe, fear your Lord. For those who do good in this world good, and God's earth is wide. Surely the patient will be paid their wages in full without reckoning.'
Label: joy

Verse_diac: فَذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلۡحَقُّۖ فَمَاذَا بَعۡدَ ٱلۡحَقِّ إِلَّا ٱلضَّلَٰلُۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُصۡرَفُونَ
Verse: فذٰلكم الله ربكم الحق فماذا بعد الحق الا الضلٰل فانىٰ تصرفون
Sahih_International: For that is Allah , your Lord, the Truth. And what can be beyond truth except error? So how are you averted?
Pickthall: Such then is Allah, your rightful Lord. After the Truth what is there saving error? How then are ye turned away!
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Such is Allah, your real Cherisher and Sustainer: apart from truth, what (remains) but error? How then are ye turned away?
Shakir: This then is Allah, your true Lord; and what is there after the truth but error; how are you then turned back?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Thus is God your true Lord. In the absence of truth there is nothing but falsehood. Then where are you turning?
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Such is Allah, your Lord in truth. So after the truth, what else can there be, save error? How then are you turned away?
Arberry: That then is God, your Lord, the True; what is there, after truth, but error? Then how are you turned about?
Label: anger

Verse_diac: قُلۡ مَا كُنتُ بِدۡعٗا مِّنَ ٱلرُّسُلِ وَمَآ أَدۡرِي مَا يُفۡعَلُ بِي وَلَا بِكُمۡۖ إِنۡ أَتَّبِعُ إِلَّا مَا يُوحَىٰٓ إِلَيَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ إِلَّا نَذِيرٞ مُّبِينٞ
Verse: قل ما كنت بدعا من الرسل وما ادري ما يفعل بي ولا بكم ان اتبع الا ما يوحىٰ الي وما انا الا نذير مبين
Sahih_International: Say, "I am not something original among the messengers, nor do I know what will be done with me or with you. I only follow that which is revealed to me, and I am not but a clear warner."
Pickthall: Say: I am no new thing among the messengers (of Allah), nor know I what will be done with me or with you. I do but follow that which is inspired in me, and I am but a plain warner.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Say: "I am no bringer of new-fangled doctrine among the messengers, nor do I know what will be done with me or with you. I follow but that which is revealed to me by inspiration; I am but a Warner open and clear."
Shakir: Say: I am not the first of the messengers, and I do not know what will be done with me or with you: I do not follow anything but that which is revealed to me, and I am nothing but a plain warner.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Say, "I am not the first Messenger. I do not know what will be done to me or to you. I follow only what has been revealed to me and my duty is only to give clear warning".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Say (O Muhammad SAW):"I am not a new thing among the Messengers (of Allah) (i.e. I am not the first Messenger) nor do I know what will be done with me or with you. I only follow that which is revealed to me, and I am but a plain warner."
Arberry: Say: 'I am not an innovation among the Messengers, and I know not what shall be done with me or with you. I only follow what is revealed to me; I am only a clear warner.'
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: رِّزۡقٗا لِّلۡعِبَادِۖ وَأَحۡيَيۡنَا بِهِۦ بَلۡدَةٗ مَّيۡتٗاۚ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡخُرُوجُ
Verse: رزقا للعباد واحيينا به بلدة ميتا كذٰلك الخروج
Sahih_International: As provision for the servants, and We have given life thereby to a dead land. Thus is the resurrection.
Pickthall: Provision (made) for men; and therewith We quicken a dead land. Even so will be the resurrection of the dead.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): As sustenance for (Allah's) Servants;- and We give (new) life therewith to land that is dead: Thus will be the Resurrection.
Shakir: A sustenance for the servants, and We give life thereby to a dead land; thus is the rising.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): as sustenance for My servants. With this We have brought the dead land back to life. Thus, will also be your resurrection.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): A provision for (Allah's) slaves. And We give life therewith to a dead land. Thus will be the resurrection (of the dead).
Arberry: a provision for the servants, and thereby We revived a land that was dead. Even so is the coming forth.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: فَجَعَلۡنَا عَٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمۡطَرۡنَا عَلَيۡهِمۡ حِجَارَةٗ مِّن سِجِّيلٍ
Verse: فجعلنا عٰليها سافلها وامطرنا عليهم حجارة من سجيل
Sahih_International: And We made the highest part [of the city] its lowest and rained upon them stones of hard clay.
Pickthall: And We utterly confounded them, and We rained upon them stones of heated clay.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And We turned (the cities) upside down, and rained down on them brimstones hard as baked clay.
Shakir: Thus did We turn it upside down, and rained down upon them stones of what had been decreed.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We turned the town upside-down and showered on them lumps of baked clay.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And We turned (the towns of Sodom in Palestine) upside down and rained down on them stones of baked clay.
Arberry: and We turned it uppermost nethermost and rained on it stones of baked clay.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَوُجُوهٞ يَوۡمَئِذٍ عَلَيۡهَا غَبَرَةٞ
Verse: ووجوه يومئذ عليها غبرة
Sahih_International: And [other] faces, that Day, will have upon them dust.
Pickthall: And other faces, on that day, with dust upon them,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And other faces that Day will be dust-stained,
Shakir: And (many) faces on that day, on them shall be dust,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): but others will be gloomy
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And other faces, that Day, will be dust-stained;
Arberry: some faces on that day shall be dusty
Label: fear

Verse_diac: بَلَىٰٓۚ إِنَّ رَبَّهُۥ كَانَ بِهِۦ بَصِيرٗا
Verse: بلىٰ ان ربه كان به بصيرا
Sahih_International: But yes! Indeed, his Lord was ever of him, Seeing.
Pickthall: Nay, but lo! his Lord is ever looking on him!
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Nay, nay! for his Lord was (ever) watchful of him!
Shakir: Yea! surely his Lord does ever see him.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): This is a fact. Their Lord is Well-Aware of (all that they do).
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Yes! Verily, his Lord has been ever beholding him!
Arberry: Yes indeed; his Lord had sight of him.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: إِلَىٰ فِرۡعَوۡنَ وَهَٰمَٰنَ وَقَٰرُونَ فَقَالُواْ سَٰحِرٞ كَذَّابٞ
Verse: الىٰ فرعون وهٰمٰن وقٰرون فقالوا سٰحر كذاب
Sahih_International: To Pharaoh, Haman and Qarun; but they said, "[He is] a magician and a liar."
Pickthall: Unto Pharaoh and Haman and Korah, but they said: A lying sorcerer!
Yusuf_Ali (YA): To Pharaoh, Haman, and Qarun; but they called (him)" a sorcerer telling lies!"...
Shakir: To Firon and Haman and Qaroun, but they said: A lying magician.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): to the Pharaoh, Haman, and Korah, who said, "He is only a lying magician.".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): To Fir'aun (Pharaoh), Haman and Qarun (Korah), but they called (him): "A sorcerer, a liar!"
Arberry: to Pharaoh, Haman and Korah; they said, 'A lying sorcerer!'
Label: anger

Verse_diac: لَهُم مِّن جَهَنَّمَ مِهَادٞ وَمِن فَوۡقِهِمۡ غَوَاشٖۚ وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجۡزِي ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
Verse: لهم من جهنم مهاد ومن فوقهم غواش وكذٰلك نجزي الظٰلمين
Sahih_International: They will have from Hell a bed and over them coverings [of fire]. And thus do We recompense the wrongdoers.
Pickthall: Theirs will be a bed of hell, and over them coverings (of hell). Thus do We requite wrong-doers.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): For them there is Hell, as a couch (below) and folds and folds of covering above: such is Our requital of those who do wrong.
Shakir: They shall have a bed of hell-fire and from above them coverings (of it); and thus do We reward the unjust.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): For them, hell will be both a cradle and a blanket. Thus do We punish the unjust.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Theirs will be a bed of Hell (Fire), and over them coverings (of Hell-fire). Thus do We recompense the Zalimun (polytheists and wrong­doers, etc.).
Arberry: Gehenna shall be their cradle, above them coverings. Even so We recompense the evildoers.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: عَلِمَتۡ نَفۡسٞ مَّآ أَحۡضَرَتۡ
Verse: علمت نفس ما احضرت
Sahih_International: A soul will [then] know what it has brought [with it].
Pickthall: (Then) every soul will know what it hath made ready.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): (Then) shall each soul know what it has put forward.
Shakir: Every soul shall (then) know what it has prepared.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): then every soul will discover the consequence of its deeds.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): (Then) every person will know what he has brought (of good and evil).
Arberry: then shall a soul know what it has produced.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: وَٱلَّذِينَ جَٰهَدُواْ فِينَا لَنَهۡدِيَنَّهُمۡ سُبُلَنَاۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَمَعَ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
Verse: والذين جٰهدوا فينا لنهدينهم سبلنا وان الله لمع المحسنين
Sahih_International: And those who strive for Us - We will surely guide them to Our ways. And indeed, Allah is with the doers of good.
Pickthall: As for those who strive in Us, We surely guide them to Our paths, and lo! Allah is with the good.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And those who strive in Our (cause),- We will certainly guide them to our Paths: For verily Allah is with those who do right.
Shakir: And (as for) those who strive hard for Us, We will most certainly guide them in Our ways; and Allah is most surely with the doers of good.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We shall certainly guide those who strive for Our cause to Our path. God is certainly with the righteous ones.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): As for those who strive hard in Us (Our Cause), We will surely guide them to Our Paths (i.e. Allah's Religion - Islamic Monotheism). And verily, Allah is with the Muhsinun (good doers)."
Arberry: But those who struggle in Our cause, surely We shall guide them in Our ways; and God is with the good-doers.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: لِّئَلَّا يَعۡلَمَ أَهۡلُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ أَلَّا يَقۡدِرُونَ عَلَىٰ شَيۡءٖ مِّن فَضۡلِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَنَّ ٱلۡفَضۡلَ بِيَدِ ٱللَّهِ يُؤۡتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُۚ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلۡفَضۡلِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
Verse: لئلا يعلم اهل الكتٰب الا يقدرون علىٰ شيء من فضل الله وان الفضل بيد الله يؤتيه من يشاء والله ذو الفضل العظيم
Sahih_International: [This is] so that the People of the Scripture may know that they are not able [to obtain] anything from the bounty of Allah and that [all] bounty is in the hand of Allah ; He gives it to whom He wills. And Allah is the possessor of great bounty.
Pickthall: That the People of the Scripture may know that they control naught of the bounty of Allah, but that the bounty is in Allah's hand to give to whom He will. And Allah is of Infinite Bounty.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): That the People of the Book may know that they have no power whatever over the Grace of Allah, that (His) Grace is (entirely) in His Hand, to bestow it on whomsoever He wills. For Allah is the Lord of Grace abounding.
Shakir: So that the followers of the Book may know that they do not control aught of the grace of Allah, and that grace is in Allah's hand, He gives it to whom He pleases; and Allah is the Lord of mighty grace.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): (Have fear of God and believe in His Messenger) so that the followers of the Bible will know that they can receive no reward from God. They should know that all favors are in the hands of God. He grants them to whomever He wants. The favors of God are great.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): So that the people of the Scripture (Jews and Christians) may know that they have no power whatsoever over the Grace of Allah, and that (His) Grace is (entirely) in His Hand to bestow it on whomsoever He wills. And Allah is the Owner of Great Bounty.
Arberry: that the People of the Book may know that they have no power over anything of God's bounty, and that bounty is in the hand of God; He gives it unto whomsoever He will; and God is of bounty abounding.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ ٱذۡكُرُواْ نِعۡمَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيۡكُمۡۚ هَلۡ مِنۡ خَٰلِقٍ غَيۡرُ ٱللَّهِ يَرۡزُقُكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۚ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ فَأَنَّىٰ تُؤۡفَكُونَ
Verse: يٰايها الناس اذكروا نعمت الله عليكم هل من خٰلق غير الله يرزقكم من السماء والارض لا الٰه الا هو فانىٰ تؤفكون
Sahih_International: O mankind, remember the favor of Allah upon you. Is there any creator other than Allah who provides for you from the heaven and earth? There is no deity except Him, so how are you deluded?
Pickthall: O mankind! Remember Allah's grace toward you! Is there any creator other than Allah who provideth for you from the sky and the earth? There is no Allah save Him. Whither then are ye turned?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): O men! Call to mind the grace of Allah unto you! is there a creator, other than Allah, to give you sustenance from heaven or earth? There is no god but He: how then are ye deluded away from the Truth?
Shakir: O men! call to mind the favor of Allah on you; is there any creator besides Allah who gives you sustenance from the heaven and the earth? There is no god but He; whence are you then turned away?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): People, remember the bounty of God that He has granted to you. Is their any creator besides God who could provide you with sustenance from the heavens and the earth? He is the only God. Where then can you turn away?
Mohsin_Khan (MK): O mankind! Remember the Grace of Allah upon you! Is there any creator other than Allah who provides for you from the sky (rain) and the earth? La ilaha illa Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He). How then are you turning away (from Him)?
Arberry: O men, remember God's blessing upon you; is there any creator, apart from God, who provides for you out of heaven and earth? There is no god but He: how then are you perverted?
Label: joy

Verse_diac: فَأَخَذَتۡهُمُ ٱلصَّيۡحَةُ مُشۡرِقِينَ
Verse: فاخذتهم الصيحة مشرقين
Sahih_International: So the shriek seized them at sunrise.
Pickthall: Then the (Awful) Cry overtook them at the sunrise.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): But the (mighty) Blast overtook them before morning,
Shakir: So the rumbling overtook them (while) entering upon the time of sunrise;
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): An explosion struck them at sunrise.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): So As-Saihah (torment - awful cry, etc.) overtook them at the time of sunrise;
Arberry: and the Cry seized them at the sunrise,
Label: anger

Verse_diac: هَٰذَا بَلَٰغٞ لِّلنَّاسِ وَلِيُنذَرُواْ بِهِۦ وَلِيَعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّمَا هُوَ إِلَٰهٞ وَٰحِدٞ وَلِيَذَّكَّرَ أُوْلُواْ ٱلۡأَلۡبَٰبِ
Verse: هٰذا بلٰغ للناس ولينذروا به وليعلموا انما هو الٰه وٰحد وليذكر اولوا الالبٰب
Sahih_International: This [Qur’an] is notification for the people that they may be warned thereby and that they may know that He is but one God and that those of understanding will be reminded.
Pickthall: This is a clear message for mankind in order that they may be warned thereby, and that they may know that He is only One Allah, and that men of understanding may take heed.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Here is a Message for mankind: Let them take warning therefrom, and let them know that He is (no other than) One Allah: let men of understanding take heed.
Shakir: This is a sufficient exposition for the people and that they may be warned thereby, and that they may know that He is One Allah and that those possessed of understanding may mind.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): This is an admonition for the people that they will be warned and know that He is the only God, and so that the people of understanding may take heed.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): This (Quran) is a Message for mankind (and a clear proof against them), in order that they may be warned thereby, and that they may know that He is the only One Ilah (God - Allah) - (none has the right to be worshipped but Allah), and that men of understanding may take heed.
Arberry: This is a Message to be delivered to mankind that they may be warned by it, and that they may know that He is One God, and that all possessed of minds may remember.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: أَلَمۡ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَٰدِلُونَ فِيٓ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ أَنَّىٰ يُصۡرَفُونَ
Verse: الم تر الى الذين يجٰدلون في ءايٰت الله انىٰ يصرفون
Sahih_International: Do you not consider those who dispute concerning the signs of Allah - how are they averted?
Pickthall: Hast thou not seen those who wrangle concerning the revelations of Allah, how they are turned away? -
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Seest thou not those that dispute concerning the Signs of Allah? How are they turned away (from Reality)?-
Shakir: Have you not seen those who dispute with respect to the communications of Allah: how are they turned away?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Have you not seen how those who dispute the revelations of God, turn away from Truth to falsehood?
Mohsin_Khan (MK): See you not those who dispute about the Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) of Allah? How are they turning away (from the truth, i.e. Islamic Monotheism to the falsehood of polytheism)?
Arberry: Hast thou not regarded those who dispute concerning the signs of God, how they are turned about?
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: ٱللَّهُ يَبۡدَؤُاْ ٱلۡخَلۡقَ ثُمَّ يُعِيدُهُۥ ثُمَّ إِلَيۡهِ تُرۡجَعُونَ
Verse: الله يبدؤا الخلق ثم يعيده ثم اليه ترجعون
Sahih_International: Allah begins creation; then He will repeat it; then to Him you will be returned.
Pickthall: Allah produceth creation, then He reproduceth it, then unto Him ye will be returned.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): It is Allah Who begins (the process of) creation; then repeats it; then shall ye be brought back to Him.
Shakir: Allah originates the creation, then reproduces it, then to Him you shall be brought back.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): God begins the creation then causes it to turn back and to Him you will all return.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Allah (Alone) originates the creation, then He will repeat it, then to Him you will be returned.
Arberry: God originates creation, then brings it back again, then unto Him you shall be returned.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: إِنَّ لَكُمۡ فِيهِ لَمَا تَخَيَّرُونَ
Verse: ان لكم فيه لما تخيرون
Sahih_International: That indeed for you is whatever you choose?
Pickthall: That ye shall indeed have all that ye choose?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): That ye shall have, through it whatever ye choose?
Shakir: That you have surely therein what you choose?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): that tells you to do whatever you want?
Mohsin_Khan (MK): That you shall have all that you choose?
Arberry: Surely therein you shall have whatever you choose!
Label: joy

Verse_diac: ٱنظُرۡ كَيۡفَ ضَرَبُواْ لَكَ ٱلۡأَمۡثَالَ فَضَلُّواْ فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ سَبِيلٗا
Verse: انظر كيف ضربوا لك الامثال فضلوا فلا يستطيعون سبيلا
Sahih_International: Look how they strike for you comparisons; but they have strayed, so they cannot [find] a way.
Pickthall: See what similitudes they coin for thee, and thus are all astray, and cannot find a road!
Yusuf_Ali (YA): See what similes they strike for thee: but they have gone astray, and never can they find a way.
Shakir: See what they liken you to! So they have gone astray and cannot find the way.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Consider what they have called you. They have certainly gone astray and cannot find the right path.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): See what examples they have put forward for you. So they have gone astray, and never can they find a way.
Arberry: Behold, how they strike similitudes for thee, and go astray, and cannot find a way!
Label: anger

Verse_diac: وَلَمۡ تَكُن لَّهُۥ فِئَةٞ يَنصُرُونَهُۥ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مُنتَصِرًا
Verse: ولم تكن له فئة ينصرونه من دون الله وما كان منتصرا
Sahih_International: And there was for him no company to aid him other than Allah , nor could he defend himself.
Pickthall: And he had no troop of men to help him as against Allah, nor could he save himself.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Nor had he numbers to help him against Allah, nor was he able to deliver himself.
Shakir: And he had no host to help him besides Allah nor could he defend himself.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): He had no one besides God to help him, nor could he himself achieve any success.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And he had no group of men to help him against Allah, nor could he defend or save himself.
Arberry: But there was no host to help him, apart from God, and he was helpless.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: هُوَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلۡمَلِكُ ٱلۡقُدُّوسُ ٱلسَّلَٰمُ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُ ٱلۡمُهَيۡمِنُ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡجَبَّارُ ٱلۡمُتَكَبِّرُۚ سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُونَ
Verse: هو الله الذي لا الٰه الا هو الملك القدوس السلٰم المؤمن المهيمن العزيز الجبار المتكبر سبحٰن الله عما يشركون
Sahih_International: He is Allah , other than whom there is no deity, the Sovereign, the Pure, the Perfection, the Bestower of Faith, the Overseer, the Exalted in Might, the Compeller, the Superior. Exalted is Allah above whatever they associate with Him.
Pickthall: He is Allah, than Whom there is no other Allah, the Sovereign Lord, the Holy One, Peace, the Keeper of Faith, the Guardian, the Majestic, the Compeller, the Superb. Glorified be Allah from all that they ascribe as partner (unto Him).
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Allah is He, than Whom there is no other god;- the Sovereign, the Holy One, the Source of Peace (and Perfection), the Guardian of Faith, the Preserver of Safety, the Exalted in Might, the Irresistible, the Supreme: Glory to Allah! (High is He) above the partners they attribute to Him.
Shakir: He is Allah, besides Whom there is no god; the King, the Holy, the Giver of peace, the Granter of security, Guardian over all, the Mighty, the Supreme, the Possessor of every greatness Glory be to Allah from what they set up (with Him).
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): He is the only Lord, the King, the Holy, the Peace, the Forgiver, the Watchful Guardian, the Majestic, the Dominant, and the Exalted. God is too exalted to have any partner.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): He is Allah than Whom there is La ilaha illa Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He) the King, the Holy, the One Free from all defects, the Giver of security, the Watcher over His creatures, the All-Mighty, the Compeller, the Supreme. Glory be to Allah! (High is He) above all that they associate as partners with Him.
Arberry: He is God; there is no god but He. He is the King, the All-holy, the All-peaceable, the All-faithful, the All-preserver, the All-mighty, the All-compeller, the All-sublime. Glory be to God, above that they associate!
Label: fear

Verse_diac: فَطَافَ عَلَيۡهَا طَآئِفٞ مِّن رَّبِّكَ وَهُمۡ نَآئِمُونَ
Verse: فطاف عليها طائف من ربك وهم نائمون
Sahih_International: So there came upon the garden an affliction from your Lord while they were asleep.
Pickthall: Then a visitation from thy Lord came upon it while they slept
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Then there came on the (garden) a visitation from thy Lord, (which swept away) all around, while they were asleep.
Shakir: Then there encompassed it a visitation from your Lord while they were sleeping.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): A visitor from your Lord circled around the garden during the night while they were asleep
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Then there passed by on the (garden) something (fire) from your Lord at night and burnt it while they were asleep.
Arberry: Then a visitation from thy Lord visited it, while they were sleeping,
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَلَقَدۡ صَدَّقَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ إِبۡلِيسُ ظَنَّهُۥ فَٱتَّبَعُوهُ إِلَّا فَرِيقٗا مِّنَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
Verse: ولقد صدق عليهم ابليس ظنه فاتبعوه الا فريقا من المؤمنين
Sahih_International: And Iblees had already confirmed through them his assumption, so they followed him, except for a party of believers.
Pickthall: And Satan indeed found his calculation true concerning them, for they follow him, all save a group of true believers.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And on them did Satan prove true his idea, and they followed him, all but a party that believed.
Shakir: And certainly the Shaitan found true his conjecture concerning them, so they follow him, except a party of the believers.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Iblis (satan) made his judgment about them to come true. They all followed them except a believing group among them.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And indeed Iblis (Satan) did prove true his thought about them, and they followed him, all except a group of true believers (in the Oneness of Allah).
Arberry: Iblis proved true his opinion of them, and they followed him, except a party of the believers.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: تَبَٰرَكَ ٱسۡمُ رَبِّكَ ذِي ٱلۡجَلَٰلِ وَٱلۡإِكۡرَامِ
Verse: تبٰرك اسم ربك ذي الجلٰل والاكرام
Sahih_International: Blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honor.
Pickthall: Blessed be the name of thy Lord, Mighty and glorious!
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Blessed be the name of thy Lord, full of Majesty, Bounty and Honour.
Shakir: Blessed be the name of your Lord, the Lord of Glory and Honor!
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Blessed is the Name of your Lord, the Lord of Glory and Grace.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Blessed be the Name of your Lord (Allah), the Owner of Majesty and Honour.
Arberry: Blessed be the Name of thy Lord, majestic, splendid.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَلَوۡلَآ أَن كَتَبَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡجَلَآءَ لَعَذَّبَهُمۡ فِي ٱلدُّنۡيَاۖ وَلَهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِ عَذَابُ ٱلنَّارِ
Verse: ولولا ان كتب الله عليهم الجلاء لعذبهم في الدنيا ولهم في الاخرة عذاب النار
Sahih_International: And if not that Allah had decreed for them evacuation, He would have punished them in [this] world, and for them in the Hereafter is the punishment of the Fire.
Pickthall: And if Allah had not decreed migration for them, He verily would have punished them in the world, and theirs in the Hereafter is the punishment of the Fire.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And had it not been that Allah had decreed banishment for them, He would certainly have punished them in this world: And in the Hereafter they shall (certainly) have the Punishment of the Fire.
Shakir: And had it not been that Allah had decreed for them the exile, He would certainly have punished them in this world, and in the hereafter they shall have chastisement of the fire.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Had God not decreed exile for them, He would have certainly punished them (in some other way). In this life and in the next life they would have suffered the torment of hell fire.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And had it not been that Allah had decreed exile for them, He would certainly have punished them in this world, and in the Hereafter theirs shall be the torment of the Fire.
Arberry: Had God not prescribed dispersal for them, He would have chastised them in this world; and there awaits them in the world to come the chastisement of the Fire.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ سَنُدۡخِلُهُمۡ جَنَّٰتٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدٗاۖ وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقّٗاۚ وَمَنۡ أَصۡدَقُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ قِيلٗا
Verse: والذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصٰلحٰت سندخلهم جنٰت تجري من تحتها الانهٰر خٰلدين فيها ابدا وعد الله حقا ومن اصدق من الله قيلا
Sahih_International: But the ones who believe and do righteous deeds - We will admit them to gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever. [It is] the promise of Allah , [which is] truth, and who is more truthful than Allah in statement.
Pickthall: But as for those who believe and do good works We shall bring them into Gardens underneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide for ever. It is a promise from Allah in truth; and who can be more truthful than Allah in utterance?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): But those who believe and do deeds of righteousness,- we shall soon admit them to gardens, with rivers flowing beneath,-to dwell therein for ever. Allah's promise is the truth, and whose word can be truer than Allah's?
Shakir: And (as for) those who believe and do good, We will make them enter into gardens beneath which rivers flow, to abide therein for ever; (it is) a promise of Allah, true (indeed), and who is truer of word than Allah?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We will admit the righteously striving believers to Paradise wherein streams flow and they will live therein forever. God's promise is true for no one is more truthful than Him.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): But those who believe (in the Oneness of Allah - Islamic Monotheism) and do deeds of righteousness, We shall admit them to the Gardens under which rivers flow (i.e. in Paradise) to dwell therein forever. Allah's Promise is the Truth, and whose words can be truer than those of Allah? (Of course, none).
Arberry: But those that believe, and do deeds of righteousness, them We shall admit to gardens underneath which rivers flow, therein dwelling for ever and ever; God's promise in truth; and who is truer in speech than God?
Label: joy

Verse_diac: فَمَا ظَنُّكُم بِرَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
Verse: فما ظنكم برب العٰلمين
Sahih_International: Then what is your thought about the Lord of the worlds?"
Pickthall: What then is your opinion of the Lord of the Worlds?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "Then what is your idea about the Lord of the worlds?"
Shakir: What is then your idea about the Lord of the worlds?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): What do you think about the Lord of the Universe?"
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "Then what do you think about the Lord of the 'Alamin (mankind, jinns, and all that exists)?"
Arberry: What think you then of the Lord of all Being?'
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَإِن لَّمۡ تُؤۡمِنُواْ لِي فَٱعۡتَزِلُونِ
Verse: وان لم تؤمنوا لي فاعتزلون
Sahih_International: But if you do not believe me, then leave me alone."
Pickthall: And if ye put no faith in me, then let me go.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "If ye believe me not, at least keep yourselves away from me."
Shakir: And if you do not believe in me, then leave me alone.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): If you do not want to believe, leave me alone".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "But if you believe me not, then keep away from me and leave me alone."
Arberry: 'But if so be that you believe me not, go you apart from me!'
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: بَلۡ يُرِيدُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ لِيَفۡجُرَ أَمَامَهُۥ
Verse: بل يريد الانسٰن ليفجر امامه
Sahih_International: But man desires to continue in sin.
Pickthall: But man would fain deny what is before him.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): But man wishes to do wrong (even) in the time in front of him.
Shakir: Nay! man desires to give the lie to what is before him.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): In fact, people want to have eternal life in this world.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Nay! (Man denies Resurrection and Reckoning. So) he desires to continue committing sins.
Arberry: Nay, but man desires to continue on as a libertine,
Label: fear

Verse_diac: قَالَ رَبِّ إِنِّي ظَلَمۡتُ نَفۡسِي فَٱغۡفِرۡ لِي فَغَفَرَ لَهُۥٓۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
Verse: قال رب اني ظلمت نفسي فاغفر لي فغفر له انه هو الغفور الرحيم
Sahih_International: He said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, so forgive me," and He forgave him. Indeed, He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.
Pickthall: He said: My Lord! Lo! I have wronged my soul, so forgive me. Then He forgave him. Lo! He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): He prayed: "O my Lord! I have indeed wronged my soul! Do Thou then forgive me!" So (Allah) forgave him: for He is the Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
Shakir: He said: My Lord! surely I have done harm to myself, so do Thou protect me. So He protected him; surely He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): (Moses) said, "Lord, I have wronged myself. Forgive me!" The Lord forgave him; He is All-forgiving and All-merciful.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): He said: "My Lord! Verily, I have wronged myself, so forgive me." Then He forgave him. Verily, He is the Oft-Forgiving, the Most Merciful.
Arberry: He said, 'My Lord, I have wronged myself. Forgive me!' So God forgave him, for He is the All-forgiving, the All-compassionate.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَبَشَّرۡنَٰهُ بِإِسۡحَٰقَ نَبِيّٗا مِّنَ ٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
Verse: وبشرنٰه باسحٰق نبيا من الصٰلحين
Sahih_International: And We gave him good tidings of Isaac, a prophet from among the righteous.
Pickthall: And we gave him tidings of the birth of Isaac, a prophet of the righteous.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And We gave him the good news of Isaac - a prophet,- one of the Righteous.
Shakir: And We gave him the good news of Ishaq, a prophet among the good ones.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We gave him the glad news of the birth of Isaac, one of the righteous Prophets.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And We gave him the glad tidings of Ishaque (Isaac) a Prophet from the righteous.
Arberry: Then We gave him the good tidings of Isaac, a Prophet, one of the righteous.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَقَالَتۡ لِأُخۡتِهِۦ قُصِّيهِۖ فَبَصُرَتۡ بِهِۦ عَن جُنُبٖ وَهُمۡ لَا يَشۡعُرُونَ
Verse: وقالت لاخته قصيه فبصرت به عن جنب وهم لا يشعرون
Sahih_International: And she said to his sister, "Follow him"; so she watched him from a distance while they perceived not.
Pickthall: And she said unto his sister: Trace him. So she observed him from afar, and they perceived not.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And she said to the sister of (Moses), "Follow him" so she (the sister) watched him in the character of a stranger. And they knew not.
Shakir: And she said to his sister: Follow him up. So she watched him from a distance while they did not perceive,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): She told Moses' sister to follow her brother. His sister watched him from one side and the people of the Pharaoh did not notice her presence.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And she said to his [Musa's (Moses)] sister: "Follow him." So she (his sister) watched him from a far place secretly, while they perceived not.
Arberry: and she said to his sister, 'Follow him,' and she perceived him from afar, even while they were not aware.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: مَن كَفَرَ فَعَلَيۡهِ كُفۡرُهُۥۖ وَمَنۡ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحٗا فَلِأَنفُسِهِمۡ يَمۡهَدُونَ
Verse: من كفر فعليه كفره ومن عمل صٰلحا فلانفسهم يمهدون
Sahih_International: Whoever disbelieves - upon him is [the consequence of] his disbelief. And whoever does righteousness - they are for themselves preparing,
Pickthall: Whoso disbelieveth must (then) bear the consequences of his disbelief, while those who do right make provision for themselves -
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Those who reject Faith will suffer from that rejection: and those who work righteousness will spread their couch (of repose) for themselves (in heaven):
Shakir: Whoever disbelieves, he shall be responsible for his disbelief, and whoever does good, they prepare (good) for their own souls,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Those who disbelieve do so against their own souls. Those who do good pave the way for their own benefit.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Whosoever disbelieves will suffer from his disbelief, and whosoever does righteous good deeds (by practising Islamic Monotheism), then such will prepare a good place (in Paradise) for themselves (and will be saved by Allah from His Torment).
Arberry: Whoso disbelieves, his unbelief shall be charged against him; and whosoever does righteousness for themselves they are making provision,
Label: fear

Verse_diac: قَالَ يَٰقَوۡمِ لَيۡسَ بِي ضَلَٰلَةٞ وَلَٰكِنِّي رَسُولٞ مِّن رَّبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
Verse: قال يٰقوم ليس بي ضلٰلة ولٰكني رسول من رب العٰلمين
Sahih_International: [Noah] said, "O my people, there is not error in me, but I am a messenger from the Lord of the worlds."
Pickthall: He said: O my people! There is no error in me, but I am a messenger from the Lord of the Worlds.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): He said: "O my people! No wandering is there in my (mind): on the contrary I am a messenger from the Lord and Cherisher of the worlds!
Shakir: He said: O my people! there is no error in me, but I am an messenger from the Lord of the worlds.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): (Noah) said, "My people, I am not in any error, rather I am a Messenger from the Lord of the Universe,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): [Nuh (Noah)] said: "O my people! There is no error in me, but I am a Messenger from the Lord of the 'Alamin (mankind, jinns and all that exists)!
Arberry: Said he, 'My people, there is no error in me; but I am a Messenger from the Lord of all Being.'
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: وَهُوَ ٱلَّذِيٓ أَنشَأَ لَكُمُ ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَٱلۡأَبۡصَٰرَ وَٱلۡأَفۡـِٔدَةَۚ قَلِيلٗا مَّا تَشۡكُرُونَ
Verse: وهو الذي انشا لكم السمع والابصٰر والافدة قليلا ما تشكرون
Sahih_International: And it is He who produced for you hearing and vision and hearts; little are you grateful.
Pickthall: He it is Who hath created for you ears and eyes and hearts. Small thanks give ye!
Yusuf_Ali (YA): It is He Who has created for you (the faculties of) hearing, sight, feeling and understanding: little thanks it is ye give!
Shakir: And He it is Who made for you the ears and the eyes and the hearts; little is it that you give thanks.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): It is God who has created ears, eyes, and hearts for you. Little are the thanks that you give.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): It is He, Who has created for you (the sense of) hearing (ears), sight (eyes), and hearts (understanding). Little thanks you give.
Arberry: It is He who produced for you hearing, and eyes, and hearts; little thanks you show.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: عَٰلِمُ ٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَٱلشَّهَٰدَةِ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
Verse: عٰلم الغيب والشهٰدة العزيز الحكيم
Sahih_International: Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
Pickthall: Knower of the Invisible and the Visible, the Mighty, the Wise.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Knower of what is open, Exalted in Might, Full of Wisdom.
Shakir: The Knower of the unseen and the seen, the Mighty, the Wise.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): He knows the unseen and the seen. He is the Majestic and All-wise.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): All-Knower of the unseen and seen, the All-Mighty, the All-Wise.
Arberry: Knower He of the Unseen and the Visible, the All-mighty, the All-wise.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: فَإِنَّهُمۡ يَوۡمَئِذٖ فِي ٱلۡعَذَابِ مُشۡتَرِكُونَ
Verse: فانهم يومئذ في العذاب مشتركون
Sahih_International: So indeed they, that Day, will be sharing in the punishment.
Pickthall: Then lo! this day they (both) are sharers in the doom.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Truly, that Day, they will (all) share in the Penalty.
Shakir: So they shall on that day be sharers in the chastisement one with another.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): On that day they will all share the torment.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Then verily, that Day, they will (all) share in the torment.
Arberry: So all of them on that day are sharers in the chastisement.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: حَٰفِظُواْ عَلَى ٱلصَّلَوَٰتِ وَٱلصَّلَوٰةِ ٱلۡوُسۡطَىٰ وَقُومُواْ لِلَّهِ قَٰنِتِينَ
Verse: حٰفظوا على الصلوٰت والصلوٰة الوسطىٰ وقوموا لله قٰنتين
Sahih_International: Maintain with care the [obligatory] prayers and [in particular] the middle prayer and stand before Allah , devoutly obedient.
Pickthall: Be guardians of your prayers, and of the midmost prayer, and stand up with devotion to Allah.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Guard strictly your (habit of) prayers, especially the Middle Prayer; and stand before Allah in a devout (frame of mind).
Shakir: Attend constantly to prayers and to the middle prayer and stand up truly obedient to Allah.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Pay due attention to your prayers, especially the middle prayer and stand up while praying, in obedience to God.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Guard strictly (five obligatory) As­Salawat (the prayers) especially the middle Salat (i.e. the best prayer ­ 'Asr). And stand before Allah with obedience [and do not speak to others during the Salat (prayers)].
Arberry: Be you watchful over the prayers, and the middle prayer; and do you stand obedient to God.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَمَا مِن دَآبَّةٖ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَا طَٰٓئِرٖ يَطِيرُ بِجَنَاحَيۡهِ إِلَّآ أُمَمٌ أَمۡثَالُكُمۚ مَّا فَرَّطۡنَا فِي ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مِن شَيۡءٖۚ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِمۡ يُحۡشَرُونَ
Verse: وما من دابة في الارض ولا طٰئر يطير بجناحيه الا امم امثالكم ما فرطنا في الكتٰب من شيء ثم الىٰ ربهم يحشرون
Sahih_International: And there is no creature on [or within] the earth or bird that flies with its wings except [that they are] communities like you. We have not neglected in the Register a thing. Then unto their Lord they will be gathered.
Pickthall: There is not an animal in the earth, nor a flying creature flying on two wings, but they are peoples like unto you. We have neglected nothing in the Book (of Our decrees). Then unto their Lord they will be gathered.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): There is not an animal (that lives) on the earth, nor a being that flies on its wings, but (forms part of) communities like you. Nothing have we omitted from the Book, and they (all) shall be gathered to their Lord in the end.
Shakir: And there is no animal that walks upon the earth nor a bird that flies with its two wings but (they are) genera like yourselves; We have not neglected anything in the Book, then to their Lord shall they be gathered.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): All the beasts on land and flying birds have different communities, just as you (people) do. Nothing is left without a mention in the Book. They will all be brought into the presence of their Lord.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): There is not a moving (living) creature on earth, nor a bird that flies with its two wings, but are communities like you. We have neglected nothing in the Book, then unto their Lord they (all) shall be gathered.
Arberry: No creature is there crawling on the earth, no bird flying with its wings, but they are nations like unto yourselves. We have neglected nothing in the Book; then to their Lord they shall be mustered.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: فِيهَا كُتُبٞ قَيِّمَةٞ
Verse: فيها كتب قيمة
Sahih_International: Within which are correct writings.
Pickthall: Containing correct scriptures.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Wherein are laws (or decrees) right and straight.
Shakir: Wherein are all the right ordinances.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): holy Book which contain eternal laws of guidance.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Containing correct and straight laws from Allah.
Arberry: therein true Books.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَقَالُوٓاْ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ وَأَنَّىٰ لَهُمُ ٱلتَّنَاوُشُ مِن مَّكَانِۭ بَعِيدٖ
Verse: وقالوا ءامنا به وانىٰ لهم التناوش من مكان بعيد
Sahih_International: And they will [then] say, "We believe in it!" But how for them will be the taking [of faith] from a place far away?
Pickthall: And say: We (now) believe therein. But how can they reach (faith) from afar off,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And they will say, "We do believe (now) in the (Truth)"; but how could they receive (Faith) from a position (so far off,-
Shakir: And they shall say: We believe in it. And how shall the attaining (of faith) be possible to them from a distant place?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): and then they will say, "We have faith in the Quran." How can they have any faith when they are far away from this world.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And they will say (in the Hereafter): "We do believe (now);" but how could they receive (Faith and the acceptance of their repentance by Allah) from a place so far off (i.e. to return to the worldly life again).
Arberry: and they say, 'We believe in it'; but how can they reach from a place far away,
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: ٱلَّذِينَ يَرِثُونَ ٱلۡفِرۡدَوۡسَ هُمۡ فِيهَا خَٰلِدُونَ
Verse: الذين يرثون الفردوس هم فيها خٰلدون
Sahih_International: Who will inherit al-Firdaus. They will abide therein eternally.
Pickthall: Who will inherit paradise. There they will abide.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Who will inherit Paradise: they will dwell therein (for ever).
Shakir: Who shall inherit the Paradise; they shall abide therein.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): These are the heirs of Paradise wherein they will live forever.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Who shall inherit the Firdaus (Paradise). They shall dwell therein forever.
Arberry: who shall inherit Paradise therein dwelling forever.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: فَخَرَجَ مِنۡهَا خَآئِفٗا يَتَرَقَّبُۖ قَالَ رَبِّ نَجِّنِي مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡمِ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ
Verse: فخرج منها خائفا يترقب قال رب نجني من القوم الظٰلمين
Sahih_International: So he left it, fearful and anticipating [apprehension]. He said, "My Lord, save me from the wrongdoing people."
Pickthall: So he escaped from thence, fearing, vigilant. He said: My Lord! Deliver me from the wrongdoing folk.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): He therefore got away therefrom, looking about, in a state of fear. He prayed "O my Lord! save me from people given to wrong-doing."
Shakir: So he went forth therefrom, fearing, awaiting, (and) he said: My Lord! deliver me from the unjust people.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): So he left the city afraid and cautious, saying, "Lord, protect me against the unjust people".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): So he escaped from there, looking about in a state of fear. He said: "My Lord! Save me from the people who are Zalimun (polytheists and wrong-doers)!"
Arberry: So he departed therefrom, fearful and vigilant; he said, 'My Lord, deliver me from the people of the evildoers.'
Label: fear

Verse_diac: خَلَقَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِن نُّطۡفَةٖ فَإِذَا هُوَ خَصِيمٞ مُّبِينٞ
Verse: خلق الانسٰن من نطفة فاذا هو خصيم مبين
Sahih_International: He created man from a sperm-drop; then at once, he is a clear adversary.
Pickthall: He hath created man from a drop of fluid, yet behold! he is an open opponent.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): He has created man from a sperm-drop; and behold this same (man) becomes an open disputer!
Shakir: He created man from a small seed and lo! he is an open contender.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): He created the human being from a drop of fluid but the human being openly disputes His Word.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): He has created man from Nutfah (mixed drops of male and female sexual discharge), then behold, this same (man) becomes an open opponent.
Arberry: He created man of a sperm-drop; and, behold, he is a manifest adversary.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: لَّا يَسۡـَٔمُ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ مِن دُعَآءِ ٱلۡخَيۡرِ وَإِن مَّسَّهُ ٱلشَّرُّ فَيَـُٔوسٞ قَنُوطٞ
Verse: لا يسم الانسٰن من دعاء الخير وان مسه الشر فيوس قنوط
Sahih_International: Man is not weary of supplication for good [things], but if evil touches him, he is hopeless and despairing.
Pickthall: Man tireth not of praying for good, and if ill toucheth him, then he is disheartened, desperate.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Man does not weary of asking for good (things), but if ill touches him, he gives up all hope (and) is lost in despair.
Shakir: Man is never tired of praying for good, and if evil touch him, then he is despairing, hopeless.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): The human being never tires of asking for good, but if he is afflicted by hardship, he despairs and gives up all hope.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Man (the disbeliever) does not get tired of asking good (things from Allah), but if an evil touches him, then he gives up all hope and is lost in despair.
Arberry: Man wearies not of praying for good; but when evil visits him, then he is cast down and desperate.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ رَبُّ ٱلۡعَرۡشِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ۩
Verse: الله لا الٰه الا هو رب العرش العظيم
Sahih_International: Allah - there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Great Throne."
Pickthall: Allah; there is no Allah save Him, the Lord of the Tremendous Throne.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "Allah!- there is no god but He!- Lord of the Throne Supreme!"
Shakir: Allah, there is no god but He: He is the Lord of mighty power.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): God is the only Lord and master of the Great Throne."
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Allah, La ilaha illa Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He), the Lord of the Supreme Throne!
Arberry: God: there is no god but He, the Lord of the Mighty Throne.'
Label: joy

Verse_diac: قُلۡ مَآ أَسۡـَٔلُكُمۡ عَلَيۡهِ مِنۡ أَجۡرٖ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلۡمُتَكَلِّفِينَ
Verse: قل ما اسلكم عليه من اجر وما انا من المتكلفين
Sahih_International: Say, [O Muhammad], "I do not ask you for the Qur'an any payment, and I am not of the pretentious
Pickthall: Say (O Muhammad, unto mankind): I ask of you no fee for this, and I am no simulating.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Say: "No reward do I ask of you for this (Qur'an), nor am I a pretender.
Shakir: Say: I do not ask you for any reward for it; nor am I of those who affect:
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): (Muhammad), say, "I do not ask any reward for my preaching to you for I am not a pretender.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Say (O Muhammad SAW): "No wage do I ask of you for this (the Quran), nor am I one of the Mutakallifun (those who pretend and fabricate things which do not exist).
Arberry: Say: 'I ask of you no wage for it, neither am I of those who take things upon themselves.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: هَلۡ ثُوِّبَ ٱلۡكُفَّارُ مَا كَانُواْ يَفۡعَلُونَ
Verse: هل ثوب الكفار ما كانوا يفعلون
Sahih_International: Have the disbelievers [not] been rewarded [this Day] for what they used to do?
Pickthall: Are not the disbelievers paid for what they used to do?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Will not the Unbelievers have been paid back for what they did?
Shakir: Surely the disbelievers are rewarded as they did.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Will not the disbelievers then be duly recompensed for their laughing at the believers?
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Are not the disbelievers paid (fully) for what they used to do?
Arberry: Have the unbelievers been rewarded what they were doing?
Label: fear

Verse_diac: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمۡ شَآقُّواْ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥۖ وَمَن يُشَآقِّ ٱللَّهَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ شَدِيدُ ٱلۡعِقَابِ
Verse: ذٰلك بانهم شاقوا الله ورسوله ومن يشاق الله فان الله شديد العقاب
Sahih_International: That is because they opposed Allah and His Messenger. And whoever opposes Allah - then indeed, Allah is severe in penalty.
Pickthall: That is because they were opposed to Allah and His messenger; and whoso is opposed to Allah, (for him) verily Allah is stern in reprisal.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): That is because they resisted Allah and His Messenger: and if any one resists Allah, verily Allah is severe in Punishment.
Shakir: That is because they acted in opposition to Allah and His Messenger, and whoever acts in opposition to Allah, then surely Allah is severe in retributing (evil).
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): This is because they opposed God and His Messenger and whoever opposes God should know that God's retribution is severe.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): That is because they opposed Allah and His Messenger (Muhammad SAW). And whosoever opposes Allah, then verily, Allah is Severe in punishment.
Arberry: That is because they made a breach with God and His Messenger; and whosoever makes a breach with God, God is terrible in retribution.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: وَإِذَا ٱلۡبِحَارُ فُجِّرَتۡ
Verse: واذا البحار فجرت
Sahih_International: And when the seas are erupted
Pickthall: When the seas are poured forth,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): When the Oceans are suffered to burst forth;
Shakir: And when the seas are made to flow forth,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): the oceans are merged together,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And when the seas are burst forth (got dried up);
Arberry: when the seas swarm over,
Label: fear

Verse_diac: فَٱصۡبِرۡ صَبۡرٗا جَمِيلًا
Verse: فاصبر صبرا جميلا
Sahih_International: So be patient with gracious patience.
Pickthall: But be patient (O Muhammad) with a patience fair to see.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Therefore do thou hold Patience,- a Patience of beautiful (contentment).
Shakir: Therefore endure with a goodly patience.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): (Muhammad), exercise patience with no complaints.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): So be patient (O Muhammad SAW ), with a good patience.
Arberry: So be thou patient with a sweet patience;
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَأَنَّهُمۡ يَقُولُونَ مَا لَا يَفۡعَلُونَ
Verse: وانهم يقولون ما لا يفعلون
Sahih_International: And that they say what they do not do? -
Pickthall: And how they say that which they do not?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And that they say what they practise not?-
Shakir: And that they say that which they do not do,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): and preaching what they themselves never practice.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And that they say what they do not do.
Arberry: and how they say that which they do not?
Label: anger

Verse_diac: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ سَيَجۡعَلُ لَهُمُ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنُ وُدّٗا
Verse: ان الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصٰلحٰت سيجعل لهم الرحمٰن ودا
Sahih_International: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - the Most Merciful will appoint for them affection.
Pickthall: Lo! those who believe and do good works, the Beneficent will appoint for them love.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): On those who believe and work deeds of righteousness, will (Allah) Most Gracious bestow love.
Shakir: Surely (as for) those who believe and do good deeds for t them will Allah bring about love.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): To the righteously striving believers God will grant love.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Verily, those who believe [in the Oneness of Allah and in His Messenger (Muhammad SAW)] and work deeds of righteousness, the Most Beneficent (Allah) will bestow love for them (in the hearts of the believers).
Arberry: Surely those who believe and do deeds of righteousness -- unto them the All-merciful shall assign love.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِـَٔايَٰتِنَآ إِذَا هُم مِّنۡهَا يَضۡحَكُونَ
Verse: فلما جاءهم بايٰتنا اذا هم منها يضحكون
Sahih_International: But when he brought them Our signs, at once they laughed at them.
Pickthall: But when he brought them Our tokens, behold! they laughed at them.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): But when he came to them with Our Signs, behold they ridiculed them.
Shakir: But when he came to them with Our signs, lo! they laughed at them.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): When he showed them Our miracles, they started to laugh at them.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): But when he came to them with Our Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) behold! They laughed at them.
Arberry: But when he brought them Our signs, lo, they laughed at them.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: لَهُۥ مَقَالِيدُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِۖ يَبۡسُطُ ٱلرِّزۡقَ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيَقۡدِرُۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ عَلِيمٞ
Verse: له مقاليد السمٰوٰت والارض يبسط الرزق لمن يشاء ويقدر انه بكل شيء عليم
Sahih_International: To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. He extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]. Indeed He is, of all things, Knowing.
Pickthall: His are the keys of the heavens and the earth. He enlargeth providence for whom He will and straiteneth (it for whom He will). Lo! He is Knower of all things.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth: He enlarges and restricts. The Sustenance to whom He will: for He knows full well all things.
Shakir: His are the treasures of the heavens and the earth; He makes ample and straitens the means of subsistence for whom He pleases; surely He is Cognizant of all things.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): In His hands are the keys of the heavens and the earth. He increases and determines the sustenance of whomever He wants. He has the knowledge of all things.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth, He enlarges provision for whom He wills, and straitens (it for whom He wills). Verily! He is the All-Knower of everything.
Arberry: To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. He outspreads and straitens His provision to whom He will; surely He has knowledge of everything.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: بَلۡ تَأۡتِيهِم بَغۡتَةٗ فَتَبۡهَتُهُمۡ فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيعُونَ رَدَّهَا وَلَا هُمۡ يُنظَرُونَ
Verse: بل تاتيهم بغتة فتبهتهم فلا يستطيعون ردها ولا هم ينظرون
Sahih_International: Rather, it will come to them unexpectedly and bewilder them, and they will not be able to repel it, nor will they be reprieved.
Pickthall: Nay, but it will come upon them unawares so that it will stupefy them, and they will be unable to repel it, neither will they be reprieved.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Nay, it may come to them all of a sudden and confound them: no power will they have then to avert it, nor will they (then) get respite.
Shakir: Nay, it shall come on them all of a sudden and cause them to become confounded, so they shall not have the power to avert it, nor shall they be respited.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): The fire will suddenly strike and confound them. They will not be able to repel it, nor will they be given any respite.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Nay, it (the Fire or the Day of Resurrection) will come upon them all of a sudden and will perplex them, and they will have no power to avert it, nor will they get respite.
Arberry: Nay, but it shall come upon them suddenly, dumbfounding them, and they shall not be able to repel it, nor shall they be respited.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: أَوَأَمِنَ أَهۡلُ ٱلۡقُرَىٰٓ أَن يَأۡتِيَهُم بَأۡسُنَا ضُحٗى وَهُمۡ يَلۡعَبُونَ
Verse: اوامن اهل القرىٰ ان ياتيهم باسنا ضحى وهم يلعبون
Sahih_International: Or did the people of the cities feel secure from Our punishment coming to them in the morning while they were at play?
Pickthall: Or are the people of the townships then secure from the coming of Our wrath upon them in the daytime while they play?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Or else did they feel secure against its coming in broad daylight while they played about (care-free)?
Shakir: What! do the people of the towns feel secure from Our punishment coming to them in the morning while they play?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): or that which could seize them during their busy hours of the day?
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Or, did the people of the towns then feel secure against the coming of Our Punishment in the forenoon while they play?
Arberry: Do the people of the cities feel secure Our might shall not come upon them in daylight while they are playing?
Label: fear

Verse_diac: ٱلَّذِينَ هُمۡ يُرَآءُونَ
Verse: الذين هم يراءون
Sahih_International: Those who make show [of their deeds]
Pickthall: Who would be seen (at worship)
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Those who (want but) to be seen (of men),
Shakir: Who do (good) to be seen,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): who show off (his good deeds)
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Those who do good deeds only to be seen (of men),
Arberry: to those who make display
Label: anger

Verse_diac: وَمَن يَهۡدِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِن مُّضِلٍّۗ أَلَيۡسَ ٱللَّهُ بِعَزِيزٖ ذِي ٱنتِقَامٖ
Verse: ومن يهد الله فما له من مضل اليس الله بعزيز ذي انتقام
Sahih_International: And whoever Allah guides - for him there is no misleader. Is not Allah Exalted in Might and Owner of Retribution?
Pickthall: And he whom Allah guideth, for him there can be no misleader. Is not Allah Mighty, Able to Requite (the wrong)?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And such as Allah doth guide there can be none to lead astray. Is not Allah Exalted in Power, (Able to enforce His Will), Lord of Retribution?
Shakir: And whom Allah guides, there is none that can lead him astray; is not Allah Mighty, the Lord of retribution?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Who can mislead one whom God has guided? Is God not Majestic and Revengeful?
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And whomsoever Allah guides, for him there will be no misleader. Is not Allah All-Mighty, Possessor of Retribution?
Arberry: But whomso God guides, none shall lead him astray; is not God All-mighty, All-vengeful?
Label: anger

Verse_diac: وَقِفُوهُمۡۖ إِنَّهُم مَّسۡـُٔولُونَ
Verse: وقفوهم انهم مسولون
Sahih_International: And stop them; indeed, they are to be questioned."
Pickthall: And stop them, for they must be questioned.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "But stop them, for they must be asked:
Shakir: And stop them, for they shall be questioned:
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Stop them. They must be questioned."
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "But stop them, verily they are to be questioned.
Arberry: And halt them, to be questioned:
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَأَمَّا مَنۡ خَافَ مَقَامَ رَبِّهِۦ وَنَهَى ٱلنَّفۡسَ عَنِ ٱلۡهَوَىٰ
Verse: واما من خاف مقام ربه ونهى النفس عن الهوىٰ
Sahih_International: But as for he who feared the position of his Lord and prevented the soul from [unlawful] inclination,
Pickthall: But as for him who feared to stand before his Lord and restrained his soul from lust,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And for such as had entertained the fear of standing before their Lord's (tribunal) and had restrained (their) soul from lower desires,
Shakir: And as for him who fears to stand in the presence of his Lord and forbids the soul from low desires,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): However, those who had feared their Lord and restrained their souls from acting according to its desires.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): But as for him who feared standing before his Lord, and restrained himself from impure evil desires, and lusts.
Arberry: But as for him who feared the Station of his Lord and forbade the soul its caprice,
Label: joy

Verse_diac: فَقُلۡتُ ٱسۡتَغۡفِرُواْ رَبَّكُمۡ إِنَّهُۥ كَانَ غَفَّارٗا
Verse: فقلت استغفروا ربكم انه كان غفارا
Sahih_International: And said, 'Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.
Pickthall: And I have said: Seek pardon of your Lord. Lo! He was ever Forgiving.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "Saying, 'Ask forgiveness from your Lord; for He is Oft-Forgiving;
Shakir: Then I said, Ask forgiveness of your Lord, surely He is the most Forgiving:
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): and told them, "Ask forgiveness from your Lord; He is All-forgiving".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "I said (to them): 'Ask forgiveness from your Lord; Verily, He is Oft-Forgiving;
Arberry: and I said, "Ask you forgiveness of your Lord; surely He is ever All-forgiving,
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَيَوۡمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلسَّمَآءُ بِٱلۡغَمَٰمِ وَنُزِّلَ ٱلۡمَلَٰٓئِكَةُ تَنزِيلًا
Verse: ويوم تشقق السماء بالغمٰم ونزل الملٰئكة تنزيلا
Sahih_International: And [mention] the Day when the heaven will split open with [emerging] clouds, and the angels will be sent down in successive descent.
Pickthall: A day when the heaven with the clouds will be rent asunder and the angels will be sent down, a grand descent.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): The Day the heaven shall be rent asunder with clouds, and angels shall be sent down, descending (in ranks),-
Shakir: And on the day when the heaven shall burst asunder with the clouds, and the angels shall be sent down descending (in ranks).
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): On that day the sky will be crystal blue, clear of clouds. The angels will descend in groups
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And (remember) the Day when the heaven shall be rent asunder with clouds, and the angels will be sent down, with a grand descending.
Arberry: Upon the day that heaven is split asunder with the clouds and the angels are sent down in majesty,
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَأَنَّا مِنَّا ٱلۡمُسۡلِمُونَ وَمِنَّا ٱلۡقَٰسِطُونَۖ فَمَنۡ أَسۡلَمَ فَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ تَحَرَّوۡاْ رَشَدٗا
Verse: وانا منا المسلمون ومنا القٰسطون فمن اسلم فاولٰئك تحروا رشدا
Sahih_International: And among us are Muslims [in submission to Allah], and among us are the unjust. And whoever has become Muslim - those have sought out the right course.
Pickthall: And there are among us some who have surrendered (to Allah) and there are among us some who are unjust. And whoso hath surrendered to Allah, such have taken the right path purposefully.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): 'Amongst us are some that submit their wills (to Allah), and some that swerve from justice. Now those who submit their wills - they have sought out (the path) of right conduct:
Shakir: And that some of us are those who submit, and some of us are the deviators; so whoever submits, these aim at the right way:
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Some of us are Muslims and some of us have deviated from the Truth. Whoever has embraced Islam has followed the right guidance.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): 'And of us some are Muslims (who have submitted to All?h, after listening to this Qur'?n), and of us some are Al-Q?sit?n (disbelievers those who have deviated from the Right Path)'. And whosoever has embraced Isl?m (i.e. has become a Muslim by submitting to All?h), then such have sought the Right Path."
Arberry: And some of us have surrendered, and some of us have deviated. Those who have surrendered sought rectitude;
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَٱلۡخَيۡلَ وَٱلۡبِغَالَ وَٱلۡحَمِيرَ لِتَرۡكَبُوهَا وَزِينَةٗۚ وَيَخۡلُقُ مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُونَ
Verse: والخيل والبغال والحمير لتركبوها وزينة ويخلق ما لا تعلمون
Sahih_International: And [He created] the horses, mules and donkeys for you to ride and [as] adornment. And He creates that which you do not know.
Pickthall: And horses and mules and asses (hath He created) that ye may ride them, and for ornament. And He createth that which ye know not.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And (He has created) horses, mules, and donkeys, for you to ride and use for show; and He has created (other) things of which ye have no knowledge.
Shakir: And (He made) horses and mules and asses that you might ride upon them and as an ornament; and He creates what you do not know.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): He created horses, mules, and donkeys for you to ride and as a means of beauty. He has also created things that you do not know.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And (He has created) horses, mules and donkeys, for you to ride and as an adornment. And He creates (other) things of which you have no knowledge.
Arberry: And horses, and mules, and asses, for you to ride, and as an adornment; and He creates what you know not.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: فَٱصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُن كَصَاحِبِ ٱلۡحُوتِ إِذۡ نَادَىٰ وَهُوَ مَكۡظُومٞ
Verse: فاصبر لحكم ربك ولا تكن كصاحب الحوت اذ نادىٰ وهو مكظوم
Sahih_International: Then be patient for the decision of your Lord, [O Muhammad], and be not like the companion of the fish when he called out while he was distressed.
Pickthall: But wait thou for thy Lord's decree, and be not like him of the fish, who cried out in despair.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): So wait with patience for the Command of thy Lord, and be not like the Companion of the Fish,- when he cried out in agony.
Shakir: So wait patiently for the judgment of your Lord, and be not like the companion of the fish, when he cried while he was in distress.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Exercise patience until the promise of your Lord (to punish the unbelievers) comes true. Do not be like Jonah (who left his people without the permission of God; he wanted them to be punished immediately),
Mohsin_Khan (MK): So wait with patience for the Decision of your Lord, and be not like the Companion of the Fish, when he cried out (to Us) while he was in deep sorrow. (See the Quran, Verse 21:87).
Arberry: So be thou patient under the judgment of thy Lord, and be not as the Man of the Fish, when he called, choking inwardly.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَذَرُواْ مَا بَقِيَ مِنَ ٱلرِّبَوٰٓاْ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤۡمِنِينَ
Verse: يٰايها الذين ءامنوا اتقوا الله وذروا ما بقي من الربوٰا ان كنتم مؤمنين
Sahih_International: O you who have believed, fear Allah and give up what remains [due to you] of interest, if you should be believers.
Pickthall: O ye who believe! Observe your duty to Allah, and give up what remaineth (due to you) from usury, if ye are (in truth) believers.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): O ye who believe! Fear Allah, and give up what remains of your demand for usury, if ye are indeed believers.
Shakir: O you who believe! Be careful of (your duty to) Allah and relinquish what remains (due) from usury, if you are believers.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Believers, have fear of God and give up whatever unlawful interest you still demand from others, if you are indeed true believers.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): O you who believe! Be afraid of Allah and give up what remains (due to you) from Riba (usury) (from now onward), if you are (really) believers.
Arberry: O believers, fear you God; and give up the usury that is outstanding, if you are believers.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: إِنَّ عَلَيۡنَا لَلۡهُدَىٰ
Verse: ان علينا للهدىٰ
Sahih_International: Indeed, [incumbent] upon Us is guidance.
Pickthall: Lo! Ours it is (to give) the guidance
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Verily We take upon Ourselves to guide,
Shakir: Surely Ours is it to show the way,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Surely, in Our hands is guidance,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Truly! Ours it is (to give) guidance,
Arberry: Surely upon Us rests the guidance,
Label: joy

Verse_diac: ٱتَّبِعۡ مَآ أُوحِيَ إِلَيۡكَ مِن رَّبِّكَۖ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ وَأَعۡرِضۡ عَنِ ٱلۡمُشۡرِكِينَ
Verse: اتبع ما اوحي اليك من ربك لا الٰه الا هو واعرض عن المشركين
Sahih_International: Follow, [O Muhammad], what has been revealed to you from your Lord - there is no deity except Him - and turn away from those who associate others with Allah.
Pickthall: Follow that which is inspired in thee from thy Lord; there is no Allah save Him; and turn away from the idolaters.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Follow what thou art taught by inspiration from thy Lord: there is no god but He: and turn aside from those who join gods with Allah.
Shakir: Follow what is revealed to you from your Lord; there is no god but He; and withdraw from the polytheists.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): (Muhammad), follow what has been revealed to you from your Lord; there is no God but He, and stay away from pagans.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Follow what has been inspired to you (O Muhammad SAW) from your Lord, La ilaha illa Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He) and turn aside from Al-Mushrikun.
Arberry: Follow thou what has been revealed to thee from thy Lord; there is no god but He; and turn thou away from the idolaters.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: خَلَقَ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ مِن صَلۡصَٰلٖ كَٱلۡفَخَّارِ
Verse: خلق الانسٰن من صلصٰل كالفخار
Sahih_International: He created man from clay like [that of] pottery.
Pickthall: He created man of clay like the potter's,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): He created man from sounding clay like unto pottery,
Shakir: He created man from dry clay like earthen vessels,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): He created the human being from clay like that used for pottery
Mohsin_Khan (MK): He created man (Adam) from sounding clay like the clay of pottery.
Arberry: He created man of a clay like the potter's,
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: قُلۡ أَتَعۡبُدُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا يَمۡلِكُ لَكُمۡ ضَرّٗا وَلَا نَفۡعٗاۚ وَٱللَّهُ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ
Verse: قل اتعبدون من دون الله ما لا يملك لكم ضرا ولا نفعا والله هو السميع العليم
Sahih_International: Say, "Do you worship besides Allah that which holds for you no [power of] harm or benefit while it is Allah who is the Hearing, the Knowing?"
Pickthall: Say: Serve ye in place of Allah that which possesseth for you neither hurt nor use? Allah it is Who is the Hearer, the Knower.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Say: "Will ye worship, besides Allah, something which hath no power either to harm or benefit you? But Allah,- He it is that heareth and knoweth all things."
Shakir: Say: Do you serve besides Allah that which does not control for you any harm, or any profit? And Allah-- He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): (Muhammad), say to them, "Do you worship things besides God which can neither harm or benefit you?" It is only God who is All-hearing and All-knowing.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Say (O Muhammad SAW to mankind): "How do you worship besides Allah something which has no power either to harm or to benefit you? But it is Allah Who is the All­Hearer, All­Knower."
Arberry: Say: 'Do you serve, apart from God, that which cannot hurt or profit you? God is the All-hearing, the All-knowing.'
Label: anger

Verse_diac: فَإِنَّهُمۡ عَدُوّٞ لِّيٓ إِلَّا رَبَّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
Verse: فانهم عدو لي الا رب العٰلمين
Sahih_International: Indeed, they are enemies to me, except the Lord of the worlds,
Pickthall: Lo! they are (all) an enemy unto me, save the Lord of the Worlds,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "For they are enemies to me; not so the Lord and Cherisher of the Worlds;
Shakir: Surely they are enemies to me, but not (so) the Lord of the worlds;
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): are my enemies? Not so the Lord of the Universe.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "Verily! They are enemies to me, save the Lord of the 'Alamin (mankind, jinns and all that exists);
Arberry: They are an enemy to me, except the Lord of all Being
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: رَبِّ هَبۡ لِي حُكۡمٗا وَأَلۡحِقۡنِي بِٱلصَّٰلِحِينَ
Verse: رب هب لي حكما والحقني بالصٰلحين
Sahih_International: [And he said], "My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous.
Pickthall: My Lord! Vouchsafe me wisdom and unite me to the righteous.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "O my Lord! bestow wisdom on me, and join me with the righteous;
Shakir: My Lord: Grant me wisdom, and join me with the good
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Lord, grant me authority. Join me to the righteous ones.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): My Lord! Bestow Hukman (religious knowledge, right judgement of the affairs and Prophethood) on me, and join me with the righteous;
Arberry: My Lord, give me Judgment, and join me with the righteous,
Label: joy

Verse_diac: فَقَالَ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكُمُ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ
Verse: فقال انا ربكم الاعلىٰ
Sahih_International: And said, "I am your most exalted lord."
Pickthall: And proclaimed: "I (Pharaoh) am your Lord the Highest."
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Saying, "I am your Lord, Most High".
Shakir: Then he said: I am your lord, the most high.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): saying, "I am your supreme lord".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Saying: "I am your lord, most high",
Arberry: and proclaimed, and he said, 'I am your Lord, the Most High!'
Label: anger

Verse_diac: ٱلَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ فِي ٱلسَّرَّآءِ وَٱلضَّرَّآءِ وَٱلۡكَٰظِمِينَ ٱلۡغَيۡظَ وَٱلۡعَافِينَ عَنِ ٱلنَّاسِۗ وَٱللَّهُ يُحِبُّ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
Verse: الذين ينفقون في السراء والضراء والكٰظمين الغيظ والعافين عن الناس والله يحب المحسنين
Sahih_International: Who spend [in the cause of Allah] during ease and hardship and who restrain anger and who pardon the people - and Allah loves the doers of good;
Pickthall: Those who spend (of that which Allah hath given them) in ease and in adversity, those who control their wrath and are forgiving toward mankind; Allah loveth the good;
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Those who spend (freely), whether in prosperity, or in adversity; who restrain anger, and pardon (all) men;- for Allah loves those who do good;-
Shakir: Those who spend (benevolently) in ease as well as in straitness, and those who restrain (their) anger and pardon men; and Allah loves the doers of good (to others).
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): who spend their property for the cause of God in prosperity as well as in adversity and who also harness their anger and forgive the people. God loves the righteous ones.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Those who spend [in Allah's Cause - deeds of charity, alms, etc.] in prosperity and in adversity, who repress anger, and who pardon men; verily, Allah loves Al-Muhsinun (the good­doers).
Arberry: who expend in prosperity and adversity in almsgiving, and restrain their rage, and pardon the offences of their fellowmen; and God loves the good-doers;
Label: joy

Verse_diac: يَتَنَٰزَعُونَ فِيهَا كَأۡسٗا لَّا لَغۡوٞ فِيهَا وَلَا تَأۡثِيمٞ
Verse: يتنٰزعون فيها كاسا لا لغو فيها ولا تاثيم
Sahih_International: They will exchange with one another a cup [of wine] wherein [results] no ill speech or commission of sin.
Pickthall: There they pass from hand to hand a cup wherein is neither vanity nor cause of sin.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): They shall there exchange, one with another, a (loving) cup free of frivolity, free of all taint of ill.
Shakir: They shall pass therein from one to another a cup wherein there shall be nothing vain nor any sin.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): They will pass cups of un-intoxicating and unsinful wine to one another.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): There they shall pass from hand to hand a (wine) cup, free from any Laghw (dirty, false, evil vague talk between them), and free from sin (because it will be legal for them to drink).
Arberry: while they pass therein a cup one to another wherein is no idle talk, no cause of sin,
Label: joy

Verse_diac: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلنَّبِيُّ إِنَّآ أَرۡسَلۡنَٰكَ شَٰهِدٗا وَمُبَشِّرٗا وَنَذِيرٗا
Verse: يٰايها النبي انا ارسلنٰك شٰهدا ومبشرا ونذيرا
Sahih_International: O Prophet, indeed We have sent you as a witness and a bringer of good tidings and a warner.
Pickthall: O Prophet! Lo! We have sent thee as a witness and a bringer of good tidings and a warner.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): O Prophet! Truly We have sent thee as a Witness, a Bearer of Glad Tidings, and Warner,-
Shakir: O Prophet! surely We have sent you as a witness, and as a bearer of good news and as a warner,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Prophet, We have sent you as a witness, a bearer of glad news, a warner,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): O Prophet (MuhammadSAW )! Verily, We have sent you as witness, and a bearer of glad tidings, and a warner,
Arberry: O Prophet, We have sent thee as a witness, and good tidings to bear and warning,
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وُجُوهٞ يَوۡمَئِذٖ مُّسۡفِرَةٞ
Verse: وجوه يومئذ مسفرة
