Mohsin_Khan (MK): Like the boiling of scalding water.
Arberry: as boiling water bubbles.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: يَوۡمَ يَقُولُ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقُونَ وَٱلۡمُنَٰفِقَٰتُ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱنظُرُونَا نَقۡتَبِسۡ مِن نُّورِكُمۡ قِيلَ ٱرۡجِعُواْ وَرَآءَكُمۡ فَٱلۡتَمِسُواْ نُورٗاۖ فَضُرِبَ بَيۡنَهُم بِسُورٖ لَّهُۥ بَابُۢ بَاطِنُهُۥ فِيهِ ٱلرَّحۡمَةُ وَظَٰهِرُهُۥ مِن قِبَلِهِ ٱلۡعَذَابُ
Verse: يوم يقول المنٰفقون والمنٰفقٰت للذين ءامنوا انظرونا نقتبس من نوركم قيل ارجعوا وراءكم فالتمسوا نورا فضرب بينهم بسور له باب باطنه فيه الرحمة وظٰهره من قبله العذاب
Sahih_International: On the [same] Day the hypocrite men and hypocrite women will say to those who believed, "Wait for us that we may acquire some of your light." It will be said, "Go back behind you and seek light." And a wall will be placed between them with a door, its interior containing mercy, but on the outside of it is torment.
Pickthall: On the day when the hypocritical men and the hypocritical women will say unto those who believe: Look on us that we may borrow from your light! it will be said: Go back and seek for light! Then there will separate them a wall wherein is a gate, the inner side whereof containeth mercy, while the outer side thereof is toward the doom.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): One Day will the Hypocrites- men and women - say to the Believers: "Wait for us! Let us borrow (a Light) from your Light!" It will be said: "Turn ye back to your rear! then seek a Light (where ye can)!" So a wall will be put up betwixt them, with a gate therein. Within it will be Mercy throughout, and without it, all alongside, will be (Wrath and) Punishment!
Shakir: On the day when the hypocritical men and the hypocritical women will say to those who believe: Wait for us, that we may have light from your light; it shall be said: Turn back and seek a light. Then separation would be brought about between them, with a wall having a door in it; (as for) the inside of it, there shall be mercy in it, and (as for) the outside of it, before it there shall be punishment.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): On that day the hypocrites will say to the believers, "Please look at us so that we might benefit from your light." They will be told, "Go back and search for your own light." A barrier with a door will be placed between them. Inside it there will be mercy but outside of it there will be torment.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): On the Day when the hypocrites men and women will say to the believers: "Wait for us! Let us get something from your light!" It will be said: "Go back to your rear! Then seek a light!" So a wall will be put up between them, with a gate therein. Inside it will be mercy, and outside it will be torment."
Arberry: Upon the day when the hypocrites, men and women, shall say to those who have believed, 'Wait for us, so that we may borrow your light!' It shall be said, 'Return you back behind, and seek for a light!' And a wall shall be set up between them, having a door in the inward whereof is mercy, and against the outward thereof is chastisement.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ مَن تُدۡخِلِ ٱلنَّارَ فَقَدۡ أَخۡزَيۡتَهُۥۖ وَمَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ مِنۡ أَنصَارٖ
Verse: ربنا انك من تدخل النار فقد اخزيته وما للظٰلمين من انصار
Sahih_International: Our Lord, indeed whoever You admit to the Fire - You have disgraced him, and for the wrongdoers there are no helpers.
Pickthall: Our Lord! Whom Thou causest to enter the Fire: him indeed Thou hast confounded. For evil-doers there will be no helpers.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "Our Lord! any whom Thou dost admit to the Fire, Truly Thou coverest with shame, and never will wrong-doers Find any helpers!
Shakir: Our Lord! surely whomsoever Thou makest enter the fire, him Thou hast indeed brought to disgrace, and there shall be no helpers for the unjust:
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Those whom You submit to the fire are certainly disgraced. There is no helper for the unjust.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "Our Lord! Verily, whom You admit to the Fire, indeed, You have disgraced him, and never will the Zalimun (polytheists and wrong-doers) find any helpers.
Arberry: Our Lord, whomsoever Thou admittest into the Fire, Thou wilt have abased; and the evildoers shall have no helpers.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: تَكَادُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتُ يَتَفَطَّرۡنَ مِنۡهُ وَتَنشَقُّ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ وَتَخِرُّ ٱلۡجِبَالُ هَدًّا
Verse: تكاد السمٰوٰت يتفطرن منه وتنشق الارض وتخر الجبال هدا
Sahih_International: The heavens almost rupture therefrom and the earth splits open and the mountains collapse in devastation
Pickthall: Whereby almost the heavens are torn, and the earth is split asunder and the mountains fall in ruins,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): At it the skies are ready to burst, the earth to split asunder, and the mountains to fall down in utter ruin,
Shakir: The heavens may almost be rent thereat, and the earth cleave asunder, and the mountains fall down in pieces,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): This would almost cause the heavens to rent apart, the earth to cleave asunder and the mountains to crumble down in fragments,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Whereby the heavens are almost torn, and the earth is split asunder, and the mountains fall in ruins,
Arberry: The heavens are wellnigh rent of it and the earth split asunder, and the mountains wellnigh fall down crashing for
Label: anger

Verse_diac: لَّا يَسَّمَّعُونَ إِلَى ٱلۡمَلَإِ ٱلۡأَعۡلَىٰ وَيُقۡذَفُونَ مِن كُلِّ جَانِبٖ
Verse: لا يسمعون الى الملا الاعلىٰ ويقذفون من كل جانب
Sahih_International: [So] they may not listen to the exalted assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side,
Pickthall: They cannot listen to the Highest Chiefs for they are pelted from every side,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): (So) they should not strain their ears in the direction of the Exalted Assembly but be cast away from every side,
Shakir: They cannot listen to the exalted assembly and they are thrown at from every side,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): The devils cannot hear those high above. They would be struck from all sides
Mohsin_Khan (MK): They cannot listen to the higher group (angels) for they are pelted from every side.
Arberry: they listen not to the High Council, for they are pelted from every side,
Label: fear

Verse_diac: فَلۡيَنظُرِ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنُ إِلَىٰ طَعَامِهِۦٓ
Verse: فلينظر الانسٰن الىٰ طعامه
Sahih_International: Then let mankind look at his food -
Pickthall: Let man consider his food:
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Then let man look at his food, (and how We provide it):
Shakir: Then let man look to his food,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Let the human being think about (how We produce) his food.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Then let man look at his food,
Arberry: Let Man consider his nourishment.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَقَالَ ٱلۡمَلَأُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِن قَوۡمِهِۦ لَئِنِ ٱتَّبَعۡتُمۡ شُعَيۡبًا إِنَّكُمۡ إِذٗا لَّخَٰسِرُونَ
Verse: وقال الملا الذين كفروا من قومه لئن اتبعتم شعيبا انكم اذا لخٰسرون
Sahih_International: Said the eminent ones who disbelieved among his people, "If you should follow Shu'ayb, indeed, you would then be losers."
Pickthall: But the chieftains of his people, who were disbelieving, said: If ye follow Shu'eyb, then truly ye shall be the losers.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): The leaders, the unbelievers among his people, said: "If ye follow Shu'aib, be sure then ye are ruined!"
Shakir: And the chiefs of those who disbelieved from among his people said: If you follow Shu'aib, you shall then most surely be losers
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): A group of the unbelievers among his people told the others, "If you follow Shu'ayb, you will certainly lose a great deal."
Mohsin_Khan (MK): The chiefs of those who disbelieved among his people said (to their people): "If you follow Shu'aib, be sure then you will be the losers!"
Arberry: Said the Council of those of his people who disbelieved, 'Now, if you follow Shuaib, assuredly in that case you will be losers.'
Label: fear

Verse_diac: إِنَّمَآ أَمۡوَٰلُكُمۡ وَأَوۡلَٰدُكُمۡ فِتۡنَةٞۚ وَٱللَّهُ عِندَهُۥٓ أَجۡرٌ عَظِيمٞ
Verse: انما اموٰلكم واولٰدكم فتنة والله عنده اجر عظيم
Sahih_International: Your wealth and your children are but a trial, and Allah has with Him a great reward.
Pickthall: Your wealth and your children are only a temptation, whereas Allah! with Him is an immense reward.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Your riches and your children may be but a trial: but in the Presence of Allah, is the highest, Reward.
Shakir: Your possessions and your children are only a trial, and Allah it is with Whom is a great reward.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Your property and children are a trial for you, but the reward (which one may receive from God) is great.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Your wealth and your children are only a trial, whereas Allah! With Him is a great reward (Paradise).
Arberry: Your wealth and your children are only a trial; and with God is a mighty wage.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: وَأَنَّا ظَنَنَّآ أَن لَّن نُّعۡجِزَ ٱللَّهَ فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ وَلَن نُّعۡجِزَهُۥ هَرَبٗا
Verse: وانا ظننا ان لن نعجز الله في الارض ولن نعجزه هربا
Sahih_International: And we have become certain that we will never cause failure to Allah upon earth, nor can we escape Him by flight.
Pickthall: And we know that we cannot escape from Allah in the earth, nor can we escape by flight.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): 'But we think that we can by no means frustrate Allah throughout the earth, nor can we frustrate Him by flight.
Shakir: And that we know that we cannot escape Allah in the earth, nor can we escape Him by flight:
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We knew that we could never challenge God whether we stayed on earth or fled elsewhere.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): 'And we think that we cannot escape (from the punishment of) All?h in the earth, nor can we escape (from the punishment) by flight.
Arberry: Indeed, we thought that we should never be able to frustrate God in the earth, neither be able to frustrate Him by flight.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: عَلَيۡهَا تِسۡعَةَ عَشَرَ
Verse: عليها تسعة عشر
Sahih_International: Over it are nineteen [angels].
Pickthall: Above it are nineteen.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Over it are Nineteen.
Shakir: Over it are nineteen.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): and it has nineteen angelic keepers.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Over it are nineteen (angels as guardians and keepers of Hell).
Arberry: over it are nineteen.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: حِكۡمَةُۢ بَٰلِغَةٞۖ فَمَا تُغۡنِ ٱلنُّذُرُ
Verse: حكمة بٰلغة فما تغن النذر
Sahih_International: Extensive wisdom - but warning does not avail [them].
Pickthall: Effective wisdom; but warnings avail not.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Mature wisdom;- but (the preaching of) Warners profits them not.
Shakir: Consummate wisdom-- but warnings do not avail;
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): but the warnings have proved to have no effect on them.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Perfect wisdom (this Quran), but (the preaching of) warners benefit them not,
Arberry: a Wisdom far-reaching; yet warnings do not avail.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَإِنَّ عَلَيۡكَ لَعۡنَتِيٓ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ
Verse: وان عليك لعنتي الىٰ يوم الدين
Sahih_International: And indeed, upon you is My curse until the Day of Recompense."
Pickthall: And lo! My curse is on thee till the Day of Judgment.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "And My curse shall be on thee till the Day of Judgment."
Shakir: And surely My curse is on you to the day of judgment.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): My condemnation will be with you until the Day of Judgment!"
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "And verily!, My Curse is on you till the Day of Recompense."
Arberry: Upon thee shall rest My curse, till the Day of Doom.'
Label: anger

Verse_diac: إِنَّ عَلَيۡنَا جَمۡعَهُۥ وَقُرۡءَانَهُۥ
Verse: ان علينا جمعه وقرءانه
Sahih_International: Indeed, upon Us is its collection [in your heart] and [to make possible] its recitation.
Pickthall: Lo! upon Us (resteth) the putting together thereof and the reading thereof.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): It is for Us to collect it and to promulgate it:
Shakir: Surely on Us (devolves) the collecting of it and the reciting of it.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We shall be responsible for its collection and its recitation.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): It is for Us to collect it and to give you (O Muhammad SAW) the ability to recite it (the Quran),
Arberry: Ours it is to gather it, and to recite it.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: ذَٰلِكَ جَزَيۡنَٰهُم بِمَا كَفَرُواْۖ وَهَلۡ نُجَٰزِيٓ إِلَّا ٱلۡكَفُورَ
Verse: ذٰلك جزينٰهم بما كفروا وهل نجٰزي الا الكفور
Sahih_International: [By] that We repaid them because they disbelieved. And do We [thus] repay except the ungrateful?
Pickthall: This We awarded them because of their ingratitude. Punish We ever any save the ingrates?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): That was the Requital We gave them because they ungratefully rejected Faith: and never do We give (such) requital except to such as are ungrateful rejecters.
Shakir: This We requited them with because they disbelieved; and We do not punish any but the ungrateful.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): This was how We recompensed them for their ungratefulness and thus do We recompense the ungrateful ones.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Like this We requited them because they were ungrateful disbelievers. And never do We requit in such a way except those who are ungrateful, (disbelievers).
Arberry: Thus We recompensed them for their unbelief; and do 'We ever recompense any hut the unbeliever?
Label: anger

Verse_diac: وَلَوۡ قَٰتَلَكُمُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ لَوَلَّوُاْ ٱلۡأَدۡبَٰرَ ثُمَّ لَا يَجِدُونَ وَلِيّٗا وَلَا نَصِيرٗا
Verse: ولو قٰتلكم الذين كفروا لولوا الادبٰر ثم لا يجدون وليا ولا نصيرا
Sahih_International: And if those [Makkans] who disbelieve had fought you, they would have turned their backs [in flight]. Then they would not find a protector or a helper.
Pickthall: And if those who disbelieve join battle with you they will take to flight, and afterward they will find no protecting friend nor helper.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): If the Unbelievers should fight you, they would certainly turn their backs; then would they find neither protector nor helper.
Shakir: And if those who disbelieve fight with you, they would certainly turn (their) backs, then they would not find any protector or a helper.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Had the disbelievers fought against you, they would have run away from the battle and would have found no guardian or helper.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And if those who disbelieve fight against you, they certainly would have turned their backs, then they would have found neither a Wali (protector) nor a helper.
Arberry: If the unbelievers had fought you, they would have turned their backs, and then found neither protector nor helper;
Label: anger

Verse_diac: قَالَ فَبِعِزَّتِكَ لَأُغۡوِيَنَّهُمۡ أَجۡمَعِينَ
Verse: قال فبعزتك لاغوينهم اجمعين
Sahih_International: [Iblees] said, "By your might, I will surely mislead them all
Pickthall: He said: Then, by Thy might, I surely will beguile them every one,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): (Iblis) said: "Then, by Thy power, I will put them all in the wrong,-
Shakir: He said: Then by Thy Might I will surely make them live an evil life, all,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): He said, "By Your Glory, I shall seduce all of them (children of Adam).
Mohsin_Khan (MK): [Iblis (Satan)] said: "By Your Might, then I will surely mislead them all,
Arberry: Said he, 'Now, by Thy glory, I shall pervert them all together,
Label: anger

Verse_diac: قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسۡتَكۡبَرُوٓاْ إِنَّا بِٱلَّذِيٓ ءَامَنتُم بِهِۦ كَٰفِرُونَ
Verse: قال الذين استكبروا انا بالذي ءامنتم به كٰفرون
Sahih_International: Said those who were arrogant, "Indeed we, in that which you have believed, are disbelievers."
Pickthall: Those who were scornful said: Lo! in that which ye believe we are disbelievers.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): The Arrogant party said: "For our part, we reject what ye believe in."
Shakir: Those who were haughty said: Surely we are deniers of what you believe in.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): The proud oppressors said, "We reject that which you believe in".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Those who were arrogant said: "Verily, we disbelieve in that which you believe in."
Arberry: Said the ones who waxed proud, 'As for us, we are unbelievers in the thing in which you believe.'
Label: anger

Verse_diac: وَبَدَا لَهُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا كَسَبُواْ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
Verse: وبدا لهم سيات ما كسبوا وحاق بهم ما كانوا به يستهزءون
Sahih_International: And there will appear to them the evils they had earned, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
Pickthall: And the evils that they earned will appear unto them, and that whereat they used to scoff will surround them.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): For the evils of their Deeds will confront them, and they will be (completely) encircled by that which they used to mock at!
Shakir: And the evil (consequences) of what they wrought shall become plain to them, and the very thing they mocked at shall beset them.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Their bad deeds will become public and they will be surrounded by the torment which they had mocked during their worldly life.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And the evils of that which they earned will become apparent to them, and they will be encircled by that which they used to mock at!
Arberry: and there would appear to them die evils of that they have earned, and they would be encompassed by that they mocked at.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: وَأُزۡلِفَتِ ٱلۡجَنَّةُ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ غَيۡرَ بَعِيدٍ
Verse: وازلفت الجنة للمتقين غير بعيد
Sahih_International: And Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far,
Pickthall: And the Garden is brought nigh for those who kept from evil, no longer distant.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And the Garden will be brought nigh to the Righteous,- no more a thing distant.
Shakir: And the garden shall be brought near to those who guard (against evil), not far off:
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Paradise will be brought near for the pious ones
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And Paradise will be brought near to the Muttaqun (pious - see V.2:2) not far off.
Arberry: And Paradise shall be brought forward to the godfearing, not afar:
Label: joy

Verse_diac: إِن يَشَأۡ يُذۡهِبۡكُمۡ أَيُّهَا ٱلنَّاسُ وَيَأۡتِ بِـَٔاخَرِينَۚ وَكَانَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكَ قَدِيرٗا
Verse: ان يشا يذهبكم ايها الناس ويات باخرين وكان الله علىٰ ذٰلك قديرا
Sahih_International: If He wills, He can do away with you, O people, and bring others [in your place]. And ever is Allah competent to do that.
Pickthall: If He will, He can remove you, O people, and produce others (in your stead). Allah is Able to do that.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): If it were His will, He could destroy you, o mankind, and create another race; for He hath power this to do.
Shakir: If He please, He can make you pass away, O people! and bring others; and Allah has the power to do this.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Had God wanted He could have destroyed you all and replaced you by another people; He has the power to do so.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): If He wills, He can take you away, O people, and bring others. And Allah is Ever All­Potent over that.
Arberry: If He will, He can put you away, O men, and bring others; surely God is powerful over that.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: قَدۡ أَفۡلَحَ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
Verse: قد افلح من تزكىٰ
Sahih_International: He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself
Pickthall: He is successful who groweth,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): But those will prosper who purify themselves,
Shakir: He indeed shall be successful who purifies himself,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Lasting happiness will be for those who purify themselves,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Indeed whosoever purifies himself (by avoiding polytheism and accepting Islamic Monotheism) shall achieve success,
Arberry: Prosperous is he who has cleansed himself,
Label: joy

Verse_diac: أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلۡكَفَرَةُ ٱلۡفَجَرَةُ
Verse: اولٰئك هم الكفرة الفجرة
Sahih_International: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked ones.
Pickthall: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Such will be the Rejecters of Allah, the doers of iniquity.
Shakir: These are they who are unbelievers, the wicked.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): These will be the faces of the sinful disbelievers.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Such will be the Kafarah (disbelievers in Allah, in His Oneness, and in His Messenger Muhammad (Peace be upon him), etc.), the Fajarah (wicked evil doers).
Arberry: those -- they are the unbelievers, the libertines.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنۡهَا ٱلۡبُطُونَ
Verse: فمالون منها البطون
Sahih_International: And filling with it your bellies
Pickthall: And will fill your bellies therewith;
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "Then will ye fill your insides therewith,
Shakir: And fill (your) bellies with it;
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): filling your bellies, with it
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "Then you will fill your bellies therewith,
Arberry: and you shall fill therewith your bellies
Label: fear

Verse_diac: قَالَ يَٰهَٰرُونُ مَا مَنَعَكَ إِذۡ رَأَيۡتَهُمۡ ضَلُّوٓاْ
Verse: قال يٰهٰرون ما منعك اذ رايتهم ضلوا
Sahih_International: [Moses] said, "O Aaron, what prevented you, when you saw them going astray,
Pickthall: He (Moses) said: O Aaron! What held thee back when thou didst see them gone astray,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): (Moses) said: "O Aaron! what kept thee back, when thou sawest them going wrong,
Shakir: (Musa) said: O Haroun! what prevented you, when you saw them going astray,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Then Moses asked Aaron, "What made you not follow me when you saw them in error?
Mohsin_Khan (MK): [Musa (Moses)] said: "O Harun (Aaron)! What stopped you when you saw them going astray;
Arberry: Moses said, 'What prevented thee, Aaron, when thou sawest them in error,
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: فَإِنَّهُمۡ لَأٓكِلُونَ مِنۡهَا فَمَالِـُٔونَ مِنۡهَا ٱلۡبُطُونَ
Verse: فانهم لاكلون منها فمالون منها البطون
Sahih_International: And indeed, they will eat from it and fill with it their bellies.
Pickthall: And lo! they verily must eat thereof, and fill (their) bellies therewith.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Truly they will eat thereof and fill their bellies therewith.
Shakir: Then most surely they shall eat of it and fill (their) bellies with it.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): The dwellers of hell will eat that fruit and fill-up their bellies.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Truly, they will eat thereof and fill their bellies therewith.
Arberry: and they eat of it, and of it fill their bellies,
Label: anger

Verse_diac: فَذُوقُواْ فَلَن نَّزِيدَكُمۡ إِلَّا عَذَابًا
Verse: فذوقوا فلن نزيدكم الا عذابا
Sahih_International: "So taste [the penalty], and never will We increase you except in torment."
Pickthall: So taste (of that which ye have earned). No increase do We give you save of torment.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "So taste ye (the fruits of your deeds); for no increase shall We grant you, except in Punishment."
Shakir: So taste! for We will not add to you aught but chastisement.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): (They will be told), "Suffer, We shall only increase the torment for you".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): So taste you (the results of your evil actions); no increase shall We give you, except in torment.
Arberry: 'Taste! We shall increase you not save in chastisement.'
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَعَدَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ لَهُم مَّغۡفِرَةٞ وَأَجۡرٌ عَظِيمٞ
Verse: وعد الله الذين ءامنوا وعملوا الصٰلحٰت لهم مغفرة واجر عظيم
Sahih_International: Allah has promised those who believe and do righteous deeds [that] for them there is forgiveness and great reward.
Pickthall: Allah hath promised those who believe and do good works: Theirs will be forgiveness and immense reward.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): To those who believe and do deeds of righteousness hath Allah promised forgiveness and a great reward.
Shakir: Allah has promised to those who believe and do good deeds (that) they shall have forgiveness and a mighty reward.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): God has promised forgiveness and a great reward to the righteously striving believers.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Allah has promised those who believe (in the Oneness of Allah - Islamic Monotheism) and do deeds of righteousness, that for them there is forgiveness and a great reward (i.e. Paradise).
Arberry: God has promised those that believe, and do deeds of righteousness; they shall have; forgiveness and a mighty wage.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: ثُمَّ قَبَضۡنَٰهُ إِلَيۡنَا قَبۡضٗا يَسِيرٗا
Verse: ثم قبضنٰه الينا قبضا يسيرا
Sahih_International: Then We hold it in hand for a brief grasp.
Pickthall: Then We withdraw it unto Us, a gradual withdrawal?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Then We draw it in towards Ourselves,- a contraction by easy stages.
Shakir: Then We take it to Ourselves, taking little by little.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Then He reduces it in gradual steps.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Then We withdraw it to Us a gradual concealed withdrawal.
Arberry: thereafter We seize it to Ourselves, drawing it gently.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: فَقَالُوٓاْ أَنُؤۡمِنُ لِبَشَرَيۡنِ مِثۡلِنَا وَقَوۡمُهُمَا لَنَا عَٰبِدُونَ
Verse: فقالوا انؤمن لبشرين مثلنا وقومهما لنا عٰبدون
Sahih_International: They said, "Should we believe two men like ourselves while their people are for us in servitude?"
Pickthall: And they said: Shall we put faith in two mortals like ourselves, and whose folk are servile unto us?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): They said: "Shall we believe in two men like ourselves? And their people are subject to us!"
Shakir: And they said: What! shall we believe in two mortals like ourselves while their people serve us?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): They said, "Should we believe in two mere mortals who are like ourselves and whose people are our slaves?"
Mohsin_Khan (MK): They said: "Shall we believe in two men like ourselves, and their people are obedient to us with humility (and we use them to serve us as we like)."
Arberry: and they said, 'What, shall we believe two mortals like ourselves, whose people are our servants?'
Label: anger

Verse_diac: وَمَآ أَدۡرَىٰكَ مَا ٱلۡحَآقَّةُ
Verse: وما ادرىٰك ما الحاقة
Sahih_International: And what can make you know what is the Inevitable Reality?
Pickthall: Ah, what will convey unto thee what the reality is!
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And what will make thee realise what the Sure Reality is?
Shakir: And what would make you realize what the sure calamity is!
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Would that you knew (in detail) what the Inevitable is!
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And what will make you know what the Reality is?
Arberry: And what will teach thee what is the Indubitable?
Label: fear

Verse_diac: لَوۡ أَنزَلۡنَا هَٰذَا ٱلۡقُرۡءَانَ عَلَىٰ جَبَلٖ لَّرَأَيۡتَهُۥ خَٰشِعٗا مُّتَصَدِّعٗا مِّنۡ خَشۡيَةِ ٱللَّهِۚ وَتِلۡكَ ٱلۡأَمۡثَٰلُ نَضۡرِبُهَا لِلنَّاسِ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
Verse: لو انزلنا هٰذا القرءان علىٰ جبل لرايته خٰشعا متصدعا من خشية الله وتلك الامثٰل نضربها للناس لعلهم يتفكرون
Sahih_International: If We had sent down this Qur'an upon a mountain, you would have seen it humbled and coming apart from fear of Allah. And these examples We present to the people that perhaps they will give thought.
Pickthall: If We had caused this Qur'an to descend upon a mountain, thou (O Muhammad) verily hadst seen it humbled, rent asunder by the fear of Allah. Such similitudes coin We for mankind that haply they may reflect.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Had We sent down this Qur'an on a mountain, verily, thou wouldst have seen it humble itself and cleave asunder for fear of Allah. Such are the similitudes which We propound to men, that they may reflect.
Shakir: Had We sent down this Quran on a mountain, you would certainly have seen it falling down, splitting asunder because of the fear of Allah, and We set forth these parables to men that they may reflect.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): The people of Paradise and hell are not alike; the people of Paradise are the successful ones. Had We sent down this Quran on a mountain, you would have seen it humbled and rent asunder for fear of God. These are parables which We tell to people so that perhaps they will think.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Had We sent down this Quran on a mountain, you would surely have seen it humbling itself and rending asunder by the fear of Allah. Such are the parables which We put forward to mankind that they may reflect .
Arberry: If We had sent down this Koran upon a mountain, thou wouldst have seen it humbled, split asunder out of the fear of God. And those similitudes -- We strike them for men; haply they will reflect.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: فَٱنتَقَمۡنَا مِنۡهُمۡ فَأَغۡرَقۡنَٰهُمۡ فِي ٱلۡيَمِّ بِأَنَّهُمۡ كَذَّبُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَكَانُواْ عَنۡهَا غَٰفِلِينَ
Verse: فانتقمنا منهم فاغرقنٰهم في اليم بانهم كذبوا بايٰتنا وكانوا عنها غٰفلين
Sahih_International: So We took retribution from them, and We drowned them in the sea because they denied Our signs and were heedless of them.
Pickthall: Therefore We took retribution from them; therefore We drowned them in the sea: because they denied Our revelations and were heedless of them.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): So We exacted retribution from them: We drowned them in the sea, because they rejected Our Signs and failed to take warning from them.
Shakir: Therefore We inflicted retribution on them and drowned them in the sea because they rejected Our signs and were heedless of them.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We took revenge on them for their rejecting Our miracles, by drowning them in the sea, but they were not aware of (reality).
Mohsin_Khan (MK): So We took retribution from them. We drowned them in the sea, because they belied Our Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) and were heedless about them.
Arberry: So We took vengeance on them, and drowned them in the sea, for that they cried lies to Our signs and heeded them not.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: فَعَصَوۡاْ رَسُولَ رَبِّهِمۡ فَأَخَذَهُمۡ أَخۡذَةٗ رَّابِيَةً
Verse: فعصوا رسول ربهم فاخذهم اخذة رابية
Sahih_International: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a seizure exceeding [in severity].
Pickthall: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, therefor did He grip them with a tightening grip.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And disobeyed (each) the messenger of their Lord; so He punished them with an abundant Penalty.
Shakir: And they disobeyed the Messenger of their Lord, so He punished them with a vehement punishment.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): They disobeyed the Messenger of their Lord and He seized them with torment which increased with time.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And they disobeyed their Lord's Messenger, so He punished them with a strong punishment.
Arberry: and they rebelled against the Messenger of their Lord, and He seized them with a surpassing grip.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: أَلَيۡسَ ذَٰلِكَ بِقَٰدِرٍ عَلَىٰٓ أَن يُحۡـِۧيَ ٱلۡمَوۡتَىٰ
Verse: اليس ذٰلك بقٰدر علىٰ ان يحي الموتىٰ
Sahih_International: Is not that [Creator] Able to give life to the dead?
Pickthall: Is not He (Who doeth so) Able to bring the dead to life?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Has not He, (the same), the power to give life to the dead?
Shakir: Is not He able to give life to the dead?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Does He then not have the power to bring the dead back to life?
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Is not He (Allah Who does that), Able to give life to the dead? (Yes! He is Able to do all things).
Arberry: What, is He not able to quicken the dead?
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَذَكِّرۡ فَإِنَّ ٱلذِّكۡرَىٰ تَنفَعُ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
Verse: وذكر فان الذكرىٰ تنفع المؤمنين
Sahih_International: And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the believers.
Pickthall: And warn, for warning profiteth believers.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): But teach (thy Message) for teaching benefits the Believers.
Shakir: And continue to remind, for surely the reminder profits the believers.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Keep on reminding them. This benefits the believers.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And remind (by preaching the Quran, O Muhammad SAW) for verily, the reminding profits the believers.
Arberry: And remind; the Reminder profits the believers.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَكُنَّا نُكَذِّبُ بِيَوۡمِ ٱلدِّينِ
Verse: وكنا نكذب بيوم الدين
Sahih_International: And we used to deny the Day of Recompense
Pickthall: And we used to deny the Day of Judgment,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "And we used to deny the Day of Judgment,
Shakir: And we used to call the day of judgment a lie;
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): and rejected the Day of Judgment
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "And we used to belie the Day of Recompense
Arberry: and we cried lies to the Day of Doom,
Label: anger

Verse_diac: وَحَدَآئِقَ غُلۡبٗا
Verse: وحدائق غلبا
Sahih_International: And gardens of dense shrubbery
Pickthall: And garden-closes of thick foliage
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And enclosed Gardens, dense with lofty trees,
Shakir: And thick gardens,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): thickly planted gardens,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And gardens, dense with many trees,
Arberry: and dense-tree'd gardens,
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَإِذَآ أَرَدۡنَآ أَن نُّهۡلِكَ قَرۡيَةً أَمَرۡنَا مُتۡرَفِيهَا فَفَسَقُواْ فِيهَا فَحَقَّ عَلَيۡهَا ٱلۡقَوۡلُ فَدَمَّرۡنَٰهَا تَدۡمِيرٗا
Verse: واذا اردنا ان نهلك قرية امرنا مترفيها ففسقوا فيها فحق عليها القول فدمرنٰها تدميرا
Sahih_International: And when We intend to destroy a city, We command its affluent but they defiantly disobey therein; so the word comes into effect upon it, and We destroy it with [complete] destruction.
Pickthall: And when We would destroy a township We send commandment to its folk who live at ease, and afterward they commit abomination therein, and so the Word (of doom) hath effect for it, and we annihilate it with complete annihilation.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): When We decide to destroy a population, We (first) send a definite order to those among them who are given the good things of this life and yet transgress; so that the word is proved true against them: then (it is) We destroy them utterly.
Shakir: And when We wish to destroy a town, We send Our commandment to the people of it who lead easy lives, but they transgress therein; thus the word proves true against it, so We destroy it with utter destruction.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): When We decide to destroy a town We warn the rich ones therein who commit evil. Thus it becomes deserving to destruction and We destroy its very foundations.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And when We decide to destroy a town (population), We (first) send a definite order (to obey Allah and be righteous) to those among them [or We (first) increase in number those of its population] who are given the good things of this life. Then, they transgress therein, and thus the word (of torment) is justified against it (them). Then We destroy it with complete destruction.
Arberry: And when We desire to destroy a city, We command its men who live at ease, and they commit ungodliness therein, then the Word is realized against it, and We destroy it utterly.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: ثُمَّ أَدۡبَرَ وَٱسۡتَكۡبَرَ
Verse: ثم ادبر واستكبر
Sahih_International: Then he turned back and was arrogant
Pickthall: Then turned he away in pride
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Then he turned back and was haughty;
Shakir: Then he turned back and was big with pride,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): then turned back, and swelling-up with pride,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Then he turned back and was proud;
Arberry: then he retreated, and waxed proud.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: قَالُواْ بَلۡ أَنتُمۡ لَا مَرۡحَبَۢا بِكُمۡۖ أَنتُمۡ قَدَّمۡتُمُوهُ لَنَاۖ فَبِئۡسَ ٱلۡقَرَارُ
Verse: قالوا بل انتم لا مرحبا بكم انتم قدمتموه لنا فبئس القرار
Sahih_International: They will say, "Nor you! No welcome for you. You, [our leaders], brought this upon us, and wretched is the settlement."
Pickthall: They say: Nay, but you (misleaders), for you there is no word of welcome. Ye prepared this for us (by your misleading). Now hapless is the plight.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): (The followers shall cry to the misleaders:) "Nay, ye (too)! No welcome for you! It is ye who have brought this upon us! Now evil is (this) place to stay in!"
Shakir: They shall say: Nay! you-- no welcome to you: you did proffer it to us, so evil is the resting-place.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Their followers will say, "In fact, it is you who deserve condemnation. It was you who led us to hell, a terrible dwelling".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): (The followers of the misleaders will say): "Nay, you (too)! No welcome for you! It is you (misleaders) who brought this upon us (because you misled us in the world), so evil is this place to stay in!"
Arberry: They say, 'No, it is you have no Welcome; you forwarded it for us; how evil a stablishment!'
Label: anger

Verse_diac: وَنُوحًا إِذۡ نَادَىٰ مِن قَبۡلُ فَٱسۡتَجَبۡنَا لَهُۥ فَنَجَّيۡنَٰهُ وَأَهۡلَهُۥ مِنَ ٱلۡكَرۡبِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
Verse: ونوحا اذ نادىٰ من قبل فاستجبنا له فنجينٰه واهله من الكرب العظيم
Sahih_International: And [mention] Noah, when he called [to Allah] before [that time], so We responded to him and saved him and his family from the great flood.
Pickthall: And Noah, when he cried of old, We heard his prayer and saved him and his household from the great affliction.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): (Remember) Noah, when he cried (to Us) aforetime: We listened to his (prayer) and delivered him and his family from great distress.
Shakir: And Nuh, when he cried aforetime, so We answered him, and delivered him and his followers from the great calamity.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We answered the prayer of Noah who had prayed to Us before and saved him and his followers from the great disaster.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And (remember) Nuh (Noah), when he cried (to Us) aforetime. We listened to his invocation and saved him and his family from great distress.
Arberry: And Noah -- when he called before, and We answered him, and delivered him and his people from the great distress,
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَظِلّٖ مِّن يَحۡمُومٖ
Verse: وظل من يحموم
Sahih_International: And a shade of black smoke,
Pickthall: And shadow of black smoke,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And in the shades of Black Smoke:
Shakir: And the shade of black smoke,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): scalding water and under a shadow of black smoke,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And shadow of black smoke,
Arberry: and the shadow of a smoking blaze
Label: fear

Verse_diac: فَـَٔاتَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ثَوَابَ ٱلدُّنۡيَا وَحُسۡنَ ثَوَابِ ٱلۡأٓخِرَةِۗ وَٱللَّهُ يُحِبُّ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
Verse: فاتىٰهم الله ثواب الدنيا وحسن ثواب الاخرة والله يحب المحسنين
Sahih_International: So Allah gave them the reward of this world and the good reward of the Hereafter. And Allah loves the doers of good.
Pickthall: So Allah gave them the reward of the world and the good reward of the Hereafter. Allah loveth those whose deeds are good.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And Allah gave them a reward in this world, and the excellent reward of the Hereafter. For Allah Loveth those who do good.
Shakir: So Allah gave them the reward of this world and better reward of the hereafter and Allah loves those who do good (to others).
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): God gave them their reward in this world and the best reward of the life to come. God loves the righteous ones.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): So Allah gave them the reward of this world, and the excellent reward of the Hereafter. And Allah loves Al-Muhsinun (the good­doers - see the footnote of V.3:134).
Arberry: And God gave them the reward of this world and the fairest reward of the world to come; and God loves the good-doers.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: يُصۡلِحۡ لَكُمۡ أَعۡمَٰلَكُمۡ وَيَغۡفِرۡ لَكُمۡ ذُنُوبَكُمۡۗ وَمَن يُطِعِ ٱللَّهَ وَرَسُولَهُۥ فَقَدۡ فَازَ فَوۡزًا عَظِيمًا
Verse: يصلح لكم اعمٰلكم ويغفر لكم ذنوبكم ومن يطع الله ورسوله فقد فاز فوزا عظيما
Sahih_International: He will [then] amend for you your deeds and forgive you your sins. And whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger has certainly attained a great attainment.
Pickthall: He will adjust your works for you and will forgive you your sins. Whosoever obeyeth Allah and His messenger, he verily hath gained a signal victory.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): That He may make your conduct whole and sound and forgive you your sins: He that obeys Allah and His Messenger, has already attained the highest achievement.
Shakir: He will put your deeds into a right state for you, and forgive you your faults; and whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger, he indeed achieves a mighty success.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): God will reform your deeds and forgive your sins. One who obeys God and His Messenger will certainly achieve a great success.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): He will direct you to do righteous good deeds and will forgive you your sins. And whosoever obeys Allah and His Messenger (SAW) he has indeed achieved a great achievement (i.e. he will be saved from the Hell-fire and made to enter Paradise).
Arberry: and He will set right your deeds for you and will forgive you your sins. Whosoever obeys God and His Messenger has won a mighty triumph.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: مَا ٱتَّخَذَ ٱللَّهُ مِن وَلَدٖ وَمَا كَانَ مَعَهُۥ مِنۡ إِلَٰهٍۚ إِذٗا لَّذَهَبَ كُلُّ إِلَٰهِۭ بِمَا خَلَقَ وَلَعَلَا بَعۡضُهُمۡ عَلَىٰ بَعۡضٖۚ سُبۡحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ
Verse: ما اتخذ الله من ولد وما كان معه من الٰه اذا لذهب كل الٰه بما خلق ولعلا بعضهم علىٰ بعض سبحٰن الله عما يصفون
Sahih_International: Allah has not taken any son, nor has there ever been with Him any deity. [If there had been], then each deity would have taken what it created, and some of them would have sought to overcome others. Exalted is Allah above what they describe [concerning Him].
Pickthall: Allah hath not chosen any son, nor is there any god along with Him; else would each god have assuredly championed that which he created, and some of them would assuredly have overcome others. Glorified be Allah above all that they allege.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): No son did Allah beget, nor is there any god along with Him: (if there were many gods), behold, each god would have taken away what he had created, and some would have lorded it over others! Glory to Allah! (He is free) from the (sort of) things they attribute to Him!
Shakir: Never did Allah take to Himself a son, and never was there with him any (other) god-- in that case would each god have certainly taken away what he created, and some of them would certainly have overpowered others; glory be to Allah above what they describe!
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): God has never given birth to a son and there is no other god besides Him. If there were, each god would have taken away his creatures and claimed superiority over the others. God is too exalted to be as they believe Him to be.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): No son (or offspring or children) did Allah beget, nor is there any ilah (god) along with Him; (if there had been many gods), behold, each god would have taken away what he had created, and some would have tried to overcome others! Glorified be Allah above all that they attribute to Him!
Arberry: God has not taken to Himself any son, nor is there any god with Him; for then each god would have taken off that he created and some of them would have risen up over others; glory to be God, beyond that they describe,
Label: fear

Verse_diac: قَالُوٓاْ أَءِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابٗا وَعِظَٰمًا أَءِنَّا لَمَبۡعُوثُونَ
Verse: قالوا اءذا متنا وكنا ترابا وعظٰما اءنا لمبعوثون
Sahih_International: They said, "When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
Pickthall: They say: When we are dead and have become (mere) dust and bones, shall we then, forsooth, be raised again?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): They say: "What! when we die and become dust and bones, could we really be raised up again?
Shakir: They say: What! When we are dead and become dust and bones, shall we then be raised?
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): They say, "When we die and become dust and bones, shall we then be raised up again?
Mohsin_Khan (MK): They said: "When we are dead and have become dust and bones, shall we be resurrected indeed?
Arberry: They said, 'What, when we are dead and become dust and bones, shall we be indeed raised up?
Label: anger

Verse_diac: مَآ أُرِيدُ مِنۡهُم مِّن رِّزۡقٖ وَمَآ أُرِيدُ أَن يُطۡعِمُونِ
Verse: ما اريد منهم من رزق وما اريد ان يطعمون
Sahih_International: I do not want from them any provision, nor do I want them to feed Me.
Pickthall: I seek no livelihood from them, nor do I ask that they should feed Me.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): No Sustenance do I require of them, nor do I require that they should feed Me.
Shakir: I do not desire from them any sustenance and I do not desire that they should feed Me.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): I do not expect to receive any sustenance from them or that they should feed Me.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): I seek not any provision from them (i.e. provision for themselves or for My creatures) nor do I ask that they should feed Me (i.e. feed themselves or My creatures).
Arberry: I desire of them no provision, neither do I desire that they should feed Me.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِقَآئِهِۦٓ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ يَئِسُواْ مِن رَّحۡمَتِي وَأُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ
Verse: والذين كفروا بايٰت الله ولقائه اولٰئك يئسوا من رحمتي واولٰئك لهم عذاب اليم
Sahih_International: And the ones who disbelieve in the signs of Allah and the meeting with Him - those have despaired of My mercy, and they will have a painful punishment.
Pickthall: Those who disbelieve in the revelations of Allah and in (their) Meeting with Him, such have no hope of My mercy. For such there is a painful doom.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Those who reject the Signs of Allah and the Meeting with Him (in the Hereafter),- it is they who shall despair of My Mercy: it is they who will (suffer) a most grievous Penalty.
Shakir: And (as to) those who disbelieve in the communications of Allah and His meeting, they have despaired of My mercy, and these it is that shall have a painful punishment.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Those who have rejected God's revelations have no hope in receiving His mercy. They will face a painful torment.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And those who disbelieve in the Ayat (proofs, evidences, verses, lessons, signs, revelations, etc.) of Allah and the Meeting with Him, it is they who have no hope of My Mercy, and it is they who will (have) a painful torment.
Arberry: And those who disbelieve in God's signs and the encounter with Him -- they despair of My mercy, and there awaits them a painful chastisement.)
Label: anger

Verse_diac: فَإِذَا سَوَّيۡتُهُۥ وَنَفَخۡتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِي فَقَعُواْ لَهُۥ سَٰجِدِينَ
Verse: فاذا سويته ونفخت فيه من روحي فقعوا له سٰجدين
Sahih_International: And when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration."
Pickthall: So, when I have made him and have breathed into him of My Spirit, do ye fall down, prostrating yourselves unto him.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "When I have fashioned him (in due proportion) and breathed into him of My spirit, fall ye down in obeisance unto him."
Shakir: So when I have made him complete and breathed into him of My spirit, fall down making obeisance to him.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): When it is properly shaped and I have blown My Spirit into it, you should then bow down in prostration".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "So, when I have fashioned him completely and breathed into him (Adam) the soul which I created for him, then fall (you) down prostrating yourselves unto him."
Arberry: When I have shaped him, and breathed My spirit in him, fall you down, bowing before him!'
Label: fear

Verse_diac: لِمِثۡلِ هَٰذَا فَلۡيَعۡمَلِ ٱلۡعَٰمِلُونَ
Verse: لمثل هٰذا فليعمل العٰملون
Sahih_International: For the like of this let the workers [on earth] work.
Pickthall: For the like of this, then, let the workers work.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): For the like of this let all strive, who wish to strive.
Shakir: For the like of this then let the workers work.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): for which one must strive hard.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): For the like of this let the workers work.
Arberry: for the like of this let the workers work.'
Label: joy

Verse_diac: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنۡهُمُ ٱلۡمُخۡلَصِينَ
Verse: الا عبادك منهم المخلصين
Sahih_International: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."
Pickthall: Save Thy single-minded slaves among them.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "Except Thy Servants amongst them, sincere and purified (by Thy Grace)."
Shakir: Except Thy servants from among them, the purified ones.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): except Your sincere servants among them".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "Except Your chosen slaves amongst them (faithful, obedient, true believers of Islamic Monotheism)."
Arberry: excepting those Thy servants among them that are sincere.'
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَيَعۡلَمُ مَا تُكِنُّ صُدُورُهُمۡ وَمَا يُعۡلِنُونَ
Verse: وان ربك ليعلم ما تكن صدورهم وما يعلنون
Sahih_International: And indeed, your Lord knows what their breasts conceal and what they declare.
Pickthall: Lo! thy Lord knoweth surely all that their bosoms hide, and all that they proclaim.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And verily thy Lord knoweth all that their hearts do hide. As well as all that they reveal.
Shakir: And most surely your Lord knows what their breasts conceal and what they manifest.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Your Lord certainly knows whatever their hearts conceal or reveal.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And verily, your Lord knows what their breasts conceal and what they reveal.
Arberry: Surely thy Lord knows what their hearts conceal, and what they publish.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: ۞إِنَّ ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ خُلِقَ هَلُوعًا
Verse: ان الانسٰن خلق هلوعا
Sahih_International: Indeed, mankind was created anxious:
Pickthall: Lo! man was created anxious,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Truly man was created very impatient;-
Shakir: Surely man is created of a hasty temperament
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Human beings are created greedy.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Verily, man (disbeliever) was created very impatient;
Arberry: Surely man was created fretful,
Label: fear

Verse_diac: هَٰذَاۚ وَإِنَّ لِلطَّٰغِينَ لَشَرَّ مَـَٔابٖ
Verse: هٰذا وان للطٰغين لشر ماب
Sahih_International: This [is so]. But indeed, for the transgressors is an evil place of return -
Pickthall: This (is for the righteous). And lo! for the transgressors there with be an evil journey's end,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Yea, such! but - for the wrong-doers will be an evil place of (Final) Return!-
Shakir: This (shall be so); and most surely there is an evil resort for the inordinate ones;
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): However, the rebellious ones will have the worst place to return.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): This is so! And for the Taghun (transgressors, disobedient to Allah and His Messenger - disbelievers in the Oneness of Allah, criminals, etc.), will be an evil final return (Fire),
Arberry: All this; but for the insolent awaits an ill resort,
Label: fear

Verse_diac: فَمَا ٱسۡتَطَٰعُواْ مِن قِيَامٖ وَمَا كَانُواْ مُنتَصِرِينَ
Verse: فما استطٰعوا من قيام وما كانوا منتصرين
Sahih_International: And they were unable to arise, nor could they defend themselves.
Pickthall: And they were unable to rise up, nor could they help themselves.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Then they could not even stand (on their feet), nor could they help themselves.
Shakir: So they were not able to rise up, nor could they defend themselves-
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): They were unable to stand up, nor were they helped.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Then they were unable to rise up, nor could they help themselves.
Arberry: and they were not able to stand upright, and were not helped.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: وَأَن لَّا تَعۡلُواْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِۖ إِنِّيٓ ءَاتِيكُم بِسُلۡطَٰنٖ مُّبِينٖ
Verse: وان لا تعلوا على الله اني ءاتيكم بسلطٰن مبين
Sahih_International: And [saying], "Be not haughty with Allah. Indeed, I have come to you with clear authority.
Pickthall: And saying: Be not proud against Allah. Lo! I bring you a clear warrant.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): "And be not arrogant as against Allah: for I come to you with authority manifest.
Shakir: And that do not exalt yourselves against Allah, surely I will bring to you a clear authority:
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Do not consider yourselves above God? I shall show you a manifest authority (in support of my truthfulness).
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "And exalt not (yourselves) against Allah. Truly, I have come to you with a manifest authority.
Arberry: and, 'Rise not up against God; behold, I come to you with a clear authority,
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَبِٱلۡمِرۡصَادِ
Verse: ان ربك لبالمرصاد
Sahih_International: Indeed, your Lord is in observation.
Pickthall: Lo! thy Lord is ever watchful.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): For thy Lord is (as a Guardian) on a watch-tower.
Shakir: Most sure!y your Lord is watching.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): your Lord keeps an eye on (all evil-doing people).
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Verily, your Lord is Ever Watchful (over them).
Arberry: surely thy Lord is ever on the watch.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: فَلَمَّا رَأَوۡهُ عَارِضٗا مُّسۡتَقۡبِلَ أَوۡدِيَتِهِمۡ قَالُواْ هَٰذَا عَارِضٞ مُّمۡطِرُنَاۚ بَلۡ هُوَ مَا ٱسۡتَعۡجَلۡتُم بِهِۦۖ رِيحٞ فِيهَا عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٞ
Verse: فلما راوه عارضا مستقبل اوديتهم قالوا هٰذا عارض ممطرنا بل هو ما استعجلتم به ريح فيها عذاب اليم
Sahih_International: And when they saw it as a cloud approaching their valleys, they said, "This is a cloud bringing us rain!" Rather, it is that for which you were impatient: a wind, within it a painful punishment,
Pickthall: Then, when they beheld it as a dense cloud coming toward their valleys, they said: Here is a cloud bringing us rain. Nay, but it is that which ye did seek to hasten, a wind wherein is painful torment,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Then, when they saw the (Penalty in the shape of) a cloud traversing the sky, coming to meet their valleys, they said, "This cloud will give us rain!" "Nay, it is the (Calamity) ye were asking to be hastened!- A wind wherein is a Grievous Penalty!
Shakir: So when they saw it as a cloud appearing in the sky advancing towards their valleys, they said: This is a cloud which will give us rain. Nay! it is what you sought to hasten on, a blast of wind in which is a painful punishment,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): When they saw the torment as a cloud proceeding to their valleys, they said, "This cloud will bring us rain." He said, "No, it is the torment which you wanted to suffer immediately. It is a wind bearing and painful torment.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Then, when they saw it as a dense cloud coming towards their valleys, they said: "This is a cloud bringing us rain!" Nay, but it is that (torment) which you were asking to be hastened! a wind wherein is a painful torment!
Arberry: Then, when they saw it as a sudden cloud coming towards their valleys, they said, 'This is a cloud, that shall give us rain!' 'Not so; rather it is that you sought to hasten -- a wind, wherein is a painful chastisement,
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَٱلصُّبۡحِ إِذَا تَنَفَّسَ
Verse: والصبح اذا تنفس
Sahih_International: And by the dawn when it breathes
Pickthall: And the breath of morning
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And the Dawn as it breathes away the darkness;-
Shakir: And the morning when it brightens,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): and brightening morning,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And by the dawn as it brightens;
Arberry: by the dawn sighing,
Label: fear

Verse_diac: لِيُحِقَّ ٱلۡحَقَّ وَيُبۡطِلَ ٱلۡبَٰطِلَ وَلَوۡ كَرِهَ ٱلۡمُجۡرِمُونَ
Verse: ليحق الحق ويبطل البٰطل ولو كره المجرمون
Sahih_International: That He should establish the truth and abolish falsehood, even if the criminals disliked it.
Pickthall: That He might cause the Truth to triumph and bring vanity to naught, however much the guilty might oppose;
Yusuf_Ali (YA): That He might justify Truth and prove Falsehood false, distasteful though it be to those in guilt.
Shakir: That He may manifest the truth of what was true and show the falsehood of what was false, though the guilty disliked.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): so that the truth would stand supreme and falsehood would exist no more, even though the criminals dislike it.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): That He might cause the truth to triumph and bring falsehood to nothing, even though the Mujrimun (disbelievers, polytheists, sinners, criminals, etc.) hate it.
Arberry: and that He might verify the truth and prove untrue the untrue, though the sinners were averse to it.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: وَأَمَّآ إِذَا مَا ٱبۡتَلَىٰهُ فَقَدَرَ عَلَيۡهِ رِزۡقَهُۥ فَيَقُولُ رَبِّيٓ أَهَٰنَنِ
Verse: واما اذا ما ابتلىٰه فقدر عليه رزقه فيقول ربي اهٰنن
Sahih_International: But when He tries him and restricts his provision, he says, "My Lord has humiliated me."
Pickthall: But whenever He trieth him by straitening his means of life, he saith: My Lord despiseth me.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): But when He trieth him, restricting his subsistence for him, then saith he (in despair), "My Lord hath humiliated me!"
Shakir: But when He tries him (differently), then straitens to him his means of subsistence, he says: My Lord has disgraced me.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): However, when his Lord tests him by a measured amount of sustenance , he says, "God has disgraced me".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): But when He tries him, by straitening his means of life, he says: "My Lord has humiliated me!"
Arberry: But when he tries him and stints for him his provision, then he says, 'My Lord has despised me.'
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: ثُمَّ يَتُوبُ ٱللَّهُ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ ذَٰلِكَ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُۗ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٞ رَّحِيمٞ
Verse: ثم يتوب الله من بعد ذٰلك علىٰ من يشاء والله غفور رحيم
Sahih_International: Then Allah will accept repentance after that for whom He wills; and Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.
Pickthall: Then afterward Allah will relent toward whom He will; for Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Again will Allah, after this, turn (in mercy) to whom He will: for Allah is Oft-forgiving, Most Merciful.
Shakir: Then will Allah after this turn (mercifully) to whom He pleases, and Allah is Forgiving, Merciful.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): After that occasion God forgave those whom He wanted. God is All-knowing and All-merciful.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Then after that Allah will accept the repentance of whom He will. And Allah is Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful.
Arberry: then God thereafter turns towards whom He will; God is All-forgiving, All-compassionate.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَلَا نُكَلِّفُ نَفۡسًا إِلَّا وُسۡعَهَاۚ وَلَدَيۡنَا كِتَٰبٞ يَنطِقُ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَهُمۡ لَا يُظۡلَمُونَ
Verse: ولا نكلف نفسا الا وسعها ولدينا كتٰب ينطق بالحق وهم لا يظلمون
Sahih_International: And We charge no soul except [with that within] its capacity, and with Us is a record which speaks with truth; and they will not be wronged.
Pickthall: And we task not any soul beyond its scope, and with Us is a Record which speaketh the truth, and they will not be wronged.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): On no soul do We place a burden greater than it can bear: before Us is a record which clearly shows the truth: they will never be wronged.
Shakir: And We do not lay on any soul a burden except to the extent of its ability, and with Us is a book which speaks the truth, and they shall not be dealt with unjustly.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We do not impose on any soul what is beyond its capacity. We have the Book which speaks the truth and no injustice will be done to it.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And We tax not any person except according to his capacity, and with Us is a Record which speaks the truth, and they will not be wronged.
Arberry: We charge not any soul save to its capacity, and with Us is a Book speaking truth, and they shall not be wronged.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: يَمۡحُواْ ٱللَّهُ مَا يَشَآءُ وَيُثۡبِتُۖ وَعِندَهُۥٓ أُمُّ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ
Verse: يمحوا الله ما يشاء ويثبت وعنده ام الكتٰب
Sahih_International: Allah eliminates what He wills or confirms, and with Him is the Mother of the Book.
Pickthall: Allah effaceth what He will, and establisheth (what He will), and with Him is the source of ordinance.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Allah doth blot out or confirm what He pleaseth: with Him is the Mother of the Book.
Shakir: Allah makes to pass away and establishes what He pleases, and with Him is the basis of the Book.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): For every event God has ordained His decree. God establishes or effaces whatever He wants and with Him is the original of the Book.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Allah blots out what He wills and confirms (what He wills). And with Him is the Mother of the Book (Al-Lauh Al-Mahfuz)
Arberry: God blots out, and He establishes whatsoever He will; and with Him is the Essence of the Book.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: فَـَٔامَنُواْ فَمَتَّعۡنَٰهُمۡ إِلَىٰ حِينٖ
Verse: فامنوا فمتعنٰهم الىٰ حين
Sahih_International: And they believed, so We gave them enjoyment [of life] for a time.
Pickthall: And they believed, therefor We gave them comfort for a while.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And they believed; so We permitted them to enjoy (their life) for a while.
Shakir: And they believed, so We gave them provision till a time.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): They believed in him so We granted them enjoyment for an appointed time.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And they believed; so We gave them enjoyment for a while.
Arberry: and they believed; so We gave them enjoyment for a while.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَيُذۡهِبۡ غَيۡظَ قُلُوبِهِمۡۗ وَيَتُوبُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌ حَكِيمٌ
Verse: ويذهب غيظ قلوبهم ويتوب الله علىٰ من يشاء والله عليم حكيم
Sahih_International: And remove the fury in the believers' hearts. And Allah turns in forgiveness to whom He wills; and Allah is Knowing and Wise.
Pickthall: And He will remove the anger of their hearts. Allah relenteth toward whom He will. Allah is Knower, Wise.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And still the indignation of their hearts. For Allah will turn (in mercy) to whom He will; and Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
Shakir: And remove the rage of their hearts; and Allah turns (mercifully) to whom He pleases, and Allah is Knowing, Wise.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): and appease their anger. God forgives whomever He wants and He is All-knowing and All-wise.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And remove the anger of their (believers') hearts. Allah accepts the repentance of whom He wills. Allah is All-Knowing, All-Wise.
Arberry: and He will remove the rage within their hearts; and God turns towards whomsoever He will; God is All-knowing, All-wise
Label: joy

Verse_diac: فَقَالَ لَهُمۡ رَسُولُ ٱللَّهِ نَاقَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَسُقۡيَٰهَا
Verse: فقال لهم رسول الله ناقة الله وسقيٰها
Sahih_International: And the messenger of Allah [salih] said to them, "[Do not harm] the she-camel of Allah or [prevent her from] her drink."
Pickthall: And the messenger of Allah said: It is the she-camel of Allah, so let her drink!
Yusuf_Ali (YA): But the Messenger of Allah said to them: "It is a She-camel of Allah! And (bar her not from) having her drink!"
Shakir: So Allah's messenger said to them (Leave alone) Allah's she-camel, and (give) her (to) drink.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): The Messenger of God told them, "This is a she-camel, belonging to God. Do not deprive her of her share of water".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): But the Messenger of Allah [Salih (Saleh) ] said to them: "Be cautious! Fear the evil end. That is the she-camel of Allah! (Do not harm it) and bar it not from having its drink!"
Arberry: then the Messenger of God said to them, 'The She-camel of God; let her drink!'
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: إِذٗا لَّأَذَقۡنَٰكَ ضِعۡفَ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةِ وَضِعۡفَ ٱلۡمَمَاتِ ثُمَّ لَا تَجِدُ لَكَ عَلَيۡنَا نَصِيرٗا
Verse: اذا لاذقنٰك ضعف الحيوٰة وضعف الممات ثم لا تجد لك علينا نصيرا
Sahih_International: Then [if you had], We would have made you taste double [punishment in] life and double [after] death. Then you would not find for yourself against Us a helper.
Pickthall: Then had we made thee taste a double (punishment) of living and a double (punishment) of dying, then hadst thou found no helper against Us.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): In that case We should have made thee taste an equal portion (of punishment) in this life, and an equal portion in death: and moreover thou wouldst have found none to help thee against Us!
Shakir: In that case We would certainly have made you to taste a double (punishment) in this life and a double (punishment) after death, then you would not have found any helper against Us.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Had you done so, We would certainly have made you face double punishment in this life and after your death and you would have found none to help you.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): In that case, We would have made you taste a double portion (of punishment) in this life and a double portion (of punishment) after death. And then you would have found none to help you against Us.
Arberry: then would We have let thee taste the double of life and the double of death; and then thou wouldst have found none to help thee against Us.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: قَالَ سَتَجِدُنِيٓ إِن شَآءَ ٱللَّهُ صَابِرٗا وَلَآ أَعۡصِي لَكَ أَمۡرٗا
Verse: قال ستجدني ان شاء الله صابرا ولا اعصي لك امرا
Sahih_International: [Moses] said, "You will find me, if Allah wills, patient, and I will not disobey you in [any] order."
Pickthall: He said: Allah willing, thou shalt find me patient and I shall not in aught gainsay thee.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Moses said: "Thou wilt find me, if Allah so will, (truly) patient: nor shall I disobey thee in aught."
Shakir: He said: If Allah pleases, you will find me patient and I shall not disobey you in any matter.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Moses said, "If God wishes, you will find me patient and I shall not disobey any of your orders."
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Musa (Moses) said: "If Allah will, you will find me patient, and I will not disobey you in aught."
Arberry: He said, 'Yet thou shalt find me, if God will, patient; and I shall not rebel against thee in anything.'
Label: fear

Verse_diac: فَحَشَرَ فَنَادَىٰ
Verse: فحشر فنادىٰ
Sahih_International: And he gathered [his people] and called out
Pickthall: Then gathered he and summoned
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Then he collected (his men) and made a proclamation,
Shakir: Then he gathered (men) and called out.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): and gathered his people together
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Then he gathered his people and cried aloud,
Arberry: then he mustered
Label: anger

Verse_diac: ثُمَّ إِنَّهُمۡ لَصَالُواْ ٱلۡجَحِيمِ
Verse: ثم انهم لصالوا الجحيم
Sahih_International: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire.
Pickthall: Then lo! they verily will burn in hell,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Further, they will enter the Fire of Hell.
Shakir: Then most surely they shall enter the burning fire.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): They will suffer the heat of fire
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Then, verily they will indeed enter and taste the burning flame of Hell.
Arberry: then they shall roast in Hell.
Label: anger

Verse_diac: فَإِنۡ عَصَوۡكَ فَقُلۡ إِنِّي بَرِيٓءٞ مِّمَّا تَعۡمَلُونَ
Verse: فان عصوك فقل اني بريء مما تعملون
Sahih_International: And if they disobey you, then say, "Indeed, I am disassociated from what you are doing."
Pickthall: And if they (thy kinsfolk) disobey thee, say: Lo! I am innocent of what they do.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Then if they disobey thee, say: "I am free (of responsibility) for what ye do!"
Shakir: But if they disobey you, then say: Surely I am clear of what you do.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): If they disobey you, tell them, "I condemn your disobedient deeds".
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Then if they disobey you, say: "I am innocent of what you do."
Arberry: then, if they disobey thee, say, 'I am quit of that you do.'
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: ءَأَمِنتُم مَّن فِي ٱلسَّمَآءِ أَن يَخۡسِفَ بِكُمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ فَإِذَا هِيَ تَمُورُ
Verse: ءامنتم من في السماء ان يخسف بكم الارض فاذا هي تمور
Sahih_International: Do you feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway?
Pickthall: Have ye taken security from Him Who is in the heaven that He will not cause the earth to swallow you when lo! it is convulsed?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Do ye feel secure that He Who is in heaven will not cause you to be swallowed up by the earth when it shakes (as in an earthquake)?
Shakir: Are you secure of those in the heaven that He should not make the earth to swallow you up? Then lo! it shall be in a state of commotion.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Do you feel secure that the One in the heavens will not cause you to sink into the earth when it is violently shaking?
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Do you feel secure that He, Who is over the heaven (Allah), will not cause the earth to sink with you, then behold it shakes (as in an earthquake)?
Arberry: Do you feel secure that He who is in heaven will not cause the earth to swallow you, the while it rocks?
Label: fear

Verse_diac: مَا تَذَرُ مِن شَيۡءٍ أَتَتۡ عَلَيۡهِ إِلَّا جَعَلَتۡهُ كَٱلرَّمِيمِ
Verse: ما تذر من شيء اتت عليه الا جعلته كالرميم
Sahih_International: It left nothing of what it came upon but that it made it like disintegrated ruins.
Pickthall: It spared naught that it reached, but made it (all) as dust.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): It left nothing whatever that it came up against, but reduced it to ruin and rottenness.
Shakir: It did not leave aught on which it blew, but it made it like ashes.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): which turned everything it approached into dust.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): It spared nothing that it reached, but blew it into broken spreads of rotten ruins.
Arberry: that left nothing it came upon, but made it as stuff decayed.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: لَا يَسۡبِقُونَهُۥ بِٱلۡقَوۡلِ وَهُم بِأَمۡرِهِۦ يَعۡمَلُونَ
Verse: لا يسبقونه بالقول وهم بامره يعملون
Sahih_International: They cannot precede Him in word, and they act by His command.
Pickthall: They speak not until He hath spoken, and they act by His command.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): They speak not before He speaks, and they act (in all things) by His Command.
Shakir: They do not precede Him in speech and (only) according to His commandment do they act.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): These servants do not speak before He speaks. They simply act according to His orders.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): They speak not until He has spoken, and they act on His Command.
Arberry: that outstrip Him not in speech, and perform as He commands.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: قَالَ قَدۡ أُجِيبَت دَّعۡوَتُكُمَا فَٱسۡتَقِيمَا وَلَا تَتَّبِعَآنِّ سَبِيلَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
Verse: قال قد اجيبت دعوتكما فاستقيما ولا تتبعان سبيل الذين لا يعلمون
Sahih_International: [Allah] said, "Your supplication has been answered." So remain on a right course and follow not the way of those who do not know."
Pickthall: He said: Your prayer is heard. Do ye twain keep to the straight path, and follow not the road of those who have no knowledge.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Allah said: "Accepted is your prayer (O Moses and Aaron)! So stand ye straight, and follow not the path of those who know not."
Shakir: He said: The prayer of you both has indeed been accepted, therefore continue in the right way and do not follow the path of those who do not know.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): The Lord replied, "Moses, the prayer of your brother and yourself has been heard. Both of you must be steadfast (in your faith) and must not follow the ignorant ones."
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Allah said: "Verily, the invocation of you both is accepted. So you both keep to the Straight Way (i.e. keep on doing good deeds and preaching Allah's Message with patience), and follow not the path of those who know not (the truth i.e. to believe in the Oneness of Allah, and also to believe in the Reward of Allah: Paradise, etc.)."
Arberry: He said, 'Your prayer is answered; so go you straight, and follow not the way of those that know not.'
Label: joy

Verse_diac: فَوَيۡلٞ لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ مِن يَوۡمِهِمُ ٱلَّذِي يُوعَدُونَ
Verse: فويل للذين كفروا من يومهم الذي يوعدون
Sahih_International: And woe to those who have disbelieved from their Day which they are promised.
Pickthall: And woe unto those who disbelieve, from (that) their day which they are promised.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Woe, then, to the Unbelievers, on account of that Day of theirs which they have been promised!
Shakir: Therefore woe to those who disbelieve because of their day which they are threatened with.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Woe to the disbelievers when the day with which they have been threatened comes!
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Then, woe to those who disbelieve (in Allah and His Oneness Islamic Monotheism) from (that) their Day which they have been promised (for their punishment).
Arberry: So woe to the unbelievers, for that day of theirs that they are promised.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: فَأَخۡرَجۡنَٰهُم مِّن جَنَّٰتٖ وَعُيُونٖ
Verse: فاخرجنٰهم من جنٰت وعيون
Sahih_International: So We removed them from gardens and springs
Pickthall: Thus did We take them away from gardens and watersprings,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): So We expelled them from gardens, springs,
Shakir: So We turned them out of gardens and springs,
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We are warning all of you about them."
Mohsin_Khan (MK): So, We expelled them from gardens and springs,
Arberry: So We expelled them from gardens and fountains,
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: وَإِذۡ قَالَ إِبۡرَٰهِيمُ رَبِّ ٱجۡعَلۡ هَٰذَا ٱلۡبَلَدَ ءَامِنٗا وَٱجۡنُبۡنِي وَبَنِيَّ أَن نَّعۡبُدَ ٱلۡأَصۡنَامَ
Verse: واذ قال ابرٰهيم رب اجعل هٰذا البلد ءامنا واجنبني وبني ان نعبد الاصنام
Sahih_International: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Abraham said, "My Lord, make this city [Makkah] secure and keep me and my sons away from worshipping idols.
Pickthall: And when Abraham said: My Lord! Make safe this territory, and preserve me and my sons from serving idols.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Remember Abraham said: "O my Lord! make this city one of peace and security: and preserve me and my sons from worshipping idols.
Shakir: And when Ibrahim said: My Lord! make this city secure, and save me and my sons from worshipping idols:
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): (Muhammad), consider when Abraham prayed, "Lord, make this (Mecca) a peaceful territory and save me and my offspring from worshipping idols.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And (remember) when Ibrahim (Abraham) said: "O my Lord! Make this city (Makkah) one of peace and security, and keep me and my sons away from worshipping idols.
Arberry: And when Abraham said, 'My Lord, make this land secure, and turn me and my sons away from serving idols;
Label: joy

Verse_diac: وَيَنقَلِبُ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهِۦ مَسۡرُورٗا
Verse: وينقلب الىٰ اهله مسرورا
Sahih_International: And return to his people in happiness.
Pickthall: And will return unto his folk in joy.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): And he will turn to his people, rejoicing!
Shakir: And he shall go back to his people joyful.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): and they will return to their people, delighted
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And will return to his family in joy!
Arberry: and he will return to his family joyfully.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: مِن شَرِّ ٱلۡوَسۡوَاسِ ٱلۡخَنَّاسِ
Verse: من شر الوسواس الخناس
Sahih_International: From the evil of the retreating whisperer -
Pickthall: From the evil of the sneaking whisperer,
Yusuf_Ali (YA): From the mischief of the Whisperer (of Evil), who withdraws (after his whisper),-
Shakir: From the evil of the whisperings of the slinking (Shaitan),
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): against the evil of the temptations of the satans,
Mohsin_Khan (MK): "From the evil of the whisperer (devil who whispers evil in the hearts of men) who withdraws (from his whispering in one's heart after one remembers Allah) ,
Arberry: from the evil of the slinking whisperer
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: وَهُدُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱلطَّيِّبِ مِنَ ٱلۡقَوۡلِ وَهُدُوٓاْ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطِ ٱلۡحَمِيدِ
Verse: وهدوا الى الطيب من القول وهدوا الىٰ صرٰط الحميد
Sahih_International: And they had been guided [in worldly life] to good speech, and they were guided to the path of the Praiseworthy.
Pickthall: They are guided unto gentle speech; they are guided unto the path of the Glorious One.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): For they have been guided (in this life) to the purest of speeches; they have been guided to the Path of Him Who is Worthy of (all) Praise.
Shakir: And they are guided to goodly words and they are guided into the path of the Praised One.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): for they were guided to speak the noblest words and follow the praiseworthy path.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): And they are guided (in this world) unto goodly speech (i.e. La ilaha ill-Allah, Alhamdu lillah, recitation of the Quran, etc.) and they are guided to the Path of Him (i.e. Allah's Religion of Islamic Monotheism), Who is Worthy of all praises.
Arberry: and they; shall be guided unto goodly speech, and they shall be guided unto the path of the All-laudable.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: قَالَ فَعَلۡتُهَآ إِذٗا وَأَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
Verse: قال فعلتها اذا وانا من الضالين
Sahih_International: [Moses] said, "I did it, then, while I was of those astray.
Pickthall: He said: I did it then, when I was of those who are astray.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Moses said: "I did it then, when I was in error.
Shakir: He said: I did it then while I was of those unable to see the right course;
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Moses said, "I did do it and I made a mistake.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): Musa (Moses) said: "I did it then, when I was an ignorant (as regards my Lord and His Message).
Arberry: Said he, 'Indeed I did it then, being one of those that stray;
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: رَّبُّ ٱلۡمَشۡرِقِ وَٱلۡمَغۡرِبِ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱتَّخِذۡهُ وَكِيلٗا
Verse: رب المشرق والمغرب لا الٰه الا هو فاتخذه وكيلا
Sahih_International: [He is] the Lord of the East and the West; there is no deity except Him, so take Him as Disposer of [your] affairs.
Pickthall: Lord of the East and the West; there is no Allah save Him; so choose thou Him alone for thy defender -
Yusuf_Ali (YA): (He is) Lord of the East and the West: there is no god but He: take Him therefore for (thy) Disposer of Affairs.
Shakir: The Lord of the East and the West-- there is no god but He-- therefore take Him for a protector.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): He is the only Lord, so choose Him as your guardian.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): (He Alone is) the Lord of the east and the west, La ilaha illa Huwa (none has the right to be worshipped but He). So take Him Alone as Wakil (Disposer of your affairs) .
Arberry: Lord of the East and the West; there is no god but He; so take Him for a Guardian.
Label: joy

Verse_diac: قَدۡ عَلِمۡنَا مَا تَنقُصُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ مِنۡهُمۡۖ وَعِندَنَا كِتَٰبٌ حَفِيظُۢ
Verse: قد علمنا ما تنقص الارض منهم وعندنا كتٰب حفيظ
Sahih_International: We know what the earth diminishes of them, and with Us is a retaining record.
Pickthall: We know that which the earth taketh of them, and with Us is a recording Book.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): We already know how much of them the earth takes away: With Us is a record guarding (the full account).
Shakir: We know indeed what the earth diminishes of them, and with Us is a writing that preserves.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We already know how much of them (of their bodies) the earth will consume. With Us there is a Book that contains all records.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): We know that which the earth takes of them (their dead bodies), and with Us is a Book preserved (i.e. the Book of Decrees).
Arberry: We know what the earth diminishes of them; with Us is a book recording.
Label: fear

Verse_diac: قَالَ أَبَشَّرۡتُمُونِي عَلَىٰٓ أَن مَّسَّنِيَ ٱلۡكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ
Verse: قال ابشرتموني علىٰ ان مسني الكبر فبم تبشرون
Sahih_International: He said, "Have you given me good tidings although old age has come upon me? Then of what [wonder] do you inform?"
Pickthall: He said: Bring ye me good tidings (of a son) when old age hath overtaken me? Of what then can ye bring good tidings?
Yusuf_Ali (YA): He said: "Do ye give me glad tidings that old age has seized me? Of what, then, is your good news?"
Shakir: He said: Do you give me good news (of a son) when old age has come upon me?-- Of what then do you give me good news!
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): Abraham asked, "Are you giving me the glad news of a son in my old age? What reason can you give for such glad news?"
Mohsin_Khan (MK): [Ibrahim (Abraham)] said: "Do you give me glad tidings (of a son) when old age has overtaken me? Of what then is your news?"
Arberry: He said, 'What, do you give me good tidings, though old age has smitten me? Of what do you
Label: joy

Verse_diac: يَعۡلَمُونَ مَا تَفۡعَلُونَ
Verse: يعلمون ما تفعلون
Sahih_International: They know whatever you do.
Pickthall: Who know (all) that ye do.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): They know (and understand) all that ye do.
Shakir: They know what you do.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): and these honorable scribes know whatever you do.
Mohsin_Khan (MK): They know all that you do.
Arberry: who know whatever you do.
Label: sadness

Verse_diac: وَلَقَدۡ صَبَّحَهُم بُكۡرَةً عَذَابٞ مُّسۡتَقِرّٞ
Verse: ولقد صبحهم بكرة عذاب مستقر
Sahih_International: And there came upon them by morning an abiding punishment.
Pickthall: And in truth the punishment decreed befell them early in the morning.
Yusuf_Ali (YA): Early on the morrow an abiding Punishment seized them:
Shakir: And certainly a lasting chastisement overtook them in the morning.
Muhammad_Sarwar (MS): We struck their faces, blinded them and said, "Suffer Our torment of which you were warned".
